tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 30 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/
—snye she snyetse rngi na— ༷〉rdo—tsha ka gi gi gi ba gi du gi bye / ka / ༷༵cir ci r+shapretrīrteXsto7༄glo tswa ni / de rdo rdo dod sna / rdo rkoram̐

〈mes po'i shul ba theg〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da myong yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul ba theg〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/ —1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying zung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'byug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka'o rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo digs su grags chen gyi slob grwa chen mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i spund sgrub shing rta wo po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gzhubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhus lugs sna tsho gis kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang rngabs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la sa zhes spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyen mkhyen/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal nga yand/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod —1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mthe di las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di/ 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las sa/zhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen hūṃ du 7 5 pa / sge wang gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis —1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/rtses rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung tsho kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mi tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhus drug ྅ hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs rme do sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591 )la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshe/sa gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bzhas bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta sdi rta nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang chen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bskyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du spyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/ dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635)la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 10—

ye shes bskal pa'i me 'od kyis/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor kun bsregs nas/ khams gsum dbang du sdud mdzad pa/ /dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de'i sgrub thabs bshad bya ste/ /kun gyi rtsa ba phyag gnyis pa/ /sgrub 'dod mar me mdzad dpal gyi/ /man ngag bzhin du 'dir bshad bya/ /'dir rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa bsgom nga/ra 'dod pas/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ su bhā wa lan gsum gyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar raXser po las nyi ma'i steng du hruXdamar po de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin du gyur pa ni/ sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yas seng ldeng gi dbyug tho rdo rjes mtshan pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod pa/dbu'i steng du rta mgo ljang khus rta skad 'byin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas klu pho mo mnan pa/ stag lpags dang sbrul rgyan sogs khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad rta mgrin gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaXdzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ dbang bskur rang gi spyi bor 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ gnas gsum byin rlabs man chad bor yang rung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra krodha ha ya kṛ wa hu lu hu lu spyiX phaṭa/ ces/ /ba bzla/ lhun mtshams su dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/

gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod paX las pad+ma dmar po baX gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma rā ga'i snod chen por gyur/ de'i nang gtor rdzas kyis gang ba/ nam mkhar dhīXdakar dmar mthing gsum brtsegs pa/ rang gi snying ga'i hiXlas 'od 'phros gsum la phog pas/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzags gtor snod gang / oṃ sarba ka ri zhes pa lan gsum dang / na maXsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ lkoX sam+bha ra sam+bha ra huX/ lan nyi shu rtsa stog brjod pas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho r+ṣa por gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin sbyan drangs/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsams/ slar yang hiXyig gi 'od zer gyis sems can thams cad khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin du byas pa dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma thams cad spyan drangs/ snying po'i sngags lan gsum gyis gtor ma gtso bo la phul/ tseX( āXlhaXhūX/ lan nyi shurtsa gcig gis 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma dang / lan bdun gyis 'jig rten pa rnams la phul/ma sna de spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs kyis gsol ba bto nas/ badz+ra muX ye shesagashegs su gsol/ dge ba bsngo'o/ /'di'i rig gto kyi dbang bskur ni/ maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad re kha dkar pos bris/ gru bcad bzhi phyogs mdog tu btang / de'i dbus su malji'i steng du bum pa mtshan nyid sgo dang ldan pa bshams/ mdun du mchod gtor rgya cher bshams shing / spyir dgos pa'i yo byad rol mo sna tshogs dang / sngon 'gro gtor ma/ brtsegs gtor/ glo gnyis su chang bu dang mtheb kyu re/ de la ril bu brgya brgyad sbungs pa zhig bya/ phyogs gang yang rung ba zhig tu stegs bu la gtor ma dang / seng ldeng gi 2—

dbyug tho zhig kyang bzhag sngon 'gro gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ kha 'bar ma'i sngags brgya rtsa gcig gis bsngos la/ ye dharma dang / sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhid sogasakyis chos bshad/ a pa ra s+tha na ru/ zhes pas rang gnas su song bar bsam/ bgegs dang loga'adren la bden pa bdar zhing / sngags bzlas pas bskrad/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ bdag bskyed gong bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇ+ḍal dang bum pa gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i dbus su/ra ser po las zhes pa nas/ dbu brgyan gyi bar gong bzhi/ dbang rdzas kyi gtor tshadang / phyag mtshan skad cig gis rta mgrin zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ar+ghaṃ nas shaga'i bar gyis mchod/ sdi rgyal ba ca gyi chos sku pad+ma'i gsung / /chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang hi las rngam chen sku/ /rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ dbang rdzas kyi rta mgrin gnyis po zhu ba las gtor ma dang sgo/ga par gyur/ gzungasathag bzung zhing sngags bzlas pas/ bum nang gi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po bdud rtsir spyan drangs/ bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar thim/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa gang bar gyur/ snying po brgya rtsa tsam bzla/ maṇ+ḍal gtor ma dbyug pa gsum la dmigs nas nyer gcig tsam re bzla'o/ /gong bzhin gtor ma phul/ mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ dung chos kyi chu bum par blug tshe ā spyi/bum nang gi lha ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu bar gyur/de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la shedagongs su ga sgo/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ sems can thams cad 'khore ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral 3—

nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i phyir du/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal rta mgrin yi dam du 'tshal gyi/ bdag la byin gyis brlabs pa stsa'/ du gar ye// ces lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon gyis legs so'i spro ba bskyed cig slar yang bzlas brjod la brtson par gdams/ de nas bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa dang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rgyas par 'bogs/ bsdu na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sangs rgyas chos/dang mas chog bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /zhesagos sngags kyi che ba brjod/ slob ma'i spyi bor rta mgrin dang / snying ga'i nang du khyi yig mar me 'bar ba lta bu gsal btab/ rta mgrin gyi gnas gsum nas 'od zer 'bar ba/ dpag tu med pa byung / slob ma'i lus gang / sdig sgrib cu bsregs/ bde ba skyes par mos/ sngags bzla zhing rol mo'i sgra bya/ des ye shes phebs par 'gyur/ mngon rtogs bzhin lha bskyed bstim/ sku'i gnang spyi dang 'dra bar byas nas/ dbang lha spyan drangs/ ji ltar bltams pa zhes sogs kyi dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med gan bor gyur pa'i rigasalngas dbu brgyan gyi bar spyi dang 'dra/ me tog spyi bor bzhag snying po lan bdun tsam bzlas te brtan par bsam/ bzlas lung dang / bcom ldan bdag la stsa'/ lags kyi/ /sogs byin gyis brlab pa'i lung spyi dang mthun/ 'jig rten 'di na gdug can dregs pa che/ /'og gi klu dngasteng gi tshangs pa sogs/ /'joms byed dbyug pa bzung zhing gdug pa thul/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang thob shog/ces dang / snying po lan gsum gyis stugapa gtad de/ thugs kyi byin rlabs so/ /de nas gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par bskur/ slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dang / mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog rnams spyi'i cho gas rigs 'gre'o/ khro rgyal kun gyi rigs sngags rgyal/ /gsang sngags 'chang kun dga' bskyed pa/ /rta mgrin snyid sto'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /mdo tsam yi —4—

ge'i lam du byas/ /rta mgrin jo bo lugs lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅/ /na mo gu sa nyin byed 'bum gyi 'od zer gyis/ /gnod byed 'byung po ca bsregs te/ /'gro la gsung gi snang ba 'gyed/ /gsung gi mnga' bdag khyed la 'dud/ /thugs rje chen po drag por grags pa/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs chen mo dpal ldan ā ti sha'i bzhed pa bzhin spund par bya'o/ /oṃ swa bhā wa bi shudha sarba dharmā sā bhā wa bi shudhe3haX/ rang gi snying gnaraX ser po'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las nyi ma dang de la gnas pa'i khyiXlas 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhag rba/pa lta bu 'phro tshos/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /sogs dang / 'og nasaḥng ba ltarasholo ka tshwag gis bstod cing phyag 'tshal/ snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha mo rnamasakyis mchod par gyur/ bu ni nas ni wi te'i bar gyis mchod/ gang yang bdag gis dusakun tu/ /sdig pa brgyas par gang gyur pa/ /skrag pas rmi ltar bshags bgyid cing / /deng nas brtsams te 'byung mi bgyid/ /dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /thams cad byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /de thob lam la gnas bgyid cing / /dam pa'i skyabs gsum la skyabs mchi/ /zhes rgyun bshags dang / de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/oṃ shā n+ya tā sogs lan gsum/ stong pa'i ngang las raX las nyi ma'i steng du hū ཾ ༷ las rdo rje nag po hūX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ de'i nang du nyi ma la bhuX dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tsho gi/sa las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rgyan thams cad kyis —5—

brgyan pa/ shar dngul/ lho biḍar+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa'i/yang na zlaX las thod rus 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa/ sha rus kyi rgyan gyis brgyan par bsgom/ de'i dbus su raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hiXyig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin dbu gsum phyag drug pa/ sku mdog dmar po/ dbus dmar/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon gnag pa'i zhal spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu gsum gyi steng du rta mgo ljang khu gsum yod pa/ zhal nas 'brug stong ldir ba/phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ gnyis pa na gser gyi zhags pa/gsum pa na dbyug thob snams pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na dung chen dmar gyis bkang ba bsnams pa/ gnyis pa na ral gri/ tha ma sbar ba gdangs pa'i mthe bong las bya khyung dkar po/ mdzub mo las mthing kha/ gung mo las ser po/srin lag las dmar po/ mthe'u chung las ljang khu rnams/ bye ba bye ba'i sprul pa 'gyed pa/ zhabs drug gis klu brgyad brdzis pa/ rdo rje gshog pa g.yas g.yon las bya khyung gi sprul pa 'gyed pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ glang chen gyi ko rlon/ thod rkam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi se ral kha/ sprul dkar nag gis yan lag rnams brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /lce rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ tshesarba ka ri zhes pas mtshan/ snying ga g.yon par nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje dkar go rtse lnga pa/ g.yas par zla ba la gnas pa'i rgya gram ljang khu/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar khruX snying ga'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ huX bhāX hiX.a zhes dbang —6—

bskur/ rgya gram las 'od 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ pur+sha sogar+sākyis mchod/ hū sku mdog chags med nub kha'i dmar thag 'dra/ /'bar ba'i dbu la ral pa gyen du brdzes/ /ma rig tshangs pa kha bub gnon pa'i lha/ /pad+ma rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes ha ya kṛ wa rta ma ce me/ dpal/ /zhal nas hu phaṭa 'brug stong di ri ri/ /zhal bgrad mche ba gtsigasapa'i tshems nang na/ /gdug pa 'dul ba'i me stag khrom khrom 'bar/ khro rgyal dbang gi rta skad tsher tsher 'tsher/ /rta mgrin rta skad 'tsher la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod/ dza hu ba ho zhes rang dang gnyis su med par thim o badz+rakro ta ha ya kṛ ba hu lu hu lu hu phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzla/ a bsdu ba'i tshe/ ye shesasems dpa' rang gi mdun du bzhugs pa la/ gong bzhi mchod bstod byas te/ bdagal dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar badz+ra mu gshegasasu gsol gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ rta mgrin phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang yang rta mgrin lhan skyes su grags pa phyag gnyis pa'i skabs dang 'dra bas de nyid 'don pa spo/ khyad par phyag mtshan gser mdog gi zhags pa dang ral gri/ seng ldeng dbyug pa'i tshab tu 'jog thugs kyi rjes༅nga skabs/ thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin gyi/ /zhags pa ralagri bu la sbyin/ /zhags pas chings la ral gris gtubs/ /stong nyid snying rje rtogs par shog /ces brjod/ 'di lta ltar byed na/ de'i i bu bkod/ 'khor bzhi khyi gdong mi dgos/ gzhan shwa na bzhi bskor dang 'dra'o/ /mtshan yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs su spo'o/ mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /dī pa ka ras yol ston la/ /gnang bas dga' skyes dngos grub thob/ /de gsung snying po tsam du bsdus/ /rta mgrin jo lugs chen mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //—7—

༄༅/ /na mo kro dha rā dzā ya/ si zab mchog tu a byung ba/ /rta mchog dpal gyi sathabs 'di/ /mdo tsam bdag gis bshad bya yi/ /yid la dga' ba bskyed de nyon/ /maṇ+ḍal dmar polegs par brgyan la/ tshom bu lnga bkram la/ mchod pa dang/ gtor ma gsum bshams/ skyabs semasasngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying gar paX las pad+ma/ raX las nyi ma/ de las gnas pa'i huX las 'od 'phros/ bla ma dang rta mgrin sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tsho gis dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ bzang spyod nasa'abyung pa ltar yan lag bdun pa bya/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni/ /bdagagi lus kun rtag tu dbul bar bgyi/ /zhes brjod/ yang na skyabs sems gong du ma byasapar/ skabs 'dir byas kyang rung / de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/shā n+ya tu'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ maX las nyi ma brtsegs pa'i steng du/ hūX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa'i bsrung 'khor dang / rdo rje huX dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i dbus su rang sems rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa las rang nyid khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing / dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum dbus ma'i steng du/ rta mgo ljang zhur gyen du bltas te rta skad 'byin pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis rdo rje dang pad+ma/ tha ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ zhabs bzhi'i g.yon brkyang pa'i brkyang bskum dang gar stabs kyis tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang po mahā de ba rnams mnan pa/ rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa/—8—

stag lpags sbrul rgyan mi mgo'i do shal can/ khro bo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du rdo rje las byed ma mthing skya/ ltor gshin rje las byed ma mthing na gnub tu klu mo las byed ma dkar mo/ byang du gnod spyin las byed ma ljang khu thams cad kyang khyi gdong zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' lha lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXskyoX baX hoX rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa spyi dang mthun par bsgoms la/ oṃ ha ha hi hi hri hri hri hri huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ ces rtsa ba'i sngags ci 'grub bzla zhing / badz+ra shwa na sa ma ya/ ya ma shwa na sa ma ya/ nā ga shwa na samaya/ kha ra ka shwa na sa ma ya/ zhes btanas pa bzla zhing /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya kṛ ba hu lu hu lu huX phaṭa/ ces pa dang / oṃ ta kri ta tsa ti bi tsa ti hu ya hu ya/ hu lu hu lu/ pu ru te pu ru te swāhā/ zhe༅pa sku dang gsung dbaltokyi sngags sam/ rtsa sngags dang nye ba'i snying po ste/ de dag kyang ci 'grub bzla'o/ /las sngags ni sgrub thabs rnams su shes par bya'o/ thun bsdu bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i hūX dmar po las gtso 'khor lnga spros mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūX las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' lha lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaX la gos pas mchod/ hūX chags med sogs kyis bstod/ dzaXhuX baX hoX zhes gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha badz+ra sa mā dzaX byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /gos kyi gsol ba bto/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltarabaltams pa tsam gyis nas/ shrī ye huX/ zhes gsung zhing / sku gang / dri ma dag chu —9—

lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga dang / 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan/ de nas mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya ba'am gang 'grub bya'o/ /bar 'dir sku gsung thugs kyi bzlas pa ci 'grub bya zhing / gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ gtso bo'i gtor snod bhuX las rin po che'i pad gzhong yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ de'i nang du bcud yi ge 'bru gsum las byung ba'i lha'i bdud rtsi dkar dmar du gyur/ las byed ma bzhi'i gtor ma/ a las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod kyi nang du 'bru gsum las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsibakug gtor ma'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhūX/ lan bdun gyis byin gyisabarlabs/ so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ i daX bā ling ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ btanas pas phul/slar yang mchod bstod/ mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs kyis 'dod don gsowab btab/ yi ge brgya pa/ ma 'byo ra pa dang sogs dang / khyed kyi sems can sogs/ badz+ra muXzhes ye shes pa gshe/gas/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byangachub tu bsngo ba dang bkra shis sogs bya'o/ /rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis dge ba bsngos nas lhun mtshams la 'jug mchod bstod lhag ma rnams gtsang sar dor ro/ /'di'i rjes gnang yang rta mgrin lhan skyes kyi de nyid 'don pa spos pas rung ba las tshom bu lnga 'god/ phyag mtshan rdo rje dang pad+ma nyid 'god/ thugs kyi rjes gnang skabs/ shes rab stong nyid rdorje dang / /snying rje ma chags pad+ma dmar/ /thabs dang thabs byung zung du 'jug/—10—

ye shes thugs kyi dbang thob shog/ces brjod pa nyid khyad par ro/ /sgrub thabs ku las ba po zhes/ /grags pa'i dga' bas yongs khyab pa/ /shwa na bzhi bskor sgom pa'i thabs/ snying po tsam zhig bkod 'di mtshar/ /zhes pa 'di dpal rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor du grags pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅/ /oX spru sti/ rigs sngags rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /'jig rten 'jigs byed phyag btsal nas/ /rta mgrin dpal gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ /mdor bsdus sgrub po'i don du bri/ khwa n+ya ta'i sngags don bsnyo/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs sho lo ka stog bya/ spyi bor zla ba la oṃ/ snying gar nyi mal āX lte bar pad+ma la huX/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis bdag dang khams gsum gyi lus ngag yid gsum dag par byas/ stong pa'i ngang las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi nyes brtsegs bsnol ma'i steng du ri rab de'i rtse mor nyi ma la skyoX/ na maXs man+ta kā ya lha ka tsit+ta badzā ṇaX/ oX āXhuX de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thamasacad spyan drangs te huX la thim/ yang hūX zhes brjod pas/ 'og min nas rta mgrin spyan drangs te thim pa las/ rang nyid rta mgrin dmar po ches khros shing 'jigs pa'i sku can/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pas rdorjes mtshan pas dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yasabaskum g.yon brkyang bas srid rtse man gyi bgegs thams cad gnon pa/ dbu'i steng du rta mgo nag po can/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang / sbrul dang / rus pa dang zin po tshes brgyan pa/ ya sos ma mchu —11—

mnan zhing / hi hi'i sgra sgrog pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs shing /nor rgyas la sogs klu rnams bka' nod pa/ 'od zer sna lnga dang / tshe dpung 'phro ba'i sku khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /snying gar sngags 'khor ga4 bokhal/ tsho rna āXskyoX ha ya kṛ wa badz+ra kro dha huX hu lu hu lu hūX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/'jug tu dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma spyi dang mas par byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying po'i mthar/ ā ka ro btags la 'bul/'di'i rjes gnang ni/ paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa gzhan rnams dang 'dra zhing / gtor dbang re mdzad pa'i phyag len gda'o/ /rta rtog pa bdun brgya ba zhes pa'i/ /rgyud las btus pa'i sgrub thabasa'adi/ /ku1tu dga' ba bskyed pa dang / /snying po'i don rtogs phan yon che/ /paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅shā/ /o swā sti/ spyan ras gzigs dbang khros pa'i sku/ /ye shes ha ya kṛ wa la/ /gus pa'i yid kyis bshud byas nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du bto nas/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngangalas pad+ma nga nyi 'i — nga la rang sems lngaX mar po las/ rang nyad khro bo'i sgron dzu5 srid na rig 'o ‘ na pha)rgyal po rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gsum phyag drug/rtsa ba'i zhal dmar po/ g.yas ljang ba/ g.yon dkar ba/ dbu gsum gyi steng na rta mgo ljang nag gsum mngon par 'phags te skad 'tsher ba/ rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag ri pas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas dmyal ba yan chad me'i dra gur gyisakhebs par mdzad pa/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal gdangs mche ba gcigs pa/ phyag —12—

g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ tha ma na ral gri/g.yon gyi dang po sdigs mdzub/ bar ba na mdung thung / tha ma na rgyu ma'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhabs bgyod kyis pad nyi'i steng du sprul brgyad mnan pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ mi pags kyi g.yang gzhi/ glang chen gyi ko rlon/rus pa'i rgyan drug khrag go thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu/sprul nag gi chun po rnams kyis brgyan pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i me dpung tsha ba rtsub pa'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ mgrin pa man chad nas byin pa yan chad du rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa'i khro bo gdug pa can ma rung pa tshar gcod pa'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa/ khrab kyi byang bu ltar gtams pa/ dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ hūX gi stod du nyi ma la hiḥphyi nang thams cad du ye shes kyi me sprul pa'i pho nya dang bcas pas khyab par bsams la/ oṃ lhasaXpad+ma ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya lhab hu lu hu lu hūX phaṭa/ ces ci mang bzla/ 'jug tu snying yi mthar/ khaX rak+ṣa sa mā ya dzaX khaX rak+ṣa sa mā ya lcoX khaX rak+ṣa sa mā ya bzlog khaX rak+ṣa sa mā ya gtub/sa/ khaX rak+ṣa sa mā ya byer/ khaX rak+ṣa sa mā ya rbad/ khaX rak+ṣa sa mā ya rbud/ khaX rak+ṣa sa mā ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya 'byung po mā ra ya dza dzaX zhes pa btanas pa dang / oṃ badz+ra dun rtsoXtig nan dzaXdzaX sa mā ya stuX/ zhes pa'ang btagasalalan lnga tsam bsla'o/ tas ga tu dge ba'i rtsa ba'i byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /gtor ma bsngo bar 'dod na/ a mṛ tas ba4sa/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho wo por gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer —13—

gyis dgra bgegs thams cad bkug rdo rje khro bo rnams kyis tshar bcad pa'i sha khrag gi phung po gtor ma dang gcig tu 'dres/ oṃ āXhūX ha ho hiX dha po'i mthar/i daX ba ling kha kha ji hi ji hi/ bhañdza ho/ rak+ṣa pi wa to sa ma ya swāhā/ zhes gsum mam bdun la sogs pas phul/ tso rna ha ya gro wa sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku pad+ma'i gsungs/ /chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang hiXlas dbang chen sku/ /rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag sogs phrin las bcol/ rjes kyi cho ga gzhan spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed tshul ni/ stegs bu'i steng du/ chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum/ mtha' zlum bskor/ gru bcad ljang khu/ dbus su nyi gdan la tshom bu dmar po/ de'i steng du mañdzi la/ gtor ma dmar po nor gzugs rtse mor rta mgos mtshan pa zhig bkod/ mdun du mchod gtor sman dang rak+ta sogasabashams/ bgegs gtor btang / mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang ma lhun/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa song nas/ skye( sarba pañtsa a rdzita hūX khyoXṭha/ zhes sman mchod byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ mahā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal la huX hruXṭha/ zhes rak+ta byin gyis brlabs/ stong par sbyangs༅sa nyi ma la sdiX zhes pa yan chad gong bzhi mdun du bskyed/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ gtor ma gong ltar byin gyis brlabs/ ha ho khyoX gos tu/oṃ mahā ba ling ta/ te dzo ba ling te/ ba la ba te/ gu phya sirnyi sa ma ya huX hiXṭha/zhes byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma byin rlabs 'di gong sman rag gi sngon du byas kyang rung / gong bzhin gtor ma dang phyi mchod phul/ nang mchod sman gtor ma la bran/ ban+ta snod bzang yangs pa —14—

sa /rang byung gdod nas rnam dag pa/ /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /a la la te bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āXkhruX zhes brjod/ rak+ta nas bran la/ dur khrod chen ngo'i ri gnas brgyad dang / /he ru ka'i gnas bcu nas/ /dpal chen 'khore bcas spyan 'dren gyis/ khrin khrag dmar gyi rgya mtsho bzhes/ /tseX( āXhūX/ zhes brjod/ de nasabastod pa dang 'dod don gsol btab byas la/ bzlas pa'ang ci 'grub dang / slob ma'i bya ba rnams bdag 'jug gi tshul gyis blang ngo / /de nas slob ma'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul/rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyis gsol ba bto/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ sogs brjod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/spro na thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro dang / gsol gdab kyang byed/ bsdu na ma byas kyang rung / de ltar sngon 'gro lnga'am gsum 'dam kha yin/ dngos gzhi ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis/slob ma'i sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad thams cad bsregs/ stong nyid du sbyangs/thugs kar huX gi bar mngon rtogs bzhi phog/slob ma'i gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru/ gsum gsal btab/ ye shes pa bstims la rol mo'i sgra bya/ slob dpon gyi dpral ba'i oṃ las rta mgrin dkar po spros te/ slob ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ la bstim/rol mo'i sgra bya/ bum dbang / de bawo du/ mgrin pa nas/ dmar po bstim ste/ gsang dkragasnying ga nas mthing ga bstim ste/ sher dbang lte ba nas/ kha dog sna sna khri/sa pa bstim/ dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de nas bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin te/ sngags skyu byin gyis brlabasapa'o/ /denas gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par byas la/ mthar khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin 'od du zhu nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs te thim pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum/ rta mgrin gyi sku gsung thugs su zhu lugs su blug par gyur pa'i —15—

mos pa mdzod/ ces pa ni sku dngos kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /rjes gtso bos ji ltar sogasadam tshig gzung bar khas blangs/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas sogs kyis yon 'bul/ dge ba bsngo/tshogs la longs spyod/ mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis brlabs/ mchod bstod dang /gsol btab bya/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam/ bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /rab mchog mkhan po rje btsun gyis/ /sgrub thabs kyis zhes bka' stsal nas/ /pad+ma dbang gi sgrub thabasa'adi/ /tā ra nā thas byas pa yin/ /zhes pa'ang dpal stag lung thang dang nye ba'i rnam rgyal rab brtan du'o/ /sgrub thabs kun nas dga' ba'i phul/ /rta mchog rol ba'i snying sto'i don/ /shin tu zab pa pad+ma yis/ /skyer sgang pa la dngos su gnang / /rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas/'phel/ /༄༅rdo/ /na mo gu sa ni kyig pa'i klu sogs tshar gcod dang / /gang las dngos grub rab mchog kun/ /thob 'gyur rta mchog dpal gyi ni/ /sgrub thabs man ngag mdo tsam bshad/ /'dir rta mgrin lcags ral can du grags pa sgom par 'dod pas skyabs sems sngon du song bas/ rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad du mdun du spyan drangs bar gyur/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs rgyun pon gas dang / tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangaskastong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dang / raX las nyi ma'i steng du/ khyiXyig dmar nag gi 'od zer 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin sku mdog mig sman ltar gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum pa/ spyi bo nas rta mgo ljang khu rta skad 'don pas khams gsum dbang du bsdud pa/ phyag g.yas —16—

pas ral gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon sdigs mdzub kyi rtse la me dpung 'bar ba klu rgyal rigs dkar pos dbu brgyan/ bram ze dmar pos mgul brgyan/ rje rigs ser pos phyag gdub/ gdol ba nag pos ga sha /dmangs rigs ser khras zhabs gdub byas pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ dpal gyi chas brgyad yongs su rdzogs pa/ ru tra pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs 0pa'o/ /rang gi snying gar lhaXde las 'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha thams cad spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ski ñtsa tu maX/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzi bha wa a hi ྅ nyu huX zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan/ spyi bor oṃ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ huX gi stod du khyoX'i mthar sngags kyis 'phreng bas bskor/sdiXpad+ma ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya kṛ ba hu lu hu lu huX phaṭa/ ces steng po dang / hiXbadz+rakro dha ha ya gro wa sarba shi ta ka la me dpung gtubs/ ha ha nan/ rbad rbad gtubs/ shag ha ha nan/ rbad rbad gtubs/ kṛ ṇa rā dza ya rbad/ mā ra ya rbad/ces drag sngags dang sbyar ba gang 'grub bzlas/ lhun 'jog khar dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ 'bru/ gsum las dam rdzasabadud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ rta mgrin 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ hūX gnyis med rang byung dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /brjod med chos dbyings —17—

don gsal ma g.yos kyang / /dgra bags gdug pa 'dul ba'i don slad du/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /badz+ra sa mā dzaXdzaXhuX baX hoX 'jig rten rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i khri yi steng / /ru tra zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /rngam brjid ngar dang bcas nas bzhugs su gsol/ /sa ma ya stuX/ a ti pu ho/ zhesabazhugs su gsol zhing phyag 'tshal/ smoXpad+ma ta kṛ ta badz+ra kre/ dha ha ya gro ba i daX ba lingata/ kha kha/ ji hi 'a hi/ mahā rak+ta sku hi/ mahā maX sa ji hi/ mahā tsit+ta ji hi/ mahā ba su ta ji hi/ mahā go ro tsa na ji hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ huX gdug pa 'dul mdzad ye shes lha'i sku/ sku mdog mthing nag dbyar gyi char sprin 'dra/ khams gsum dbang du bsdud pa'i rta skad 'tsher/ /ye shes rol pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod do/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes sogs 'dod don gsol ba bto/ yig brgya brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang sogaga.oX khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra muX zhes skad gsasu gsol/ smon lam btab cing bkra shis bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ maṇ+ḍal nag po gru gsum tshom bu dang bcas pa'i steng du/ mañdzi la gtor ma dmar nag nor gzugs ma zhig 'god/ mthar mchod gtor gyis bskor/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar du song nas/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhesapa nas/ thugs kar huX gi bar bdag bskyed bzhin la 'don pa spo/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyisamachod/ hūX gdug pa 'dul mdzad sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa gang 'grub bya/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs nas/ 'dod 'don gsol bto kyi bar gtor chog gong bzhin gyis phul/ slob ma'i —18—

maṇ+ḍal phul zhing / gur nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin yi dam du 'tshal gyis/ slob dpon gyis bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slob ma'i spyi bor me tog bzhag ste swa bhā was stong par sbyangs ba nas/thugs kar hū gis bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ slob ma'i spyi bor me tog gtor la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /rta mgrin 'di la dbang bskur cig /dus 'di nas ni bzung gnas su/ /rta mchoge go 'phang ma thob bar/ /rtag tu yi dam lha yin gyi/ /yi dam lha ru mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brdzod pas/ rta mgrin 'od du zhu/ sleb ma la thim pas/ skad cig gis rta mgrin du gyur pa ni/ sku mdog nas/bzhugs pa'o'i bar brjod/ ye shes pa bstim lugs spyi dang 'dra/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te tsa ka li spyi bor bzhag sku'i rjes gnang ngo / /sngags byang lag tu gtad de bzlas lung spyi dang ma lhun par sbyin pa ni/gsung gi rjes gnang ngo / /phyag mtshan bstim pa ni/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo / /snying po lan gsum bzlasapa'i phur pa lag tu gtad de/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin gyi sku gsung thugs gsum dang / slob ma 'di'i lusang ga yid gsum nus pa mnyam par gyur cig/ces brjod/ 'phrin las kyis rjes gnang ngo / /gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par bya ste/ yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo / /rjes kyi bya ba sogs lhag ma spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bgegs kun 'joms shing sgrub po la/ /dga' bde'i dngos grub ster ba'i phul/ /rta mgrin nag po sgrub pa'i thabs/ /zla rgyal dgongs don snyed stor dril/ /zhes pa'ang dpal rta mgrin lcags ral can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs bshad pa'i — 19—

skabs te dgu pa'o/ /gcig zhus/ /༄༅/ /o swā sti/ na mo badz+ra bhā rā ya/ da ni khro bo'i rgyal po 'phags pa mi stoshā sgrubs thabs nyams su len bar 'dod pas/ 'dir 'chad par 'dod pa'i sgrub thabs rnams la nan tan tu sgrub par bya ste/ gang la gang mos pa de dang de yis bya'o/ /dpal ldan 'gro kun sgrol ba'i mgon/ /bla ma mchog dang mi g.yo ba/ /dbyer med de la gus btud nas/ /sgrub thabs rim pa rnams bshad bya/ /dang por mi g.yo sngon po pus btsugs bsgom par 'dod pa la de'i sgrub thabs pond par bya'o/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du bto / chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgoms la/ oṃ swa bhā wa 〈khri sde sarba dharma swa bhā wa shu rdzo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las lus 'od kyi phung po rang gi snying ga'i nang du paX las pad+ma/ raX las nyi ma'i steng du huX sngon po 'od 'bar ba/ de lasa'od zer 'phros/ lus gang zhing sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ phyir 'phros/sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa las rang nyid gtum po chen po'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog zar ma'i me tog ltar sngo ba'am/ dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ye shes/kyi ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon rdo rje zhags pa sdigs mdzub la lan gnyis su dkris shing thugs kar gtod pa zhabs g.yon gyi pus mo dang / g.yas kyi mthil sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhengs stabs kyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gyi g.yas pa steng du gzigs pa/ lha'i bu'i bdud tshang gcod cing / g.yon pa 'og tu gzigs pas lha min dang klu'i gdon 'dul ba dang /dbus thad kar gzigs pas sa steng gi bgegs thams cad 'joms pa cher —20—

'khrugs shing khros pas khro gnyer bsdus shing / ya sos ma mchu mnan pas mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po thor tshugs su bcings shing zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas mi bskyod pas dbu la brgyan pa dar sna tshogs pa'i sham thabs dang / rin po che'i rgyan dang / sprul dkar po se ral khar byas pa/shin tu 'jigs pa'i sku can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /'dil dbu sgra nag po byas kyang rung zhing / bye brag tu klu'i gdon 'dul bar 'dod na/ pus mo g.yas btsugs stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang /klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa byed ces gsung / de nas rang gi thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūX nas 'bru tsam/ spro na gnas gsum byin rlabasadang / ye shes sems dpa' spyan 'dren pa dang / dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams kyang bya la/ bsdu na lha'i rnal 'phro gyi bya ba ni/ de nyid kyis 'grub pa yin no/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar sngags kyis bskor ba/ de'i 'od kyis bdag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gdon bgegs thams cad myong bcad/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam pas bdag la thim/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūX phaṭa/ ces ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzla'o/ /'bum phrag brgyad cu bzlas pas las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur zhing / byang chub sgrub pa la ni tshad med do/ /rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /gtor ma dkar gtor legs par bshams la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod/ de'i nang du a las lha'i bdud rtsis gang ba/de'i dbus su huX ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āXhuX zhes brjod —21— —

pas byin gyis brlabs/ snying ga'i hū gi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogasathams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dza zhes spyan drangs/ snying po'i mthar/ urla lotsal ba / pa ri wā ra i da bā ling ta kha kha ji hi sku hi/ zhes btags pa lan bdun gyis pha lu/badz+ra puspye nas ni wi te'i bar gyis mchod/ kye kye mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos kyang / /sprul pa'i gzugs kyi 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ /'jigs byed chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing / /srid pa gsum na dgyes pa'i gar mdzad pa/ khred pa'i chu bo skems shing bdud rnams 'joms/ /srid pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo thugs rje'i mgon/ /rab brjid migayo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba lubo ra dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ yi go brgya bsalhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byore ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs kyis mthar/ badz+ra mu tshig gas su gsol/ 'di'i rjes gnangani/ maṇ+ḍal sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma la tshom bu sngon po zhig bkod/ ma 'grub na maṇ+ḍal la 'bru'i tshom bu bkod kyang rung / dkar gtor cha gnyis dang / mchod pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed kyang stong par sbyangs ba nasabartsams te/ bzlas pa'i bar du byas nas/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba nas/ 'dod don gsol btab kyi bar du byas/ dkar gtor gnyis phyogs skyong dang gzhi bdag la bsngo/ rjes gnang dngosani/ khrus bya chos bshad maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ /dus gsum zhes sogs gsol ba btab/ /gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ /dngos gzhi rjes gnang gzhi 'god dang / /lung gsum sbyin pa de rjes su/ /phyag mtshan —22—

bstim par mdzad pa yin/ /dam tshig khas blangs maṇ+ḍal dang / /deng nas zhes sogs yon 'bul lo/ /rjes chog mchod pa kha gsos nas/ /mchod bstod dngos grub blang ba dang / /yig brgya bzod gsol gshegs gsol dang / /smon lam gdab cing bkra shis bya/ /zhes pa'i sdom tshig blo la nges par bya ste/phyag mtshan bstim pa tsam ma gtogs lag len sgrub thabs brgya rtsa bzhin yin no/ /'di'i khyad par gyi byin rlabs chu srung byed thabs ni/ tho rangs skar khongs gnyis gsum tsam la bum pa gtsang mar chu'i gting nas chu blangs te nam mkha' ma mthong bar bya/ sngar gyi rjes gnang dang 'brel bar byed na/ shin tu legs/ thog mtha' gang du byas kyang chog logs su byed na maṇ+ḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogasakyis gsol ba btab/ bla ma'i lag pa g.yas kyis bum pa'i kha bcad/ na ma tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ya/oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa/ k+ṣa tra/ t+yā sa ya/ tā sa ya/ sa t+yā ya sa t+yā ya/ hu hū hū / phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa bzla'o/ /bla ma mi g.yo bar sgom du gzhug slob mas me tog bzung la/thal mo sbyar/ sngags de'i rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ bla mas lan bdun bzlas la/ slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par blug la 'thung du gzhug rjes zlos dang 'thung thengs lan gsum byas la/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi nas/ 'jug par gyur cig gi bar byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung spyi dang mthun par byas nas gtang rag gi yon 'bul ba sogs bya'o/ /de thob nas rang gis chu srung nyams su len na/ chu la sngags brgya rtsa bzlas/ de khrus bya/ lag pa g.yas par chu blug la g.yon pasade'i rgyab nas mnye/ sngags lan gsum bzlas nas 'thung / de 'dra lan gsum bya'o/ /kun nas zab cing rnyed dka' ba/ /rab dga' khro bo gtum po yi/ /sgrub thabs snyid sto bsdus pa 'di/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal phyir yin/ /ces pa ni rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug las nang gi bar chad sel ba mi g.yo ba sngon po phyag gnyis pa pus btsugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyal 'phel/ /

༄༅/ /a ti'i lugs kyi gtum po'i sgrub thabs so/ /na mo gu sa mtha' dag 'gro ba sgrol ba'i slad/ /mi g.yo mgon la rab btud nas/ /gtso/po'i sgrub thabs bla med pa/ /mdo tsam bdag gis bri bar bya/ /mi g.yo sngon po bka' gdams lugasabasgom par 'dod pas/ rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od 'phros/ lus thams cad gsal zhing dag par byas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ 'od zer des sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ pur+sha sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ sarba bi shwa hūṃ dzame gha sa mu dra āXhuX swāhā/ rdo rje gur ram bzang spyod nas 'byung ba ltar yan lag bdun pa dang /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams bsgom/ su bhā wa dang /shā n+ya tas stong bar sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las paX raX las pad nyi'i gdan la rang sems huX las rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na kā ya badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ de las rang nyid khro bo rgyal po mi g.yo ba sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gnyis steng 'og tu yon por gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas ye shes kyi ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkhar 'phyar ba/g.yon rdo rje zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod pa/zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas tsho gos bdag glang sna dang dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad brdzes pa/ sma ra dang smin ma —24—

dang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan zhing / mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang rin po che dang sprul gyis brgyan pa/ sprul pa'i khro bo nam mkha' gang ba 'phro ba/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /thugs kar raX las nyi ma la hūX 'od 'bar ba/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ spro na gong ltar mchod/ dzaXhuX baX hoX yang 'od kyisadabang lha spyan drangs/ oṃ a(bhi khri thu dz+wa/ maX sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi mthar yi ge bcu pas bskor bar bsgoms la/ pho nya spro ba dang me sbar ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa huX phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzla'o/ /'jug tu mi dmigs rda/sal/ yig brgya bzla/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub du bsngo/ skye( āXspruX the/༷༷ zhes ye shes pa gshegs/gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ dkar gtor snod chu gtsang gis bkang ba bshams la/ skye( āXdzo ta kṛ ta huX gis ba4sa/ oṃ gyi sgra dang 'od kyis gtor ma snod dang bcas pa stong bar sbyangs/ āXrin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba bdud rtsi dkar pos gang ba/huX sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bkug ste thim pas/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma chos skyong sems can thams cad khro bo mi g.yo ba'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaX lkog spyan drangs/ snying por mthar bā ling ta kha kha ji hi ji hi swāhā/ zhes pa lan bdun gyis yi dam dang / a kā ro lan bco gyisags rnams la phul/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ chos dbyings rang bzhin in+d+ra ni —25—

la'i mdog/zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs zung brjed pa'i sku/ /ye shes ral gri rdo rje zhags pa bsnams/ khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /cesabarjod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ oṃ mu zhes pas gi shogs su gsol/ lhun mtshams su yang lha'i snang ba dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ lhun mong ba bka' gdams lha bzhi g.yin rnams kyi bzlas lung 'bogasatshul de nyid 'dod pa spos pas chog pa yin zhing / khyad par can ni/ maṇ+ḍal grub bzhi/ grubacad sngon po la dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dang bcas pa/ lte ba nyi gdan la tshom bu sngon po/ me tog sngon po sil mar dgram/ mchod gtor rgya cher mug mas/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa spyi dang ma lhun par byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed kyi 'dod pa spos la mdun bskyed bsgom/ mchod pa ci nusabya/ gzhi bdag gtor ma dang bgegs gtor btang / slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ bzang spyod kyi yan lagabadun pa tshar gsum bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas pa 'bogs pa'am/ bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos dang ma bya/ bdag bskyed ltar mngon rtogs phog lha sku snang stong la mnyam par 'jog tu 'jug sngags kyi bzlasalung phog slob dpon gyi bgrang 'phreng mgo thog tu bzhag la/ snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ man ngag ltar mi dmigs kyi spro bsdu'i dmigs pa phog chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar sgom du bcug slo tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hu zhes brjod/ mi dmigs par bzhag la phaṭa ces brjod du bcu ga'adir rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra ba las/ mchod pa gsang pa rgya cher bshams nas byin gyis brlabs/ dpon slob lhan cig tu 'bul/ yan lag bdun pa lan gsum yang bya/ dkar gsum gyi tsa ru'i ston mo bya'o/ khro rgyal kun 'dus rab dga'i tog/bdud sde'i snyed la 'jigs skyed pa/ /zab mo'i sgrub thabs gsong swor smras/ /dge des gtum po'i gnas thob shog/a ti sha'i zhal gyi gdams pa khro bo gtum po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //zhus dang /dar rgyas 'phel/ /—26—

༄༅/ /o swā sti/ dpal ldan rdorje twam po ni/ /blo 'phel dkar po'i tshul 'dzin pa/de la bsnyad nas de sgrub thabs/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig bri bar bya/ /bcom ldan 'das gtum po dkar pos sgrub pa la/ 'jug pa dang sbyor ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sgrub pa pos tshad med bzhi spyi dang ma lhun par bsgom/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod sogs skyabs sems lan gsum/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dkar po/ a las zla ba raX las nyi ma rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du/ rang gi rnam shes huX dkar po las 'od 'phros/ mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs bsdus/ slar 'dus pa las rang nyid gtum po dkar po sku mdog gangs la nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yon pa'i pus mo'i lha nga dang / g.yas pa'i mthil nyi ma'i gdan la brten pa/ phyag g.yas ye shes kyi tsher ba tu 'bar ba'i ral gri 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad de/ rdo rje zhags pa lan gnyis su dkris pa'i sne gnyis phrag gong du lding ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum steng 'og bar du gzigs shing bgrad pa/ mtsheb ma mchu'i steng du gtsigs pa/ dbu skra sma ra smin ma dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa/ sbrul gyi ske rags bcings pa/ dar gyi sham thabs kyis sku smad mjes par byas shing / spyi bor mi bskyod pa dkar po bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ mdun du gru gang tsam la pad nyi'i steng du rang 'dra ba'i bcom ldan 'das bskyed/ spro na gnyis ka la ye shes dgug gzhug dbang bskur rgyas btab kyang bya'o/ /—27—

gnyis pa ni/ snying gar nyi dkyil steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu pa/lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa g.yas bskor du 'khor ba/ de'i nye bar hūX/ rtsibs bcu la/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa huX phaṭa bsams te/ srog rtsol nas grangs bsnyen pa ci rigasabya'o/ /phyi bzlas so/ /nang bzlas ni/ bdag gi snying gar hūX yi ge bcu po zhal nas thon mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'khor lo bzhin du bsam/ slar mdun gyi lha'i lte ba nas thon/ bdag gi lte bar zhugs/ snying ga'i 'khor lo la thim par bsams/ srog rtsol bsdams la bzla'o/ /oṃ urla a tsa la ar+ghaX sogs kyisamachod/ bstod pa ni/ rab mdzes gangs kyi bu mo nyi gzhon gyis/ /'phyud pa'i sku brnyan la94 khro brjid pa'i gar/ /pad+ma gzhon nu nyin byed lta bu'i steng / khyod zhabs pus btsugs lcid kyis 'gying zhing brdzis/ /rab zlum spyan gsum steng 'og bar g.yo zhing / /mche gtsigs ma mchu'i steng na rjes rtsen pa/ /ral grisa'adebs shing zhags pas 'ching ba'i tshul/ /bdud bzhi'i dgra dpung ma lus 'joms par mdzad/ /rab bkra'i stag lpags dar gyis dkris pa'i gos/ /smad g.yogs sbrul ljang sked chings brten pa'i tshul/ /rang 'od las byung me 'od 'khyil ba'i klong / /g.yas bskum zhabs mthil 'khor los mnan pa'i stabs/ /rab gus lus kyi ba sbu'i bla gos g.yo/ /ngag tshig smra ba'i snyan ngag dbyangs su 'tsher/ /yid gnyis ma mchis snying nas skyabs mchis pas/ /deng nas byang chub bar du brtsebs skyongs / /rab brjid yid 'phrog lha khyod bdag bsgrub na/ ltong nyid blo dang rjes 'brel snying rje dang / /'go da rtsom pa'i spobs pa dge ba can/ khyed kyis mthu las gegs med mngon gyur shog/mdun gyi —28—

lha rten nam rang gi snying gar thim/ dge ba bsngo/ gtor chog ni mi g.yo ba sngon po pus btsugs kyi skabasadang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ sa mong ba ni rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra ba las/ gsung la sngags 'khor bstims pa dang / thugs la phyag mtshan dkar po bstim pa nyid yin zhing / thun mong ma yin pa zab mo'i lugs ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po zhig bri/ de'i dbus su lugs sku'am/ tsa ka li bzhugs su bcu gag yas su me tog dkar po/ g.yon du dri bzang gi chu snod bzhag mtha' mchod gtor gtsang mas bskor/ mchod pa spyi dang ze par byin gyis brlabs/ tshad med bzhi nas/ snying gnathim gyi bar bdag bskyed gong bzhin/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sku gzugs/ me tog dri bzang gsum ka'i gnas su paX gsum las/ pad+ma dkar po gsum a gsum las zla ba gsum/ raX gsum las nyi ma gsum rnams so sor brtsegs pa'i steng du hūX dkar po re re/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las sku yongs su rdzogs pa gsum du gyur pa ni/ gtum po dkar po zhes pa nas/ thugs kar huX gis bar gong bzhi/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas srasadang bcas pa thams cad ye shes sems dpa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXkhruXbaX hoX dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi khiñtsa huX/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/rten gsum po la dmigs nas sngags brgya rtsa re re bzla'o/ /me tog dang dri bzang gog nasasubazhugs pa'i mi g.yo ba 'od du zhu ste/ shes rab spel ba'i rdzas khyad par can du sdo/ra/ tso( āXguX lan mang du brjod/ gsum ka la dmigs nas yi ge brgya pa tshar res brtan par bya/ bar 'dir gtor ma 'bul/ bdag bskyed ltar mchod bstod bya/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ rdo rje —29—
