'dzin pa sogs kyis gsol btab dang / rgyun bshags spyi dang mthun/ sku'i rjes gnang spyi dang mthun par grub pa'i rjes su sku gzugs spyi bor bzhag pa'i rjes su snying po brgya rtsa bzla/ mdun bskyed ye shes pa'i tshul du thim par mos/ bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par byin pa las/ slob dpon gyi 'phreng ba slob ma'i mgul dang lag tu gtod pa phyag len yin/ dam bca' ba'i lung dang byin gyisabarlabs pa'i lung mi dgos/ de nas me tog dkar po spyi bor bzhag nas snying po brgya rtsa bzla/ slob dpon gyi mtheb srin gyis dri bzang gi chu de slob ma'i spyi bo nas brtsams te lus thams cad la cung zad 'thor bzhin du snying po brgya rtsa bzlas pa'i mthar dri bzang gi chu ma lus par 'thung du gzhug bdud rtsi bde ba chen pos lus thams cad la khyab pa la shes pa gtad nas mnyam par 'joga'adi thugs kyi rjes gnang yin/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ /bdun kun 'joms pa'i lha mchog ni/ /dga' ba rgyas byed lhag pa'i lha/ khyod nyid brten pa'i mkhas mchog rnams/ /snyid sto'i don la shin tu mkhas/ /mi g.yo ba dkar po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅// /mi g.yo phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs so tsho /na mo gu rba/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal dpa' bo ni/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyi bzhad cing rol/ /srid zhi'i rlung gis ma g.yos pa/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /'dir mi g.yo ba phyag bzhi pa'i mngon rtogs bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro dang tshad med bzhi sems bskyed rnamasabasgoms la/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paX las pad+ma dang / raXlas nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje'i nye bar huX/ de las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ phyi rol ral gri'i rwa ba me dpung 'bar ba dang —30—

bcas pa'i bsrung snyen ra/ de'i nang du pad nyi dang bdud bzhi mnyam par 'byel ba'i gdan la hūX las ral gri huX gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ gdug pa can rnams btul/ slar 'dus pa las bdag nyid rje btsun ma mi g.yo ba mthing kha zhal bzhi kar nag pa/ zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum sna tsho gis pas bdud bzhi mnan pa'am/ g.yas brkyang du bya/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis kyis ral gri 'debs tshul dang / rdorje gsor ba g.yon gnyis kyis zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod pa dang / khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ mtsheb rnon po gtsigs shing / stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang / mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs can sprul dang / rin po che dang / rus pas brgyan pa/ khro bo sprul pa'i sprin spro ba/ me ri 'bar ba'i bskor ba'o/ /gnas gsum byin rlabs dang / ye shes spyan 'dren dang / dbang bskur rnams spyi dang 'dra/ dbu rgyan mi bskyod pa'o/ /bkod pa'i bzlas dmigs gsal btab la/ na maXs man+ta kā ya lha ka tsit+ta badz+ra ṇaX oṃ a tsa la ka na ka na tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa h+pho ṭa ya huX/traX maX taX bsnyen pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa ma ma sha trun a mu ka phya shi daX gī la ya huX phaṭa/ a ti mu ka stuX bhā ya hri daX gī la ya huX phaṭa/ las la sbyar ba'i sngagasaso/ /rjes lha sku stong par bsdus te/ slar yang lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma nang mchod kyis bran la/a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āXhūX zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshochen por gyur/ oX āXspyiX ha ho hiX rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ mi —31—

g.yo mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ a tsa la te dza badz+ra pukhyedhu pe/ dī paX/ ga rje/ nai we te sa pa ri wā re khyoX dzaXhūX baX hoX saX tri sta sarba sa ta nā na i maX bā ling gro hā gro hā kha kha ji hi ji hi/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa huX phaṭa/ ces lan gsumagyis 'bul/ mchod bstod sogs rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang mas/'di'i rjes gnang ni spyi dang 'dra ba las/ 'grub na maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung mthing kha dbus su ral grisamatshan pa zhig 'bri/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi skabs/ sang 'a / rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i ral gri 'di/ /bzung zhig gdug pa kun choms la/ /srid pa gsum las rgyal bar mjodi/ /ces lag tu gto/ mdun bskyed la mos gus byas pasathim par mos su 'jug pa ni khyad par ro/ /zab mo kun gyi phul du gyur/ /thos pas dga' ba rab 'phel ba/ /bsgoms na dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi/ /snying po mngon du 'gyur 'di mtshar/ /zhes pa ni mi g.yo ba phyag bzhi pa'i sprub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༈ mi g.yo ba zhabs bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs dre rna /na mo gu dra/ dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad dpa' bo che/ /'jigs byed mi g.yo la 0snyad nas/ /dud kha phyag gnyis zhabs bzhi pa'i/ /sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri bar bya/ /'di la skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dang / raX las nyi ma'i steng du hūX mthing nag las 'phags pa mi g.yo ba sku mdog dud kha nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum mche btsigs/ skra dang kha sbu ser po gyen du brdzes pa/—32—

zhabs dang pos bsgrub bya'i kha/ gnyis/ pas snying ga/gsum pas pus btsugs kyi lte ba/ bzhi pa phyir brkyang bar rkang pa mnan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang sprul gyis brgyan pa/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ rgyal pomibaskyod pas dbu la brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /snying gar nyi ma'i steng du huX mthing nag la snying pos bskor ba/ me'i rje ngar gyi phur bu sor bzhi pa rgya mdud la hūṃ bris pa lag tu thogs/ phur bu stong pa'i ngang las rang dang 'dra bar bskyed/ gnyis ka'i thugs ka'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shesasems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis ka dang gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa huX phaṭa/ zhes mdun bskyed kyi sngags las dngos grub zhu ba'i tshuwagyis gang nus bzlas/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe phur bu'i lha la gsol ba btab pas/ de'i thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng / rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim/ phur pa'i lha la gtor mal sto/te/ de'i cho ga ni gong du mi g.yo ba sngon po pus btsugs kyi sgrub thabs su spund zin pa nyid do/ /'on kyang khyad par ni/ gtor ma dmar gtor gru gsum du bya/ oṃ las byung ba'i gtor snod thod pa dkar po zhes 'don pa spo/ mthar badz+ra muX zhes ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa dzaXhuX baX hor+shaX zhes/ rang la thim/ phur pa mgul khug tu bcug go /dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chubatubasngo/ bsnyen tshad 'bum phrag bcu gnyis so/ /'di'i lung 'bogs pa ni/ rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra ba las/ sku'i rjes gnang gi mthar bris 'bur gyi sku spyi bor ga‘/sa/ gsung gi mthar phur bur mgrin par gtugs/ thugs kyi mthar ral gri snying gar gtugs/ brtan byed thod pa rgun chang gis gang ba las 'thung du gzhug de bzhi re re la sngags gsum gsum bzla'o/ /snying rjes kun tu rab 'khros pa/ /dga' ba'i thugs rjes bdud bzhi 'joms/ /snyid —33—

nas mgon sto khyod brten na/ /dngos grub bzang po ci yang thob/ /mi g.yo ba zhabs bzhi pa'i sgrub thabasakyi le tshan no/ /pad+ma badz+ra/ kha che dge slong ya ma ri zhal gzigs/ dge tshul 〈sdang mig gis mi 'chi nusapa/ 〉mi g.yo zhal gzigs/ dharma shī 〈mnga' ris pa 〉la/ nu bo dharma di bya/ dge byas gtso bo/ a skyabs/ dkar ba rnam gsum/ yar bsgom/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ yon tan khri/ seng ge rgyal/ 〈seng gobazang po/ 〉'di dpa' bo chig sgrub las byung gsung // //༄༅/ /mi g.yo spre'u brgyad mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs so/ /na mo gu ru we/ dpal ldan ye shes me lce yis/ /ma rig mun pa drungs 'byin zhing / /'dutshogs ma lus bsregs pa po/ /gtum po che la spyi bos 'dud/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs rmad byung ba/ /mtha' dag srid pa'i nad sel zhing / /ri lu la sogs grub stsol ba/ /de 'dra gang yin 'dir bshad bya/ /'dir mi g.yo spre'u brgyad mar grags pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi man ngag las 'byung ba gtum po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro byams snying rje sems bskyed dang 'brel ba sngon du 'gro bas/ shā n+ya tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las sna tshogs pad+ma shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam de'i steng du raX las nyi ma la gnas pa'i rang sems oṃ a tsa la zhes pa nas/ tshin+ta huX zhes pa'i sngags 'phreng yongs su gyur pa las/ ral gri sngags 'phreng gi mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mi g.yo ba spyan drangs te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid mi g.yo sku mdog nag /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs gnyis pa/ /g.yas dmar g.yon dkar dbus mthing zhal/ /g.yas gsum rdo rje ral gri dang / /'khor lo —34—

bsnams shing g.yon dang po/ /thugs kar khro bo'i sdigs mdzub can/ /lhag ma dgra stu zhags pa bsnams/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gom stabs kyis/ /nad brgyad rang bzhin spre'u brgyad gnon/ /stag lpags na bza' sbrul rgyan dang / /mi mgo'i dbu rgyan do shal can/ /spyan gsum mche gtsigs me dpung bzhugs/ /spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āXdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la huX sngon po/ huX de'i steng du paX las pad+ma dang / raX las nyi ma'i steng du huX las rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ raX las byung ba'i nyi ma la gnas pa'i huX las byung ba'i ral spi hūX gis mtshan pa/ ye shes spyan 'dren dang dbang bskur spyi dang mas par sbyar yang rung ste/ spyi bo dpral bar ltag pa sna ltag g.yas g.yon rnams su rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa re res brgyan pa ste rigs bdag gi rgyan no/ /ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar yig 'bru bskor bar bsams la/ oṃ a tsa la ka ṇa sarba ro gā na/ dhin+ta dhin+ta/ rjo tshin+ta hūX zhes bzlas pas/ yig 'bru las ral gri 'phros/ bshang lam nas thon/ spre'u brgyad gzir ba dang / gzhan yang gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ gsang ba nas zhugs ste snying gar thim par bsam thun 'jog khar lha sku stong pa nyid du bsdus la cung zad mnyam par bzhag slar yang dbang bskur gsal btab la dge ba bsngo/ga sto ma ba4sa sbyangs/ a las thod pa'i nang du a las zla ba/ de'i steng du hūX lasardo rje gdengs pa rgya gram gyi lte ba la hūX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/snod bcud kyi bdud rtsi thams cad lha mo bdud rtsi'i bum pa can gyi rnam par spyan drangs te bstim/ zla ba dang rdorje rgya gram yang 'od du zhu/ bdud rtsi'i rgya —35—

mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha ho khyiX gtor mgron spyan drangs pa man chad mi g.yo pusabatsugs kyi skabs dang 'dra/ bsnyen pa'i tshad ni 'bru 'bum mo/ /rang g.yin gyi gnad gdon zhi ba la lhagapar bsngags pa yin zhing / ril bu dang rmi lam brtag pa'i las tshogs rnams kyang ji skad bshad pa bzhin bsgrub par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /nad kun 'joms pa'i dpa' bo ste/ /yid la dga' bde bskyed pa'i gnas/ /shin tu gsang ba snyed sto'i don/ /sgrub thabs mdo tsam rnam par spel/ /zhes pa ni mi g.yo spre'u brgyad mar grags pa'i mngon rtogs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bcu pa'o/ /dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri ba/ gong ma lnga/ lo mchog dpal ldan seng ge chos rje bla ma/ / ༄༅ma/ /tsho'e swā sti/ gang gomatshan tsam thos pas kyang / /'chi med gnas la nyer spyor ba/ /tshe dpag med la gus btud nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs rmad byung bri/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ kha shar du phyogs te rang yi dam gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal la gnas pas rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar ser rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can/ na bza' chos gos ngur smig rnam gsum gsol ba/pad zla la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs tshar tshwa g.yo badz+ra ā yu ṣe sa ra ha ka ra re sha ra re huX phaṭa/ zhesanyer cig bzlas la/ thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pas bdag tshe—36—

dang ye shes dpag tu med par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ rlud phyir gsal bas lhung bzed khol/ nang du brngubs pa'i tshe bdud rtsi lud pa rnams sna sgo nas zhugs te lus thams cad dang / khyad par snying ga'i rtsa sbubs gang bar bsams te/ mchil ma re mid pa lan bdun bya/ de nas/ oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzī bā skyi ye swāhā/zhes pa ci nus dang / tshe gzungs tshe gnyis ma nyer gcig tsam bzlas pas/ tshe dpag med 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas zhugs pas lus thams cad gang bar gyur/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di'i rba slo pa bya bar 'dod na/ ra ba bzhi po gang rung gi yar tshes gza' skar bzang ba'i tho rangs shig nas 'go brtsams/ khrus byas/ kha shar phyogs su bltas la bzla'o/ /rgyun gyi nyams len la tho rangs snying po brgya rtsa re bya/ 'chi ltas byung na stong rtsa re bzlas pas kyang dus min gyi 'chi ba bzlog go zhes bshad do/ /'di'i slob ma rjes 'dzin la sgom lung tsam 'bogs pa'i srol yod pa ni spyi dang za/ bum chog byed na/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad tshom bu dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ bum pa spyi dang mthun par bkod/ gu gul gyis bdug la bges/sa gtor btang / spyo bhā wabros stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sgruX las bum pa baX las byung ba'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du/ tshe dpag med sngar ltar bskyed/ bzlas pa ci nus byas pa'i mthar mchod bstod bya/ gsol ba btab cing dngos grub blangasal/ lha 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsir gyur/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal phul la/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can sogs kyis gsol bto dang / gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ slosamatha mal gyi nga rgyal la/ mdun bskyed dang slob dpon dbyer med pa tshe dpag med kyi nga rgyal la dmigs pa las byin rlabs len pa sogs dmigs pa sgrub thabs dang 'dra bar phog khyad par ni 'dir yan lag bdun pa mi dgos/ rlung brngubs pa'i tshe bum chu re sbyin/ bzlas pa dpon slob gnyis kar lhan du byed/tshe dpag med spyi bor thim pa'i skabs spyi bor bum pa 'jogacing / bum chu gtor ba rnams lag len yin/—37—

slob ma dang mdun bskyed kyi rjes kyi bya ba dang spyi dang 'dra'o/ /grub pe'i rgyal mo gsung kun nas/ /rasachung snyan du dga' bas brgyud/ /bur sgom zhal gdams stag lung pa'i/ /snying gi gdams pa gsal snror bris/ /ras chung pa'i lugs tshe dpag med sprul sku'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel//༄༅༅/ /tshoṭa swā sti/ rgyal ba kun las ches lhag pa'i/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel/ /tshe dpag med la gus btud nas/ /rdo rje gdan pa'i man ngag bri/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du bto nas/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ pad zla'i gdan la rang sems rtswaX las rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan drangs/ dbang bskur rgyasabatab rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ tso ( rje pu/pu rje/ mahā rje pu / a pa ri mi ta pu// a pa ri mi ta rkye pu/ dzñā na saX bha ro bha tsi te ka ri ṇa ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas/ mtho bskyed/ gtor chog rjes gnang rnams ni/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i cho ga nyid sbyor ba yin la/ bum chog byed na/ bum pa sgrub tshul spyi dang 'dra zhing / bum pa gnyis 'cha'/ gcig tu rgyal ba tshe dpag med dgaganyis par rdo rje gnod spyin g.yas rdo rje mche ba 'phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa/ ga sku1na brkyang gis/ bzhugs pa zhig/ bskyed/ de la sngags kyanga.oX badz+ra yak+ṣa kre/ dha ji da ji da hūX phaṭa/ ces bzla/slob ma'am/ nad pa la bum mchog gi byin rlabs byed na/ thog mar bgegs sbyangs pa dang /sdig pa sbyang ba bya/ de nas rdo rje gnod sbyin bskyed pa'i bum pa des bkrus shing byabs srung kyang bya/ de nas—38—

bkra shis brjod cing / slar bum pa gnyis pa des dbang bskur zhing / lha dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa ltar bsgom du bcug sbyin pa'i stobs kyi sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags/ /sogs go lo ka re re'i mthar/ snying po re brjod cing dbang bskur/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang / bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs kyis shes pa brjod/rjes gnang dang sprags te byed na/ rgyun bshags song mtshams su 'di rnams byed pa yin/ 'dil yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis slob rgyud 'ga' re'i yi ge na/ tshod bang lha gcig bum gcig gi dmigs pa phal cher da thugs te 'di la sbyar yod na'ang / bsre bslad kho na yin no/ /sgrub thabs 'di'i khungs ni ngan song sbyod rgyud yin zhes bla mas gsung / brgyud pa 'di'i mos zhen can/ /kun la'ang rgya cher ma grags mod/ /'phags pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ /rab dga' snyid sto'i rjes su 'brang / /tshodapag med ba ri lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅// /o swā sti/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rjes chags dngos/ /rgyal ba tshe 'dzin dbang po'i skur/ /ston mdzad de la rab dang bas/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ paX las pad+ma a las zla ba de'i steng du tseXkhu kye 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje dkar po/g.yon dang po shel gyi 'phreng ba/ 'og ma gnyis yum la 'khyud tshul gyi mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na shel gyi bum pa bdud rtsi dkar pos gang ba 'dzin pa/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ yum pad+ma kun dha li dmar mo phyag dang po gnyis kyis byi dra' bgrang phreng dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis —39—

kyis yab la 'byud pas pad+ma rā ga'i bum pa bdud rtsi dmar pos gang ba 'dzin pa/ pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i spyi bor rnam snang / mgrin par snang mtha'/ snying gar mi bskyod pa/ lte bar zin 'byung / gsang bar don grub rnams rang snang gi yum dang bcas par gyur/ mi bskyod pa'i thugs kar nyi zla kha spyor gyi dbus su oṃ/ klad skor gyi dbus su thig le dkar la 'tsher ba/ nyi zla ā lika li'i skud pas bcings pa/ ba sbu'i sgo thams cad rta mgrin phyag gnyis pa'i go mas gtamasapa/ ye shes pa bstim pa dang dbang bskur rgyas bto spyi dang 'dra ba las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ de nas bzlas dmigs gsal btab la/ tshe gzungs tshe gnyis ma gang nus bzla'o/ /rjes mi dmigs par bsams la dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ a las byung ba'i ka pā la bcud dang bcas pa me rlung gi sbyor bas sbyangs/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs la bstim/ oṃ ā hu zhes byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi mdun du rgyal ba tshe dpag med 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza a kā rol na bdun gyis phul/ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe yi bdag/rgyawab kun gyis rtag tu dgongs gyur pa'i/ /'phags pa'i tshogs kyis skye shi gcod pa'o/ /skye dgu rnams kyi skyabs gyur bcom ldan 'das/ /dad pas bdag ni rtag tu bstod phyag 'tshal/ /zhe༅bstod/ bgegs dang 'chi las rnam grol ba'i/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho de/ /mkha' mnyam rnams dang lhan cig tu/ /myur du thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba bto/ yig brgyas kha bskang / badz+ra mugashogs su gsol/—40—

'di'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni/ maṇ+ḍal dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi rnam pa can nam/ ma 'grub na pad+ma 'dab brgyad zhig bri/ der bum pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas bsangs sbyangs/ bum pa spyi dang ma lhun par bskyed/ bum pa'i nang du lha bskyed pa ni/ bdag bskyed kyi 'don pa spos pas 'grub cing / mthar mchod bstod gtor ma phul la/'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis mchod yon phu' bas zhu bar mos/ slob ma rnamasakhrus byas/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum/ byang chub rnam rje la sogasagasol gdab lan gsum/ dngos gzhi dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas gsang gnas kyi bar du rtsa a wa tī dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zhig yod par mos la/ bum pa 'a nyid bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med par gyur pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon par sgoms shig cesabarjod la bum pa spyi bor bzhugayab yum snyoms pa zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'chomed ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur pa/ spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ smin mtsha'o/sa yan chad gang / bum dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang / gsang dbang thob/ snying ga yan chad gang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum dri ma bag chags dang bcas dag par mos mdzode/ ces brjod de bum chu sgyin/ de nas mngon lis kyi dmigs pa tshang bar 'bogs/ dbang bskur gyi skabs bum chu spyi bor gtor/ bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par spyin/ spros pa la dga' bas tshe ril tshe chang ster ba'i lugs kyang gda'/ yig rnying na med pas ma byas kyang chog go /slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di yang lo ro ras—41—

chung pa'i/ /gdams pa zab mor kun du grags/ /ri bo che ba'i yig tshogs las/ /rab dga'i snying po byung ba yin/ /tshe dpag med dkar po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅// /o swā sti/ gang las 'chi med ye shes kyi/ /dngos grub 'byung ba'i sgrub thabasani/ /rab zab 'dir ni bri bar bya/ /skal ldan rnams kyis blang bar byos/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du bto nas/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhūX las byung ba'i sengakhre'i steng du paX las sna tsho gi/sa pad+ma dang a las zla ba la gnas pa'i rang sems 'chi med srog gi ngo bo a dkar po/ de'i 'od kyi 'phro 'dus las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog zla ba chu shel ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha rdzas ‘kyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan can/ mtshan dpes spras shing 'od 'bar ba'o/ /thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ steng phyogs 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan dpag tu med pa nas/rgyal ba tshe dpag med 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXspruXbaX hoX dpral bar tsho(/ mji kho/ par āX thugs kar huX/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ skye( na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ra mi ta ā yudzñā na/ su bi ni nyi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ a rta te saXmyaklaX bud+dhā ya/ ta bya thā/ oṃ pu rje/pu/ mahā pu rje/ a pa ra mi ta nywa dzñā na saX bha ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saX sku ra pa ri shudha dharma te ga ga na sa muṅka te swa bhā wa bi shudhe mahā na ya pa ri lha ra ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ mthar tsho'es bta thā—42—

ga tā a pa ra mi ta ā yur dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra tismo swāhā/ zhes sogs chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku tshe dang / /ye shes dpag yas shin tu rnam nges pa/ /gzi brdzid rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba bta0la/ mi rtog pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag lhun 'tshams su skad cig gis lhar bskyed la gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas dgob bsngo'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra ba las/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po 'bri/ rdul tshon dkar po'i tshom bu bkod/ gtor bsngo'i skabs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyasabyin gyis brlabs/ gzungs ring gi mthar a kā ro btags pas 'bul/ rjes gnang dngos kyi skabagarjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa la/ sku'i rjes gnang dang / lung gsum la gsung gi rjes gnang dang / byin gyis brlabs pa la thugs kyi rjes gnang gi ming 'dogs bsgyur ba tsam mdzad do/ /'di'i bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa skad gas pa dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor bsngo sogs byed pa ni/ rang 'dod kyi grub mtha'i rgyas bkab tsam yin gyi/ de'i rang lugs ma yin no/ /mi trore gdams pa kun grags pa/ /rab byung dga' ba'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /snyib nas nyams su len 'dod na/ /rang lugs drang stor sgom par byos/ /tshe dpag med dkar bo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅༅/ /glu6 snyu sti/ gang gi mtshan tsam thos pas kyang / /dus min 'chi ba nyer zhi zhing / /sdig sgrib mtha' dag sbyong mdzad pa'i/ /gtsug tor rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ spro na tshogs zhing spyan 'dren dang / /yan lag bdun pa rgyas par bya/ mdor bsdu na tshad med —43—

bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa rka3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las paX lasapad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i steng du zlaX las rin po che las grub pa'i mchod rten du gyur pa ni/ rin po che'i rang bzhi no seng khri'i steng du pad+ma/ de'i steng du khri zlum po bang rim sum brtsegs/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i bum pa zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba sgo dang bcas pa/ steng du rin po che'i bre/ gdugs bcu gsum/ char khebs tog dang bcas pa/ tshe tog gi phreng ba dang / dar gyi lda ldi sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la zlaX las sna tshogs rdo rje bhāX gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ tshurmis can gyi don byas/༄tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug gtor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ser ba/ g.yon sngo zhing yid tsam khro ba/ zhal re re zhing zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa phyag g.yas kyi dang pos sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gnyis pas pad+ma'i steng du 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa bsnams pa/ gsum pas mda'/ bzhi pas ma ce ske sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon dang pos zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigasamadzub/ gnyis pas gzhu/ gsum pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ bzhi pas ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang bcas pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i g.yas su spyan ras mug zags dkar po/ g.yas rnga yab dang g.ye na pa khru dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du phyag na rdorje sngon po g.yas —44—

rnga yab dang g.yon rdo rje sngon po 'dzin pa/ gtso sde bor gsum gyi phyogs bzhir khro bo bzhi gnas pa ni/ shar du mi g.yo ba g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba/ lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po g.yas lcags kyu 'phyar ba/ nub tu dbyug sngon g.yas dbyug pa 'grir ba/ byang du stobs po che g.yas rdo rje rtse gsum 'phyar ba/ thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing kha rab tu khros pa/ phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod cing / spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra nag po thor tshugs su byas pa/stag lpags dang / sbrul gyi rgyan can/ medapung 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso mo'i steng gi nam mkha' la gnas gtsang ma'i rigs kyi lha'i bu gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ gtso mo la sku khrus gsol ba/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ snying gar hū sngon po/ dpral bar tra ser po/ lte bar khyi dmar po/ brla gnyis la a a ljang khu/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug gtor rnam par rgyal ma 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā urdzi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dza de bawo du sbyar te/ ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshe/gas pa rigs lnga 'khordo ra dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza oṃ badz+ra ar+gha pra tisnro swāhā nas/ shasta ā hū gis mchod/ de bzhin g.ye/gas ka pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar ༵zlo~X/sa dho hūṃ~X/ ༵༵ ༵dag nga/ /chi kā~X cad je /sna~X lhag dzī spyi bo/ —45—

lud pa las/ gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ spyan mur sa gzags la 'od dpag med/ phyag na rdorje dang / khro bo bzhi la mi bskyod pa/ lha'i bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ tshesarba ta thā ga ta urdzi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaX pra ru swāhā nas/ badz+ra shasta āXhūX gi bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog/zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /yeshes dpag yas tshe yi ma snab stsole ma/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la sgyuX yig bsrung bya sngags 'phrong dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ oṃ hūṃ traX hri aX a༄༷༷ bdag dang bsrung bya la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swāhā/ zhes cu ri zad bzlas nas/ gon bor gzungs ring nyid bzla'o/ /bzlasapa tshar nas/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod bstod/ yig brgya/'dod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams byas nas/ dge ba bsngos la/ lhun mtshams la 'jug/gtor ma dkar gtor zhig smra badz+ra yak+ṣa huX gis bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsamatha bhañtsa ra ṇa hūX phaṭa kyis sbyangs/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharmā ṇaX u bya nu po sno twa ta gyisabyin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam rgyal lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ gzungs ring tshar stogagimathar/ gi zhi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri lha re khyoX i a kā ro sogs lan bdun gyis phul/gongabazhi mchod bstod bya/ mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs/ 'dod don ga i ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam/ bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang go bya ba ni/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra ba las/ ming 'dogs kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang go tha snyad dang / slob ma 'ga' zhig gi don du 'gyur na/ bdag mdun gnyis kyi bar —46—

du bum pa sgrub cing rjes gnang gi thog mtha' gang rung du bkru byabs zung gsum byed pa ni khyad par ro//bum pa'i cho ga ni gzhan du 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /gzungs 'di'i sgrub thabs mang na yang / /kun la 'di nyid grags che bas/ /gzhan la phan phyir dga' bas bris/ /'dus gsal snying po ngo mtshar rmad/ /rnam rgyal lha dgu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅rti/ /glu(rdza sti/ he ru ka dpal lha mor bcas/ /de bzhin rtsa rgyud bla ma la/ /mchog tu gus pas btud byas nas/ /tshe sgrub kun gyi mchog gyur bshad/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhin sngon du 'gro bas/ shā n+ya tas stong par sbyangs/ hūX las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwagur bla bre mda' dra me dpung dang bcas pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba dkar po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba'i gdan la rang sems huX dkar po'i 'phro 'du las phyir bzlog ma wo mo 'chi med rdo rje lha mo'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dkar zhing na bza' dkar po can/ zhal brgyad rtsa zhal dkar po khro la 'dzum pa'i rnam pa can/ g.yas su sngo dmar ser ba'i zhal gsum drag tu bzhad pa/ g.yon du dmar ljang dud kha cher khros pa/ de drug ka'ang khro zhal/ steng zhal dkar po zhi ba/ zhal thams cad spyan gsum pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ lhag ma rnams kyis/ zhags pa ral gri dgra sta lcags kyu dang / /mda' dang tho ba 'khor lo g.yas pa na/ /sdigs mdzub bum pa mdung dang thod pa dang / /gzhu dang kha ṭāX skyabs sbyin g.yon pas so/ /pad zla la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bdud dang dbang phyug la sogs pa bgegs thams cad mnan pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang / gtsug gi nor bu dang / thod skam dang mgo —47—

'phreng dang / stag lpags la sogs pas brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ thugs kar zla ba dmar skya la hū dang / de las 'od zer 'phros ye shes sems dpa' dang dbang gi lha badz+ra sa mā dza ar+gha nas sha lta'i bar gyisamachod/ dza hu ba ho ye shes pa rang la thim/ ji ltar bltams pa nas shrī ye hū/zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga yum can gyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ a mṛ ta san dza wa ni/ mahā a mṛ te sa mu khe dzi wa/ pra be sha ya/ pra pe sha ya/ sarba badz+ra pad+ma sam yo gi ma na bo dhi tsit+ta/ pi pa tha mu ste hu hu/ a/ 65 glu( ā swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla zhing / khri'am 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas na 'chi ba nges/par bzlog pa ste/ a bhi dha na las/ 'di ni khri tsam bzlas byas na/ /'chi ba ngesapar 'tsho bar gyur/ /mi dus na 'chi ba zhi 'gyur zhing / /'chi ba las ni nges par slong / /zhes gsungs so/ 'jug tu ar+gha la sogs pas mchod/ nang mchod bde mchog ltar byin gyisabarlabs nas 'bru gsum gyis myang / he ru ka'i rigs byung ba/ /rdo rje gtsug gtor chen mo ni/ /'chi bdag bzlog mdzad bdud rtsi'i zhal/ /phyir bzlog chen mo khyod la 'du/da/ /ces bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya bzlas te phyag gnyis pa'i bar du bsdusal/ dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma bde mchog ltar byin gyis brlabs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar srung 'khor nasadabu brgyan gyis bar gong bzhin bskyed la/ sngags kyi mthar i di bā li ta kha kha kha hi 'a hi/ tsham ā sdo/ra sirnyi pra yasne ni skye glu( ā hu grwa hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ lhag ma mkha' 'gro spyistegator gyis bsngos/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol bto sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni rten gzhi chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma dkar po la me tog dkar po'i tshom bu bkod/ bum pa bca'/ rjes gnang sgrub thabs spyi dang 'dra/ bum pa'i nang du sngags kyi yig 'brus gang —48—

bar mos la bum bzlas bya/ rjes༅nga dngos ni/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge sogs kyis go yel btab/ rgyun bshags dang rigs lnga'i sdom bzung bya/ sku'i rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra ba'i rjes su bum chusadabang bskur zhing / mngon rtogs ltar dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa'ang 'bogs/ gsung gi rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra/ thugs kyi rjes gnang la/ spyi bor haX nam mkhar zla ba la gnas pa'i kha ṭāXga'i dbyug pa'i sbom sar huX/ des sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste/ kha ṭāX ga nas brgyud nas/ slob ma'i lus gang ba'i dmigs pa 'bogs/gzhan spyi dang 'dra/ tshe sgrub kyi tshe yang sngags kyi 'khor lo snying gar bsgoms na shin tu zab par 'gyur mod kyi gsal thebs dka' ba'i phyir 'dir ma bshad do/ /rdo rje lha mo'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /sngags 'chang kun la'ang ches dkon na/ /g.yin la smos kyang ci dgos pas/ /thos la dga' bas snyib sto long / /bde mchog las/ 'byung ba 'chi med rdo rje lha mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ sgrub thabasarin chen 'byung gnas las tshe sgrub kyi lha'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bcu gcig pa'o/ /dge'o// //༄༅༅/ /skye6snya sti/ gang gi mtshan tsam thos pas kyang / /bdud rnams thams cad spa skong ba/ /gsung gi mnga' bdag 'jam dbyangs la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal sgrub thabs bshad/ /'gro sto rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs ye rgyas chas dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro/ shes rab snying rtse dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar cwa(ga /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral —49—

zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog/ces lan gsum gyis tshad med bsgos yoXswa bhā wa shudha sarba dharma spyo bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las baX las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkar la dwangs pa/ mtsho mtha' ne'u gsing me tog dang 'bras bu'i nags tshal du mas rnam par brgyan pa/ glang chen thal dkar gyi khyu tshogs nye bar rgyu ba/lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin du ma gnas pa'i gzhi mtsho'i steng thams cad me tog sna tshogs pas rnam par bkra ba/ chu bya sna tsho gos dregs pa'i skad snyan sgrog pa/de'i dbus su paX las pad+ma'i sdong po rab tu rgyas pa/ yal ga gnya' shing tsam la gser gyi lo 'dab shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gyis g.yogs pa/ rtse mor pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong ldan ze'u 'bru dmar ser du yod pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang sems a yig dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes par mun pa bsal/ shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun 'jam dbyangs sku mdog zla ba nor bu'i phung po ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis ut+pa la'i sdong bu'i rtsa ba thugs kar bzung bar rab tu rgyas pa snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / dbu skra ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang sna tshogs pa'i dar gyi smad dkris gsol ba/brgyad gnyis lon pa'i lang tsho can skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad sto yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /rang gi snying rtse mo —50—

gyen bstan pad+ma 'dam ba brgyad kha 'bus kyi rnam par kha bye ba'i dbus su 'khor lo dkar po/ rtsibs drug pa'i rtse mo rno ba/ lte bar zla ba la a/ rtsibs drug la mdun nas g.yas skor gyi/ oṃ wā kyai da na ma/ zhes pa'i gsang sngags yi ge drugapa ste/ yig 'bru rnams reg la ma 'byar ba'i tshul du gnas pa/ de nyid 'khor lo g.yas skor dang yig 'bru g.yon skor du 'khor bas sdig sgrib mtha' dag dag par 'gyur/ glu( wā kyai da na ma/ zhes pa ci nus su bzla'o/ /mthar oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā urla mañdzu shrī/sa pa ri wā ra ar+gha pra titsā/snyasmade bzhin du pu zhe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ge ga rnye/ ni wi te/ sha lta rnams kyis mchod/ maṇ+ḍal tshomacubadun ma bshams la phul/ bstod pa ni mtshan brjod dam paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis mdzad pa'i bstod pa yongasardzogs kyis bstod/ shin tu bsdu na/ngo bo ma nor chos nyid rab mkhyen zhing / /rnam pa ma lus 'ja' tshon lhang nger gzigs/ /thugs rje che dang thabs tshul dpag med kyis/ /srid mtsho mtha' yas skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs mgon khyod gus pas rjes dran zhing / /bsgoms bzlas legs mchod mngon par bstod pa yis/ /blo ngan ma rig 'thibs po'i tshogs rnams kun/ /sprin med nyi shar ji bzhin dwangs par mdzod/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bdag la shes rab phun sum tsho go/sa pa stsa'/ du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/rgya ston gyi yi ge ltar na/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal zug mas pa'i steng du/ bdag bskyed gyi lha byon par bsamasanas/ rang tha mal ba'i nga rgyal gyis mchod pa man chad byed pa yin na'ang / bdag bskyed la ye shes pa sbyan 'dren med pas mi legs so/ /de'i phyir gzhung gi dgongs pa bdag bskyed nyid la mchod pa yin no/ /bsnyen pa'i skabs gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na 'og nas 'chad pa bzhin 'bul/ phyis kyi yi ge —51—

'ga' na/ zhing khams thugs kar bsdu ba dang / mchod bstod sogs maṇ+ḍal mchod chog tu byas gda' na'ang sgrub thabs gzhan 'ga' zhig gis rgyas bkab par zad la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi skabs/ 'dzam bu'i gling ngam gling gzhan dag ces sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ rgyal srid sna bdun kar 'bul ba'i dbang du byas 'dug na'ang / spyir mchod pa'i rnam grangs mang gin bzang ba yin mod/ 'di'i man nga gtu nges par dgos pa ni ma yin te/ rgya ston gshin rje gshod kyi phyogs la thugs bag chags brtas pa'i rnam 'gyur tsam mo /bsnyen pa'i skabs gtor chog kyang nges par dgos pa ma yin la/ lhun mtshams su 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sku brnyan la phyag mchod bstod pa sogs ci nus su byed pa ni gal che'o/ /de la 'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ rdul tshon dkar pos pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris la/ de'i steng du 'jam dbyangs kyi sku dang 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi glegs bam bzhugs su gsol ba'i mtha' skor du/ byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog gi snod bshom pa nas gzung ste/ mchod pa spyi 'gro ltar mug ma/ shar du dkar gtor gcig bshams la/ de nas slob dpon gyis mdun gyi mchod pa rnams o badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i zinapo che'i snod ces sogs mchod pa spyi 'gro ltar dang / oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi sogs gsum gyis rmi gyis brlabs/ de nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bdag bskyed sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin bsgomasanas bzlas pa ci nus bya/ de nas bdag bskyed la mchod bstod bya/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni bsangasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baX las zhes sogs bdag bskyed ltar bskyed la/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ thugs ka'i huX las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rjes btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaXzhes spyan drangs/dzaXhuX baX hoX dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang thugs ka'i sogs nas/ dbang gi lha rigs—52—

lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi khiñtsa huX/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing ba spu5 mo/ /de nas phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā a rlu mnyu shrī/ sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra tisnro swāhā/ de bzhin du sha lta'i bar sa slo(la/bstod pa ci shes pas bstod/ de nas gtor ma la chab bto la bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āXhūX zhub snyobyung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsams la/ skye( a kā ro mu khaX zhesasogs lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ na maXsarba ta thā ga ta u rlu mañdzu shrī i daX bā ling ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun gyis phul la/ mchod bstod byas la/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bdagasogs sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas/ shes bya thams cad bde blag tu rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus byagaphyag dang yon phul te gral la 'khod/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu byas nas 'dug pa la/ slob dpon gyis chos bshad cung zad byas la/ 'dir slob dpon gyis las su gyur pa bdag bskyed sngon du btang nasamadun bskyed bsgrubs te/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul dgos pa rnams legs par grub pa yin/ gnyisapa slob ma'i bya ba la/ rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal gcig phul mdzod/maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas rdo rje gur las/ gang gi slob dpon gsol ba btab/ /de yi rigs su skye ba med/ ces dang / tshul ji lta bus gsol ba 'debs na/ mdun du —53—

dul bar 'dug pa dang / /gos sogs tshul ni sdom pa dang / /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar ba yis/ /nyan sogs 'dod pas gsol gsum gdab/ /cesagasungs pas na/ khyed rnams snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nasagasol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod cig dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ /zhes dang /mdun bskyed rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mtha' skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' sprin phung 'bas pa bzhin du bzhugs par bsams nas/ khyed rang gis sngar byas pa'i sdig pa dran pa dang mi dran pa thams cad la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang / phyin chad srog la bab kyang sdig pa mi byed do snyam du bsams pa dang / 'khor 'das kun gyi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba la rjes su yi rang ngo / /snyam pa dang / stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid can gyi don dam pa byang chub kyi sems tshul bzhin du bsgom par bgyi'o snyam du yi dam 'cha' ba dang / rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro'o snyam pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang thob par byed do snyam pa'i smon pa'i sems bskyed pa dang / sangs rgyas de thob pa'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam la bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang / de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bdag dang sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig gu snyam pa'i bsam pa —54—

dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzode cig dkon mchog gsum la sogasalan gsum bya/ gsum pa gnyis ka'i bya ba la/ sku'i rjes gnang dang / gsung gi dang /thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i dang / yon tan 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang dang bzhi yod pa las/ dang po sku'i rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig gang tshe lta bar 'dod pa'am zhes sho lo ka snyag lan gsum bya/de ltaragasol ba btab nas/ khyed rang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ nged kyis rma subhā wa shudha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ zhes brjod pas khyed rang gi phung po dang khams dang skye mched thams cad mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du sangs te song ba'i rjes su baX las/ sogs bdag bskyed lhar gsal btab la bsgom du bcug la/ de ltar khyed rang 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gsal ba'i spyi gtsug tu rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs gcig byon nas khyed rang la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod cig byas la/'jam dbyangs kyi sku slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku che ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yin te/ /sangs rgyas sku yis byin brlabs pas/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku thob shog/dzaXhuX baX hoX zhes brjod pas khyed rang gi lus 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku dang dbyer med du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar byas pa la phan yon gnyis te/ gnas skabs su nad med pa dang / 'grob gzhan gyis mthong ba tsam gyis dad par 'gyur ba dang / mthar thug tu mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i —55—

rjes zlos mdzod/ brtse ldan khyod kyis mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis/ /sogs sho lo ka gcig lan gsum/ de nas yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mjodi cig bla ma 'jaslapa'i dbyangs su gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo'i steng ba yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi 'phreng ba 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa bla ma'i zhal nas thon te/ khyed rang 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gsal ba'i zhal du zhugasanas/ snying ga'i ba yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim pa'i mos pa gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig 'phreng ba lag tu 'dzin du bcug la/ oṃ wā kyai da na ma/ zhes tshar kha cig(gseg ka'adon/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis nged la me togagator zhing 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lagasakyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang gis slob dpon la me tog phul ba de sngags su byin gyis brlabs nas dngos grub kyis tshul du byin pa'i mos pa mdzod cig byas la me tog mgo thog tu bzhag nas/ ba the me ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnamasal/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gsung gi byin gyis brlabs pa ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig/ces brjod/ de ltar byas pa la phan yon gnyis te/ gnasaskabs su 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba la mkhas pa dang / mthar thug tu gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cudang ldan pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /—56—

gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cigashes pas srid la mi gnas shing / /snying rje zhi la mi gnasapas/ /mya ngan 'das dang 'khor mi gnas/ /'jam dbyangs thugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa lan gsum/ de nas dpon slob gnyis kas lus gnad bca' ba ni/ rkang pa skyil krung / lag pa mnyam bzhag sgal tshigs bsrang / mig/ bar snang la bstad nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar smin mtshams kyi thad tsam du yi ge a gcig gsal btab la/ de la sems rtse gcig tu bstad nas a a zhes nyi shu rtsagacig brjod pas/ a de 'ja' yal ba bzhin du yal nas dmigs pa med pa'i stong pa nyid rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba la gsal le sing nge ye re bar sems ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag nas/ slob ma'i spyi bor me tog cig bzhag la/oṃ.ā hū/ zhes dang /rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig zhes kyang brjod de brtan par bsam mo/ /de ltar thugs kyi rjes gnang thob pa la phan yon gnyis te/ gnas skabs su chos la blo 'gro zhing mthar thug tu shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes rdo rje lta bu thob par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa yon tan 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig dus 'di nas ni gzung nas su/ /phyi ma byang chub ma thob bar/ /bcom ldan 'jam dbyangs mgon gyis ni/ /bdag gis bla ma mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa lan gsum/ de nas slob ma'i lag tu mtshan brjod gto la/ 'di ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rgyud mtshan yang dag par brjod pa zhes bya ba tshig nyung la —57—

don zab pa/ rgyud sde thams cad kyi yang rtse yin pas 'di la thos bsam dang /'di nas bstan pa'i don nyams su blangs na/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur bas/ 'di la khyed rang rnams thos bsam gyis la nyams su long / gzhan la ston la bshad pa gyis la sems can gyi don du gang 'gyur gyis shig ces rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa yin no/ /de ltar byas pa la phan yon gnyis yod de/ gnas skabs su rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'grub pa dang / mthar thug tu 'jam pa'i dbyangasal mnga' ba'i yon tan 'phrin las thams cad dang mnyam pa'i gnas thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar khyed rnams kyi dad pa dang 'dun pa'i sgo nas nged la gsol ba btab nas/ de la nged kyis brtse ba'i bsam pas ci shes kyi sgo nas/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rje rnga/ gnang byas pa 'di la phan yon ci yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can gyi don du bsngos nas las byas pa 'brasabu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig 'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi/ /dge ba bdag gis gang thob pa/ /de yi skye bo thams cad kyis/ /'jam dbyangs shes rab thob par shog/ces pa lan gsum/ de'i dus su khas blangasapa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa thams cad bla ma'i bka' bzhin du sgrub bo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzode/ gtso bos gos lan gsum/ rjes gnang zab mo thob pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs gsum byas nas/ de ltar na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi rjes gnang zab mo grub pa yin pas/ des dga' ba bsgom pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad —58—

gzigs pa nyid/ /ces sogs kyi smon lam 'debs shing phyag phul nas 'gro bar gzhug go /de nas slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa rnams kha gsos nas/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod sngar ltar byas nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol nas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang zhes sogs dang / mdun bskyed la brtan bzhugs bya'o/ /de nas smon lam bkra shis bya'o/ /mchod gtor rnams bsdu'o/ /kun la ngo mtshar cher grags pa'i/ /'jam dkar sgrub thabs dga' ba'i tog/snying gi thig le 'dir bkod kyi/ /blo gsal rnams kyis myur dwor long / /'jam dkar kha che paṇa chen lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// /maṅgalaXbistu ra kus /༄༅༅/ /skye ste swā sti/ mtha' yas rgyal ba'i mkhyen pa kun/ /gcis bsdus 'jam dbyangasagazhon nu'i sku/ /de la btud cing gsol btabs nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /'dir shin tu byin rlabs kyi bka' babs che ba 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dmar ser sa lugs kyi sgrub thabs ni/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ rang gi snying 'od kyi gur khang kha gyen du bstan pa'i nang du/ pad zla'i gdan la dhīXdamar ser de las 'od 'phros/ rang gi mi shes pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ ba sbu'i bu ga nas spros/ 'phags pa mchod/sems cad gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa las rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu gyur pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu gur gum gzhon nu'i mdangs can 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed pa/ zhi zhing 'dzu/ma la sgeg pa zhal gcig phyag —59—

sko gnyis/ g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri sngo sangs dpung pa'i thad kar 'phyar ba/g.yon ut+pal sngon po'i rtsa ba thugs kar 'dzin zhing snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba rab tu rgyas pa'i steng du gsung rab kun 'dus pa po ti dang bcas pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing dbu skra ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pas spras pa/zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can no/ /bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ spro na/ dpral bar oṃ las 'jam dpal dkar po/ mgrin par āXlas 'jam dpal dmar po/ snying gar huX las 'jam dpal sngon po/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dhīXde lasa'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rang nyid la zhugs par gyur/ dhīX'i mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor ba dang / lce'i rtsa bar yang dhīXyig mgo phug tu gnas par bsams la/ oṃ ā ra pa tsa na dhīX zhes ci nus su bzlas shing /na momanyu shrī/ ye/ ku ma ra bhu tā ya/ bo dhī sa tā ya/ mahā sa tā ya/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ta du thā/ o.ā ra dze/ bi ra dze/ shudhe/ bi shudhe/ sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya/ a ma le/bi ma le/ nir ma le/ dza ya wa re/ ru ru tsa le/ huX huX huX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhesashes rab blo 'phel gyi gzungs nyid ci rigs par bzlas nas/ thun 'jog pa'i dus su dbugs thog gcig la sgyilaX rgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas lus lhaXyig gcig tu gyur par bsam/ thun 'jog mtshams su yang lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pa'i sgo nas gtsang sbra dang mchod pa la brtson par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ gru/rnyal tshom bu can mchod pa ci 'byor dang dkar gtor gnyis dang bcas pa bsham/ bdag bskyed gong bzhin byas nas/ mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ pad zla la zhes pa nas/ gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin/—60—

ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ mchod yon phal cher sogs tshigs bcad sngagasadang bcas pas mchod/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po sogs dang / rgyal sras gzhon nu mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor can/ /gur gum mdog can 'od kyi dra bas mdzes/'od 'bar ral gri glegs bam phyag na bsnams/ /lha yi bla ma khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rnon po gsang sngags yi ge drug/brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi sgo ru bstan/ /gsung ma snaṇ+ḍi / mtshungs med rig sngags rgya mtsho yis/ /gti mug nyid log slong bar mdzad la 'dud/ /gang thugs nam mkha'i dkyil ltar dag pa la/ /thugs rje'i char rgyun rgyun rbad med pa yis/ /'gro kun sgrib gnyis dri ma 'khrud mdzad pa'i/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'jam dbyangs khyod la 'dud/ /skyeb 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mgon po 'jam dbyangs khyod dang 'bral med cing / /bdag dang ma lus 'gro ba thams cad kyis/ /don rab rgya chen 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ lkog pa'am shes shing spro na rgya bod kyi bstod pa ngo yo'i can du ma yod pa rnams kyis bstod do/ /gtor ma dang po 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la 'bul/ gtor ma phyi ma phyogs skyong bcu la cha gsum nang ltar btang / 'di'i 'jig rten 'das gtor yig rnying las ma bshad kyang phyis kyi phyag len yin/ mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa ci 'grub bya ste/ slob dpon gyi bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /rjes gnang gi ngo bo ni/ phal cher sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i chings dang 'dra/ 'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dang / go rim rnams bshad na slob ma rnams khrus byas/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po sogs/ sho lo ka gnyis kyis gsol pa btab/ rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma lhar bskyed ye shes pa bstim/ bzlas lung gi skabs/ dpon slob gnyis ka'i thugs kar shes rab kyi —61—

'khore lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar oṃ a dhīX rtsibs bzhi la ra pa tsa na rnams bkod la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i de las de 'dra ba gnyis pa chad nas/zhal nas thon/ kha sgor zhugs/ slob ma'i snying ga'i 'khor lo sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim par bsams la/ sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ slob ma'i lce'i rtsa bar dhīXmago phug bstan/ dhīX'i 'od kyis ngag gi skyon thams cad sbyangs/slob dpon kyi thugs ka'i 'od kyas sangs rgyas byang sems kyi yon tan thamasacad bsdus te dhīXci nus shig rjes zlos byed/ de nas dam bca' ba'i lung dang / lga gyisabarlab pa'i lung byas la dam tshig khas blangs/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs dang / yon 'bul/ rjes chog ni mchod pa kha gsos/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ mchod bstod yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gnags gsol smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /grub brnyes mkhas pa chen po dzi tā ris/ /lo bdun lon tshe 'di nyid zhal gzigs pas/ /blo gros mchog gyur mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab/ /rdo rje gdan pa gnyis kyi'ang 'di grub cing / /ba ri lo dzñā rig sngags 'di grub nas/ /'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs shes rab cher gyur la/ /sa chen mkhyen pa'i bdag po'ang 'di yis mthu/ /zhal gzigs brgyud pa mang por byin kyis brlabs/ /blo chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ khu dbon gsung gi bcud bsdusanas/ /snyi1 sto tsam zhig bkod pa la/ /nyes pa mchis na bzod par gsol/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dmar ser gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅ma/ /glu khe swā sti/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /mkhyen dngos 'jam dbyangs la btud nas/ /rdo rje mtshon chas mdzad pa yi/ /bstod pa'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /bzang spyod nasa'abyung ba'i yan lag bdun pa dang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du btang nas/—62—

shā n+ya kha stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la 'khor lo dmar ser rtsibasalnga pa lte ba la dhīXrtsibs rnams la a ra pa tsa na dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang dang mdun gyi nam mkhar 'phags pa 'jam dpal gur gum gyi mdog can ral gri dang po ti 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang zin po che'i brgyan pa/ mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku can re re gyur/ rang gi snying gar sngags kyi 'khor lo/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar dhīXsangs rgyas byang sems thams cad ye shes pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaXhuX baX hoX snying ga'i sngags 'khor las 'od 'phros/sangs rgyas mchodi/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas par bsam/ ar+ghaX nasasha lta'i bar gyis mdun bskyed mchod/ snying ga'i 'od zer las mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul nas/ mdun gyi 'jam dbyangs la mchod cing gsol ba 'debs par bsams la/ gang gi blo gros sgrib gnyis sprin bral nyi ltar rnam dag rab gsal ba/ /bden gnyis don kun ji bzhin gzigs phyir nyid kyi thugs kar glegs bam 'dzin/ /gang dge srid pa'i brtson rar ma rig mun 'thoms sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i/ /'gro tshogs kun la bu gcig ltar brtse yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan gsung / /'brug ltar cher sgrogs nyon mongs gnyid slong las kyi lcags sgrog grol mdzad cing / /ma rig mun sel sdug bsngal myu gu ji snyed gcod mdzad ral gri bsnams/ /gdod nas dag cing sa bcu'i mthar son yon tan lus rdzogs rgyal sras thu bo'i sku/ /bcu phrag bcu dang bcu gnyis rgyan spras bdag blo'i mun sel 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ /ces nyer snyag la sogs pas—63—

bstod cing / mthar mdun gyi 'jam dbyangs 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ snying ga'i 'khor lo drag tu 'khor bar bas yas la/ a ra pa tsa na dhī: zhes pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla'o/ /mthar stong pa nyid la mnyam par bzhag ste/ dge ba bsngo/ 'od zer dgu phrugs kyi byin rlabs byed par 'dod pas/ spro na 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sku'i drung du mchod pa bshams la byin rlabs bya/ de rnams med kyang rung ste/ slob dpon gyis bstod sgrub tshar gcig nyams su len/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum byed/slob dpon 'phags pa 'jam dpal du gsal ba'i dpral ba nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa phul/ 'od zer dpral bar phog pas thugs rgyud yongs su bskul nas/ 'od zer gyi rnam pas dpral ba nas byung / slob dpon gyi dpral bar thim/ slob dpon 'jam dpal du gsal ba la mos gus dung bas bstod pa tshar gcig gam gsum gyis gsol ba btab/co slob dpon gyi dpral ba nas 'od zer byung / slob ma'i dpral bar thim pas lus kyi sdig sgrib byang zhing / sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par mos su bcu gde bzhi du/ mgrin pa nas 'od zer spro bsdu dang / ngag gi sdig sgrib dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs pa dang / thugs ka nas 'od zer spro bsdu dang / yid kyi sdig sgrib dgathugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'ang rigs 'gre/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang 'dra/ 'di la mdun bskyed la rjes chog byed pa ni med do/ /mkhas mchog kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /bstod sgrub zab mo rab dga' ba/ /'di yis rang g.yin don byed tshul/ /snyid po tsam zhig bris pa lags/ /'jam dpal yon tan ye shes bzang po'i bstod sgrub tu grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅2/ /skye'o swā sti/ rgyal ba'i ye shes mkhyen pa rnams/ /gcig bsdus 'jam pa'i rdo rje —64—

la/ /gus pas btud nas de'i sgrub thabs/ /dam pa'i man ngag bshad par bya/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du bto /shā n+ya tus stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las gtso bo'i gnas dngade'i mdun du paX las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ gtso bo'i gdan pad zla'i steng du saX las seng ge sngon po mgo bo g.yas su bstan zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa/ ral pa dmar ser grol ba nyal stabs su gnas pa'i steng du/ pad nyi la gnas pa'i dhīXyig gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog can dang /gdan mdun ma'i steng du hruXyig sngo sangs sa bon de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun 'jam dbyangs sku mdog li khri'i phung po lta bu phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i mtheb mdzub kyi bar nas byung ba ut+pa la'i sdong bu snyan g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng g.yas na ral gri dang g.yon na glegs bam can/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho dang ldan pa/ dbu skra zur phud lnga dang bcas shing / zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis seng ge la bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhi ba dang 'dzum pa dang sgeg pa'i cha lugs can/ mdun du 'phags ma dbyangs can ma sku mdog in+d+ra ni la ltar sngo ba lha mo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs shing / zhabs tsog pu'i phyed krung gis bzhugs pa/ bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis sal kyang zhing mtshan nyid gzhan thams cad yab dang mtshungs pa'o/ /gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ ye shes sems dpa' dang dbang go lha badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX oṃ badzi bha wa a hi khiñtsa hūX/ yab yum gnyis ka la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ —65—

khyoXdhī ma me ti pa sā ra swa sti/ mnyu shrī/ muX hiX pradzñā wa rna ni khyi:dhīXswāhā/ zhes rtsi nusasu bzla/ 'jug tu lha sku mi dmigs par sbyangs shing dge ba bsngo/ lhun mtshams su 'jam dpal gyi sku gzugs la mchod bstod gang 'grub bya/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gtor ma'ang 'bul/ bsnyen pa lan gcig thon nas/ sgrub rdzas su dpa' bo'i ril bu sgrub ste/ spang rgyan gla rtsi mtshal dkar gsum/ /yung ba tsan dan a ka sa /spang spos a ka ru shu dag gsum/ /shing mngar rgya skyegs a ru ra/ /dpa' bo bcu gnyis bsdus pa ni/ /zhib par btanas la sbrang rtsi dang / /ba dmar 'o mas ril bur bya/ /zhes pa ltar yin la/ dar dkar la rgya skyegs dang rang byung gis pho 'khor bris pa la steng nas bkab/ dar dmar la ba la dang yur bas mo 'khor bris te 'og tu bting / gnyis ka'ang rtsibs brgyad dam 'dab brgyad/ mu khyud gsum pa/ mu khyud la ā li kā li ye dhar dang bcas pa bri/ ril bu dbyangs can ma bskyed cing sgrub/ skye rna ya mun+ta ka hūX gis bar chad bzung /'di'i rjes gnang gi lag len ni/ maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dmar ser can bri/ der bum pa kha rgyan can/ shar du 'jam dpal gyi tsa ka li/ ltor dpa' bo'i ril bu/ nub tu mtshan brjod/ byang du ral gri rnams bkod/ mdun du mchod gtor bsgrigs/ bdag bskyed sngon bzhin byas la mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mas/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhāX las bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su paX las pad+ma nas/ dbu rgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed bzhi bris sku dhīXlas 'jam dbyangs zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa/ril bu hiXlas dbyangs can ma po ti ā li kā li byung ba'i mtshan brjod kyi glegs bam/ ral gri dhī:las byung ba'i phyag mtshan ye shes kyi me 'bar ba rnams su gyur/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/ /sogs kyis bstod/ mdun gyi rten thams cad la dmigs la bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ gtor ma bsangs—66—

sbyangs/ a las byung ba'i ka pā la'i nang du gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba lasabyung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ ā hu ha ho khyi zhes lan bdun gyis byin gyisabarlabs/ snying po'i mthar a kā ro btags la lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsowab btab/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ rnam rje 'dzin pa sogs gsol btab dang / yan lag bdun pa spyi dang 'dra/ sku'i rjes gnang la sku bskyed bstim spyi dang 'dra zhing / de nas/ sangs rgya bro / kun gyis byin rlabs pa/ /rgyu bzang rin chen bum pa 'di/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs su byin rlabs nas/ /mi bskyod chu yis dbang bskur ro/ /snying po'i mthar a bhi khiñtsa zhesabatags la chu dbang bskur/ tsa ka li spyi bor bzhag tshig rkang dang po dang gsum pa gnyis 'dra ba las/gnyis par/ dbyibs legs ga khu/gas sku dam pa 'di/ /zhes dang / bzhi par/ rnam snangasku yis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes 'tho pa spo zhing sngags kyang 'dra/ sku'i rjes gnang tho/ /debazhi du ril bu sbyin la/ dpa' bo bcu gnyis sbyar ba'i bcud/ /dbyangs can lha mozhes dang / rin 'byung yon tan dbang bskur ro/ /zhes 'don pa spo/ yon tan gyi rjesaganang ngo / /po ti gto la/ rgyud kun gyi ni bdag po mchog/ā li kā lir zhes dbādapag med gsung gi zhes 'don pa spo/ bar 'dir bzlas lung spyi dang ma lhun par sbyin pa las/rjes zlos lan nyer gcig byed/ ā li kā li dpag tu med pa mgrin par thim par bsam/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo / /ral gri gto la/ shes rab ral gri rnon po 'di/ /ye shes sems dpar zhes dang / phyag mtshan thugs kyi dbang bskur ro/ /zhes 'don pa spo/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo / /yang maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba btab/ yangaslob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi dpral ba nas/ dbyangs can dkar mo dpag tu med pa spros slob ma'i dpral bar thim/ de bzhin du mgrin pa nas dmar mo/—67—

snying ga nas sngon mo/ lte ba nas ser mo/ gsang gnas nas ljang khu rnams spros te/ slob ma'i gsang bar thim pa'i bar dmigs pa rnams phog ste 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo / /rjes kyi bya ba thams cad ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /yang mngon rtogs ca zad rgyasapar byed na/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs nas phyag 'tshal mchod pa yan lag bdun pa rnams byed cing /gshegs su gsol ba rnams spyi dang 'dra/ ye shes pa dang dbang lha la yang mchod pa 'bul zhing / rgyasabatab kyi rjes su mchod bstod rgyas pa dang / bzlas pa'i rjes su yang mchod bstod byed pa lag len yin no/ /mchog tu ngo mtshar sgrub pa'i thabs/ /kun las zab cing dga' bar bsngags/ /gsang rnying yi ge phung po las/ /don ston snyid swor blangs pa 'di'o/ /dam pa sangs rgyas kyi thugs dam lha'i gan bo 'jam dpal smra seng gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// /khijam dbyangs/ dam pa/ kha che gu phya ba/ glan sgom yab sras/ bla ma 'od shaka slob dpon 'od zer mgon/ slob dpon shaka gzhon/ spyan snga bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ 'khon bzod pa dpal/ 'khon bsod nams 'od zer/ 'khon sher mgon/ shar pa ngor chen/dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /glud swā sti/ rgyal ba sras bcas mkhyen pa'i dngos/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la rab btud nas/ /zla 'byung sbas pa'i sgrub thabs bzhin/ /shes rab 'khor lo'i man ngag bshad/ /skyabasasmos sngon du bto / snying 'od kyi gur khang du gyur dbus su zla ba la dhīXde'i 'od kyis ma cer 'os rgya mtsho'i tsho gis rnams badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaX nas shaga'i bar gyisamachod/ rdo rje gur nas 'byung ba ltar bdun rnam dag dang / tshad med bzhi spyi dang ma lhun par bsgom/ stong pa nyid kyi don bsam zhing / swa bhā was sngags dang / shā n+ya tā gnyis brjod/ stong pa'i nga pa lasapaX las pad+ma dang a las zla ba la dhīXlas ral gri'i yu ba dang rtse mor rdo rjes —68—

mtshan pa dhīXs brgyan pa/ de'i 'od kyis snod gzhal yas khang bcud 'jam dpal du gyur/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa mkhas grub thams cad kyi byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas tshur bsdus yongs su gyur pa las 'jam dbyangs dkar po phyag g.yas ral gri dkar po 'phyar zhing /g.yon thugs kar gtad pas po ti dang 'khor los mtshan pa'i ut+pal bsnamasapa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ 'jam dpal zhi ba'i mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i thugs kar zla ba la 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar yang dhīXrtsibs brgyad la sngags 'bru brgyad/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min nas ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod cing gsol ba btab/ dzaXspyiXbaX hoX snying ga'i dhīXl thim pas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpar gyur/ de'i thugs kar yang zla ba la dhīXting nge 'dzin sems dpa' 'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gyi spro bsdu dang lha sku snang stong la sems gto/ bzlas pa'i tshe lte ba mi 'khor rtsibs 'khor zhing / 'khor lo yig 'bru bsnol mar 'khor ba la sems gtad la/ glu( a ra pa cang na dhīXhuX zhes 'bru 'bum bzla'o/ /rtags spyi dang mtshungs pa las/ thun mong ma yin pa ni gza' pa sangs shar ba mthong ba'o/ /mthar rjes gzhig gi rim pas 'od gsal du bsdus nas/ sdang ba'i tshe dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ mgron spyan drangs/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīXbā ling gro hā kha kha ji hi ji hi/ zhes pas phul/ mchod bstod sogs 'jam dbyangs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang spyin par 'dod na/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga rgyas pa byang chub gzhung las sogs nas 'byung ba 'grub na rab min na'ang maṇ+ḍal bshams la/ zhing khams su mos/ tshom bu bkod de gdan du mos/ mchod pa sna lnga bzang du 4nam/ bshos gtsang gtor ma dang mchod pa'i —69—

maṇ+ḍal yang bshams/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang ma lhun/ gong ltar bdag bskyed kyi mthar bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ mdun bskyed kyang bdag bskyed kyi rigs 'gre zhing / mchod bstod gtor 'bul bzlas pa rnams bya/ 'grub na cha gsum gtor ma'ang btang / slob ma'i don du gsol ba drag tu btab/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ bgegs sbyang ba de'i sdig sgrib sbyang ba spyi dang mthun/ maṇ+ḍal phul/'gro rnams bsgral 'dod sogs kyi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ rdo rje 'jin pa dgongasasu gsol/ sogs kyis gsol ba lan gsum btab/ slob ma sems dpa' sum su skad cig gis bskyed pa'i snying gar sngags 'khore phyi rol du ā li kā lisabaskor ba bsgom/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar yang de bzhin du bsgom pa mu tig gi 'phreng ba ltar zhal nas 'thon te slob ma'i snying ga'i de la bstim/ rjes slosalan gsum/ bcom ldan bdag gi sogs byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung bya/ de nyid lan gsum bskyar zhing / 'jug tu yi go brgya pa lan gsum gyis brtan bzhugs bya/ rjes spyi dang mthun no/ /shesarab sgrub thabs bla med pa/ /kun nas dga' ba'i man ngag ni/ /shin tu mang ba'i snyid bho tsam/ /bkod 'di'ang blo gsal yid bde'i gnas/ kha che paṇa chen gyi man ngag 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅m+bi/ /o swā sti/ dga' ldan gnas kyi 'khor los bsgyur/ /lha rgyal drang srong chen po'i tshul/ /rgyal tshab mi pham chos kyi rjer/ /bshud nas sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sdu sog sa smo rdo/ gser mas mtshan dog pa / / yongs su de'i 'od / gyur sgyu kyi' rdo khri ༷ ༷ ma mo bla / shad gi parang nyid ༷ khro ༵ ༷ /—70—

byams pa gser mdog mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyag g.yas thugs kar chos 'chad dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag gi tshul gyi klu shing gi yal ga'i rtsa ba bzung zhing me tog snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na ril ba spyi blugs dang bcas pa/ ral pa'i cod pan gyi ngos la mchod rten gyis spras pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab cing tshangs skud can rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang zin po che'i rgyan can/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la d+ma de las 'od zer 'phros/ dga' ldan gyi gnas nas ye shes semasadapa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX ga bon gyi mthar sngags kyis 'phreng ba bsgoms te/ oṃd+ma mai tri ye swāhā/ 'bum phrag bcu rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa yin la/ tso ( ma ti ma ti 'e ti grwa twa zhesabazlas pas shes rab phun sum tshogs pa bskyed pa dang / oṃ mo hi mo hi mahā mo hi swāhā/ zhesabazlas pas 'gro don wo por 'gyur ro/ /rjes tshad med bzhi yun ring du bsgoms nas smon lam bto/thun mtshams su phyag mchod dang / byams pa'i mtshan brgya dang / dam bcas pa'i gzungs 'don pa'am klog gzhan yang chos spyod 'phel zhing / tshul khrims dag pa la gtsang sbra dang ldan pas 'grub na/ rtagasarnams myur du 'byung zhing / spyir ni byin rlabs shin tu che'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ spyi'i cho gas rigs 'gre zhing /rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyis gsol btab dang / 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sogs kyi skyabs sems lan gsum 'jin/ rgyun bshags mi dgos thugs kyi rjes gnang phyag mtshan bstim pa yin/ 'di la yi dam gyi gtor chog mi dgos shing / spro na cha gsum gtor ma gtong ngo / /byams pa'i sgrub thabs kun gyi phul/ /byin rlabs bka' babs dga' ba'i tog/ni ri ti pa'i rgya gzhung ni/ /zhal gdams bcas pa'i snying po 'di'o/ /byams pa'i sgrubs thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /—71—

༄༅// /glu6snya sti/ spros bral nam mkha'i rdo rje ni/ /rgyal ba skyed mdzad lha mo'i tshul/ /shesarab pha rol phyin btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ paX las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du rang nyid skad cig gis phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung / phyag dang po gnyis chos 'chad dang mnyam bzhag 'og ma gnyis po ti dang 'phreng ba/ lha mo'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar a dkar po/ rtsibs rnams la g.yas bskor gyis/ ta bya thā/ ga te/ ga te/ pa ra ga te/ pa ra saX ga te/ bo dhi swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags tshan drug gis bskor ba/ a las ce(da 'phro se/ ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX yan lag bdun pa gang yang rung ba zhig khyab las/ bzang spyod ltar mdzad pa gon che/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ dzaXhuX baX hoXrang la thim/ sku snang stong / gsung grag stong / thugs rig stong / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rjes kun nas bslangs ste/ gong gi sngags 'di nyid drag tu bzlas pas/rang dang rigs drug gi sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam/ 'jug tu dge babathothun mtshams su sher phyin gyi mdo klog po ti la phyag mchod dang mtshan brgya 'don pa sogs bya/ 'di la rjes gnang mi dgos/ sgom lung tsam gyis chog go /'di dang phyogs mtshungs pa zhig bka' gdamasalugs la'ang gnang mod kyi/ 'di ni bi byā khya ta de wa dang / bud+dhā shrī nas brgyud pa'o/ /kun nas ngo mtshar sher phyin gyi/ /sgrub thabs zab cing ches dga' ba/ /'di la snying nas nyams len byos/ /blos gros—72—

gsal po skye bar 'gyur/ /sher phyin ser mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅// /oṃ snya sti/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /rab dkar shes rab lha mo'i tshul/ /shes rab pha rol phyin dngos la/ /gus par brtsad nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du bto / oṃ shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ rkeng pa'i ngang las sdong bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dkar po'i steng du/ slar yang pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma gsum pa la gnas pa'i a las zla ba/ de'i steng du rang sems o dkar po 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba las pad+ma dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra g.yon ngos su 'khyil ba/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i phyag mthil g.yas la pad+ma dkar po dang g.yon las dmar po'i rtsa ba skyes shing snyan gnyis kyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti bzhugs pa/ sked skabs phra zhing nu 'phur rgyas pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ / thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad kyi nye bar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar yang pad zla la oṃ dkar po ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'o/ / dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' dbang gi lha dang bcas pa badz+ra sa—73—

mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX dam ye gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oX badz+re bha wa a bhi dzi myu huX/ zhes gsungs zhing dbang bskur ro/ /'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ dbang ni lha rnams kyang rang la thim/ ar+ghaX nasasha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ye shes shes rab pha rol phyin/ /'phags pa thams cad bskyed byed yum/ /de la gus pas phyag 'tsha'o/ 'e1/ /zhes bstod/ 'khor lo'i bzlas pa'am/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā wa rna ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha wadha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri/ so / wadha ni swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzlag lhun 'jog khar lha sku stong nyid du sbyangs/ dzinas gsum byin gyisabarlabs nas dgob bsngo'o/ /thun mtshams su shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo bklag pa dang /mtshan brgya ci nus su 'don pa sogs dge ba la 'bad/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ dri bzang dang ba byung gi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du/ bris 'bur gyi sku gzugs sam/ med na tshom bu zhig bkod/ mdun du mchod gtor bshams la/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang ma lhun/ maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/bhāX las maṇ+ḍal gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i dbus su tshom bu pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan du gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX pad+ma ka la ye stuX/gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ gong bzhi mchod bstod byas la/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las byuX las byung ba'i rin po che'i gtor snod yangs par/ oṃ āXhūX las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha ho hiX ṣ+ka po'i mthar ā kā ro btags pas lan lngas phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod dang 'dod don gsol btab sogs rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /grangs bsnyen bzhi 'bum du bshad kyang 'bum phrag bcu gnyis—74—

dus zla ba drug gi bar du bya/ sgrub pa dang las sbyor rgyud las shes par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang zur bka'i lugs yin mod kyis/ rjes gnang gi cho ga sku bskyed bstim/ gsung lung gsum/ thugs phyag mtshan bstim pa rnams spyi dang 'dra la/ khyad par ni bzlas lung mtshan brgya'i lung klog pa nyid yin no/ /kun dga'i grags ldan 'ga' cig gis/ /sgrub thabs 'khrul bar sbyar mthong nas/ /'khrul med snying sto mdor bsdus tsam/ /bsnyen pa'i bya ba 'di ltar smras/ /sher phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅rti/ /o swā sti/ 'jig rten mgon pos rnam sprul zhing / /'jam dbyangs mgon dang dbyer med pa/ /dbyangs can mgon la gus btud nas/ /blo dman mgon du sgrub thabs bri/ /paṇ+ḍita brnya shrī nas brgyud pa'i man ngag 'di la/ rang dbyangs can mar gsal ba'i snying gar lha las/'od zer 'phros/ dbyangs can mas thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa mā dza tse( byu4phya hi/ badz+ra de bi mahā tsakra sa mā ya gi/ sa ma ya dza ar+gha nasashasta'i bar gyis mchod/ blo gros bskyed par gsol ba bto pas/ rang gi snying gar thim/ zin po che sna bzhi'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus/ rang nyid dbyangs can mar gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dang zhal gsum dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ral gri dang ut+pal/ 'og ma gnyis kyis pi wa bsgreng pa/ pad zla la rdorje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho la bab pa/ dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa/ thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hrī'adab ma brgyad la dbyangs bcu drug g.yas skor yig 'bru rnams ral gri phyed pa'i gdan la gnas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra de lī pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā wadhe hi hu/ zhes—75—

'bum phrag gsum bzla bar gsungs na'ang bcu gnyis bzla'o/ /lhun zhabs su lha sku lte ba'i 'khor lo la bsdu/ de yang sdiXl bsdu/ bsnyen pa song bas gzhung las bshad pa'i las tshogis rnams sgrub tu rung ba yin/ 'di la gtor chog mi dgos/ gzhan rjes gnang gi bya ba sogs ni spyi dang 'dra/ thugs kyi rjesaganang phyag mtshan bstim pa nyid la mdzad do/ /dbyangs can kun las phyag bzhi'i skur/ /ston mdzad sgrub thabs rnyed dka' ba/ /blo gros mchog gi dga' ston can/ /sgrub thabs snyid sto'i yi ge'o/ /slob dpon zla ba gzhon nu'i lugs dbyangs can ma phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu sa bla ma dang ni lha mo la/ /gad nas sgra dbyangs lha slo yi/ /mngon rtogs shin tu mdor bsdus pa/ /mdo tsam rnam par bkod par bya/ /dbyangs can ma dmar mo bsgom par 'dod pas/ rang gi mdun du ba'i lci ba'i maṇ+ḍal bya/ rdza bum gtsang mar gzhon nu ma'i chu blug/bum rdzasabazang ba gis ra dang yongs grags rnams me long du bsres te gzhug dar leb rgan gyis bkab bo/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas hrīXlas rang nyid dbyangs can ma dmar mo/ phyag g.yas na nor bu/ g.yon me long bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa/zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i bzhugs pa'i thugs kar khyiXsngags kyis bskor ba/skye rna su ra swo ste hri hri hri swāhā/ lhun 'jog khar bdag bskyed kyi lha mo bum pa'i nang du bzhugs parabasam/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ byasapas gzhan thams cad kyi blo gros phrogs nas rang la thim par bsam/ dkar gtor bsangs sbyangs/rin po che'i snod du 'bru gsum las bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ sngags snying i mthar i daX bā li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul/ 'di blo gros bskyedaspul ches myur/ bsnyen sgrub thon nas bum chu 'thung ngo / /mngon rtogs rgyas pa bsgom par 'dod na/ yi go—76—

rnying pa 'ga' zhig tu shes par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed na/ gtsang sbra shin tu che ba'i ngang nas/ maṇ+ḍal pad ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi steng du bum pa bca'/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bgegs gtor gyi tshul dang / gzhi bdag gtor ma'ang spyi dang mthun par btang / mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed sngar bzhin bsgom nas/ mdun bskyed bum pa bskyed chog spyi dang ma lhun/ bum pa'i nang du bdag bskyed bzhin lha mo bskyed la bzlas pa bya/ar+gha la sogs pas mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ de nas slob ma'i bya ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa dang / skyabs sems rgyas bsdus long skabs dang sbyar/ sangs rgyas / kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon khyod kyis lha mo yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngosasdo/ba dang / /byin gyis brlab/ pa stsa'/ du gso rnal/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/slo0ma dam tshig pa 'jam dbyangs dmar ser du skad cig gis bskyed pa la/ ye shes pa dbyangs can lha mor bstim/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ snying po'i mthar ji ltar bltams pa sogs brjod/ lha mo'i/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung stospyi bor thim/ gsung bzlas lung spyi dang 'dra/ thugs rjesagazhig gi rim pas stong pa nyid du bsdu ba mdzad/ lhag ma spyi dang 'dra'o/ /dbyangs can sgrub thabs ma lusapa/ kun las bab cing dga' ba'i tog/snying swo mdor bsdus yi ge bkod/ /dge des blo gros mtshungasamed shog/dbyangs can ma dmar mo sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ sgrub thabs zin chen 'byung gnas las/ shes rab kyi lha'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bcu gnyis pa'o/ /zhus dag /༄༅༅/ /glu(khyu sti/ ma lus bgegs rnams nyams pa dang / /phyi yi bar chad bsrung ba'i mchog /rdo rje phag mo'i pho nya mo/ /'od zer can mas bdag srungs shig/'dir slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug ni/ dgra sogs phyi yi bar chad zhi ba'i phyir 'od zer can ma dang / gdon bgegs—77—
