sogs nang gi bar chad zhi ba'i phyir mi g.yo ba sngon po pus btsugs dang / nad zhi ba'i phyir lha mosangasargyas spyan ma dang / rmi lam ngan pa sogs bar chad bzlog pa'i phyir/ spyan ras gzigs yi ge phyed dang bzhi pa dang / tshe bsgrub pa'i phyir thub pa me ru shi ṣa dang / sdig sgrib sbyang ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa'i bsgom bzlas te drug las/ dang po 'od zer can ma'i gzungs 'don thabs ni/ snga dro shar dang / dgong mo nub tu gdong phyogs shing / nyin mo snang byed nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / mtshan mo snang byed zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan bsgom pa blo yul tu nges par byas nas/ skyabs sems sngon du btang byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya bcas te/ rang gi snying gar snang byed kyi dkyil 'khorwa ra la oṃ/de las 'od 'phros/ rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can/ ba sbu'i bu ga nas 'od 'phros/ 'od zer dkar po'i rwa ba zlum po rtse mo mchod rten gyi rnam pa can du gyur/ byang chub mchoge/ gi phyag rgya bcas la/ snying gar snang byed kyi dkyil 'khore la ma las mya ngan med kyi yal ga ma gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las 'od zer can ma gser mdog skem pa'i lus can/ g.yas khab dang g.yon skud pa bsnams pa/ mnyam par bzhengs par gyur/ sna bug g.yas pa nas phyir spros mdun du bzhugs/ rang 'dra'i pho nya mo dpag tu med pa sprul/gnod byed rnams dbang med du bkug ste/ kha mig btsems/ yan lag bcings nas rwa ba'i phyi rol 'obs kyi nang du 'phangs par bsam/ gzungs kyi tshwa chung tshar gcig 'don/ lha mo 'od zer can gyi snying po brjod par bya ste zhes pa nas swā hwa'i bar lan bdun brjod/ de nas phyag rgya bshig la ci bder byas/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang bstun te/ 'od zer can sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te snying gar thim pa las/ rang nyid lha mo 'od zer can gser —78—

mdog sgeg cing mdzes pa/ g.yas mchog spyin dang / g.yon myang ngan med pa'i shing gi sdong po las yal ga gcig 'dzin pa/ yid tsam khro ba/ dar dang rin po tshes brgyan pa/ phag ser po bzhis drangs pa'i shing rta la rol pa'i bzhugs pa/rang dang phag las 'od byung / phag 'jigs rung dpag tu med pa sprul/ 'obs kyi nang gi gnod byed rnams zos shing / lhag ma gser gyi sa gzhir gyur/ phag rnams gdong phyir bstan pas rwa bar gyur/ o mā ri s+t+ya maX swāhā/ gang 'grub bzla/mthar bdag bskyed kyi lha la mchod bstod bya/ mi dmigs par bzhag la dgob bsngo/ gtor ma ni dkar ga sto ba4sa sbyangs/ bhuX las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba lasagator ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āXhūX lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rangagi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan pa'i 'od zer can ma badz+ra sa mā dzaX pad+ma ka ma la ye stuX/ oṃ mā ri dzhai de wi sa pa ri lha re khyuX zhes pa la a kā blo( btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/gang gis mtshan tsam 'dzin zhing dran pas kyang / /'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob byed cing / /dri med bde chen nye bar stsol ba yi/ /lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshogs gsol rnams spyi dang mthun/ 'di la nges par rjes gnang dgosashing / 'on kyang rjes gnang gi bya ba ni sgrub thabs brgya rtsa bzhin no/ /gsung bzlas lung gi mthar gzungs mdo klog dgos so/ /rgyal ba kun gyi pho nya mo/ /dga' chen 'od zer can sgrub thabs/ /gzungasalas 'byung ba ngo mtshar can/ snying po'i yi go 'di tsam lags/ /'di'i lam bsrung la sogs pa khyad par gyi las tshogs ni/ yig rnying las shes par bya'o/ /rdorje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug las/ phyi'i bar —79—

chad sel ba gzungs las 'byung 'od zer can ma'i skub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅’/ /skyed swā sti/ ston pa go rta shākya'i tog/de la btud nas de sgrub thabs/ /ri rtse brtsegs pa 'od kyi rgyal/ /gzugs sngags sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /nam langs ma thag tu khrus byas shar du phyogs pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa gser mdog byang chub shing gi rtsa bar skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yon chos gos kyi dra nye ba'i thad kar bzung ba/ g.yas skyabs sbyin no/ /ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/mtshan mchoge ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal/ /sogs kyis bstod/ phyag spyi bor bzhag pasa'achi med tsho dngo༅spyab stsol bar bsam/ na mo bha ga wa te/ me ru shi ṣa ra kū ṭa prabha rādzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ a rta te sa myaklaX rte ya/ ta du thā/ o me ru me ru mahā me ru ye swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa bzlas/ 'od du zhu rang la thim pas rang yang thub par gyur/sngags cung zad gcig bzla/ stong par sbyangs la dge ba bsngo/ dmigs kyis bkar nas tshe sgrub byed na/nyin mtshan tsi nus bzla ba yin no/ /dam tshig tu gzhan la gsang / 'di la bzlas lung gis chog pa'i lugs kyang yod la/ rjes gnang ltar na snab thabs brgya rtsa bzhin no/ /mkhas rmongs kun la grags chung yang / /shin tu zab phyir yid dga'i gnas/ /sbas te snying nas bsgrubs gyur na/ /tshe ni mchog tu ring sto gyur/ /rdorje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug las/ /tshe ring po sgrub pa thub pa me ru shi ṣa'i sgrub thabs kyisale tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅’/ /glu ste swā sti/ 'jig rten mgon la rab btud nas/ /nad dang sdug bsngal zhi byed phyir/ /rmi lam ngan pa'ang bzlog gyur la/ /tshe sgrub mchog gyur spund par bya/ /skyabs sems stong nyid —80—

sgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi mdun du skad cig gis spyan ras gzigs sku mdogadakar po na bza' sngon po gsol ba/ g.yas skyabs spyin dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ changs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa/ thugs kar zla ba la sngags/kyi 'che/nga ba gsal btab te/ mos gus kyi gdung ba chen pos/ skye( a ro lika /ces lan gcig brjod la/ a ro lika ces pa nyid brgya rtsa bzla'o/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyis sngags glu( can gcig gis 'go drangs nas/ gzhan brgya brgya bzla ba nyid ci nus su bya'o/ /mthar bdag gi sdig sgrib sbyong ba dang / bar chad zhi bar gsol ba drag tu btab pas 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rnam smin gyi lus sbyangs te 'od kyi rang bzhin gyi lha skur gyur/ de yang mi dmigasapar sbyangs te cung zad mnyam par bzhag dge ba bsngo/ rmi lam du dge slong chos gos sngon po gyon pas lung ston pa sogs 'byung ngo / /'di la bzlas lung tsam mdzad pe'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ rjes gnang ltar byed na/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra'o/ /kun la ming yang ma grags pa/ /man ngag shin tu dga' ba'i tog/dzi tā ri dang ba ri ba'i/ thugs dam sgyid bho mchog gyur lags/ /rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug las/ rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa spyan ras gzigs yi ge phyed dang bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /glu khe swā sti/ zhi ba'i las sgrub gtsor gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas spyan la gus btud nas/ /nad zhi rims sogs bzlog pa'i phyir/ /de yi sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /skyabs 'gro semasabaskyed sngon du bto nas/ shā n+ya tus stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la rang sems la yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid sangs rgyas spyan ma sku mdog dkar mo phyag g.yas pas 'khore lo mig 'bras kyis mtshan pa dang / g.yon pas pad+ma —81 —

dkar po 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dkar po can/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du laX/ de las 'os 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXskyoX baX hoX snying ga zla ba la sngags 'phreng sa bon ming yig dang bcas pa bsgom/ oṃ ru ru sbu sa dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnyi lo tsa ne/ sarba ar+sha sa dha ni ma ma shān+ti ku ru swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlag ar+ghaṃ nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ spyan ni zhe borardelo mdzes ma ste/ /'chi ba slong bar byed pa'i mchog/bdag cag sdug bsngal gyur ba la/ /lha mo khyod kyis bskyab par mjodi/ /dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ 'di'i las tshogasabar chad zhi byed maṇ+ḍal nad 'don sogs ni yig rnying du shes par bya/ rjes gnang ni sgrub thabs brgya rtsasarigs 'gre'o/ /rigs sngags rgyal mo bde gshogs ma/ /kun gyi thog mar rab dga' ba/ /spyan ma'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum las/ bsnyen pa tsam zhig snying por bris/ /rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug las nad zhi bar byed pa sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sgrub thabs kyis le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /skyed swā sti/ dkyil 'khor kun tu zhugs pa dang / /rigs sngags kun gyi gzhir gyudapa/ /sdig sgrib mtha' dag sbyong ba'i thabs/ /dam tshig gsum bkod sgrub thabs bshad/ /gtsang sbra dang bsnyen gnas kyi cho ga la gnas pa'i sgo nas 'di nyid kyi gris sku'am/ ma 'byor na thub pa'i dbang po'i sku gzugs bris 'bur gang yang rung ba stegs bu la bzhag gtsang sbra can gyis mchod pa rgya cher bshams/stan dma' ba la pus mo btsugs pa'i tshul gyis 'dug sto mchod pa rnams spyi dang mthun par byin gyisabarlab pa'am/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ sems bskyed tshad med bzhi dang sbrel ba sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun du rin po che'i khri pad+ma'i gdan dang bcas paragyur/ bdug spos 'thul zhing / ma lung / sems can ma'i mthar rdo rje bsdams pa las/ gung mo —82—

gnyis bsgreng zhing rtse mo sbyar/ mthe bong gnyis mnyam par brkyang ba rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya g.yab cing / oṃ ta thā ga to bha ga wān/ oṃ hre hi/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po byon te gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ ar+ghaX nas shaga'i bar gyisamachod/ mgon po thugs rje che sogs kyis bstod/ bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun patshar snyog bya/ bcom ldan dam tshig gsum bkod ni/ /gser mdog rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs/ /tshangs spyod cha byad chos gos bsnams/ /phyag g.yon chos gos dra 'dzin zhing / /gnyis kar thugs kar chos 'chad mdzad/ /thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /gsang sngags yi ge brgya pa bzhugs/ /na ma ste ya dhi kā nāX/ sarba ta thā ga tā naX/ sarba tra a pra ti ha ta bsti/ dharma tā bā li nāX/ oṃ a sam sa ma sa mo rto/ ā na nā bsti sha sa ni ha ra ha ra/ sma ra sma ra ṇa bi ga ta ra ga bud+dhā dharma te sma ra sma ra/ sa ma ba la/ ha sa ha sa/tā ya bhā ya/ ga ga na mahā ba ra lak+ṣa ṇi/ dz+wa la dz+wa la na sa ga re swāhā/ zhes rtsi nusa.ubazlas pa'i mthar mchod bstod byas te/ oṃ khyod kyi sems can sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra muXzhes gshegs su gsol/ de ltar na sngags 'bum tsam bzlas pa'i mthar/ zla ba yar ngo zhig la phyag mchod lan bdun pa re'i mthar sngags re bzla/ thun re re bzhin lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bya ba nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du bya ba yin no/ /des rmi lam du zhal ston zhing sdig pa dag pa'i rtags 'byung la/lan gcig la ma byung kyang / zla smad la sngar bzhin bsnyen pa byas la lan gsum bskyar bas 'grub nges pa yin no/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra/ sdig sbyong kun las ches zab pa yig brgya'i man nga gar ba dga' 'di/ /rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam gyi/ /snying sto yin zhes mkhas pa bsngags/rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa'i sdig sbyong go cho gar —83—

grags pa dam tshig gsum bkod gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bstogasum pa'o/ /༄༅shā/ /o swā sti/ rje bas rig byed lha mo la/ /btud nas de yi sgrub thabs kyi/ /mchog tu grags pa lha lnga dang / /rjes 'brel cho ga'i khyad par bshad/ /'di la sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi bya ba gnyis las/ dang po'i skabs su/ re las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lha chen dbang phyug dang u ma bsnol ba'i gdan/ de'i steng du rā hu la nag po mda' gzhu 'dzin pa kha bub tu bskyel ba la sdiXlas utu la dmar po sdiXs mtshan pa las 'od zer lcags kyu sogs zhes dang / me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa'o/ /spyodang / shar du ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ lho ru ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ nub tu ni las pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ byang du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu rnams ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭāX ga thod pa 'dzin pa gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /spyi bor hiXlas khro bo rta mgrin dmar po dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub can/ de'i thugs kar hiXdang rta mgo'i mdun du bla ma'i sku gzugs kyis brgyan pa/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma 'dab bzhi la rig byed ma lha lnga dang / khro rgyal rta mgrin bla mar bcas pa/ gtso mo'i thugs kar hiXyig gi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar yang rang rang gi sa bon/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ zhogasogs bya/ lha tswangabaskur ba mi dgos/ bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hiXhūX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ tso( āXhūXhri hri hri ha ri ni sa hri dzaX.a kar+ṣa ya hūX dzaX ba su wa shaX ku ru a du sha hri wa shaX ku ru huX huX dza dzaX zhes drag tu bzla'o/ /—84—

— gnyis pa'i skabs su maṇ+ḍal pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad/ thod pa chang gis gang ba/ si rgya ra'i dkyil 'khor/ chos 'byung pad+ma 'dab bzhi/ sa bon dang bcas pa bris pa rnams brtsegs/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ po 'gro gtor ma bto gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gtor 'bul yan chad song nas/ bum pa gnyis bshams la/ gcig tu ku ru kul+le lha lnga dang / gcig tu rta mgrin skad cig gis bskyed la/ bzlas pa cung zad bya/ mchod bstod bya zhi pa/ bum nang gi lha 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsir gyur/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bcad/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ rgyun bshags rigs lnga'i sdom bzung / mig dar bcings me tog gto/ las bum gyi chu dang / oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gro wa huXphaṭa kyis bgegs bskrad/ 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi lce la bzhag de nas yol ba bsal/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig/rje btsun rig byed ma bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba bto/ slob ma'i snying gar pad+ma 'dab bzhi sabon lnga dang bcas pa bsgom du bcug la/ rig byed ma dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te bstim/ oṃ ku ru kulbe hriXtri'iXhriX.a be sha ya hri hri hri/ zhes drag tu bzlas me tog phul/ badz+ra tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu badz+ra/ zhes mig dar phye/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob ma rig byed ma daslatshig sems dpa' gtso rkyang la snying ga'i lha lnga dang / spyi bo'i rta mgrin yongs su rdzogs pa skad cig gis bskyed/ oṃ a bhi khiñtsa tu maX sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+re bha wa a bhi khri3ni huX zhes brjod cing dbang bskur/dbu rgyan spyi bor gtso/sa/ sngags de nyid brjod/ phyag mtshan bzhi po gto la/ thabs shes mda' dang gzhu sbyar bkang byas la/ /mi shes nad sel ma rig dbug par bya/ /ut+pal mdzes pa lha mo'i phyag mtshan nyid/ /de ring bu khyod la ni spyin par bya/ /mi shes 'dam nas 'dren mdzad pa/ /rgyal ba'i phyag mtshan lcags kyu bzung zhes—85—

dang /rigs lnga'i phyag sgon gto la/rdo rje 'bor lo rin po che//pad+ma rdo rje rgya gram rnams//mkha' 'gro rnams kyi phyag mdzad de//de ring khyod kyis bzung bar bya/mkha' 'gro rtag tu byin rlob 'gyur//oṃ ḍā ki nī sarba a bhi khirtsi sri sarba ta thā ga ta sam ya hu/de nas bzlas lung spyi dang mas par sbyin/snying po'i mthar rdo rje'i ming ba khas la ming dbang bskur te/bum dbang ngo //maṇ+ḍal dbus kyi ka pā la'i bdud rtsi spyin te gsang dbang /gnasagasum du gis ra'i thig le byas te lha rnams bstim pa sher dbang ngo //stong pa nyid la mnyam par 'jog tu bcug dbang bzhi pa'o//rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang 'dra'o//'di la 'khor mkha' 'gro bzhi pa bskyed pa ni/phag mo lha lnga'i 'dres yin no//zhes mkhyen ldan dam pa rnams bzhed kyang /yig rnying phal cher na yod pa dang /deng sang lag len byed pa'i grags pa dbang btsan par byos nas 'dir bkod pa yin no//dā na hi las 'o bi ba'i//man ngag kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal//sa skya paṇa chen la gnang ba'i/snying po mdo tsam bkod pa yin//ku ru kul+le gsang sgrub tu grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no////༄༅༅//glu ste swā sti/ye shes lha mo sgrol ma dang //las kyi lha mo la btud nas//shin tu za0rdepar grags pa yi//dbang gi las la nyer mkho bshad//dpal mo snying gog ser thig can du grags pa'i sgrub pa las sbyor gyi rim pa yig rnying las shes par bya ba dang /'dir bsnyen pa tsam dang rjes gnang gi tshe nye bar mkho ba'i dbang du byas te cung zad brjod na/tsan dan dmar pos byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum rtse mo rang la bstan pa/dbus su me tog dmar po'i tshom bu bya/logs gcig tu bum pa yang bshams/mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang /gnas yo byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/hwa/ n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/pa las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du/tī las sna yi/la tī gis mtshan pa'i 'phro rde86

'du las/ rang nyid sgrol ma sku mdog ljang khu g.yas skyabs spyin/ g.yon ut+pa la/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi rol pas bzhugs pa/ ye shes sems(dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX thugs kar pad zla'i steng du tāX la sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba bsgoms la/ oṃ tā re snyostu re tu re swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /ra tshe bskyes ba4sa sbyangs/ pad zla'i steng du hiXyig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ lha mo ku ru kul+le dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis mda' gzhu/ 'og ma gnyis lcags kyu dang ut+pal/ g.yon brkyang gi gar stabs can/ de'i thugs ka rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar pad zla la sgruXye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX oṃ ku ru kul+le lhaXswāhā/ bsgrub bya a kar+ṣa ya dzaX zhes ci 'grub bzla'o/ /bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ bum pa'i nang du skad cig gis rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma/ de'i steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma/ shar du gang bzang dkar po/ rin po tshes mtshan pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ lhor tshogs bdag ser po rin po che dang gser gyi ga'u bsnams pa/ nub tu rnam sras dmar po rin po che dang ljon shing / byang du 'a la nag po rin po che dang ne'u le/ shar lhor dbang gi sgrol ma ljang khu rin po che dang utrul/ lho nub tu ku ru kul+le dmar mo ut+pal dang nor bus mtshan pa'i lcags kyu/ nub byang du nor rgyun ma ser mo rin po che dang 'phreng ba/ dbang ldan du gdugs dkar mo rin po che dang des mtshan pa'i pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /sgrol ma dang ku ru kulbe'i snying po la a kā ro ba kha4rga ༅ gsum gyis 'bul/de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyud bshags bya/ rje btsun —87—

rjes chags rnal 'byor ma/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba skyobs/ /rig byed ma yi byin brlab pa/ /bdag la nye bar stsal du gso le// /zhes lan gsum gsol babato/ sgrol ma'i sku'i rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra bar byas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas sposapa'i ku ru kul+le slob ma la bstim pas/ slob ma ku ru kul+le gyur pa la ye shes pa bcug dril bu dang bcas pa'i rol mo'i sgra bya/ ku ru kul+le pra be sha ya huX/ wa shaX ku ru ho/zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad brjod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan par bya/ sngags kyi bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ slob ma ku ru kul+le sems dpa' gsum brtsegs/ de'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros te/ khams gsum gyi 'gro ba thams cad kyi snying nang nas sems kyi ngo bo a dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa bkug ste/slob ma'i gnas gsum du/ rol mo dang sngags gong bzhi/ de bzhi du snod kyi 'jig rten gyi bcud dang / sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyang bsdu/ re re bzhi rol mo dngasngags gong bzhin/ mthar lha sku rjes gzhig gi rim pas 'od gsal du bsdu ba'i dmigs pa 'bogs/slob ma dang mdun bskyed kyi rjes ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'gro kun dbang bsdud gdams nga gces/ /gnyan lo'i gdams ngag dga' bar grags/ /gong bsnyen tsam dang rjes gnang gi /snying sto'i yi ger ngo mtshar smad/ /dmar chung skor gsum du grags pa las/ dpal mo snying gi gser thig gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅rti/ /o swā sti/ rdorje phag mo la twad nas/ /de yi bka' nyan pho nya mo/ /nor rgyun dmar mor grags pa yi/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang cung zad 4gad/ /'di'i bsnyen pa dang las sbyor ni/yig rnying ji lta ba bzhin yin la/ 'di'i rjes gnang dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs ni/ maṇ+ḍal khru gang pa ba —88

byung dang dri bzang gis byugs pa zhig la ra khrag gis chos 'byung gru gsum du bris/ nang chag chag btab/dbus su me tog dmar po'i tshom bu gcig dang / maṇ+ḍal gyi tha mar me tog dmar po'i tshom bu nyi shu rtsa gcig dgod/ mdun du gtor ma shas brgyan pa dang / gtor mar brtse gram gyi khrag gis sbran pa dang gzhan yang mchod pa spyi dang ma lhun par bsham/ phag mo gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus kyi tshom bu skad cig gis lha mo nor rgyun ma dmar mo nyi ma la brkyang bskum kyis bzhugs pa/ g.yas rin po che'i snye ma dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ 'dzum khro sgrub pa po la dgyes pas lta ba/lang tsho la bab cing rin po che dang rus pas brgyan pa'o/ /mtha' skor gyi i ga gosame tog re blangs la dbus ma la 'bul zhing sngags rje brjod/ tshul des nyer gcig song ba na snying po'i mthar i da bā ling ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ zhes btags pa lan bdun gyis gtor ma bstab/dmar gyi ar+gha nas gtor zhing sngags kyi mthar ar+gha na ma zhes brjod/ mchod pa gzhan rnams yid kyis phul/ sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla ba nyid bstod pa yin no/ /sngags ni/ a ya bhi bhi/ bhu ṭibha sna/ ka ma ra ska ma/ sā ma pā ti/ sarba wi si ti/ ku ru ṇi re/ ga sa zhes pa'o/ /de nas lung blang ba ni/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal zhig phul la/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ mdun bskyed kyi lha mo gsal btab la/ slob dpon gyis sngags brjod/ slob mas me tog lan nyi shu rtsa gcig 'bul/ slob ma lha mor bskyed/ sngags kyi bzlas lung spyi dang ma lhun par sbyin/ slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/mdun bskyed kyi me tog gi tshom bu kha gsos la/ gong bzhin me tog dang ar+gha phul/ ca ru swa bhā wā na/ zhes rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ dbang sdud kun las myur ro zhes/ /dga' bar bsngags mod snyib sto'i don/ /sgom pa rnams la mi dgos kyang / /blo dman rjes su bzung phyir yin/ /nor rgyun ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /—89—

༄༅༅/ /tsho( snya sti/ shes rab mar bcas he ru kar/ /btud nas de yi pho nya mo/ /dusamatshan dmar mo'i rnam 'phrul ni/ /lha mo ti nu'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /bde mchog yab yum gang rung gi bsnyen pa sngon du song ba zhig gis/ mdun du gis ra'i maṇ+ḍal la lhe bar bsgom rgyu'i sngags 'khor lta bu zhig bri/ me tog dmar po dang chang dang mchod pa sna lnga bsham/ sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sngon du song nas/ rang skad cig gis lha mo ti nu sku mdog dmar mo g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs can pad zla la bzhugs pa/ khro zhing sgeg pa/ rus pa'i rgyan can no/ /lte bar zla ba la dbus su khyi shar du sa/ lho ru hi/ nub tu kabyang du la/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal gyi gnas su yang sngags kyi 'khor lo yig 'khru rnams lha'i rang bzhin du grub par gyur/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas sngags 'bru bkug la bsnyem pa yid kyis bya/ mdun gyi yi ge lnga char la mtheb srin gyis chang dang me tog blangs la gtor/ lte ba'i khyi las sngags 'phreng thol thol 'ong bar bsams la/ sa hi ka la hri zhesabazla'o/ /de ltar sngags 'bum phrag nyi shus 'di'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa yin no/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad pa'i steng du mañdzi la thod pa chang gis bkang ba/de'i steng du sri rdzo ra'i sngags 'khor/ de'i steng du bris sku zhig bkod/ mdun bskyed mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las bdag bskyed bzhi lha mor bskyed/ gong bzhi me tog dang chang gis mchod/slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ gang gi drin sogs dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /bdag la lha mo ti nu yi/ /rjes su gnang —90—

ba stsal du gsol/ /lan gsum/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum/ slob ma lha mor bskyed/ slob dpon gyi srin lag g.yon pas mdun gyi bdud rtsi nas blangs/ slob ma'i dpral bar thig le lan gsum bya/ sngags brjod cing nang mchod lan gsum sbyin/ mdun gyi lha mo'i bha ga las rak+ta byung ste 'thungs pas lus gang bar mos su 'jug lha mo las lha mo byung / slob ma'i dpral bar thim/ sngags kyi mthar skye( mang du brjod/ maṇ+ḍal gyi yig 'bru las srin lag g.yon pas gis ra blangs te/ slob ma'i mgrin par thig le bya/ lha mo'i lte ba'i yi ge rnams lha mo'i ri mgrin par thim par bsam/ sngags kyi mthar a mang du brjod/ dril bu dkrol/ 'gro kun chags pas 'od du zhu/ slob ma'i snying gar dkrol bas de thams cad slob ma la thim/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas lha mo byung ste snying gar thim/ sngags kyi mthar huX mang du bzla zhing / dril bu de slob mas 'khrol du gzhug rjes su bzlas pa'i lung dgabyin gyis brlabs pa'i lung spyi dang 'dra ba las/ sngags 'khor lte bar byed pa dang / slob dpon dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka'i zhal nas byung ba/ slob ma'i khar nyis sbrag gi tshul gyis byung bar sgom pa ni khyad par ro/ /rjes kyi bya ba yang spyi dang 'dra'o/ /kun du gab pa'i man ngag ni/ /gsal bar bstan na dga' spro skye/ /snying nas las tshogs sgrub na ko /gsong swor smra la 'dun pa skye/ /lha mo ti nu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅’/ /cha swā sti/ rdo rje phag mo'i bdag nyid can/ /zil gnon mthu stobs dpag tu med/ /thod pa rgyan zhes bya ba yi/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gtso la 'dud/ /'di'i sgrub thabs ni/ thog mar stong nyid bsgom/ de nas snying rje bsgom/ de nas rang gi snying gar oṃ las 'od 'phros don —91 —

gnyis byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las sngags kyi sgra dang bcas pa lha mo'i skur gyur ba ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum seng ge'i gdong can ral pa 'phyar ba/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po gri gug gnyis pa ral gri 'phyar ba/g.yon gyi dang po thod khrag zhal du gsol ba/ gnyis pa kha ṭāX rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du/ mkha' 'gro sde lngas btegs pa'i rin po che'i gdan mi ro bsnol ba dang bcas pa'i steng du g.yon brkyang ba'i phyed krung can/ snying gi nang du sngags kyi yi ge g.yas su 'khor ba/ de las 'od 'phros/'dod khamang cad mar/ brta/gas khams dkar/ gzu/gas med khams khan ga gi sems can rnams kyi srog rtsa zhal du bcug snying khrag zhal du gsol bas/ sgrib pa dag cing skye 'chi rtsad nas bcad par gyur/ oṃ du kha ye na ma/ zhes zla ba phyedadubazla'o/ /denas de la oṃ ha ra ṇi sa āXri ni sa ha huX ni ha sa ri/ zhes pa btags la zhagabadun bzlas pas mi dang mi ma yin dbang du 'du/ bdud tshogs zin gyis gnon/ mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin du 'du ba yin no/ /thod pa mtshan ldan du dkar gtor chang gis brgyan pa kha rang la bstan pa zhig bsham/'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying po la ji hi btanas pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ phud me la bsreg cing lhag ma za'o/ /dpung pa gnyis su seng ge ral pa dkrug pa/mkhal logs gnyis su stag mo mi ro za ba/ brla sgang gnyis su sbrul nag kha nas me 'bar ba bsgoms nas/ las la sbyor ba yin no/ /'di'i to nge 'dzin gyi dbang ni tshogs 'khor bzang ba po gam/ nyon mongs dug gsum dbang du bsdu/ /rig pa nam mkha'i dbyings dang bsre/ /lha sku je che je bstim bya/ /'dzab bzlas bya zhing gtor dbang bskur/ /dam rdzas tshogs la rol —92—

bar bya/ /zhes pa ltar te/ bla ma'i man nga galas shes par bya'o/ /pad+ma'i man nga gag nyan ston gyis/ /legs grub kun du zhal gzigs pa'i/ /zil gnon sgrub thabs rab dga' ba/ snying po mdo tsam bris pa yin/ /rje btsun ma thod pa rgyan gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /glud swā sti/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje las/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes sprul/ /'phrin las myur sgrub dbang gis las/ /mchog stsol ma la gus pas 'dud/ /yig drug gi bsnyen pa sngon du song ba zhig gis skyabs sems tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun pa'i rjes su/ rang gi snying gar hiXdamar po/ de'i 'od kyis lus khar/ 'od du zhu ba las rang nyid gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyis pad+ma la bzhugs pa/ khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams can/g.yas dang po gri gug 'og ma ral gri/ g.yon dang po thod khrag 'og ma rtse gsum gyis mtshan pa'i kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa/ gcer bu skra grol mgo 'phreng dang rusargyan can/ mkha' 'gro rigs bzhis gdan gyi phyogs bzhi nas 'degs pa/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud pa/ thugs kar spyan ras gzigs dmar po mu tig gi 'phreng ba dang pad+ma 'dzin pa zla gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /thugs kar sa bon dang sngags 'phreng gsal btab la/ om ṇi pad+me huX/ oṃ dhu ma gha yi na ma swāhā/oṃ ha mi ni sar tsa hri ya/ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis gyi gyis brlabs/ rang gi mdun du skad cig gis mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes 'khor / dang bcas pa bzhugs par gyur/ sngags kyi mthar i daX bā li ta kha kha ji hi khā+e hi/ —93—

zhes pa btags pa lan lngas bdag mdun gyi lhaganyis char la phul/ ar+gha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/rdo rje mi 'chi 'dod chags che/ /mi rtog nam mkha'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen po'i sku sprul pa/ /lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shesani/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas la bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'dod don gsol ba bto/ mdun bskyed rang gi snying gar thim/ ranganyid mi dmigs par byas la/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di la dbang rjes ༅nga sogs mi dgos/ sgom lung phog pa nyid kyis chog go /kun nas zab pa pad+ma'i gsung / /'di la brten nas las tshogasarnams/ /dga' bas bsgrubs nas myur 'grub ste/ /snying po'i sgrub thabs 'di tsam yin/ /'di ni bsnyen pa tsam ste/ me mchod la sogs pa las tshogs mang du yod do/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ dbang sdud kyi lha'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bcu bzhi pa'o/ /dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅’/ /tso tshe snya sti/ ma lus rgyal ba'i thugs rdo rje/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i skur bstan nas/ /bdud bzhi'i stobs 'joms las bzhi sgrub/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms la 'dud do/ /skyabs semasasngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying gar pad nyi la hū ljang sngon de las 'od 'phros/ lusagang / sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sna bug nas phyir 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dza oṃ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+gha nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/dkon mchoge gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ sems can —94—

thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshad med bzhi bsgogasu bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dang raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ khruX las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la huX gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba dra ba gur bla bre/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/ hūX ljang sngon las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la huX ljang sngon gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/zhal khrom 'dzum gyi rnam pa can/ mtshe ba'i myu gu cung zad gcigs pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shang / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/gzi brdzid mtha' yas pa mnga' zhing / ma lus pa'i sprul pa 'chang ba'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin pa āX thugs kar huX/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra a du sha dzaX oṃ badz+ra pā sha huX/ oṃ badz+ra sbo ṭa baX/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha a/ slar yang snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khore dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra zhes sbyar te/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi khi ྅ rga/maX/—95—

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar blta mis pa nas shrī ye hū/ zhes dbang bskur/sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lha ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/slar yang ar+ghaṃ nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ 'di skad bdag gis nas smras rbe'i bar gleng gzhi tshar gcig bton/ gzungs kyi bzlas pa ci rigs par byed pa las/ gzungs yongs su rdzogs pa dang / nye snying kho na bzla ba gnyis 'dam ka las gzhan med par grags na'ang / rtsa sngags dang snying po nye snying gsum ji ltar rigs par bzlas pas chog go /'jugatu phan yon tshar gcig bton pa la/ ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ gong brgo mchod/ gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las/ /rdo rje'i rwa gur me dpung 'bar ba'i mthus/ /bdud bzhi'i stobs rnams rnam par 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag la da lnga(sa sdo/ba ma lus pa stsa'/ du garbe(la/ zhes gsol ba btab/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byo‘ra pa dang sogs bzod par gsol/ oṃ badz+ra mu zhes gi shogs su gsol/ rang nyid dam tshig par gsal ba'i gnas gsum du yi go 'bru gsum bkod/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ rjes gnang gi bya ba dngos ni/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra la/ 'on kyang bum chog dang sbrel bar 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad tshom bu dang bcas pa'i steng du bum pa bsham pa'am/ ma 'grub na bum gdan ci bde ba la bum pa kha rgyan dung chos chur bcas/gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas pa bkod/ spro na de nyid la dgos mchod kyang spun ma/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed song ba'i mtshams sam/ mdun bskyed dang bum bskyed lhan cig tu byas kyang chog ste/ gang ltar yang —96—

mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i gang la paX las pad+ma dang/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhuX las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lto ba yangs shing mgrin pa phra ba mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyi mgul cings dang ldan pa/ dpag bsam kyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan zhes pa nas/ dbu rgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed nyid 'don pa spos pa rung ba las/ khyad par ni/ ye shesapa badz+ra sa mā dzaX zhes spyan drangs pa'i rjes su/ ma lus sems can nas yongs dag 'khore dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi da ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra e phya hi/ zhes brjod/ de nas mchod bstod byas la/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste dmigs pa dang bcas pas gzungs mdo 'don cing bzlas pa byed tshul bdag bskyed kyis rigs 'gre/mthar bum pa'i lha la mchod bstod dang / ma 'byor pa dang sogs bzod gsol bya/ badz+ra muXzhes ye shes pa gshegs/ dung chos kyi chu blug mchod yon phul bas dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ste bum pa'i chur gyur zhes brjod/ de nas 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor 'bul dang / 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma cha gsum bzhin du btang / slob ma'i bya ba'i skabs/ rjes gnang dngos gzhi song mtshams su/ bkru byabasabasrung gsum bya ste/ 'di skad bdag gis nas/ nye snying yan chad rdzogs par bton mtshams nye snying gi mthar/ sarba pā paX shwarnyi du ru swāhā/ de bzhi du sbyar te/ sarba zhe/ sarba ro lgasarba du giX/ sarba dz+wa re/ sarba u pa dra be/ sarba a ka la mṛ tu/ sarba dur sob ni/sarba dur mi ti/ sarba tsit+ta ku le zlaX shān+ti ku ru swāhā/ zhes bum pa'i chus slob ma la khrus bya zhing / mthar kha spug la lo/ /de bzhin du rma bya'i mdongs sogs kyis byabs te/ shān+ti ku ru sruhwa'i dod du a pa na ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de nas bsrung ba bya ste/ re re'i mthar rak+ṣa rak+ṣa —97—

zhes brjod cing / spyi bo snying gsog phrag dpung pa g.yas g.yon/ dpyi g.yas g.yon rnams la rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag nas/ mthar rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /'gro ba 'di la bdag gis bsrungs zin gyi/ /'di la sus kyang gnod par ma byed cig /ces brjod la me tog dor snya /rol mo dang bcas pa'i bkra shis bya'o/ /de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs dam tshig khas blangs/gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas sogs yon dbul/ dge ba bsngo/ mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa kha gsos nas byin gyis brlabs te/ mchod bstod/ gsol btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegasagasol/ smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /'di re bzlas lung gi skabs long skabs med cing mi spro ba dang /rgyun gyi nyams len bdag bskyed skabs dang rgyas pa mi lcogs na/ na ma shu lha1badz+ra kro bhā ya/ hu lu hu lu/ je tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+ta ban+ta/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te huX phaṭa/ ces nye snying snyog pu bzlasapas chog cing / bkru byabs bsrung gsum dang bral ba'i rjes gnang kho na yang skabs su bab pa dag la sbyin pa dang / bsdu na sngon 'gro tshogs zhing tshogs bsag rnams kyang bor bas rung ngo / /rnam 'jomasamathing kar grags pa'i lugs kyang cho ga'i bya ba 'di kho na la/ bcom ldan 'das sku mdog mthing nag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing / g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs can/ stag lpags dang sbrul gyi rgyan can/ medapung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /phyogs bcur skad cig tsam gyis sprul pa'i khro bo bcu rang dang mtshungs pa'i rnam pa can no/ /zhesabaskyed pa ni khyad par ro/ /'di la gtor ma'i chog rnal 'byor rgyud ltar byed pa'i lugs kyang yod/ rnam pa gcig tu na 'jig rten 'das gtor med kyang chog pas ci bde bar bya'o/ /mkhas rmongs kun la cher grags shing / /sngags rgyud ngo mtshar dga' ba'i tog/gzungs sngags snyib bho'i byin rlabs can/ /sgrub —98—

thabs mdor bsdus e ma ho/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa ljang sngon gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅rti/ /o swā sti/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i dngos/ /gsang ba'i bdag po thugs lasasprul/ /de la btud nas de'i sgrub thabs/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig bri bar bya/ /de la gnas yid du 'ong bar ras bris dgram/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir maṇ+ḍal bya/ dbus kyi maṇ+ḍal du bum pa spyi dang mthun par bca'/ mchod pa dang gtor ma cha bzhi dang / bkra shis kyi rdzas kyang tshogs tshad bsham/ mchod pa yang rgya cher bsham/ shar gyi maṇ+ḍal du mañdzi la rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gzugs bzhags ngas rgyas kyi ras bris kyang dgram/ phyogs gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal la gzungs mdo'i glegs bam re bzhag cing / maṇ+ḍal bzhi po la yang mchod pa tshar re bsham/ dung chos su snying po'i sngags kyis bsangs chu bsgrubs/ gnas dang yo byad la bgegs sbyang ba lag len spyi dang mthun par byas la/ bsangs chus gtor/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lor mos/gnas yo byin rlabs spyi dang ma lhun par byas la/ shar gyi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying gnas 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa rdo rje rnam 'dzoms kyi tsho gos dang bcas pa spyan drangs par mos la/ ma lus sems can ma brjod/mchodi/ sku1na phal cher sogs sngags dang phyag rgyas mchod pa 'bul/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ skyabasa'agro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams spyi dang mthun par brjod/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la huX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/rang nyid rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu pa thugs kar gtod pa/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ mche ba cung zad brtsigasashing / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi —99—

rgyab yol can no/ /thugs kar zla ba la rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i nye bar zla ba'i steng du hū/ de'i mtha' skor du sngags kyis yongs su bskor bar mos/ ye shes pa bstimaspuspyi dang 'dra/ bdag bskyed la dbang bskur mi mdzad/ rtsa sngags snying po nye snying gsum gang nus su bzla/mdun bskyed bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ bum par bskyed la/ de'i nang du dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ dbang bskur te mi bskyod pas rgyas 'dibs/ dbus kyi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ a rgyu nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ rnam 'joms spyi dang mas pa'i bstod pas bstod/ gzhan sgrub pa po dam tshig ldan pa gsum gyis phyogs gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng gi gzungasamado klog cing / slob dpon gyis gzungs thag nas bzung la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa nagasmras so/ /zhes pa'i bar lan gcig brjod/ sngags gsum po gang nus bzlas la/ mthar phan yon tshar gcig brjod/ phyogs gsum gyi klog mkhan rnams kyis mdo yongs rdzogs skyar gyin 'don pa yin pa la/ nyer gcig 'don na re res bdun bdun bya/ yang na brgyad brgyad dam so drug so drug 'don/ de dag gomathar re res mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ bum pa'i lha la dmigs nas mchod bstod byed/ bum pa'i lha la 'dod don gsol ba btab/ slob ma rjes bzung bya bar 'dod na skabs 'dir bya ste/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ yan lag bdun pa gang 'os zhig bya/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol sogs kyi gso5ba btang/ bgegs sbyangs ba dang / sdig pa sbyang ba byas pa'i rjes su bkru byabs bsrung gsum sogs byed lugs rnam 'joms ljang sngon dang 'dra ba las/ dmigs pa'i khyad par bum nang gi lha las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bkru ba sogs byed cing / he phu phu zhes pa'i skabs su khro bo phur bu thogs pa dpagatu med pa spros te/ bar chad dang bgegs thams cad phur bus btab par bsam/ de dag gi mthar lha sku bsgom pa'i rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra ba las/ ye shes pa bstim pa'i mthar/ slar yang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ de dag gi mthar bzlas lung sgyin/ de la slob mas gang la — 100—

lung len pa'i mdun bskyed de/ shar gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gzugs las byed pa 'di'i khyad chos yin/rjes gnang gi rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ slar mchod pa rnams kha gsos te rjes chog byed tshul spyi dang 'dra ba las/ bum pa'i lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ shar gyi sku gzugs la rab gnasabyed/ de nas las rjes mi mngon par byas te/ smon lam dang bkra shis rgya cher bya'o/ /kun nas gru dang dmar gyi lugs/ /lag len ngo mtshar dga' ba'i phul/ /shin tu mang ba'i yig tshogs las/ /snying po tsam zhig bkod pa lags/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms dkar po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyasa'aphel/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru we/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin bcas la/ /gus pas yongs su bco nasade'i/ /gsung dang gong ma'i man ngag bzhin/ /kun la nyer mkho'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /gang zhig bgegasa'ajoms par 'dod pa dang / bsnyen pa thams cad kyi sngon du nye bar mkho ba'i phyir/ dpal sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi man ngag ltar/ bgegs mthar byed kyi man ngag bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems spyi dang mas/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i skyoX/ de'i 'od kyis bla ma dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung du/ /zhes sogs rgyun zug gas bya/ gal te de tsam mi lcog na/ dkon mchog/ gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/sngos bya/ shā n+ya sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du huX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang khu'am/ nag po zhal gsum phyag drug rtsa zhal sku lus dang mtshungs shing /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang snang gi yum la —101—

'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje nag po kha gyes pa dang ral gri/g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum pas bdud sdig can chung ma dang bcas pa dang / g.yon brkyang bas tshogs bdag mnan pa/ spyan gsum/ skra ser stag lpags kyi sham thabs so gos khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs shing / klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra bcings pa/ 'jog po dmar pos rna rgyan byas pa/ rigs ldan khra bos dpung pa brgyan zhing / dung skyong ser pos phyag gdub byas pa/ pad+ma dkar pos mgul ba brgyan zhing / stobs rgyu ljang khus mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ nor rgyas kyi bu bdud rtsi'i kha dog lta bus skor gas byas shing / pad+ma chen po dkar pos zhabs gdub byas pa/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ āXrna krita hūX hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing ga4pa bar bskyed do/ /mig tuk+ṣi/ rna bar dzi/ sna la khaX/ lce la ge dpral bar skaX/ nye bar saX/ dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoXganyis su med par thim/rang gi snying gar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūX/ dbang go lha 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ badz+re bhā wa a gi tiñtsa hūX/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ bzlas pa ni/to nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od zer 'phro 'du la sems gto de/ oṃ āXbirtswan+ta krita huX phaṭa/ ces pa nye snying dang / oṃ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha rnge/ ban+ta ban+ta/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ a mṛ te hūX phaṭa/ ces pa —102—

snying po dang / oṃ hu lu hu lu/ sta tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+ta ban+ta/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ ga rdza ga rdza/ bi sbo ṭa ya/ bi sbo ṭa ya/ sarba bisnan bi na ya ka na mahā ga na pa ti dzi wi tan+ta kā ra ya huX phaṭa/ ces pa ni/ rtsa ba'i sngags chung ba'o/ /na maXs man+ta kā ya lha ka tsit+ta badz+re ṇaX/ na mo mahā badz+ra kro bhā ya/ mahā do sno ta ka ṭa bhe ra wā ya/ a si mu sa la pa ra shu pa sha hasta ya/ oX a rdzita kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha ji hi ji hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ man chad brjod ma thag pa ste/ rtsa sngags che ba'o/ /'di rnams re res bsnyen pa rdzogs par byed na/ grangs ni rim pas 'bum phrag soganyis/ bcu drug brgyad/ bzhi rnams yin la/ thams cad sdoms pas byed na/ 'bum phrag brgyad/ bzhi/ gnyis/ gcig rnams so/ /lhun mtshams su dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /gtor ma nye snying gis bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bdud rtsi lnga'i phung po/ hūX bhuX aX dzi khaX gisamatshan pa/ de rnams 'od du zhu ba las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ 'bru gsum lan lngas byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i lha tsho gis badz+ra sa mā dzaX gyi po'i mthar pañtsa a mṛ ta āXguXlan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'jigs pa'i huX sgra nges sgrog cing / /sogs kyis bstod/ mchodi sbyin gtor ma sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba bto/ yigabargya bzlas/ ma 'byor ra pa dang sogs/ khyed kyis sems can sogs/ smon lam dang bkra shisagang 'grub bya/ bsnyen pa mthar phyin nas sgom pa dang / bris pa'i srung ba dang / las bzhi'i sbyin bsregaser ba srung ba/ sri'u gsob sogs gong ma rnams kyis man ngag las 'byung ba'i las tshogs rnams dang /gzhan yang gsang 'dus sgyu dra rdo rje gur rnams las 'byung ba'i las tshogs rnams dang / gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi nas gsungs pa'i bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i las thams cad sgrub pa la dbang ngo / /'di nyid ngo bo —103—

gsang ba'i bdag po yin pa'i phyir/ gsang bdag gi sngags rgyud las 'byung ba'i las tshogs mtha' dag kyang sgrub pa la dbang bar mngon no/ khyad par 'di'i bsnyen pa sngon du song bas/ lha gzhan ci lta bu bsgrubs kyang de dang de'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum la bar du gcod pa mi 'byung zhing / rang gzhan gyi bgegs bsrung ba'i thabs 'gran zla med pa'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang lag len spyi dang 'dra'o/ khro bo'i lus can kun gyi rgyal/ /gang de'i sgrub thabasarig 'dzin mchog/dga' skyed shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /snyid pos yi gol ma du byas/ /zhes pa ni khro bo bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅgal/ /༄༅shā/ /o swā sti/ cha med kun 'gro chos kyi dbyings/ /bde stong zung 'jug lhan skyesasku/ /dus kyi 'khor lo la btud nas/ /nad kun zhi byed sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du song nas/ shā n+ya tu'i sngags don ba45/ rang gi snying gar pa las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du dzi dkar po'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs yum zla ba nor bu'i 'od ltar sku mdog dkar ba zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yas mchog spyin dang / g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i rtsa ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar 'dzin pa/'dab brgya snyan drung du rgyas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar gyi na bza' dkar pos spras pa/ zhabs rdorje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / zla 'od 'phro ba/ rdorje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can no/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hu/ lte bar ho sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad yeshes sems dpa'i tshul du oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza hu ba ho hi/ gnyis su med par —104—

gyur/ mdor bsdu na/ rdo rje bzhi byin gyis rlabs pa dang / ye shes bstim pa med kyang chog go /snying gar zla ba la rlu gyi mthar sngags kyis 'phreng bas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/sangs rgyas thams cad sna rdzos yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas snying ga'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ rang gzhan gyi nad gdon sdug bsngal thams cad zhi zhing / tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rgyas par gyur/ oṃ rlu bi shwa mā taX badz+ra kaṇ+ḍa kaX nā sha ya/ nā sha ya/ ma ma sa rnyi ku ru ku ru swāhā/ ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar/ skye( rlu bi shwa mā tā badz+ra ar+ghaX āXhuX/ shaga'i bar spyi dang mthun par mchodapa'am/ yang na mchod pa bcu gnyis bya/ phra rab rdul gyi cho khro/ nyid 'das/ /zhes sogs sam/sangs rgyas kun gyis bskyed mdzad ma/ /skye ba dang ni 'jig pa spangs/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa can/ /sna tshogs yum de la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bstod/ dge bstochub tu bsngo/'di'i rjes gnang ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad tshom bu can zhin byas la/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ sgrub tshul spyi dang 'dra/ gtor ma 'bul ba gcig du dgos pa ma yin kyang / phyis kyi lag len ltar byed na/ dus 'khor nyid kyi gtor chog ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ oṃ āXhuX hraXphaṭa kyis bsangs/ sbi bhā was sbyangs/ i rna āXhuX homaXs byin gyis brlabs/ snying po mthar 6gakā ro btanas te 'bul bar bya'o/ /rjes gnang gi ngo bo yang / sku bskyed bstim/ gsung bzlas lung /thugs phyag mtshan bstim pa rnams yin pas spyi dang 'dra la/ sngon 'gro rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyis gso la bto dang / gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags byed pa'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ rdo rje shugs kyi rjesaganang gi skabs dang mthun par byas na legs pa yin te/ dus 'khor lhan skyes dang / dze+e bha la ljang khu dang / dus 'khor rgyud lugs kyi khyung khra rnams la'ang de bzhin du godagos so/ /shin tu zab par rab —105—

grags pa/ /rgyud 'grel nyid las gsal ba'i phyir/ /mkhas pa kun gyi yid dga'i gnas/ /snying po mdor bsdus tsam zhig bris/ /sna tshogs yum dkar mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅’/ /skye( snya sti/ bla ma yi dam phyag 'os la/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag btsal nas/ /sosor 'brang ma sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rdo rje'i gur las 'byung bzhin bshad/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du so nas/ shā n+ya tas stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las sna tshogasapad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du rang sems traX yig dkar po las/ rang nyid sosor 'brang ma sku mdog dkar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon 'khor lo dkar po thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis zlum po'i stabs sa kyas bzhugs pa/ sgegs cing 'dzum pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaXdzaXhuX baX hoX dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+re bha wa a sgyi ṣañtsa hūX/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ spros bsdu'i dmigs pa gsal bto la/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+re ṇi mahā pra ti sma re huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci nusasu bzlas shing / mthar mkha' nang nas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku dpag tu med pa sprul/sems can gyi don byas par bsams la nyer gcig bzla/ 'dod don gsol ba bto/dgob bsngo/ sa mtshams su mchod gtor gla med spyi dang mas pa'i byin rlabs mdor bsdus zhig bya/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX pad+ma ka ma la ye stuX/ snying po'i mthar a kā robatags pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/rdo rje sems dpa'i —106—

rang bzhin can/ /chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /dung dang kun+da zla ba'i 'od/ /so sor 'brang ma la phyag 'tshal/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba yang / rjes gnang spyi'i cho ga las zur khyad med cing / thugs kyi rjesaganang la phyag mtshan bstim pa kho na yin no/ /nad pa la sogs pa 'ga' zhig gi don du bum pa bca' zhing / sbyang ba dang bcas pa'i bkru byab srung gsum bya ba yin la/ rjes gnang gi cho ga'i yan lag tu sbyar nas thob dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /kun las 'khyer bde bla med lugs/ /'dus gsal mchog tu dga' ba 'di/ /mnang ga snyid sto tsam blangs nas/ /rgyud don ji bzhin brjod pa yin/ /rdo rje gur las 'byung ba sosor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs kya le tshan no// //༄༅༅/ /tso'e swā sti/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor las/ /rab sprul phyir bzlog chen mo'i sku/ /gzhan gyis mi thub la btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ snya bha was stong par sbyangs/ pad nyi la gnas pa'i hu las sna tsho gi sordorje hu gis mtshan pa las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bar gyur ba'i dbus su/ bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad 'og tu mnan pa'i pad nyi'i gdan la rang sems gdugs dkar po o gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas gdugs dkar can gyi sngags kyi yig 'bru dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma sku mdog dkar mo/— 107—

dbu'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang bcas pa/ dbus dkar g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba'i zhal gsum la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas gsum na rdo rje mda' lcags kyu/ g.yon gsum na sdigs mdzub zhags pa gzhu/ lhag ma nyams sna tshogs can gyi dbu stong mnga' ba/phyag rgya ma nges pa sna tshogs pas rdo rje 'khor lo nor bu pad+ma ral gri mda' lcags kyu gzhu tho ba zhags pa la sogs pa mtsho ni cha sna tsho gis pa 'dzin pa'i phyag stong dang / sku lus kyi cha thams cad du khyab pa/ rnam 'gyur ma nges pa'i spyan bye ba brgya stong can/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /pho nya dang pho nya mo dang mchod pa'i spyin gyi 'od zer 'phro ba/ sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rim gro byed pa/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis mchod cing bstod la bka' sgrub pa'i sku can du gyur/'bring du na rtsa ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug tsam du gsal btab kyang rung / shin tu bsdu na skyabs spyin dang gdugs dkar po can bsgom/ dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ ye shes sems dpa' dang dbang go lha rnams spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaX la sogs sa mchod/ dzaXhuX baX hoX dam ye gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsal ba btab pas/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya lha ye hūX/ zhes dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu bu༅/ta bya thā/ oṃ a na le/ a na le/ kha sa me/ kha sa me/ be+e ra/ be+e ra so me so me/ sarba bzhi a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhispyi te/ sarba ta thā ga ta gi zhi ṣa si ta ta pa tre hūX phaṭa/ 108—

huX ma ma hūX ni swāhā/ zhes snying po nyid gang 'grub bzla'o/ /mthar ye shes pa mdun du bzhugs pa la/ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ phyir bzlog chen mo rigs sngags rgyal/ /gzhan gyis mithub stobs chen ma/ /gdugs dkar chen mo sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tsho gis bcas bstod/ /ces bstod bzod pa gsol zhing badz+ra muX zhesadzin gas su gsol/ 'di la 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor ma ni mi dgos so/ /byed par spro na/ dkar gtor a kā ros 'bul/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gtsang ma'i zas sna sna tshogs btab pa'i dkar gtor zhig dang / sha chang sgog tsong sogs sna tshogs kyi sbags pa'i dmar gtor zhig bshams/ sngagasadrug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs/ a kā ro lan bdun bdun gyis gtsang rigs rnams dang /'byung po rnams la sgyin/ de nas cha gsum gtor ma'ang gtong ngo / /thun mtshams su bris sku'i mdun du gzungs mdo ci nus su 'don pa'am klog go /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang gi cho ga nyid sbyar bar bya'o/ /rigasasngags kun las phyir bzlog pa/ /phun tshogs kun gyi dga' bskyed 'di/ /gdugs dkar sgrub thabs rgya mtsho yi/ /snyib stor mkhas rnams nges shes bskyed/ /gtsug tor gdugs dkar gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅rti/ /eXkha swā sti/ rnam 'phrul du ma mtha' yas pas/ /'gro ba'i nad gdon zhi mdzad pa/ /ri khrod ma la rab btud nas/ /sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri bar bya/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ /rang gi snying gar pad zla la paX/ de las 'od 'phros/ bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can gyi dbu brgyan pa'i lha mo ri khrod ma la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX na mo gu ru khyuX na maXpaṇ+ḍa sha — 109—

wa rī bzhi bo dhi satwa sa pā ri wā re khyoX zhes phyag 'tshal/ oṃ paṇ+ḍa sha wa ris pa riwā ra ar+ghaX pra ru swāhā/ nas shag āXhuX gi bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum labadag skyabs mchi sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ tso rdzo badz+ra muX zhes gshegs su gsol/sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs kyi tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ su bhā wa sku gos kyisastong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i ri bo me tog dang 'bras bus bgyon pa'i nags tshal sna tshogs dang bcas pa'i rtse mor paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang sems paX ser po las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa ma sna de/ sems can thams cad kyi nad dang sdug bsngal bsal/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod ma lo ma can sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gsum phyag drug rtsa zhal ser ba khrozhing sgeg pa'i nyams can/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing zhi ba/ g.yon zhal dmar zhing chags pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje gsor ba/ gnyis pas dgra sta/ gsum pas mda'/ g.yon gyi dang po rdo rje'i zhags pa dkris pa'i sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas me tog dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i shing lo gsar ba'i sbrang yab/ gsum pas gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas kyi rting pa gsang bar bstad cing / de nyid kyi pus mo dang g.yon gyi mthil gdan la brten pas phyed bzhengs kyi stabs kyi 'gying bag can/ dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang shing lo gsar pa bshibs pa'i smad g.yogs can/ rin po che dang me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sprul dkar pos se ral khar byas pa/dbu skra phyed bcings su byas shing / lang tsho gsar du bdo ba/ mdzes shing grim —110—

la cung zad khro ba'i nyams can/ 'bar ba'i 'od dpung mtha' yas pa dkris pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āXdamar po/ thugs kar hūX sngon po/ snying gi nang du nyi ma la gnas pa'i paX de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo ri khrod ma 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoXyang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX skye rdzo badz+ra ar+ghaX pra tismo swāhā nas/ sha snya āXhuX gis mchod/ de bzhin gde/gas pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sa ma ya shrī ye huX/ zhes gsungs shing / bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku lus thams cad gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi/ /cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul ba las byung ba/ /lha mo gang gi bsgrub pas nad gdon bgegs/ /kun tu zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bzlas pa ni/ oṃ pi sha rnyi paṇ+ḍa sha wa rdi hrī haXhūX phaṭa snyahāsnying po dang / oṃ pi sha rti paṇ+ḍa sha wa risarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ṇa ye swāhā/ zhes las sngagaso ci nus bzla zhing / shes shing spro na gzungs kyang bzla'o/ /thun 'jog khar bdag bskyed kyi lha la gsol ba btab cing / ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam la/ gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byore pa dang sogs bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can nas muX zhes gshogs su gsol/ rang nyid dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal tsam gyis co mtshams kyi bya ba'o/ /gtor ma dkar gtor a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar oṃ āXhūX las —111—

gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhūX lan bdun/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros lha mo ri khrod ma 'khore dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX zhes spyan drangs tho pi sha rtswa paṇ+ḍa sha wa rī sa pa ri wā ra i daX bā li gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya/ sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ṇa ye swāhā/ lan gsum gyis phul/ gong bzhi mchod bar+sā dang / mchod sbyin gtor ma nas kun 'grub shogagi bar gyis 'dod don gsol btab bya/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam rnamasakyang gong dang 'dra'o/ /de'i rjes gnang gi cho ga ni sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra la/ 'on kyang de'i rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa la/ 'dir sku'i rjes gnang dang / dngos gzhi lung gsum la gsung gi rjes gnang dang / rjesasnying gar lha bstim pa la thugs kyi rjes gnang go tha snyad mdzad pa ni/ zur bkar grags pa 'di'i khyad par yin zhing / bsnyen pa'i thun thun mtshams skabs dang / rjes gnang gi rjes chog gi skabs bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gong bzhin gshegs su gsol ba yang lag len gyi khyad par snang ngo / /rjes gnang gi rjes chog gi tshe/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa sngon du gshogs nas/ dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis rjes chog byed pa dang / mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog grub nas bdag bskyed gshegs pa dang / bdag bskyed kyi ye shesapa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod nas/ mchod bstod man chad chabs gcig tu byed pa'i lag len gsung snang ba/ dang po mi bde zhing / phyi ma gnyis po gang rung bya'o/ /'di lta bu'i sgrub mchod byed pa'i rigs la/ bdag mdun gyi bar du bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba'i lag len gyis deng sang sa steng khyab mod kyi/ shin tu nor ba yin pas mi bya la/ spyir cho ga'i yan lag gzhan thams cad bla med dang chog sgros lhun mong yin pa'i phyir/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshogs su gsol ba byed mi dgos mod/ ba ri lo ts+tsha ba tshun chad kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len yin zhing / 'di — 112—

nyid thugs la bzhag nas bdag bskyed sgrub thabs yod pa ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/zhes sgrog par mdzad pa yin no/ /'di'i mchon nas/ 'di rigs kyi sgrub thabs gong 'og thams cad la rigs 'gre bar bya'o/ /rgyal ba kun gyis byin rlabs pas/ /ri khrod lha mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ /nyung gsal dgas ba 'dir bshad kyi/ /snying po len 'dod rnams kyis long / /ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅/ /yo swā ste/ na mo gu sa bgegs dang bar chad kun 'joms pa'i/ /lha mo de la gus bshud nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba'i/ khyad par cung zad bshad par bya/ /ri khrod ma lom gyon ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs legs par shes par byas la/ lhag ma rigs bzhi po rnams la 'dor len cung zad tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur bas so sor bshad par bya ste/ de'i yang dmar mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs la/ sngon 'gro tsho gis bsag gi skabs bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can gyis dbu brgyan pa zhes pa'i dod du/ bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can gyis dbu brgyan zhes 'don pa spo/ bskyed chog gi skabs rang sems pa ser po'i dod pa dmar po/ zhal phyag gi skabs/ rang nyid ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis bgegs tshogs la bsnun zhing / g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ gnod byed thams cad la gzir ba/ dmar la zlum po'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba gtsigs pa/ sku thung stsokhe la dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ stag lpags dang rin po che dang / rus pa dang / sbrul gyis —113—

brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang ni stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes dang / rigs bdag gi skabs/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes 'osapaspo ba rnams khyad par ro/ /de bzhi du sngon mo la bla ma don yod grub pa'i rnam pa can gyi zhes dang / pa sngon po las zhes dang / rang nyid ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma sku mdog namamakha' ltar sngo sangs zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas kyi dang pos lha'i shing gi yal ga 'bras bu dang bcas pa 'dzin pas nad zhi bar mdzad pa/ gnyis pas dgra sta 'dzin pas gdug pa can la brdeg pa/ g.yon gyi dang po zhags pas bgegs rnams 'ching ba/ gnyis pas rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can 'dzin pas nad sel bar mdzad pa/ sgeg cing khro la rin po che dang rus pa dang sprul gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang / shing lo'i stod g.yogs can/ nyi ma'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can/ zhes pa dang / don yod grub pas dbu brgyan zhes pa rnams khyad par ro/ /ri ṅgadrag mo kaṅka la chibs pa'i sgrubs thabs la sngon 'gro tshogs bsag mi dgos/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ pad nyi'i gdan la pa nag po las ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dbu skra gyen brdzes cher khros pa'i nyams can/ stag lpags dang/ dar dang rin po tshes brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas na gcod pa'i dgra sta dang / g.yon shing lo gsar pa'i sbrang yab 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis 'dab chags ka ske'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /yan lag lhag maser mo'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ rnam snang gis dbu rgyan can no/ /sngags ni/ oṃ pi sha stsupaṇ+ḍa sha wa risarba ro ga tshe da ni hu phaṭa/ ces pa rnams khyad par ro/ /'di nyid sku mdog — 114—

dkar mo cung zad zhi ba'i nyams can du byed pa'ang yod do/ ljang khu'i sgrub thabs ni/ bshad ma thag pa 'di nyid las sa bon paX ljang khu/ rang nyid ri khrod ma sku mdog ljang khu zhi ba'i nyams can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rma bya'i sgro yab dang / g.yon sman sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i rol pas rma bya'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /lkog pa dang / rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan zhes pa dang / oX pi sha ā+o ཾ paṇ+ḍa sha wa risarba dz+wa ra su n+ti ruswāhā/ zhes bzla ba rnams khyad par ro/ /lhag ma sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi bya ba thams cad ser mo'i skabs ji lta ba bzhin no/ /kun nas mos pa tha dad rnams/ /dga' zhing gus pa'i rnam cha ni/ /sna tshogs 'di yang ngo mtshar ra/ /'dor len byed tshul snying po tsam/ /ri khrod ma rigs bzhi'i sgrub thabasakyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅rti/ /lkoX snya sti/ rgyal ba kun gyis byin brlabs pa/ /bgegs kun 'joms par mdzad pa mo/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo la bco nas/ /de yis sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang /stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du hūX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa las/ rang nyid rig pa'i rgyal mo gza' yum sku mdog dkar mo/ dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis cho se 'chad/ bar pa gnyis rdo rje dang pad+ma/ tha ma gnyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha rdzas kyi rgyan dang na bza' can sna// /gnas gsum byin rlabs ye shes dgug gzhug dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las/—115—

rnam snang gi dbu rgyan/ oṃ sarba bi bya huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa snying po dang / oṃ na mo bha gawa tī swāhā/ zhes pa nye snying gang nus su bzla/ bzlas pa tshar ba dang ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/gang gi mtshan tsam bzung bas kyang / /gza' dang rgyu skar gdon rnams kyi/ /nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi mdzad pa/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo khyod la bstod/ /cesabastod/ oṃ sarba bi bya badz+ra muX zhes ye shes pa skad gas/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ dkar gtor mchod pa dang bcas pa bsham/ glu( badz+ra ya ka hūX gis bsangs/ badz+ra dz+wa la'i sngags rgyas gangabar byas/ a kā ros bzhed don 'grub par byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zera'aphros/ rig pa'i rgyal mo gza' yum la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' gza' dang rgyu skar 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ sarba zi du sarba brnya bo dhi sa tā nāX/ sarba gra ha na k+ṣa tra/ sarba bhu ti khyuX i daX bā ling gro hā pā ya/ gro hā pā ya/ hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab rnams byas la/ de dag gi rgyud bskul ba'i phyir gzungs mdo 'don par bya zhing /mthar yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gnags gsol/ rnams bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi cho ga ni sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /'gro kun dge legasamadzad pa yi/ /lha mo'i sgrub thabs rab dga' ba/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i snying po nyid/ /gzhan la phan phyir bkod pa yin/ /gza' yum rig pa'i rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshen no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /tseX6 snya sti/ khro rgyal 'chol ba la btud nas/ /sgrub thabs shin tu rnam mang las/ /'di ni ba ri lo sme'i lugs/ /dud khar grags pa'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ khro rgyal rme brtsegs mdun —116—

gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ u tsuṣ+ṭha mahā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra tismo hūX nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ khro bo'i rgyal po rme brtsegs ni/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs gnyis bgrad/ /dud kha me ri'i dbus na bzhugs/ /lhobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchogo gsul bdag skyabs mchi sogs rgyun bshagasabya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dang raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang sems huX yig dud kha las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rme brtsegs stobs po tsho skur gyur pa ni/ zhal gsum phyag drug rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dud kha/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba'i zhal spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ thod skam lnga lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa la sbrul sngon po lto ser gyis dkris pa/ sma ra smin ma phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje rgya gram/ gnyis pa na rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ gsum pa na rdo rje lcags kyu/ g.yon gyi dang po na rdo rje dbyug pa/ gnyis pa na rdo rje zhags pa/ gsum pa rdo rje'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ phyag thams cad brkyang zhing / thod skam gyi se ral kha dang / yan lag sprul gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/zhabs gnyis bgrad pa'i stabs kyis nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na 'gying ba'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ huX las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad khro rgyal rme brtsegs kyi rnam —117—

par badz+ra sa mā dza zhes pa nas/ khro rgyal 'khore bcas gnas 'dir gshe/gas sugasol/ gong bzhi mchod/ dza hu ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ yang thugs s+ho/ nga bcas ༵ dri /sa ༵ ༵zhi~X snro zhu ku ༵ shā ༵ ri rjo ༵ sbyi ༵ ༵bye/ gos nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsa'1 du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thug ta a bhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya sgyi ye hu/ zhes gsungs shing / bum pa'i chus dbang bskur lus thams cad gang / drim thams cad dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ ar+gha nas sha lta'i bar gyisazlo/rlo bye/ sngu/ /rdo rnyi las / gyi ༵ ༵༵ sag ci/ sna/ bsdu ༵ ༵/ rnyi ༵ ༵ hā bi man 1 se sna ༵ / lha zlo rdo/ hu/ phaṭa/rma ghu /༵ hā ri tsa sna ḍā / ༵ sna glo s+ho bi~X ṭā.u tsukhye mahā kro dha pho phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzla'o/ /mngon rtogs bsdus pa sgom par 'dod na/dhi~Xḍi rdo~X ba kau~X / ra pa rnyi//dho bo wo po ༵ dzhai/ s+ho rdo lhag ma rnam/༵ dgos par bzlas pa 'jug pa'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang go bya ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su me tog gi tshom bu bkod/maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus sam g.yas g.yon ci bde bar bum pa bcas la gtor ma gsum dang mchod pa po gam/mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mas par bya/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bya/—118—

mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i stengadu bhuX las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang dang / maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su paX las pad+ma nas/ dbu brgyan gyis bar bdag bskyed ltar bsgom/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khri|la nas song /bum nang gi lha'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te bum pa gang bar gyur/ bzlasapa ci 'grub bya/ mchod bstod rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ gtor ma a mṛ tasabasangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lkoX āXhūX/ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsis rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhūX ha ho hiX ga sto ma dang po snying po'i mthar/ a kā robatanas pa lan lngas khro bo chen po la 'bul/ ma snab sbyin ga|pru ma 'di bzhes la so gos kyisagasol ba btab/ gnyis pa chos skyong nag po chen po la 'bul/ gsum pa kha 'bar ma'i sngags kyisarigs drug la bsngo/ slar yang bum bskyed kyi lha la mchod bstod bya/ yig brgya dang / ma 'byore pa dang sogs bzod gsol dang / oṃ āXhūX zhes mchod yon phul/ ye shes pa gshe/gas/ dawatshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa kun dang ldan par gyur/ zhegabarjod de/ /slob dpon gyi bya ba'o/ /slob ma la bya ba ni/ phal cher sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i chings dang mas pa las/ rgyun po zhags song ba'i rjes su sku'i rjes gnang gi gsol 'debs 'di skad ces bya ste/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku yi ngo bo slob dpon gyis/ /bdag la khrorgyal rme brtsegs kyi/ /sku yi rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsowab 'debs/ sku'i rjes gnang gi ye shes pa bstim pa song mtshams su mngon rtogs ltar lha dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa 'bogs/ gsung dang thugs kyi rjes gnang gi 'gor yang / sku'i zhes par gsung gi zhes— 119—

pa dang / thugs kyi zhes 'don pa spos la gsol ba btab/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi mthar bum pa'i chusabakru ba dang / byabs srung bya ste sngags kyi khyad par ma gtogs/ rdo rje rnam 'joms ljang khu'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dang / mdun bskyed kyi rjes kyi bya ba yang spyi dang 'dra'o/ /shin tu zab mor rab grags pa/ /yig rnying man ngag kun mthong nas/ /dga' bas snying sto tsam zhig bsdebs/ /dgosa'adod sgrub la 'di yis chog/rme brtsegs dud kha'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅// /o swā sti/ gsang bdag dang ni de'i sprul pa/ /stobs po che la phyag 'tshal nas/ /lhebs chen 'chol ba'i sgrub thabs ni/ /jo bo'i lugs su grags pa bshad/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du sto nas/ rang gi snying ga'i huX gi 'od kyis sdig sgrib dang ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad bsregs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid khro rgyal rme brtsegs sku mdog ljang khu/ ljang sngon dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug godang po gnyisathugs kar sdigs mdzub bsnol ba/ bar pa gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu/ tha ma gnyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bgegs kyi tsho gis thams cad gnon par mdzad pa/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal/ mi lpags glang lpags stag lpags la sogs pa dpal gyi myos yongs su rdzogs pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /gnasagasum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams bya zhing / rigs bdag ni don grub bo/ /bzlas pa'i snying po ni dud kha'i skabs dang 'dra/ grib sel ba'i sngags/ i ho shudhe shu khyesko/bi ho shudhe shudhe/ raX ho shudhe shu khye/ i bi raX shudhe shudhe/ a a a swāhā/ zhes pa'ang btags te bzlas/ sa 'jog khar/ ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas —120—

thams cad kyi/ /bka' yi 'phrin las kun sgrub pa/ khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che/ /gdul dka' 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod/ /ces bstod do/ /lha sku stong pa nyid du sbyangs nas/ thun mtshams la 'jug go /rjes gnang byed tshul ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar bum pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/ gtor ma gsum dang / mchod pa yang bsham/ bdag bskyed gong bzhin byas/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang ma lhun/ mdun bskyed bum pa sings sbyangs/ bum pa'ang spyi dang ma lhun par bskyed nas/ bum pa'i nang du mngon rtogs ltar lha bskyed/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/gong bzhin bstod/ gtor ma rnams 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyasaspel nas/ gan bo la snying po'i mthar i daX bā li kha kha ji hi sku hi/ btags pas 'bul/ ge tor ma gnyis pa phyogs skyong bcu dang / gsum pa bgegs la kha 'bar ma'i sngags kyis gtong ba'i lag len nam cha gsum gyi cho gas 'bul/ spro na gzhi bdag gtor ma'ang bya/ bum pa la dmigs nas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya zhing / mthar bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu/ de nas slob ma khrus bya/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ ba thegs gtor btang / a mṛ tas bsrungs/ gsol btab ni/ jo bo'i lugs kyi rjes gnang gzhan dang 'dra/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyun spun gas bya/ slob ma'i spyi bor huX las khro bo bskyed rigasabadag rgyas 'debs kyi bar byas te/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i huX gi 'od kyis/ slob rme'i lus byin gyis brlabs nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi lus byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ khro bo 'od du zhu nas slob ma khro bo'i skur gyur/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣañtsa hūX/ zhes brjod cing / bumapa'i chus dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab ste sku'i rjes gnang ngo / /gsung gi rjes gnang bzlas lung dang byin gyis brlab pa'i lung spyi dang —121 —

'dra/ thugs kyi rjes gnang slob ma'i snying ga'i sngags 'khor las 'od 'phros/khams gsum 'od du zhu ba nas snying ga'i huX gi nā da'i bar du bsdus te/ stong pa la mnyam par bzhag slar yang lha skur ldang ngo / /rjes gnang go rjes kyi bya ba dang / ma rma bskyed kyi rjes chog kyang spyi dang 'dra/ 'di'i grib sel gyi rim pa ni/ bum pa snga ma bzhin bsgrubs/ mtheb kyu nyer gcig chang bu nyer gcig dmar gtor gcig dang srad bu nag po rnams bshams/ dang por bkru ba dang byab pa gnyis bya/ chang bu re dang mtheb kyu re la/ na maXs man+ta bsnyi nāX/ na maX sa bo ta thāg ta a wa 'o 1 gi te/ oṃ saX bha ra saX bha ra huX/ zhes lan gsum gsum bzla zhing bskor/grib sel ba'i sngags kyang re re btags/ bsgrub bya la gu gul gyis bdug drag sngags bzla zhing yungalokar gyis brabs/ srin mdzub bzhi la srad bu nag po btags/ byabs pa'i tshul gyis grib rnams srad bu la bstim par mos/ de nyid khro bo'i sngags gyib sel gyi sngags dang sbrags pas bcad nas gtor ma'i nang du bor/ gtor ma gong gi sngags kyis bgegs rnams la bsngos/ bden pa bdar te/ khrus khu dang gtor ma sogs lam gyi bzhi mdor bskyal/ de nas srung ba dang shis brjod bya'o/ /gzhan yang lam gtor gyis phyogs sol ba/ chu mig mtsho jing yul phyogs sogs kyi grib sel ba dang / srung skud/ sri'u gso ba/sbyin bsreg la brten nas las bzhi sgrub pa sogs kyang bsnyen pa sngon song gi rnal 'byor pas ci rigasapar sgrub bo/ /'di yi gdams pa ngo mtshar zhes/ /bka' gdams pa kun sgrog cing dga'/ /yig rnying rnams kyi snyid sto tsam/ 'dus la gsal bar bkod pa yin/ khro bo rme brtsegs ljang khu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅〉/ /glu ste swā sti/ bla ma mchog dang khro bo'i rgyal/ /de bzhin mkha' 'gro mar bcasal/ /ba yid nas sgrub thabs bzlas lung gi /bya ba cung zad bshad par bya/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro — 122—

bas/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems hu mthing nag gi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las mkha' 'gro ma rme brtsegs sku mdog sol ba ltar gnag pa/ khro mo'i cha lugs spyan gsum pa/ phyag gnyis kyis dag byed kyi bdud rtsis gang bas bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ skra lhug par grol zhing rgyan spangs pa/ dar nag gon bza' lhug par 'phyang ba/ pad nyi la mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'o(/ /gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes dgug gzhug dbang bskur zhing mi bskyod pas rgyas btab/ar+gha la sogs pas mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ o arakha tsir kha bi ma na se u tsuṣ+ṭha mahā kro dha hu phaṭa/ ces bzla/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis rmi gyis brlabs la/ o badz+ra ḍā ki nī u cu zhu kro dha kha kha ji hi ji hi/ zhes pas 'bul/slob ma'i bya ba ni/ sgom lung 'bogs pa ste/ sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa kho na yin/ bum chog ni gzhi dkar po'i steng du/ 'bru dkar gyis g.yung drung ris bris te/ der bum pa spyi dang mthun par bcasal/ dngos gzhi bum pa sgrub tshul/ bkru byabs srung gsum dang bcas pa ni/ rme brtsegs dud kha'i bum chog dang 'dra la/ grib srung ba'i sgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor mkha' 'gro ma skad cig gis bskyed la/bum chus bkrus par bsams te bzlas brjod byed/ mthar mkha' 'gro ma rang la bstim/ kun tu zab cing ches bla ba/ /don chen 'grub pa yid dga'i gnas/ /gzhan 'ga'i snyib la'ang dga' bskyed pa'i/ /'dus por bris 'di e ma ho/ khro mo rme brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel//༄༅khya/ /e khe snya sti/ heru ka dpal khros pa'i sku/ /'jigs pa 'joms pa la btud nas/ /sgrub thabs shin tu rnam mang las/ /shin tu bsdus pa'i tshul lugs bri/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ shā n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/ bhu gsum las rtse gsum/ rdo rje 'khor— 123 —

lo'i srung ba'i 'khor lo gsum sbrag tu gnas pa'i nang du/ chos 'byung la gnas pa'i rlung me chu sa'i 'og gzhi dang gur khang / de'i nang dur khrod r+ṣa po'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa lte ba la hūX dang baX las rdo rje dang tri shu la rnams su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan reg tshig sku mdog nag po/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i steng na me'i 'bor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dang / g.yon tri shu la'i rtse mor rlung gi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa bsnams pa/ sku sbom thung khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs shing / dur khrod kyi mas brgyad dang ldan pa/ 'khor lo dang sna tshogs rdo rjes spyi bo brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i dus mtshan ma dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed mnan pa/ yum g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon tri shu la 'dzin pasa'akhu/da pa/ gnyis ka'ang me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ snying gar hūX sngon po/ lte bar a ser po/ bol du taX ljang khu/ mig la traX dkar po/ rna bar hūX ser po/ sna la tri dud kha/ lce la āXdamar po/ lus la khaX ljang khu/ yid la tuX mthing kha rnams su gyur/ ye shes pa bstim pa dang /dbang bskur spyi dang 'dra ba las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams su spros/rang dang 'dra ba'i khro bo dang khra gdong ma la sogs pa'i sgo mtshams kyi khro bo yab yum zhal sbyor rnams su gyur/ steng dang 'og tu gtso bo yab yum gyi sku re re/ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ khro rgyal reg tshig stobs po che/ /mun nag lta bu'i sku 'dzin zhing / /phaṭa kyi sgra 'byin me dpung 'bar/ /mgon du gyur la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ khro rgyal 'khor —124—
