bcas sdang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ /zhal du ma lus dgra bgegs don snying gsol/ /gtum chen me 'bar las rnams grub par ma rdzod/ /ces bstod/ de nasabazlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab nas/ tsho( bha ya nā sha ni tru sa ni/ sarba mā ra/ prarkye gor/ bi nā sha ya/ ye ke tsi ta/ duṣ+ṭhaX satwa ba da ki ma ma bi rū ba/ kur bhan+ti ta ni/sarba mā ra/ pra s+t+ya ga ri ṇi pa ta tu huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzla'o/ /'bum phrag yor lngas bsnyen pa 'grub par mug da/ thun 'jug tu dkyil 'khor 'od gsal du bsdu zhing dge ba bsngo/gtor ma byin rlabs bla med gang yang rung ba zhig dang ma lhun par byas nas/ dgra bgegs thams cad bkug ste gtor ma la thim par mos/ khro bo chen po 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ bha ya nā sha ni/ bhā sa ni/ badz+ra kro dha bā li ta kha kha sku hi ji hi/ thu lha thu lha ji hi ji hi/ mahā maX sa kha ji hi/ mahā rak+ta kha ji hi/ gti mug sha yi ma cer pa bzhes/ /zhes sdang rus pa'i mchod pa bzhes/ /'dod chags khrag gi mchod pa bzhes// /ma ra ya tsit+ta srog thun kha ji hi/ zhes lan bcu gcig gis bstab/ mchod bstod nas/ gnags gsol gyi bar spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni chos 'byung nag po gru gsum gyi steng du rten gtor bkod/ rjes gnang gi bya ba sgrub thabs brgya rtsas rigs 'gre ba las mthar gtor dbang byed pa nyid yin/ mu stegs ngan sngags kun bzlog ces/ /rdo rje gdan pa'i ba ri la/ /dga' bar bsngags pa'i gser chos kyi/ /snying sto mdo bsdusa'adi bzhin lags/ /spyir 'di la dbang bzhi sogs chos skor shin tu tshogs che bar yod na'ang / bsdus pa 'di rjes gnang tsam gyis 'grub pa/ bde mchog khro bo reg tshig gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyasa'aphel/ /—125—

༄༅’/ /oṃ sma sti/ he ru ka la bsnyan byas nas/ /mngon brjod rgyud rgyal las gsungasapa/ /man ngag kha bsgyur dang bcas pa'i/ khrag 'thung mkha' lding sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/hūṃ n+ya twas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las rgya mtsho'i dbus su paX las pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar raX las nyi ma/ der rang sems huX las rdo rje 'bar ba huX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing ga rtsa zhal gnag pa/ g.yas zhal dud kha dang dmar po/ g.yon zhal ljang khu dang dud kha/ steng zhal mkha' lding gi gdong dmar po/ nyi ma bcu gnyis kyi gzi brjid can phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum la 'byud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang /tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ g.yas gsum pa mtha' yas dkris pa rdo rje 'bar ba gsor ba/ bzhi pa pad+ma dkris pa'i lcags kyu/ lnga pa ma dros pa dkris pa'i ḍa ma sa g.yon gsum pa nor rgyas zhags pa'i tshul du 'dzin pas sdigs mdzub/ bzhi pa 'jog po ba dan du btags pa'i kha ṭāX ga dang thod pa/ lnga pa pad chen gyis dkris pa'i mdung / tha ma gnyis dbang po'i pags pa stod g.yogs su bsnams pa las g.yas kyis stobs rgyu dang / g.yon gyis dung skyong 'dzin pa'o/ /chu lha pho mo'i steng na g.yas rkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing / kha dog lnga dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i gshog pa brdeb pa/ he ru ka'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs shing / yum rdo rje phag mo ser mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /snying khar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūX naX huX/ spyi bor —126—

mkha' 'grol ma gsang bar lā ma/ mgrin par dum skyes ma/ lte bar gzugs can ma/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su dpa' bo dpa' mo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ khar khwa gdong ma/ sna bug gi 'dom sor 'ug gdong ma/ gsang bar khyi gdong ma/ gshang sgor phag gdong ma/ mig g.yas su gshin rje brtan ma/ rna ba g.yas su gshin rje pho nya ma/ rna ba g.yon du gshin rje mche ba ma/ mig g.yon du gzhan rje 'joms ma/ thams cad kyang phyag gnyis pa/ dpa' bo thams cad rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ rnal 'byor ma rnams gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa/mkha' lding gi zhal dang rdo rje'i gshog pa can no/ /de nas go cha gnyis 'god/ gnasagasum byin rlabs/ dam ye bsre ba/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams bya ste/ sdom pa'i mngon rtogs gang yang rung ba zhig dang bstun no/ /snying gar nyi ma'i steng du huX gi mtha' skor du sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar bsams la/ oṃ sgrubadz+ra he he ru ru kaX badz+ra ga ru ḍa guX ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+bha ra hūX phaṭa/ ces 'bum phrag nyi shu rtsa gnyis su bzla'o/ /de nas tshi ga dra ḍa/ sam ya hūX dzaX zhes btags pa 'bum bzla/ de nas taX ka ra kaX ka ra/ ts+tsha ti/ ts+tsha ti/ khyudardeshun ri rbad/ zhes btags pa 'bum bzlas pas gdon thams cad dang / khyad par klu nad zhi zhing /'byung po thams cad mngag gzhug tu 'gyur ro/ /rang gzhan gyi klu gdon drag po 'dul na/ nā ga srog tshig nan rbad mā ra ya hūṃ/ zhes btags pa 'bum phrag bzlas te las la sbyar ro/ /rjes lha sku stong par sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las lha skur langs te go cha bkod tsham rngam byas la thun mtshams la 'jug go /gtor chog lha hi pa dang 'dra/ sngags kyi sham bu bzla ba nas bzung ste/ bdag bskyed dang gtor chog gnyis kar la he ru ka bya khyung gi 'khor gyis bskor ba bsgom pa dang / gtor chog gi skabs/ bzlas gtor gyi rjes la/ tsho rdzo mahā ga ru ḍa 6/dam bā 'ing5 ta kha kha ji hi sku hi/—127—

zhes brtags pas 'bul/'di'i rjes gnang ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ dbus su bum pa bca'/ mchod gtor rgya cher bshams/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa khyen gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/bum pa bskyed chog spyi dang mthun/ bum pa'i nang du bdag bskyed ltar lha bskyed mchod pa phyi nang gsang ba tshang ba dang / rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ gtor ma 'bul/ klu gtor yang btang la bzlas pa ci nus zhi bya'o/ /slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rgyun bshags/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung / dam tshig nyer gnyis bzung ba rnams bya/ lha'i sku las byung ba'i bdud rtsis bkru bar bsams te/ bum chu spyi bo nas gtor zhing 'thung du 'jug/tshad med bzhi nas rigasabadag rgyas 'debs kyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin dmigs pa phog/dbang bskur gyi skabs/ bum chus dngosasu dbang bskur/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung byin te/ sham bu rnams byin mi dgos/ slar yang bum pa'i chus gnas so sor gtor la/ lha thams cad kyi sngags la a bhi khiñtsa zhes btags la dbang bskur ro/ /'dil phyag mtshan gtod pa dang / gtor dbang byed pa zhig kyang snang ste/ blos btags yin yin 'dra ba'i mi dgos par mngon no/ /rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ 'di rgyud las char 'bebs kyi skabs su/bsnyen pa song na las de la lhag par bsngags shing / 'di nyid kyi bka' nyan srin mo ral gcig ma bsgrub par bya ste/ logs su bstan pa zhig yin no/ /kun las khyad 'phags mkha' lding gi /sgrub thabs mchog tu dga' ba'i tog/rwa lo'i gdams par grags pa yi/ /snyib swo nyung ngu tsam zhig bris/ /bde mchog rdo rje mkha' lding gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ /༄༅༅/ /tso ste snya sti/ ye shes lnga ldan dus 'khor ni/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad bya khyung tshul/ /de la bsgyud nas sgrub thabs ni/ /rgyud don bzhin tu gsal bar bri/ /skyabs sems sngone du 'gro — 128—

bas/ shā n+ya tu'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma zla ba nyi ma brtsegasastepa'i gdan la skru kha dog lnga ldan du zhu ba las/ rang nyid 'dab chags kyi mgon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rkang mthil nas dpyi'i bar ser po/ de nas lte ba'i bar dkar ba/ de nas mgrin pa'i bar dmar ba/ de nas smin ma'i bar nag pa/ de yan chad ljang khu spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ rgyal ba ljang khu dang rnam rgyal sngon pos dbu skra bcings pa/ stobs rgyu dang pad+ma nag pos snyan cha/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar pos phyag gdub/ 'jog po dang pad zhi ser pos zhabs gdub/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar pos 'og pag dang mgul rgyan byas pa/ gshog pa kha dog sna tshogs pa 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa/ klu rgyal gdug pa can sbrul gyi rnam pa sked pa nas phyag gnyis kyis bzung zhing mgo bo zhal du gsol ba/ mjug ma zhabs 'og tu mnan pa'o/ /nye bar sa'i dkyil 'khor la laX/ snying gar chu la u/ mgrin par me la raX/ dpral bar rlud la i/ gtsug gtor du nam mkha' la a/ thugs kar nyi ma la skru/ de la sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs te/ oṃ pak+ṣi swāhā/ zhesaci 'grub tu bzla/ 'jug tu dge ba bsngo/ de ltar bye ba bzlas na/ ji skad po gad pa'i las thams cad 'grub bo/ /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'am/ yang na maṇ+ḍal la 'bru'i tshom bu bkod/ mchod pa bcu gnyis kyi rnam pa bsham/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas mchod pa byin rlabs dus 'khor khros pa rdo rje shugs dang 'dra/ mdun bskyed oX āXhūX hra phaṭa kyis bsangs/spyo bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ nyi ma la k+ṣ-i gi bar gong bzhin/denasaso—129—

rbe'i phyag rgya dang bstun te/ tso( pa lha|badz+ra gan+dha pra tismo na ma zhes pa la sogs pa/ pa skru zhesapamago bor sbyar nas/ o pa skru kā ma pra tismo na ma 'i bar du mchod pa ya gnyis rdo rje shugs dnga'adra/ 'di la gtor chog mi dgos shing / gal te byed par spro na rdo rje shugs kyi skabs bzhin pas/ badz+ra bhe ra wa lha ska ra zhes pa'i tshab tu/ pak+ṣi tra zhes brjod/ slob ma'i bya ba yang dus ge'i lhan skyes kyi skabs 'don pa spos pas rung ngo / /rgyud 'grel gyi dngos bstan 'di ltar na nam mkha' lding la rwa mi dgos shing / zhal ras lha zhal la bya'i mchu yod par bya/ mkha' lding gi mngon rtogs thams cad na mjug ma'i gsal kha med kyang 'jug sgro dgos shing / pus mo man chad bya'i rkang pa'i rnam pa/ phyag zhabasathams cad la sen mo lcags kyu ltar rno ba/ dbu skra nag po thor tshugs sam/ ser po gyen brdzes gang rung dang / zhal bzhi na zhi khro skabs dang sbyar/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyi steng du rin po che'i dbu rgyan yang bya'o//de ltar byas na rgya gar yul gyi mkha' lding gi bkod pa dang yang mthun zhing / rgyud 'grel gyi dgongs pa yang de las mi 'da'o/ /bya khyung rwa can ni/ bal po dang li dang rgya nag sogs yul gzhan gyi bkod pa lalo'abyung zhing de nas de dag las 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs dang / bod rnying ma dang / rgya gar la kha 'phangs pa'i bod ma sogs la de nyid kyi rang lugs yin pas bya yi/ rgya gar gyi yin nges rnams la de'i rigs 'gre mi sbyor zhing / bris rgyud nor ba rgya 'byams pa la'ang snying po med do/ khyung sgrub kun la yod mod kyi/ /rgya gar yul dang mthun na dga'/ /rnying ma'i snyid sto gsar ma la/ /sbyor ba 'di yang gad mo'i gnas/ /ye shesakhyung khra rgyud lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel//༄༅// /o swā sti/ ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin mchog/rigs lnga mkha' lding la bshud nas/ /ye shes khyung khra'i sgrub thabs ni/ /mal lo'i man ngag bzhin du bri/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad — 130—

nyi'i steng du phuXyig las klu rgyal sog ma med nyal stabs su gnas pa'i steng du/k+ṣi mthing kha las bdag nyid ye shes khyung khra tsog pu'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/brla man chad sa'i rang bzhin ser po/ lto ba chu'i rang bzhin dkar po/ stod me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ mgo bo rlung gi rang bzhin nag po/ spyi gtsug ye shes kyi rang bzhin sngon po/ ga sgog pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin kha dog sna tshogs pa/ sprin sna lnga la rgyab brten pa/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin dang / g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ gnam lcags kyi rwa gnyis kyi dbus na klu'i rgyal po'i gtsug gi nor bu phrogs pa rgyan du mdzad pa/ me dpung drag la rtsub pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i mgrin par khyung rigs lnga snying gar snying po yi ge lnga/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dbang bskur nas mi bskyod pas rgyas btab/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i tso gyis mchod/ brtan dang g.yo ba'i dug rnams kun/ /me dang chu bzhin 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /ye shes lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ //mkha' lding khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'byung ba lnga dang dug lnga 'joms/ /rigs lnga khyung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtan g.yo'i dug rnams rab zhi nas/ /dug lnga ye shes mngon 'gyur shog/oX pak+ṣi swāhā/ zhes pa ci nus bzla zhing / badz+ra ga ru ḍa hūX phaṭa/ rat+na/ pad+ma/ khaṅge/ budha ga ruḍa hūXphaṭa/ ces btags pa'ang cung zad bzla/ mtha' stong par sbyangs nas dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma bsangasasbyangs/ rin po che'i snod du lkoX las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho wo por gyur/oṃ āXhūX/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes khyung khra 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaX sngags tshan drug gi rjes su/ a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis phul/ mchod bstod/ mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba bto/ yig —131—

brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshogs gsol/ smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad tshom bu lnga dang bcas pa mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor ba/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du mañdzi la gtor ma che ba gcig rnams bzhag mchod pa byin rlabs dang / bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mdun bskyed ba4sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las getsobo gong bzhi/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma la k+ṣi las sangs rgyas mkha' lding dkar po/g.yas 'khor lo dang / g.yon sbrul dkar bzung nas bza' ba/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhir nyi ma la k+ṣ-i re re yongs su gyur pa las shar du rdo rje mkha' lding g.yas rdo rje/ lhor rin chen mkha' lding g.yas rin po che/ nub du pad+ma mkha' lding g.yas pad+ma/ byang du ral gri mkha' lding g.yas ral gri/ de rnams rim pas sku mdog sngo ser dmar ljang ba/ phyag g.yon par rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i sbrul bzung nas bza' zhing sku'i dbyibs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /ye shesaspyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ bzlas pa mchod bstod gtor 'bul rnamasabyas la/ slob mas phyag byas/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyis gsowab btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun mug gas bya/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag la bcom ldan 'das ye shes khyung khra'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa sdi nyam du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ rjes gnang gi ngo bo ni/ sku bskyed bstim/ gsung bzlas lugathugs phyag mtshan bstim pa/ 'phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo dang bcas pa yin pa las/ ye shes pa bstim pa'i skabs/ mkha' spyod kyi gnas nas khyung rigs lnga dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas bstim pa dang / bzlas lung gi skabs/ mdun bskyed lha drug so so'i thugs kar nas rang rang gi sngags byung ste/—132—

slong ma'i snying gar bstim pa dang / de'i rjes su rungs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas sngags 'gugasashing bstim pa rnams mdzad/ dam bca' ba'i lung mi dgos/ lhag ma rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang 'dra/'di ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud la brten pa yin mod kyi/ gon bor nā ro pa'i man ngag pham thing pa nasabargyud pa dang / sa skya pa'i lcags ri khongs las mi 'da' ba'i gser chos kyi nang tshan yin pas zab mor grags shing / las tshogs kyang klu nad gso ba/ gag lhog bcos pa/ dug gi bcud len/ bya khyi gnam gsum bcos thabs sogs man ngag rnon po mang du yod do/ /rigs kun 'dus pa'i ye shes kyi/ /rnam cha shin tu dga' ba'i phul/ /yi go snga phyi rgya mtsho las/ /snying po bsdus pa e mo ho/ khyung khra man ngag lugasasu grags pa'i sgrubs thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅// /glu ste swā sti/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i byin brlabs pa'i/ /rdo rje mkha' lding la btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ /cung zad tsam zhig bri bar bya/ /skyabs sems phyag rdor gyi bdag bskyed rnams sngon du bto nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems kyi snang ba'i hūX yig badz+ra ba ti ga ru ḍa zhes pa'i sgra dang bcas pa zhig mdun du chad pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che 'bar ba huX gi mtshan pa/de'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las mkha' lding gi rgyal por gyur/ ri dza pri dza skyoX/ bya khyung gser gyi gshog pa dang rdorje'i mchu can/ lus rdorje'i rang bzhin me 'bar ba/phyag g.yon na nor bu rin po che dang / g.yas na klu mgo bo gsum pa 'dzin pa/rin po che dang mu tig dang gser gyi dbu rgyan can/ sbrul mgodagu pas rgyan du byas pa/ klu brgyad zhabs 'og tu mnan pa/ 'khore mkha' lding gi tsho gis thams cad kyis bskor bar gyur/ mkha' lding gi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra —133—

du rnyi mi li mi li swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis brtan par byas/ rang gi snying ga nas stu de zer 'phros/ mkha' lding 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoXbazlas pa na/ oṃ badz+ra ba ti ga ru ḍa be ge ta huX hūṃ dza dzaX ri dza pri dza huX phaṭa/ ce dza sko re bzhin stong nas khri'i bar bzla'o/ /thun 'jog khar/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ dmigs med thugs rje chen po'i ngang nyid nas/ /thabs las mkhas pas gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /phyag na rdo rje'i las kya pho nyar sprul/ /bde gshegs mkha' lding tsho gi/sa la phyag 'tshal 'e1/ /zhes bstod/ gu gul gyi bdug spos btang / badz+ra muX zhesagashegs su gsol/ de nas thun mtshams su sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyi drung du/ phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa dang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed len pa gang nus bya/ gtsang sbra'i spyod pa la gnas par bya'o/ /yang 'di bdag bskyed du byas kyang rung bas gong du zugad pa la 'dod pa spo bar bya'o/ /'di la rjes gnang sogs byed pa med de/ ngag gam glegs bam las lung thob pas chog/phyag na rdo rje'i gzungs kyi las tshogs kyi lha yin no/ /a ti sha yi man ngag ces/ /bka' gdams kun la grags pa ltar/ /thos nas dga' bas bris pa lags/ /legs par bsgrubs na snyid sto 'byung / /rdo rje mkha' lding khyung ser du grags pa/ bka' gdams lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅’/ /skye ste swā sti/ gsung gi mnga' bdag 'jam dpal ni/ /zhi khro mig sman mdog 'chang ba/ /de la bshud nas de sgrub thabs/ /gsal zhing 'dus pa bri bar bya/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ paX las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ rang sems dhīXmathing nagagi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las rang nyid 'jam dpal nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon ut+pal thugs kar 'dzin pa snyan gyi thad —134—

kar kha phye ba'i steng na sher phyin gyi po ti bzhugs pa/ zhabs rdorje'i skyil krung can yid tsam khro zhing dar dang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o /oṃ pra sod/ chu sod/ dur ta sod/ snying mgo la 'edi/ kha la dz+wa/ ka sha tra rbad phaṭa swāhā/ brgya rtsa sogs gang 'grub bzla'o/ /rnamartog che na sku khro bo'i cha lugs can/ dbu skra bcings pa/ phyag g.yon po ti thugs kar bsnams pa/ g.yasabaskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs can du bsgoms la/ stong dang nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzla'o/ /zhal gdams bcu gcig gi don ni/ skya rengs shar ba'i dus kha shar du blta/ sgal tshigs bsrang / rlung g.yas nas drangasagayon la 'bud/ bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ sngags kyi sham bur/ sarba dz+wa ra ro ka du ni bigha nan upa tra be/ shān+ti ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes gdags/ rang gi rkang pa'i rgyu mo khung gnyis kyi dreg pa srin lag g.yon pas blangs nas/ bu ga dgu dang drug mdor byug de rnams phyi sgom phye ba'i sngon du bya/ bzlasapa'i mthar rkan sgra drag po lan gsum bya/ rkang pa g.yon pa'i sen mos g.yas pa'i mthe bong mnan/tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad kyi gnod byed thams cad mnan par bsam/ shin tu lhog pa che na/ gosamago mjug tu zlog thal mo gdab/ rlung drag tu 'bud/ bzlas sgom rgyun mi 'chad par bya'o/ /'di yisand gdon grib sogs mi thub pa gang yang med par grags shing / byin rlabs kyang che ba yin no/ /'di la sgom lung tsam gyis chog/'ga' zhig gi lag len ltar rjes gnang byed na/ zhi ba'i sku la brten nas sgrubs thabs brgya rtsa'i chings sbyor ba yin no/ /kun las zab par bsngags pa 'di/ /gsar ma nyid du dga' bas sgrog/rnying ma'i chos su gsal ba la/ /bdag snying ya mtshan chen sto skyes/ /'jam dbyangs nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /tse( khyu sti/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la bsad nas/ /dpa' bo gcig sgrub las byung — 135 —

ba'i/ /rmi lam lung ston ga dmasang ga ni/ /shin tu zab par grags pa bri/ /shing drung ngam brag phug sogasashin tu dben zhing gtsang ba khyi sgra med pa'i phyogs sus phyogs byi dor byas gu gul gyis bdug gzhi bdag gtor ma mang du bto / a mong gi srung 'khor bsgoms te/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ zhes 'bum tsam bzla'o/ /de nas zhag bdun tsam du rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya bsgom bzlas la 'bad par bya'o/ /de dag tu yang khrus dang gtsang sbra gal che'o/ /dngos gzhi ni/ stegs bu grub bzhi'i steng du pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ de'i steng du bum pa dkar gsum dang / bum sman sbyar ba'i chu gtsang mas gang ba/shug pa lta bu'i shing gi yal gas kha brgyan/ yod na de la tsa ka li 'dog tsa ka li med kyang btub/ steng nasadar sngon po'i gdugs phub/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ sgrol ma'i bris sku dang / dkar gtor gsum yang bsham/ a mṛ ta bzla zhing bgegs bskrad/ bdag bskyed sgrol dkar gyi mngon rtogs bzlas pa dang bcas pa ci rigs bya/ mdun bskyed swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ bum pa ri rab lhun por gyurapa'i rtse mor kha rgyan dpag bsam gyi shing yal ga lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu rgyas pa/ ri rab kyi steng du pad zla'i gdan la lha mo shra ma ṇa sku mdog sngon mo zhi zhing sgeg pa/ rir ba la khyel bzhugs kyi tshul can/ dar dang rin po tshes brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas me 'e1nga rngam rnga yab/ g.yon dpag bsam shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ de las 'od 'phros/ lha mo shra ma ṇa badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ dzaXhūX baX hoXganyis su med par thim/ 'dod don gsol ba drag tu bto/ lha mo la phul bar mos te/ me tog gtsang ma bum pa'i nang du phul/ oṃ shra ma ṇa pi sha tsi ni muṇ+ḍi swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla'o/ /sa le(gas/gtor ma dang po/ tso rdzo shra ma ṇa pi sha tsi i dam bā li ta kha kha kha hi ji hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul/ gnyis pa chos skyong dang / gsum pa gzhi bdag la 'bul/ thun mtshams su yang bzlas pa rgyun — 136—

mi 'chad par bya zhing / khyad par nyal khar drag tu bzla'o/ /zhag bdun gyis bsnyen par 'grub cing / rang gzhan gyi don phal cher dang tshe ring thung skye ba snga phyi sogs phal cher lung ston par gyur ro/ /gal te ma 'gru ba na/ grib shas che ba yin pas khrus chog dang / bsha/gas bsdams byas la/ slar zhag bdun sgrub bo/ /sgrol ma'i bsnyen pa sngon du song na/ zhag nyer gcig gis mi 'grub pa ye mi srid par gragasaso/ /'di sgrub dus bya rgyud nas bshad pa'i bsrung bya gang yod kyi steng du/ mi khyi dang mi 'phrad/ sngo rngad mi bza'/ dkor zas dang / grib zas la 'dzem pa gal che'o/ /'di la rjes gnang mi dgos/ lung tsam gyis 'grub bo/ /zab mo yin zhes kun la grags/ /rgyud las gsungs phyir mkhas rnams dga'/ /lung bstan sgrub pa'i snying swo 'di/ /gzhan pas ngo mtshar che bar 'khum/ /lha mo shra ma ṇa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /skyed swā sti/ sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /mkha' 'grom dpal dragashul can/ /'jigs med zhal can la ba spyod nas/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnas mdo tsam bri/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi/ /gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags rnams spyi dang mthun par byas la/ tseX( swa bhā wa shudha sarba dharma sā bhā wa shu khyo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag rgya che zhing gting zab pa/ 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa/de'i dbus su paX las pad+ma chen po dang / raX las nyi ma la gnas pa'i mi ro'i snying gar rang sems kyi ngo bo huX yig mthing kha/ de las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs lo go 'dren byad ma thams cad tshar bcad/ mtshan ltas ngan pa dang /nyer 'tshe thams cad bsregs/ slar 'dus hūX la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sku mdog mthing nag— 137—

sku bong che bas srid gsum khyab pa/ yan lag dang nying lag mkhrang zhing hrags pa/ rab khros seng ge'i zhal gdangs shing / ljags 'gril la mche ba gtsigs pa/ dug gi kha rlangs na bun ltar 'thibs shing / dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar zhing la la thur du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭaX ga la ḍā ma ru dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs can/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang / mi lpags dang glang lpags sbyar ba'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/ thod pa skam pos dbu brgyan zhing / sbrul dang rus rgyan dang / mi mgo'i do shal can/ khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'od 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs shing / mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs thams cad kyang phyag g.yas pa rnams na sna tsho gis pa'i mtshon cha 'dzin zhing / g.yon gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ seng ge'i zhal nas drag sngags kyi sgra 'ur ru ru sgrog par gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āXthugs kar hūX/ huX las 'od 'phros/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can 'khor dang bcas pa phe phe/ zhes 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bskor bas spyan drangs/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ oX āXhuX/ zhes nang mchodaphul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dzaXhuX baX hoX yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha badz+ra sa mā dzaX thob dzi bha wa a bhi —138—

dzi myu huX/ zhes gsungs shing / de rnams kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/a/༷༷kaXba'i maXraXca / ༷4zhaXdaXraXsaXmaXr zhuXyaXphaṭaX ces drag tu bzlas pas/ dmigs pa dang bcas thal mo brdab cing / mthar/khro mo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlog/rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /mthar lha sku mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas dge ba bsngo/ a mtshams su lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya/ gtor ma sha khrag gis brgyan pa bshams la/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs te bran/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āXhuX las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho wo po 'bru gsum gyis mawo pa/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste/ 'bru gsum la thim/ de rnams zhu ba las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po zad mi shes par gyur/ oṃ āXhūX ha ho hiX gong bzhi ye shes pa spyan drangs/ chasidha mukha ḍā ki ni i dam bā khyu ta kha kha ji hi ji hi swāhā/ oX a kā ro mu khaX sogs bta/sapa lan bdun gyis phul/ oṃ sidha mu kha ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā re khyuX lkog pa 'go bor sbyar te.ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ bcom ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /'jigs gzugs dpa' bo chen mo ni/ /seng ge'i gzugasakyis gdug pa 'dul/ /rngam pa'i zhal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag g.yas gri gug bsnams pa yis/ /dgra bgegs ma lus srog rtsa gcom da/ /mi mthun bar chad sel mdzad ma/ /mthu stobs ri drag mo phyag 'tshal bstod/ /g.yon pa thod khrag bsnams pa yis/ /bdud bzhi zhing bcu'i snying khrag gsol/ /'khor ba'i —139—

khrag rgyun rtsad nas gcod/ /byad ma sgrol la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dug gsum sgrol mdzad kha ṭāX bsnams/ /'jigs pa'i sku la thod 'phreng can/ /zhabs gnyis nyi zla pad steng dbus/ /me dpung klong bzhugs phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dug gsum rnam dag chos 'byung ni/ /rnam thar sgo gsum yongs rdzogs pa/ /mthing nag gru gsum me ri 'bar/ /e las drag byed phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bsnyen sgrub mchod bstod bgyis pa yis/ /sa lam bar chad zhi ba dang / /tshe dang longs spyod rgyas pa dang / /rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas myur thob shog/mchod sbyin gtor ma nas/ kun 'khru1ba sgo(ga gi bar spyi dang mthun/ badz+ra muX zhes gi shogs la/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci 'grub bya'o/ /rjes gnang byed par 'dod na/ chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag re kha dkar po can/ dbus su nyi gdan la chom bu dkar po dgod/ mtha' rdo rwa me ris zlum skor bya/ khyams zla gam rdul tshon dmar posadagang / dbus su ma sdi'i steng du dmar gtor gru gsum rgyan gyis brgyan pa bzhag mtha' mchod gtor gyisabaskor/ spro na/ go skabs yangs pa zhig tu bum pa'ang 'cha'/ malji re steng gi gtor ma dang / bum pa bca' ba phyag len yin gyi yig rnying ni ma bzhugs/ gtor dbang byed pa'ang de dang 'dra'o/ /rdor dril cang te'u nang mchod sogs yo byad thams cad tshogs par byas nas/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/gong bzhin mngon rtogs blangs nas bzlas pa song mtshams su/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed nyid 'don pa spos pas chog de nasamachod bstod byas la/ bum pa bcas yod na/ bum pa sngags kyi yig 'brus yongs su gang bar gyur/sngags ci rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ yig 'bru rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang ni churagyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas gtor chog gong bzhin las/ mgron spyan 'dren pa mi dgos so/ /slob ma —140—

rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod/ slob dpon gyis slob ma rnams la sems bskyed gsal btab/ sngon 'gro'i chos rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa dang / 'di nyid kyis lo rgyus bshad/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar bskul/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can sogs kyis gsol ba lan gsum 'gos su bcug/yang na/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /zhes sogs byas kyang rung / rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ snyo|na tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon/ brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ snod kyi skyon gsum spangs te gsan par zhu/ ces brjod/ rgyun spun gas ni/ dkon ma snab gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs spyi dang mas/ dngos gzhi ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phrogamadun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i 'od kyis slob ma'i lus sogs ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad sbyangs/ oṃ su bhā wa nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan gyi bar mngon rtogs ltar gyi dmigs pa sprod pa yin pa las/ ye shes spyan 'dren gyi skabs/ rol mo'i byin 'bebs/ bum pa bcas na dbang bskur ba'i sngags 'don bzhin du/ bum pa slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzhug cing bum chung sbyin no/ /de dag rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa yin/ de nas slob dpon gyi dpral ba'i oṃ las/ mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can gyi sku dpag tu med pa byung / khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par mos mdzod/ ces brjod la rol ho bya/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo / /slob dpon gyi mgrin pa'i āXlas ā li kā li dang sngags 'phreng dpag tu med pa byung /mgrin par thim/ rol chen bya/ de rjes bzlas lung dang / bcom ldan bdag gi sogs sgro gyis brlabs pa'i lung yang spyi dang mas par sbyin/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo / /slob dpon —141—

dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i hūṃ las/ gri gug ral gri kha ṭāX rtse gsum cang te la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa byung / slob ma'i snying ka'i huX la thim/rol chen/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo / /slob dpon gyi gnas gsum nas yi ge 'khru gsum dpag tu med pa spros/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du bstim/ rol chen/ yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo / /de rnams bum dbang la sogs pa dbang bzhi'i don yin no/ /zhes kyang ngo sprad/ de nas gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba ni/ gtoram 'di nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sdes bskor bar dngos su bsgom/ de la mos gus dung ba byas pas/de nyid 'ur 'ur chem chem khyed rang gi spyi bor byon/ phyi nang gi bar chad thamasacad bsrung ba dang / gnod byed bgegs dang log 'dren/ mthu gtad sbyor ba ngan pa byed pa'i byad ma thams cad zhal du chom chom gsol bar mos shig byas la/ gtor ma de rnams kyi spyi bor bzung / rol chen dang bcas par bka' bsgo drag tu bya'o/ /'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo / /rjes gtso bos ji ltar gas dang /gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang / deng nas brtsams te gos dang / bsod din mas 'a yis sogs bya'o/ /rjes chog ni/ mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ spyi dang mas par byin gyis brlabs/ gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs pa/dam tshig pa bsdu ba/ rang gi gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa/ smon lam gdab pa/ bkra shis kyisamatha' bsten pa rnams rim pa bzhin spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /kun khyab zab par grags pa yis/ /phyir zlog man ngag rab dga' ba/ /sgrub thabs snga phyi bgrang yas las/ /snying po khol byung tsam zhig bkod/ /mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can sngon mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /—142—

༄༅〉/ /o swā sti/ dbang du byed dang phyir bzlog la/ /mchog tu rno zhing myur ba yi/ /seng gdong mkha' 'gro'i rig sngags la/ /btud nas dmar mo'i sgrub thabs mug da/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/shā n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang la e las chos 'byung mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ rang sems hiXyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas gri gug gser mdog nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭāX ga dang bcas pa/ spyan gsum/ skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang / phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ pad nyi ru ṭa pho mo gan rkyal du bsnol ba'i steng du zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus nas bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX dang hiXde las 'od 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ oṃ sidha mu kha ḍā ki nī badz+ra sa mā dzaXh+pha/ dza hāXbaX hoX slar yang 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaX de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi ski nyu skyoX/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu rgyan/ snying gar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma —143—

bcu bzhi pa'i nye bar nyi ma la hiX'adab ma rnams la sngags 'phreng g.yas skor du 'khore bar dmigs la/ yi ge bcu bzhi pa nyid bzla'o/ /lhun 'jog khar/ ar+ghaX nas/ sha sto)bar gyis mchod/ sku mdog dmar mo dgyes pa'i nyams ldan ma/ /bde ba'i nyams ldan dgyes pa'i 'dzum ldan ma/ /thar pa'i lam ston mchog gi dngos grub ster/ /mu stegs tshar gcod drag sngags 'khrug ltar sgrog/sngags kyi yig 'brus mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud/ /sangs rgyas bstan bsrung drag po'i spyod pa mdzad/ /rnal 'byor bar chad bzlog la rab brtson ma/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod/ gtor ma byin rlabs bsdus pa bla med spyi dang ma lhun pa zhig byas la/h+pha/ zhe༅'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ sidha mu kha ḍā ki nī pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raX ji hi/ i daX bā li ta kha raX ji hi/ mahā rak+ta kha raX ji hi/ zhes pa lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ mchod bstoda'adod don gsol ba btab/ badz+ra muX zhes gi ni gas su gsol/ 'di'i gsang ba lhun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag ni/ lte bar mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sa bon bsgom/ de'i 'go drangs nas bzlas pa byed pa yin no/ /dbang sdud dang bsrung bzlog bsad gsum dang / gzhan yang las tshogs thor bu rnams ni snga phyi'i yi go rnams las shes par bya'o/ /rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ bca' gzhi sngon mo dang mtshur sa pa las/ mdun du gri gug g.yas su thod pa/ rgyab tu ḍā ma sa g.yon du phur pa rnams bkod/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa dang / gtor dbang gi bar seng gdong sngon mo'i skabs dang mtshungs shing 'don pa spo/ de nas gri gug gto la/ skal ldan rigasakyi bu khyod la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pa/ /gri gug mtshan ma'i dbang bskur bas/ /zhi ba'i las kyi dbang thob shog/oṃ badz+ra shwarnyi ku ru a bhi sa ṣañtsa huX/ thod pa gto de/ gri gug mtshan ma'i zhes pa'i tshab tu/ bdud rtsi thod pa'i spyo—144—

dang / zhi ba'i zhes pa la rgyas pa'i zhes dang / shan+ti ku ru la spu sna ku ru zhes 'don pa spo/ de bzhin du/ ḍa ma ru 'khrol du bcug la/ sgra snyan rnge'u chung zhes dang / dbang gi zhes dang / wa shaX ku ru zhes 'don pa spo/ phur bu gto la/ 'phrin las phur bu'i zhes dang / drag po'i zhes dang / mā ra ku ru zhes 'don pa spo/ rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gal te 'di'i gsang ba'i dbang bskur na/ me long la tsan+dan dmar po dang / gi lha dang rang byung gtsang ma sbyar bas mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sabon bri/ sa dmar gyi maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa bri/ bdag mdun gyi skabasagasang ba'i sngags bzla/ rjes gnang snga ma bzhin rdzogs pa'i rjes su me long gnas lngar gtugs/ mkha' 'gro rigs lnga gnas lngar bstim/ maṇ+ḍal gyi sa dmar nas slob dpon gyis mtheb srin gyis blangs te/spyi bor thig le gcig bya/ rigs bdag bla mar mos/ dpral bar thig le gcig bya/ lus lha skur bsgom pa'i brda'/ snying gar thig le bcu bzhi bkod/ yig 'bru bcu bzhin mos/ lte bar thig le lnga bkod/mkha' 'gro sde lngar bskyed cing bstim/ me long gi yi ge rnams nang mchod kyis bkrus la spyi bor blug 'thung du gzhug khrus kyang byar gzhug go /'di bka' gnyan par byed pas gang thod thod du mi sbyin no/ /mkha' 'gro seng ge gdong can gyi/ /sgrub thabs kun las dga' ba'i phul/ /bsgrub bya snying nasa'agugs pa dang / /drag sto'i sngags kyi phyir bzlog yin/ /mkha' 'grom seng ge'i gdong pa can dmar mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅m+bi/ /o swā sti/ 'jam dpal sprul pa'i khro bo ni/ /tshure dzind po klu srin tshul/ /de la btud nas de'i sgrub thabs/ /klu nad can la phan phyir bri/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang sems phe yig nag po las phe yig dpag tu med pa spros/ phe rak+ṣa ku ru huX/rin po che bkrams pa'i rgya mtshor sbrul las byas pa' gzhal yas khang gi nang du — 145—

sa bdag klu gnyan stan du bting ba'i steng du/ rang nyid rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga ra kas sku mdog nag po dbu bcu phyag bco brgyad pa/ rtsa zhal trin po'i gdong shin tu khros pa'am/ yang na dbu dgu khro zhal du byas kyang legs/ gang ltar yang sprul mgo dgu bar snang khams su 'phyo ba/ sprul mgo dbus ma'i spyi bor rgyal ba mi bskyod pa bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad gri gug gam ral gri/g.yon brgyad sprul zhags 'dzin pa/ dang po gnyis thugs kar bsnol bar byasapa'ang yod/ sku stod srin po'i lus ri rab la rgyab brten pa/ sku smad sbrul 'jug rgya mtsho'i gting du 'khyil ba/ zhal thams cad nas ig sha'i sgra sgrog pa/ral pa sprugs pa las srog chags gdug pa'i tsha tsha 'phro ba/ klu chen brgyad kyis sku la brgyan pa/ klu rigs thams cad zas su za ba/ gdol pa nag po 'og tu gnon pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /snying gar ye shes sems dpa' sprul dkar po 'khyil zhing gdengs ka byas pa'i snying kar ting 'dzin sems dpa' nyi ma la gnas pa'i phe nag po la sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs nas/ oṃ phe laX hūX/ zhes yig 'bru bzhi pa bzla zhing / nag po ti pa tsa nā ga raka oṃ phe laX huX/ zhes pa'i drag sngags kyang cung zad bzla/ bsnyen sgrub byed na sgrub yig nas bshad pa bzhin las/ bzlas pa mang nyung sogs blo bzo byar mi bshub/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying po'i mthar/ i daX ba li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi btags la phul/rjes gnang ni/ gtor ma gru gsum gyi mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gtor 'bul rnams song ba'i rjes su gtor ma lha —146—

skur gsal ba'i sprul mgo dbus ma'i rin po che'i dprog zhu'i nang du/ bla ma rdorje 'a myong gi rnam pa can bzhugs par mos la/ bla ma rin po che bdag la 'jam dpal nā ga raka sa'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer byung /slob ma'i dpral bar thim/ bum dbang/ de bzhin du/ mgrin pa'i ā las gsang dbang / thugs ka'i hu las sher dbang / gnas gsum gyi 'bru gsum las dbang bzhi pa len zhing / de bzhin du rig pa'i rgyal po'i sku las kyang len/de rnams re re'i mtshams su spos dang rol mo bya/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhagabaka' bsgo re mdzad/ lha zhi drag gnyis ka bsgom pa nga/nga / sngags bzlas pa'i lung 'bogs/ rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'og gdon kun la ches rno ba'i/ /gdams ngag gu rle'i gter mar grags/ /kun tu nyer mkho rab dga' 'di'i/ /rjes gnang byed tshul snyid twor bkod/ /'jam dpal nā ga rasga'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ sna tshogs pa'i sde'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bco lnga pa'o// //zhus dag/ dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /tsho6snya sti/ 'dren pa sangs rgyas rnams sangs rgyas/ /dpa' bo bdun la rab btud nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs rmad byung ba/ /shin tu rnyed dka' bkod par bya/ /sems bskyed tshad med bzhi dhi dhi rdo~X ༵ /gro rin/ kyā sna lhi stong / da ༵༵ gad/kli hūṃ ༵ je re rjo ༵ngas ༵ ༵ra —147—

pa las/ dbus su rang nyid rgyal ba shākya thub pa chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/shar du rnam gzigs sa gnon dang mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ byang shar du gtsug tor can mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag shar lhor thams cad skyob skyabs sbyin mnyam bzhag nub tu 'khor ba 'jig ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ lho nub tu gser thub chos 'chad mnyam bzhag nub byang du 'od srungs g.yas mchod sbyin dang g.yon chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba lta bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang gser mdog mtshan dpes spras pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing / rdo rje'i skyil krung gi rang rang gi byang chub shing drung du bzhugs pa/ lho ru khro bo chen po sngon po mchan khung ral gri dang zhags pa bcug cing thal mo sbyar ba/ khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /byang du phyag na rdo rje zhi ba ljang khu g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing / g.yon gdan la brten pa rol pas bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po tshes brgyan pa'o/ /sgo bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi dang bcas pa gsal btab/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza dzaḥhub ho thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par ā thugs kar hu/ ar+gha nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /sogs kyis bstod/ dkar gtor zhig sngags drug gis byin gyis brlabagadakar phyogs kyi lha rnams yid kyis bkug ste/ a kwa ro lan bcu gcig gis bsngos/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs mya ngan 'tshang la gnas/ /rgyal ba gtsug tor pad+ma dkar po'i drung / /thams cad skyob pa sā la'i drung na gnas/ /bram ze 'khor ba 'jig ni shirnya'i drung / /sangs rgyas gser thub u dum ba ra'i drung / /'od srungs n+ya gro da —148—

yi drung na gnas/ shwakya thub mchog a shwa tho drung du/ /phyin nas byang chub thob gyur go ta ma/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul chen po de dag la/ /mngon par dad pa'i lha gang spyod pa dag/lha rnams de dag yid dga' mgu gyur nas/ /rtag tu dge zhing zhi bar 'gyur bar mdzod/ /ces brjod la/ ga sto ma dor/ ru ru su bhā wa naX/zhes mgron rnams gi shogs/ na maXsarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya/ a nu ga te/ tshe ku ruXgo ni swāhā/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi spyi'i sngags dang / sangs rgyas bdun pa'i gzungs las 'byung ba ltar so so'i gzungs kyang nus na bzla'o/ /sa 'jog pa'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang la bsdu/rang yang snying ga'i sa bon la bstim la cung zad mnyam par bzhag/dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su lha'i snang ba dang ma bral ba dang / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang / sangs rgyas bdun pa'i gzungs klog pa'am/ 'don pa ci nus su bya zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sku gzugs la phyag mchod rgya cher bya/ 'di'i rigs gtad bya tshul ni/ bsgom bya dang sna pa'i dkyil 'khor ras bris rdul tshon sogasa'agrub na rab/ min na rgya gar pa'i lugs kyi maṇ+ḍal me tog gsar ba'i tshom bu can bsham/ bum pa gtsang ma bum rdzas kyis gang ba gnyis bsham/ mchod gtod yang mang du bzhag go /bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mdun bskyed bzlas pa la thug gi bar yang bdag bskyed kyi rigs 'gre/ bum pa gcig gi steng du de bzhin gshogs pa bdun/ rgyal chen bzhi dang bcas pa bskyed cig shos su khro bo chen po dang gsang ba'i bdag por bskyed/ 'di la oṃ bi kṛ ta daXlge a mo gha sa ma ye/ a bhi khri thu 9༷ku/sarba bi du a mo gha/ a bi ṣe kai hūX mi li mi li swāhā/ zhes bzla'o/ /de dag gi skulas byubaba'i bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar mos/ lha rnams mchod bstod gshogs gsol bya/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal byasate/ slob dpon gyis bdag la rig sngags dam pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/— 149—

yan lag bdun pa dang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gang yang rung ba zhig bya/ sngags kyi che ba mang du brjod/bgegs rnams la gtor ma byin te phyir bskrad/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa sgom du bcu gdang por khro bo chen po'i sngags kyis dbang bskur/ des bkru byabs bsrung gsum bya/ de nas gzhal yas khang ṣ+kashar sgo'i nang du 'dug par mos su bcug la/ snying po'i mthar a bhi khiñtsa btags la/ bum pa gan bodes dbang bskur zhing / spro na so so'i mtshan sngags kyis kyang dbang bskur ro/ /de nas gong gomangon rtogs bzhin bsgom lung phog la sngags kyi bzlas lung kyang sbyin no/ /rjes spyi dang 'dra/ de la mtshan sngags ni/ oṃ na mo bi pa phye ta thā ga tā ya swāhā/ oṃ na maXtshan khi ni ta thā ga tā ya swāhā/oṃ na mo bi shwa bhu dze ta thā ga tā ya swāhā/ oṃ na maXkra ku ta na rnye ta thā ga tā ya swāhā/oṃ na mo na ka na ka mu na ye ta thā ga tā ya swāhā/ oṃ na maXka shu pa ta thā ga tā ya swāhā/ tsho( na maXtshan kya mu na ye ta thā ga tā ya swāhā/ zhe༅pa rnams yin no/ ta du tha/ skye( munimu ne mahā mu na ye swāhā/ zhes pa'ang bzla'o/ /sangs rgyas kun las dpa' bo'i sku/ /chos 'dul gcig tu rab dga' ba/ /rnam bdun sgrub thabs rmad byung 'di/ /nyams len snying por byed na'o/ /paṇ+ḍita gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣa ta'i man ngag sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyis sgrub thabasakyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅// /o swā sti/ gsung go rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid/ /bde ba can gyi zhing sbyangs te/ /'od dpag med par sangs rgyas pa/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/shā n+ya ta so stong par sbyangs/ rang gi snying gar sdiXyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/rang nyid rgyal ba 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs rdorje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ na bza' —150—

chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaXdzaXhūX baX hoX dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ thugs kar khyiXyig gi mthar sngags 'che/nga dmigs la/ tsho ( a mṛ ta pra bhe a rdzita huX/ zhesaci nus bzla/ 'jug tu dge ba bsngo/ thi mtshams sku gzugs kyi drung du mchod bstod/ bde ba can gyi wo bkod kyi mdo dang bzang po spyod pa 'don/ 'di la gtor chog mi dgos/ slob ma la'ang bzlas lung tsam gyis 'grub/ slob dpon gyis bdag la rigs sngags dam pa stsal du ga cho ye//zhes pa gsol ba lan gsum du gdab dgos te/ slob dpon gyi rjes zlos byas pas chog go /de yang sems bskyed gsal btab la/ sko/ n+ya tā nas/ thug ba/kar hūX zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin phog gsung gi rjes gnang gi lung bzhin rjes su bzlas pa'i lung ster ba yin no/ /dbang ma thob pa la bzlas lung sbyin yang don med pas rgyud sde bzhi gang rung gi dbang bskur thob pa zhig la sbyin no/ /sangasargyas kun las ches dga' bar/ /zhing mchog bla na med sgrub pas/ /rgyal ba mchog la snying nasadad/ /sgrub thabs 'dus shing gsal stor bkod/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag 'od dpag tu med pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅’/ /skyed swā sti/ rgyal tshab mi pham mgon po la/ /btud nas de yi sgrub thabs ni/ /shin tu zab cing 'khyer bde ba/ /'phags yul bla ma'i gsung bzhin bri/ /tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ hwa/ n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/ rang gi snying gar ri dmar ser yongs su gyur pa las/ ranganyid rje btsun byams par gyur/ oṃ mi tri ya tri/ de yang sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis bshad pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon pas klu shing gi —151 —

yal ga me tog dang bcas pa snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ dar gyi smad dkris dang ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi ngos la byang chub chen po'i mchod rten can mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa/ khro bo gzhan kyis mi thub pa dang bcas pa'o/ /zhabs kyi bzhugs tshul rang gang mos pa bya/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āXthugs kar huX/ oṃ mi tri dra lha tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha ho/ zhes lan gsum gyis brtan par byin gyisabarlabs/ snying gar zla ba la sngags 'phreng bkod la/ glu( a ji / tañdza ya/ sarba satwa rba(mya ya mkhanu ga ta swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /sa 'jog pa'i tshe/ stong pa nyid du bsdus nas/ slar lha skur ldang / dge ba bsngo/ thun 'tshams su mchod bstod spyi ma lhun gang 'grub dang / byams pa'i mtshan brgya dang dam bcas pa'i gzungs rnams 'don no/ /'dil gtor bsngo mi dgos/ 'di bzlas lung blangs pa kho nas chog de yang lha'i mngon rtogs slob ma la phog la/ sngags nyid bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin no/ /de la'ang dbang bskur ba thob pa dgos so/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos sangs rgyas sras/ /rab dga' la sogs sa bcu'i bdag/gsung rab snying sto'i don ston pa/ /gang 'di'i sgrub thabs rmad byung spel/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag byams pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅༅/ /glu'o swā sti/ dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /smon lam rgya mtsho las 'khrungasapa/ /mchod pa'i sprin la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /kun tu bzang por gus pa'i 'dud/ /sems bskyed dang tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ shā n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la rangasems stuX yig yongs su gyur pa las kun tu bzang po sku mdog dmar po/—152—

g.yas gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar gtod cing / g.yon nyi ma dang pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ khro bo ṭak+ki rā dza dang bcas pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXspyiX baX hoX dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ thugs kar zla ba la sngags('phreng bkod de/ oṃ gaX hriXka ya swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ 'jug tu sku stong par sbyangs/ dge ba byang chub tubasngothun mtshams su kun du bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa la sogs pa ci nus su 'don zhing / phal po che dang gser 'od dam pa la sogs pa bklag par bya'o/ /g.yin yang sku gzugs la mchod bstod dang smon lam mang du 'debs/'di'i bzlas lung 'bogs pa ni/ 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs su bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /kun tu bzang po grags che yang / /mkhas rnams dga' ba'i sgrub thabs ni/ /sngon chad bod kyi phyogs na med/ /de phyir snying la dam por bzung / /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅// /glud swā sti/ rgyal sras thugs rje'i dbang phyug ni/ /nam mkha'i snying po la btud nas/ /nang mtshon mu ge'i 'jigs pa dag/zhi phyir lhag pa'i lha de bsgrub/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/shā n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/ rang gi snying gar khaX yig yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid nam mkha'i snying po sku mdog sngon po na bza' sngon po can/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yon pas pad+ma'i rtsa ba 'dzin pa/ snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na ral gri sngo sangs can/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyi —153—

khang bzang 'od zer sngon po 'bar ba'i dbus na/ khro bo dbyug sngon sogs 'khor rig 'dzin mtshon cha thogs pa mang po dang / rang gi sprul pa kha dog sna tshogs can mang pos bskor ba/ spyan gyi 'od kyis nam mkha' thams cad 'od dang dri zhim pos khyab par mdzad pa/ dar dang rin po tshes brgyan pa nas/ thugasakar huX gi bar kun tu bzang po'i skabs dang 'dra/ tso ( snya nyis ka ma lwa k+ṣi/ bi pu la/ saX bha wa/ dharma bhā tu/ go tsa re swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba dang / a mtshams kyang kun tu bzang po'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa klog pa nyid khyad par ro/ /'di'i bzlas lung 'bogs tshul ni/ 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs su bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /nyesalhung kun nas dag mdzad pa'i/ /yi dam 'di 'dra mchog tu dga'/ /mtshan brgya'i man ngag snying po ni/ /zur du bkol ba 'di tsam yin/ /paṇ+ḍita gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i sgrub thabs kyi len tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅// /tseXṭaswā sti/ gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha min 'joms shing 'byor ba rgyas/ /chos ldan rgyal srid brtan 'gyur ba'i/ /sa snying sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shā n+ya twas stong par sbyangs/ pad zla la rang sems cha yig yongs su gyur pa las/rang nyid sa'i snying po ser po stod g.yogs ser po can/ zhi ba spyan rtsa dmar ba/me tog sngon po'i phreng ba'i thod can/ phyag g.yas shing tog dang g.yon pad+ma'i steng na nor bu dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ 'od zer ljang khu 'phro ba rdo rje sa 'og la sogs pa 'khor gyis bskor ba/ gzhal yas khang ser po rin po che'i brag ri dang gangs ris bskor ba/ dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa sogs mngon rtogs lhagam—154—

sa du bzang po'i skabs dang 'dra/ oṃ su bha ni su bha/ ha ra tsa ra/ mahā pa sha mā ru ta/a mo rna gha badz+ra san+ta swāhā/ zhes bzla/ rjes dang thun mtshams kyang kun bzang gi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ sa'i snying po'i mtshan brgya nyid klog pa khyad par ro/ /'di'i bzlas lung 'bogs tshul yang / 'od dpag med kyi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /sa steng kun du rnyed dka' ba'i/ /sgrub thabs thos pa dga' ches nas/ /snyib nas dad pa skyes gyur te/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig gsal stor bkod/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag 'phags pa so'i snying po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅༅/ /glu'e swā sti/ sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba dang / /rdo rje'i tshe 'grub phyir bzlog che/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam se'1 gyis/ /rig sngags lags pas de phyir bsgrub/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shā n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la rang sems ske las rang nyid sgrib pa rnam sel sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin zhing / g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng du/ zla ba nya gang ba ra ri med cing 'od zer 'phro ba/phyir bzlog chen po gtsug gtor 'khor los bsgyur ba sogs rig pa'i khro bo mang pos zhabs la bshud pa/ dar dang zin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ nas/thugs kar hu gi bar kun tu bzang po'i skabs bzhin no/ /o a spru ta 'e dzā wā/ mahāsukha swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ rjes dang thun mtshams kun bzang gi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ sgrib pa rnam sel gyi mtshan brgya klog pa nyid khyad par ro/ /'di'i bzlas lung 'bogs tshul yang / 'od dpag med kyi skabs su bshad pa 'dra'o/ /bod yul kun du 'di yis ni/ /sgrub thabs yod par ma mthong nas/ /bla ma'i drung du dga' bas zhus/ /gsung tho snyed swo tsam zhig bkod/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las— 155—

byung ba/ shākya ra khri ta'i man ngag 'phags pa sgrib pa rnam sel gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyasa'aphel/ /༄༅༅/ /glud swā sti/ gang zhig bsam pa tsam gyis ni/ /'jigs pa brgyad las nges skyob pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang la bsgyud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus bshad/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ hūṃ n+ya lhag stong par sbyangs/ pa las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/pad zla la rang sems a dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dkar po 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan can/ zhal gcig phyag brgyad kyi g.yas bzhi na/ seng ge glang chen dug sbrul gza'/ g.yon bzhi na/ me chu lcags sgrog mi rnams 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs can/ dar dang zin po tshes brgyan pa/ mdun du tā las sgrol ma ser mo phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar bas nor bu 'dzin pas gtso bo la 'dud pa'o/ /oṃ a wa lo ki te pad+me ni/ wa rā gi ṇi/ tu ru tu ru hu swāhā/ zhes pa dang / oṃ ma ṇi hā re hu/ golayang ci 'grub tu bzla'o/ /lhun 'jog khar sgrol ma rang gi snying gar thim/ phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyisalhun mtshams la 'jug gtsang sbra dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ bris sku dang mchod rten la phyag mchod gang 'grub bya'o/ ta di'i bzlas lung 'bogs tshul yang 'od dpag med kyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /kun las ngo mtshar rmad byung sku/ /'jigs brgyad skyob pa rab dga'i gnas/ /rgyud kyi snying po yin no zhes/ /bla ma'i gsung las gsal bar thos/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag spyan rasagazigs 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅/ /o swā sti/ gang la gang 'dul sna tshogs sku/ /don yon zhags pa —156—

la btud nas/ /sna tshogs dbang po'i sgrub thabs ni/ khren tu mdor bsdus gribar bya/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/shā n+ya twas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me chu sa ri rab pad+ma zla ba nyi ma brtsegs pa las sgra gcan 'gyel ba'i steng du/ rang sems khyiXlas rang nyid don yod zhags pa sna tshogs dbang po sku mdog dkar po/ zhal bcu gcig rtsa zhal zhi ba dkar po spyan gsum pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ g.yas su lha zhi ba dang / gshin rje gnod sbyin/ drag po chen po/ zla ba rnams kyi zhal brtsegs pa dang / g.yon du khyab 'jug chu lha/gdong drug khros pa/ drag po/ nyi ma'i zhal rnams brtsegs pa'o/ /kun gyi steng gi dbus su 'od dpag med mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ g.yas su rlud lha dang /g.yon du me lha lus phyed phyed snang ba/ phyag sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dang po gnyisanor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gzhan rnams kyis brgya byin gyi rdo rje la sogs pa lha rnams kyi mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa'o/ /zhabs brgyad kyi 'og tu klu dang lha min dang srin po'i tshogs rnams mnan pa/ dar dang pags pa'i gos dang /rin po che dang / sprul dang / tshe tog la sogs pa na bza' dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ tshe dpung dang 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'o/ /thugs kar zla ba la zhags pa dmar po'i steng du sgyiXmatha' mar sngags kyis bskor ba/ oṃ a mogha pā sha kro dha a kar+ṣa ya/ pra pe sha mahā pa shu pa ti/ ya ma/ wā ru ṇa/ ku be ra/pra h+ma/ be ṣa dha ra/ a mo gha khyoXd ya/ pad+ma ku la sa mā ya/ hūX huX huX/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'i snying po nyid ci nus su bzla zhing / don yod zhags pa'i gzungs ring kyang 'don no/ /rang lus cha gnyis su gyur pa las g.yas kyi cha ni sna tshogs dbang po'i sku —157—

dang / g.yon gyi cha lha mo gos dkar mo rang dang mtshungs pa las lha mo'i rnam pa can/ phyag na pad+ma 'ba' zhig 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ pad+me paṇ+ḍa ra wā si ni kuṇ+ḍakuṇ+ḍa grwa hā/ zhes pa ci rigs pa bzla'o/ /a mtshams kyi bya ba dang / lung 'bogs tshul ni/ 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs dang 'dra'o/ /mos pa sna tshogs kun 'dud cing / /mu stegs 'dul ba rab dga'i gnas/ /spyan gzigs sgrub thabs snying po 'di/ khren tu ya mtshan che phyir bkod/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag 'phags pa sbyan ra logazigs sna tshogs dbang po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /glu ste swā sti/ spyan ras gzigs dbang 'od dpag med/ /bla mar bcas la gusabatud nas/ /pad+ma'i phyag tu mtshan gsol ba/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs semasatshad med bzhi sngon du bto ste/hūṃ n+ya tus stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las snod bcud thams cad rang bzhin ye shes kyi dkyil snyen ra du gyur/ oṃ pra kṛ te pa ri shudha sarba dharma pra kri te pa ri shurnyo3ha/ snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang gyidabus su/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi ci lus gag tu 'dres pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sems gcig tu 'dus pa nor bus mtshan pa'i pad+ma dkar po dag gcig tu 'dus pa de'i lte ba la sdi sa mtshan pa/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/sangs rgyas thams cad rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ zla ba la pad+ma khyo dang bcas pa la thim/ thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur ba las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig phyag stong dang ldan pa/ sku lus ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar zhing mgrin pa —158—

sngo ba/ rtsa zhal dkar po'i steng du 'tshog ma dang rna ltag g.yas g.yon gyi phyogasal zhi ba'i zhal drug sngo ser dkar dmar ljang ba dang rgya tshos kyi kha dog can/de'i nang rim la khro bo'i zhal gsum ste/ nag po dmar nag sngo skya'o/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi rtse mor sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa'i zhal tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can dmar po'o/ /dbu bcu gag po thams cad kying mgul pa dang bcas pa/ phyag dang po gnyas thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas pa rnamasakyis bgrang 'phreng mda' 'khor lo ral gri rtse gsum/ g.yon pa rnams kyisagaser gyi pad+ma gzhu spyi blugs po ti kha ṭāX ga rnams 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang brgyad cu gya brgyad mchog spyin gyi mthil nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bab pa/ phyag gi mthil na spyan re re dang bcas pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung ngam mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/g.yon phyogs su lha mo sgrol ma dkar mo cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs can/ phyag g.yas pas gtso bo la 'byud cing / g.yon pas ut+pal sngon po mdzes pa/ steng gi nam mkha' la de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnamasapa'i chu rgyun gyis rtag tu dbang bskur ba'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āXthugs kar huX/ mig tu k+ṣi/ rna bar dzi/ sna la khaX/ lce la gaX dpral bar skaX/ lte bar saX/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ a mṛ ta u pa ta ya mi/ 'khor 'dasathams cad kyi bcud kyi bdud rtsi gsol/ oṃ bodhi tsit+ta a nu rā ga ya mi/ rjes chags kyi bde bas rgyud gang / lte bar pad+ma dmar po la āX snying gar sngon po la huX/ spyi bor dkar po la oṃ mgo thur bstan/ srog rtsol bsdams te 'bar —159—

dzag ci nus su bsgom mo/ /de nas bzlas pa ni/ oṃ pad+ma hasta/ sa ha sra badz+ra bhu dzane sta nī la kaṇ+ḍa/ lo ke shwa rā ya hūṃ huX phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma tā re huX/ zhes ci nus su bzla zhingamathar dmigs med du mnyam par bzhag dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su snang grag thams cad lha sngags su shes par bya/ mchod bstod yan lag bdun pa sogs ci rigs par spyad/ 'di la dbang bskur thob pa la sgrub thabs bshad nas sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa nyid kyis chog go /'di ni spyan ras gzigs kyisagrub thob chen po kam la ga ma'i sgrub thabs kyi lugs yin no/ /kun dga'i yul mchog li yul nas/ /dgobasnyen pad+mas spyan drangs pa'i/ /rgyud las snying po tsam bsdus pa'i/ /sgrub thabs ngo mtshar e ma ho/ /paṇ+ḍita gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba li yul nas gdan drangs par grags pa/ zhal bcu gcig pa pad+ma'i phyag go sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /o swā sti/ yi go drug pa'i bdag nyid can/ /bde ldan jo bor mtshan gsol pa/ /su kha de bas zhal gzigs pa'i/ /sgrub thabs bzhin du bsgom par bya/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du bto nas/ hūṃ n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i gdan la pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs jo bo su kha wa ti sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ g.yas kyi dang po ba dan rtsegasum pa'i phyag rgya/ gnyis pa na bgrang 'phreng / gsum pa na nor bu dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin/ g.yon dang po pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu nor bus mtshan pa/ gnyis pa na dbyug gu rtse gsum/ tha ma na spyi blugs 'dzin pa/zhabs rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing / dar dang rin po tshes brgyan pa/—160—

ral pa'i cod pan can/ g.yon phyogs su rang snang gi yum ut+pal 'dzin pas 'byud pa/ rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan pa'o/ /mig tu oṃ dkar po/ rna bar ma sngon po/ snar ṇi ser po/ lce la pad dmar po/ dpral bar me ljang khu/ lte bar huX sngo skya/ sgyi bor oṃ/ mgrin pa āX thugs kar huX/ ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXspyiX baX hoX oṃ ma ṇi pad+me huX/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzla'o/ khas ga tuchos thams cad skyu ma lta bur shes pa'i sgo nas dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su lha'i snang ba dang ma bral bar bya/ rdzo bo bde ldan dmar po bsgom par 'dod na/ phyag g.yon gyi dang po pad+ma dkar po'i steng du glegs bam dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ sku mdog dmar po thugs kar sbasapa'i yum sgrol ma ut+pal dmar po 'dzin zhing kha 'byed pa/ de'i thugs kar sabon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa bsgom pa dang / bzlas pa'i tshe/ yum la/ oṃ pad+ma tāre huX/ zhes bzla ba ni/ 'di dang mtshungs pa lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs ma hā dza nas mdzad pa zhin sngar 'gyur yang bka' med la/ 'di ni dbang thob pa zhig la sgrub thabs bshad nas/ sngags kyi bzlasalung spyin pa tsam gyis chog go /tshong dpon rigs las grub brnyes pa/ /kun dga' grags ldan de yi gzhung / /snyid stor bsdus pa'i nyams len ni/ /'di ltar lags pas sa zhes par bzung / /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ spyan ras gzigs su kha wa ti'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyasa'aphel/ /༄༅’/ /skyed swā sti/ spyan ras gzigs dbang la btud nas/ /don yod lcags kyu sgrub pa'i thabs/ /mdo tsam bla ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /gzhan la phan phyir bri bar bya/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shā n+ya lhas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems hiXyig dmar po —161 —

yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid don yod lcags kyu skya rengs gsar pa'i mdog can/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa/ rgyan spangs pa/ sbyan gsum 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ rgya nag go bla gos dang / ri dwags kyi pags pa'i smad g.yogs can mnyam par bzhengs pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas bzhi na lcags kyu dang / g.yon bzhi na zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /snying gar zla ba la sngags 'phreng bkod de/ oṃ a du sha a mo gha a khan ya huX/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzla'o/ /lhun mtshams su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku brnyan la mchod cing bstod pa dang / mdo sde klog pa la nan du bya'o/ /'di'i lung 'bogs tshul ni/ 'od dpag med kyi skabs dang 'dra ba yin no/ /kun du spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs/ /rab dgas skul bar byed pa'i lha/ /don yod lcags kyu'i sngags rgyud ni/ /mtha' yas gsungs pa'i snying po 'di'o/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag don yod lcags kyu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅/ /o swā sti/ spyan ras gzigs dbang la bcad nas/ /don yod ma rdzo pa sgrub pa'i thabs/ /mdo tsam bla ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /gzhan la phan phyir bri bar bya/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shā n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngangalas pad zla la lhaXyig las/ rang nyid 'phags pa don yod mchod pa'i nor bu zhes bya ba/ sku mdog dkar po yid tsam khro zhing spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang tri shu la/ g.yon gnyis na zhags pa dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ral pa'i cod pan la 'od dpag med kyis brgyan pa/ chu'i dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po la gnas pa/ g.yas g.yon na klu dga' bo nyer dga' dkar po pus mo —162—

btsugs shing / thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /lkoX a mo gha pū dza ma ṇi/ pad+ma badz+re ta thā ga tā/bi 'e1 ki te/ sa man+ta pra sa ra khruX zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /thun mtshams su bris sku la phyag mchod ci 'grub bya/ bsnyen pa 'bru 'bum du song nas/ bdag dang sa sku gnyis ka lhar bskyed la/mchod bstod yan lag bdun pa dang bzlas pa 'bum tsam bya'o/ /phyis de la mchod cing gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis klu nad gso ba dang / char 'bebs pa dang / longs spyod sgrub pa thams cad thogs pa med pa yin no/ /'di'i lung 'bogs tshul ni/ 'od dpag med kyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /rgyud las gsal bar gsungs na yang / /kun gyis mtshan yang ma thos pa/ /bdag gis thob 'di yid dga'i gnas/ /nyamasalen snyid sto mdo tsam yin/ /paṇ+ḍita gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag 'phagasapa don yod mchod pa nor bu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅’/ /oX snya sti/ rdorje sems dpa' thugs kyi bdag /thugs kyi rdo rje thugs kyi gan/ /thugs gyi dbang phyug gsang ba'i rgyal/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ shā n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/ rang gi snying gar hūX yig rdo rje dngabacas pa'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po zhi ba phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing / g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ yid tsam khro ba'i nyams can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan pa/rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad zla la bzhugs pa/ yum mā ma gī dkar la sngo ba'i mdangs can/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas sku'i g.yon phyogs nas 'byud pa/oṃ sarba mahā badz+ra a gra wa raX huX/ oṃ ki ri ki ri mā ma gī hūX/ zhes cung zad bzlas/yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub sems kyi phung por gyur/ phyogs —163—

bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ sam ya stuX zhes bskul bas/ de nyid hūX du gyur/de las rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum shin tu khros pa/ g.yas rdo rje 'bar ba 'phyar zhing g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa'i sdigs mdzub kyas yum la 'khyu/da pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ nyi ma'i 'og tu dbang phyug chen po dang / u ma dang / nor bdag dang / klu dang / lha ma yin la sogs pa dregs pa thams cad kha bub tu mnan pa/ gdug pa'i sbrul zhal du gsol ching stag lpags dang sbrul rgyan dang mi mgo'i do shal can/ khro bo'i rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /yum rig 'dzin ma sngon mo cung zad zhi zhing sgeg pa/ skra grol ba/ rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'byud pa/ gcer bu sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ gnyis ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing / mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ ri rab kyi rtse mor byon par gyur/ snying gar sngags 'phreng bkod la/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duXrnge ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūX phaṭa/ oṃ ku lun+ta mi ban+ta ban+ta hūX phaṭa/ ces kha spyor gyi bzlasapaci nus su bzla'o/ kha zas kyi phud yi ge 'bru gsum gyis gtor mar byin gyis brlabs la/ snying po'i mthar/ 6tidaX bā kla ta kha kha khā hi ji hi zhes btags pas 'bul/ /'di'i byin rlabs byed par 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal gru gsum nag po zhig bya/ der ma zhi'i steng du thod pa dam rdzas kyis bkang ba'i nang du lcags kyi rdo rje zhig bzhag sha chang gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang mchod pas bskor/ thams cad a rlu tas bsangs/ mchod pa rnams spyi dang ca par byin gyis brlabs/ bdag mdun dbyer med kyi tshul du bzlas pa'i bar tshar gyis bsgom/ thugs ka nas las kyi rdo rje zhig chad de/ mchod pa —164—

'bul bar bsams la/ ar+gha nas/ shasta'i bar gyi sngags dang phyag rgyas mchod/ gtor ma'ang gongabazhin byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul/ stobs po che la drag shul che/ /rigs sngags 'chang ba bde ba po/ /gdul dka' ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ de nas slob mas/ oṃ he badz+ra ā tsar+ya ma ma a sa ta glun kuruhu/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ slob dpon gsang ba'i bdag po dngos su bsgom du gzhug slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad gsang bdag yab yum gyi sku'i rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma la bstim/ de bzhin du yig 'bru dang phyag mtshan gyi rnam par yang spyan drangs te bstim/ de gsum la rol mo'i sgra re bya/ slob ma zhi ba yab yum du sgom du bcug la de'i sngags kyi bzlas lung spyin/ khro bo yab yum du'ang sgom du bcug la de'i sngags kyi bzlas lung spyin/ gtor ma nas kham gcig sbyin la 'khru gsum brjod/ bum dbang ngo / /snying po'i mthar 'khru gsum btags pas thod pa'i nang gi dam rdzas spyin/ gsang dbang ngo / /rdo rje snying gar gtad la/bde stong gi ye shes sgrib gnyis 'joms byed du ngo sprad/ sher dbang ngo / /mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs slob ma la bstim/ mi rtog pa sgom du gzhug ste dbang bzhi pa'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rdo rje/ /lhan cig skyes dga'i rang bzhin dngos/ khro rgyal 'di la snying nas dang / /sgrub thabs 'di yang gsal por bkod/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ 'gro lding gi rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po de wa cha bha wa'i man ngag phyag rdor lhan cigaskyes pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /—165—

༄༅༅/ /o swā sti/ rig sngags kun gyi rgyal mo ni/ /mtha' dag bgegs kyi dzind ma mchog/bzod dka' gzi brdzid chen po 'chang / /mā ma kyil rab tu 'dud/ /sems bskyed dang tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/shā n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las huX las rdo rje hūX gisamatshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje lha mo mā ma gī sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/ phyag g.yas pas ye shes kyi rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa me lce'i zer 'phro ba 'phyar ba'i tshul 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thugs kar ut+pal sngon po'i zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ sde brgyad kyi gtso bo dregs pa can thams cad kha bub tu bsgyel ba'i steng du/ pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang / stag lpags kyi smad das can/ sbrul dang rin po che dang me tog gis brgyan pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba'i myu gu gtsigs pa/ khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra phyed ltag par bcings shing phyed grol ba/sangs rgyas mi bskyod pas dbu la brgyan zhing / tsha zer 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ thugs kar rin po che ljang khu cha dgu pa dang / lte bar pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ mgrin par nyi ma'i gdan dgu/ de rnams la rigs lnga yum bzhi'i phyag mtshan dang sku dang sa bon rnams 'god/ lte 'og sor bzhi'i gnas su thod pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i lte bar sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa bkod la/ oṃ ku lun+ta rī ban+ta ban+dha huX phaṭa/ ces pa dang / oṃ shaṅka ri sharnyi ka ri/ ru lhu sna/ snga ni sgyi sne ni/ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci —166—

'grub tu bzla/ sngags kyi 'od zer gong nas gong du spros te spyi bo nas thon pa dang / yang rim pa de nyid go bzlog ste tshur bsdu ba dang / yang gsang ba'i lam nas spro zhing bsdu ba ci nus su bya/ mthar phyag rdor lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs bzhin gtor ma phul la mi dmigs par bzhag go /'di'i byin rlabs byed tshul ni/phyag rdor lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs byed tshul nyid 'don pa spos pas rung ngo / /bgegs 'joms kun lasa'adi mchog ces/ /rgyud las dga' bar bsngags na yang / /phyogs 'dir shin tu dkon pa'i phyir/ /snyi nga bo 'di yang 'bad pas zhus/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ 'gro lding gi rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po/ de wa se bha wa'i man ngag rdo rje lha mo mā ma ki'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅/ /o swā sti/ dbang du byed dang nad zhi dang / /blo dang ting 'dzin nor sgrub pa/ /rig sngags 'di yis 'grub bo zhes/ /rgyud sde kun las gsal bar gsungs/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/shā n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar gnas pa'i paX yig si/ 'od kyis snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor bsgyur/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid lha mo gos dkar mo chen mo sku mdog dmar mo/ phyag g.yon pa pad+ma'i khu tshur gyis pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu brla g.yon pa'i steng du 'dzin zhing / g.yas pas de nyid thugs kar kha phye nas lte bar gnas pa'i nor bu dmar po la sa gzags pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / stod g.yogs dkar po sogs dang dar dang rin po tshes brgyan pa/ rig sngags kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoXganas gsum du oṃ āXhuX/ snying gar pad+ma dmar po kha sbyor gyi dbus su zla ba la —167—

sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa gsal btab ste/ glu rna ka ṭi/ bi ka ṭi/ ni ka ṭi/ ka ṭi ka ṭa grwa hā/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /'di'i bzlas lung 'brogs tshul yang 'od ltag)dkyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /lha 'di dkyil 'khor kun la yod/ /logs su rab dga'i sgrub thabs med/ /de phyir 'phags yul mkhas pa la/ /ched kyis zhus pa'i snying po'o/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi waṃ man ngag lha mo gos dkar mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /glu ste swā sti/ gang la 'chi med tshe sgrub cing / /sdig 'phrog rgyal ba'i byin rlabasa'ajug/nyi ma'i bu las rgyal ba'i thabs/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig bri bar bya/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed/rang gi mdun du bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sa gnon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad cing seng ge la bzhugs pa/ ar+gha la ne/ grags chen snyan grags chen po ba/ /thub chen dpa' bo chen po ba/ /srid pa'i mya ngan bsgal ba po/ /nyon mongs brgal la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tor las sngags 'phreng dang bhu yig brgya rtsa brgyad byung ste/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma dkar mo g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje dang / g.yon lhung bzed bdud rtsi'i gang ba 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par gyur/ rang gi spyi bo'i thad du bzhugs/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun spyi bo nas blug par bsam la/ rnam rgyal gzungs ring nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ bcom ldan 'das ma bhu yig tu gyur/ bhu brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas/ rang nyid gtsug tor rnam par rgyal maragyur/ rang gi snying gar rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa/ de'i thugs kar sna tshogs —168—

rdo rje'i nye ba la bhuX/ mtha' skor du sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ oṃ a mṛ te a mṛ to ta bha we/ a spo ta bi grwa rnye/ a mṛ ta ga te/ a mṛ ta ga mi ni/ a spo ta ā yur da te/ ga ga na sdi sti ka re/ sarba kle sha k+ṣa yaX kā ri ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i gzungs thung '-idonyid ci nus su bzla'o/ /gzungs ring la mos na stong phrag brgyad/ gzungs thung la mos na 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas pas/ bsnyen pa'o/ /thun gyi mthar/ mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das la mchod bstod gsol btab gong bzhin byas nas/ rang gi snying gar thim/ 'jug tu dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/'di'i lung 'bogs pa la/ thub dbang gi bris sku'i drung du/ dpon slob gnyis kar gyis phyagamachod rgyas par bya/ slob dpon gyis gong du bshad pa'i bsgos bzlas de tshar gcig byas nas/ slob masamaṇ+ḍal phul/ 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs ltar gsol ba btab/ gong du bshad pa ltar gyi mngon rtogasasgom tshul tshar gcig spund nas/ gzungs ring thung gnyis la bzlas lung spyi dang ma lhun par spyin pa nyid yin no/ /rnam rgyal sgrub thabs sngon byung ba/ /kun dang thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /ngo mtshar dga' bskyed chos mang can/ /snying po 'di 'dra'ang bdag gis thob/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi tas ma na ngag gtsug tor rnam rgyal phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅rti/ /skye6swā sti/ bar chad zhi zhing ye shes 'bebs/ /bsrung zhing lha sogs dbang du byed/ /rungs rgyas bstan pa rgyas mdzad pa/ /tsuna'i rig sngags la phyag 'tshal/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shā n+ya twas stong pas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la rang sems tsuXyigadakar po las/ lha mo tsun+da dkar mo 'od zer dmar po 'bar ba/ dbu la rgyal ba rigs lnga bzhugs pa/ dkar sngo ser ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar rang gi rtsa ba'i phyag rgya 'a cing ba/ lhag ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi/ /g.yas —169—

rnams skyabs spyin ral gri 'phreng / /bi dza pu ra mda' dgra sta/ /ga da tho ba lcags kyu dang / /rdo rje ba dan bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /g.yon rnams rgyal mtshan pad+ma dang / /spyi blugs zhags pa gzhu shasti/ /'bor lo ral gri sdigs mdzub bum/ /'phang mdung sher phyin po ti 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa yid tsam khro zhing thor tshugs can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og dang / rang gi ba sbu'i bu ga rnams la sangs rgyas bye ba bye ba bzhugs shing / de rnams la mchod cing de rnams kyis bstod pa/ thugs kar zla ba la tsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXklibaX hoX dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar skyoX snying ga'i dbus su pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la sngags yi ge dgu bkod de/ de dag las byung ba'i 'od kyi gong bu dgu'i nang du rigs lnga yum bzhi bzhugs par gyur/ de rnamasakyi 'od kyis 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad dang / tshangs pa dang / sa'i lha mo rnamasakyi sdig sgrib sbyangs bar bsam/ oṃ tsa le tsa le tsu n+di swāhā/ zhes lan dgu bzlasaso/ /de nas bzlas pa ni/ na maXs man+ta ba khyu nāX/ sa myaklaX ba khyu ko khyi naX/ ta du thā/ oṃtsale tsu le tsu rnye swāhā/ zhes pa nyid gang 'grub tu bzla'o/ /thun mtshams su sku gzugs la mchod bstodadang mdo 'don/ maṇ+ḍal mchod chog byed na/ bdag bskyed la dpags na spyi'i rigs 'gre zhing / gtor chog gcig tu dgos pa ma yin kyang / spro na gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs ltar byin gyis brlabasanas/ snying po'i mthar a kā ro btags pas 'bul/ slob ma rjes 'dzin ni/ bzlas lung byed pa stosnodadapag med kyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /rtsa ba'i phyag rgya ni mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i tshigs bar pa la btsugs/—170—

mthe bong gnyis kyi rtse mo mdzub mo'i rtsa ba la bzhag pa'i thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /sa pas rgyas kun gyis bstod gyur pa/ /rab dga' lha mo mthu ldan 'di'i/ /snying po bzlas pas pā la bdun/ /chos skyong rgyal por gyur zhes thos/ /paṇ+ḍita gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag lha mo tsusdo'i sgrub thabasakyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /e rmo swā sti/ mi pham mgon po'i rnam 'phrul las/ /de yi rjes 'brang khro rgyal ni/ /shes rab mthar byed rnam sprul pa/ /bgegs kun 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ hūṃ n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi la rang sems hū serapo las/ khro rgyal gzhan gyis mi thub pa sku mdog gser mdog g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i be con dkar po 'phyar zhing / g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod tshul gyis yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon bskyang bas srin po pho mo mnan pa/ stag lpags dang sbrul dang mgo 'phreng gi rgyan can/ de'i pang du oṃ las gzhan gyis mi thub ma sku mdog ser mo g.yas thal mo sbyar zhing / g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis yab la 'phyud pa/ gcer bu rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas yab la 'khyud cing / g.yas brkyang bas tsho gis bdag mnan pa'o/ /gnyis kar yang rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can me dpung 'bar ba'i sku can gyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hū/ lag g.yas thal mo sbyar/ g.yon sdigs mdzub byas la ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dza dza : rba ho lheng sna dang / sog phrag dang / rtsibs logs g.yas g.yon dang / sta zur g.yas —171 —
