g.yon dang / spyi gtsug dang lte ba rnams su rnam gzigs la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshe/gas pa bdun dang / byams pa la sogs pa bzhugs par bsam/khyogs kyi bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ na maXs man+ta kā ya lha ka tsit+ta badz+ra ṇi oṃ skyoX dzi na ri shis huX huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes yab kyi sngags dang / oX oX a pa ra dzi tī dhi ka swāhā/ yum gyi sngags so/ gtor chog tsu sde'i sgrub thabs kyi rigs 'gre/ lung 'bogasatshul yang 'dra'o/ khro bcu kun gyi zhor tsam las/ logs su sgrub thabs sngar med pa/ /dga' bas bla ma la zhus te/ snying sto tsam 'di rnyed pa lags/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ glu ste swā sti/ gsung mchog bde stong lha yi sku/ /ye shes ha ya gro ba la/ /btud nas de yi sgrub thabs ni/ /shin tu zab pa'i man ngag bshad/ /snying rje chen po dung ba zhig bsgom/ rang sems hiXdakar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rta mchog rol pa sku me dog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ phyag g.yas pad+mas mtshan pa'i dbyug pa 'phyar ba/g.yon pad+ma'i zhags pa 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ pad nyi'i steng du g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bgegs thams cad gnon pa/ dbu'i steng du rta mgo sngon po can khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /yum ral gcig ma sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'phyud pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ lte bar traX/ gsang gnas su a/ nor bu gzhal med khang gi nang du khyiXlas rta mgrin rang dang mtshungs pa las sku mdog ljang khu yum gyi pad+ma'i sna rtser rdo rje sder mo sngo skya phag gdong can ḍā ma ru dang thod pa 'dzin pa —172—

rjes chags snyoms 'jug gi bde bas mchod par bsam/ rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya zlog ste rtse mo bstan la snying pos dam la bzhag/oX badz+ra khu ra wi kri tā na na huX phaṭa/ oX e rkye hi bha ga wa tī yak+ṣi ṇi ye/ e ka dza khyi ṇi/ rak+ta sa hi te/ de wi gi snan pra sha ma ṇi swāhā/ phyi'i yab yum gnyis kyi sngags so/ /gsang ba'i lha la dmigs na ga tseXṅka.a mṛ ta bha woṇ+ḍa wa se swāhā/ oX e he hi/ badz+ra na khri/ badz+ra mu khri/ ha na ha na/ ha na ha na/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ra rgo ra rgo/ a wa a wa/ ā bi sha ā bi sha ha ya kṛ wa pa ya ti swāhā/ zhes bzlas/ dbyug pa sbrul gyis dkris pa la/ /nyi zla rlung gi 'gro 'od can/ /nyi zla mchod cing nyi zla btud/ /'di ni rdzogs pa mchog yin no/ /'di zab mo'i sgrub thabs kyi lugs yin pas phyi'i mchod gtor med/ lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ 'dod yon lnga la rol pa'i mchod pa dang / 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas kha zas bza' ba'i gtor ma dang /dngos sam yid las byung ba rjes chags kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo rnams so/ /'di'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur byed par 'dod na/ mdun du thod pa chang gis bkang ba dang dbyug pa dang zhags pa rnams bzhagabadag dang de rnams ro gcig tu bsgoms te/ gong bzhin mngon rtogs bsgoms nas bzlas pa ci nusabya'o/ /denas slob mas/ oṃ he badz+ra ā tsar+ya ma ma a ti zlas ku ru hūX/ zhes lan gsum gyisagasol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba bzhin yan lag bdun pa bya/ slob ma'i blo ngor slob dpon mngon rtogs ltar bsgom du bcu gde las sku gnyis pa zhig chad nas slob ma la bstim pas/ slob ma rta mgrin du gyur pa'ang mngon rtogs bzhin/ bar der bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par phog yang kyi sngags kyis lan gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i dbyug pa lag pa g.yas su sbyin/ ral ga rtseg ma'i sngags kyis byin gyisabarlabs pa'i zhags pa g.yon du sbyin/ dbyug pas khams gsum 'dul ba dang / zhags pas khamasagasum dbang du byed pa'i dmigs pa bsgom du gzhug bum dbang ngo / /yab kyi sngags gsang ba brjod cing /— 173—

thod pa nas myos byed cung zad sbyin/ nyams myong brjod du med pa ngo sprad de ga4 dbang / rdo rje sder mo'i sngags brjod cing thod pa'i chang rim gyis btung du gzhuganyams myong shes rab ye shes kyi dbang du ngo sprad/pi waX rnga gling bu'am dril bu'i sgra grag stod dbang bzhi par ngo sprad de/ de nas yon 'bul/ tshogs la longasaspyod do/ /'di la rjes kyi cho ga'i bya ba ni med do/ /sgrub thabs kun las lhag pa yi/ /mchog grub rta mgrin ches dag 1 bas/ /snying snro'i ye shes 'char ba 'di/ /mchog tu gsang ba bla med yin/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag rta mgrin dkar po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅༅/ /glu ste swā sti/ rnam par 'dren pa thams cad kyis/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa mi g.yo mgon/ khro bo'i dbang por rab btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs mdo tsam bshad/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ su bhā was sngags brjod/ rang gi snying gar hūXde las 'od 'phros/ lus thams cad gang 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de las rang nyid khro rgyal mi g.yo ba sku mdog dmar po phyag dang po gnyis ral gri dang zhags pa/ bar pa gnyis lcags kyu dang thod pa/ tha ma gnyis dbyug pa dang sdigasamadzub/ zhabs mdun ma gnyas g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bdud dang dga' ma mnan pa/ rgyab ma gnyis / gar stabs kyis tshangs pa/ khyab 'ju / gdabang phyug rnams mnan pa/ yum gtum mo dga' byed ma/ ḍā ma ru dang me tog gi 'phreng ba 'dzin pas 'khu/da pa/ thags bzang ris dang / klu zhabs 'og tu mnan pa/ yab yum gnyis kar khro bo dang khro mo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /rang gi spyi bor rnam snang / mgrin par 'od dpag med/ snying gar mi bskyod pa/ lte bar rin chen tog gsang bar don grub/ de rnams las mi g.yo ba rka—174—

rigs lnga dpag tu med pa spros te/ dgra bgegs thams cad myong bcad/ yum gyi spyi bor spyan ma/ mgrin par gos dkar mo/ snying gar mā ma gī lte ba rin chen glog ma/ gsang bar sgrol ma/ de rnams las gtum mo dga' byed ma rigs lnga dpag tu med pa spos te/ skye 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdus par bsams la/ oṃ ka ni dhu ni hū phaṭa/ zhes pa nyid gtso bor bzla zhing / oṃ a mo gha tsaṇ+ḍamahā ro ṣa ṇa ya phaṭa ya hu tra sa ya hu/ tra ṭa ra ma zhes yab dang / oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍi ha ha tshar ma ra/ a karnya a kwa r+ṣa ya hū phaṭa/ ces yum gyi 'phreng sngags kyang ci rigs par bzla'o/ /mjug tu dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma 'bru gsum lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ yab kyi rtsa sngags kyis spyan drangs te/ a kā ro3rde sngags kyis 'bul/'di'i byin rlabs ni/ phyag rdor lhan skyes kyi skabs dang phal cher 'dra ba las/ chos 'byung dmar por bris/ rdo rje'i tshab tu ral gri bzhag lha bsgoms sngags bzlas kyi lung gi skabs mngon rtogs bzhin du lha'i rnal 'byor phog la bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ sher dbang gi skabs ra la gri snying gar bzhagabastod pa'i skabs mi g.yo ba'i bstod pa gang rung zhig gis bstod/ 'di'i bstod pa logs su yod pasashes na de yang 'don/ lhag ma 'don pa spos pas 'grub bo/ /tho mtshar dngos grub snang brnyan can/ /sakun skyong bas bsgrubs pa na/ /phun tshogs dpal la dga' mgur spyad/ /dbang bsgyur lha yi snying bho lags/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag mi g.yo ba dmar po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ /༄༅༅/ /skye ste swā sti/ ma lus bgegs rnams 'dul mdzad par/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin rlabs shing / /nyi zla'i 'od dang rtag rol ba/ /lha mo 'od zer can la 'dud/ /sems bskyed dang stong nyid —175—

sngon du 'gro bas/ rang sems maX yig yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'od zer can ma li khri'i mdog can/ zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rnams kyis rdo rje khab skud sbyar ba/ mda'/ g.yon rnams kyis zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ a shwa ka gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang / dar dang rin po che dang me tog gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can rgyal ba rigs lnga dbu la bzhugs pa/ rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaXdzaXhuX baX hoX snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang phag gi rwa ba dang /mda' gzhu'i gur khab skud dang zhags pa'i dra ba/ phyi rol du mya ngan med pa'i shing gis bskor bar gyur/ oṃ mā rī rgyu de wa ta ye swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzla'o/ /nyimadang zla ba 'char nub kyi tshe/ mchod pa la brtson par bya/ gtor ma mi dgos/ slob ma la bzlas lung byed tshul 'od dpag med kyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /rgyud kun bdag po sgyu dra las/ /legs gsung sgrub thabasadaga' ba'i phul/ /mgyogs 'gro'i shing rta dang bcas pa'i/ /mngon rtogs snying po ngo mtshar rmad/ /paṇ+ḍita gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi tsho man ngag 'od zer can ma rta ljang can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no/ /dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs go /skye( snya sti/ lha min g.yu la las rgyal ba dang / /bgegs rnams mtha' dag nyams byed pa'i/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi/ /rig sngags sgrub thabs bdag gis bshad/ /sems bskyed —176—

sngon du 'gro bas/ shā n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/ rang gi snying gar dh+waX yig gi 'od zer gyisarang nyid rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan rdo rje ro langs mar gyur pa ni mthing nag drag mo/ zhal bzhi mthing kha/ phyag brgyad g.yas rnams ral gri/ gtun shing / 'khor lo/ mda'/ g.yon na rtse gsum/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ sdigs mdzub/ zhabs bzhis bdud bzhi mnan pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ khro mo'i cha lugs dang rgyan dang na bza' yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /dpral bar oX/mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX na mo bha ga wa te/ dh+wa dza a gra ke ྅ re/ pa ra phye n+ya/ bi dh+wa zla nā kwa su bai n+ya ba ri la ni/ u mu kā mu khi kha kha khu hi ji hi/ pa ra ma si n+ya ma/ a nan+da bhu dze/ a nan+da mu khe/ pra ha ra pra ha ra huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzla zhing ba sbu'i khung bu rnams na ge grodazer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par byas shing / ming po gsum gyis dmag tshogasabaskul te/ gdug pa can tshar bcad par bsam/ mchod pa dang gtor ma spyi dang mthun/ bzlas lung 'bogs tshul yang 'od dpag med kyi skabs bzhin no/ /dgra 'joms g.yul las rgyal ba'i lha/ kun gyi mchog gyur rab dga' 'di/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i snying po zhes/ /zab mor nges nas don gnyer byas/ /paṇ+ḍita gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag rgya mtshan rtse mo'i dpung brgyan gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //ma ṅga laX/ /༄༅༅/ /glu ste swā sti/ bde gshegs mtha' dag skyed byed yum/ /ye shes dbang phyug ma lasasprul/ /gtum mo ro langs ma zhes grags/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs po zhad/ /rgyud kyi dngos bstan las gsungs pa'i dud gsol ma ni/ 'di kho na yin ces gsungs te/ bdag bskyed gan bor byas te —177—

sgrubs kyang rung / mdun bskyed kho nas bsgrubs kyang rung ba las/ 'dir phyi ma bshad na yi dam gyi bdag bskyed gang yang rung ba sngon du 'gro bas/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du pad nyi dngami ro'i gdan la/ oṃ ma tha ma tha dun hūX phaṭa/ zhes pa yongs su gyur pa las ro langs ma nag mo skra dmar ser g.yon ngos su 'khyil ba/ phyag dang po gnyis ral gri dang thod khrag 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs sbrul dang mi mgos brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang / glang lpags kyi stod g.yogs gsol ba/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus su ma mo 'bum sdes bskor ba/ sku'i g.yas g.yon na gdug pa'i sbrul gyi pho nya 'gyed pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod kyi gnas thams cad nas ro langs ma badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXspyiXbaX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ oX bhi tsa sba ta khruX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa re res6kho te.ar+ghaX nas ni wi t+ya'i bar gyis mchod/ de'i mgo bor oṃ/ mig tu huX/ rna bar hri/ snalaha/ lce la hra/ snying gar hriX zhes pa rnams kyis rgyas bto/ rdo rje bsdams pa lasagrumo brkyang ba'i phyag rgyas gnas lngar reg par bsam/ phyag rgya de nyid kyis dbang bskur bar mos la/ oX phuX phe phaṭa huX swāhā/ rdo rje rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mar gtor spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs nas/ gong bzhi mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod pa phul/ rkang pa g.yas brkyang gi stabs bca'/ lag pa g.yas brkyang gis rtse gol gtog/g.yon sdigs mdzub bya ba ni lha mo'i dam rgya ste/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍi be ta mi sa mā ya stuX/ zhes lan bdun gyis dam tshig laX gnas par bya/ de nas bzlas pa ni/ oṃ khyiXha naX haX naX sarba sha lhaXta tshatham tha ban+ta ban+ta hū/ a mu ka sa ṅga ta ya/ sa ṅga ta ya/ hu hu hu phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/—178—

phu phu zhe༅ci nus su bzlas/ mthar tsho( a karnya ya/ a kar+ṣa ya/ mahā pū dza bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ hu hū hu swāhā/ zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig gis gtor ma phul/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ skye( rlu/ zhes ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ tshul de'i bzlas pa 'bum phrag brgyad song ba na/ ra'i pags pa la bris sku byas te/ de'i mdun du ra nag po'i shas brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang / khrag gi ar+gha sogs mchod pa bshams/ mdun bskyed kyi sngon du lag pa g.yon snying gar sdigasamadzub/ g.yas khu tshur sked par sbyar la/ hu hu hū zhes bgegs bskrad/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/ tshul desasngags 'bum phrag bzhi bzla/ de nas ra nag dang bya nag gi sha khrag gis sbyin sreg bya/ sreg blugs kyi cho ga spyi dang 'dra ba las/ gong gi gtor ma'i sngags kyis sha bsregs pa la grangs 'dzin pa yin/ sbyin sreg stong phrag bzhi'o/ /de tsam gyis kyang las phra mo 'grub cing / tshul des 'bum phrag bzhi bcu bzlas na/rbod gtong las thogs pa med par 'grub par the tshom med do/ /'di la rjes gnang gi bya ba ni mi mdzad/slob dpon gyis mchod gtor bzlas pa/ slob ma'i don du gsol ba gdab pa rnams byas la/ 'di'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi las sbyor rnams slob ma la tshar gcig bshad/ de phyin chad lha mo ro langasasgoms shig sngags tshar gcig bton te 'di zlos shig/bsnyen pa gyis shig sgrub pa gyis shig las la spyor ba gyis shig gdug pa can rnams tshar chod cig ces bka'i gnang ba sbyin/ de tsam gyis don sgrub pa yin no/ /'di'i las sbyor yang dgra bgegs 'gugs 'dren byas so/ /liṅga me la bsreg pa dang / gtso bor sbyin sreg gi las sbyor la brten nas rbod gtong sgrub pa yin no/ /kun las yid ches rab dga' yi/ /sgrub thabs rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin/ /man ngag mchog gi snying swo can/ /mdo tsam 'di yang ngo mtshar rmad/ /paṇ+ḍita gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag lha mo ro langs ma'i sgrub thabs kya le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /— 179—

༄༅rti/ /glu khe swā sti/ thub pa shākya seng ge dang / /gsang bdag rdo rje 'chang ba la/ /btud nas 'phrog ma zhes bya ba/ /gnod sbyin mo yi sgrub thabs bshad/ /chang bu dang shing thog sna tshogs pasabargyan pa'i gtor ma dang mchod pa sna tshogs pa bshams la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya dang / kha 'bar ma'i sngags rgya dang / yi ge 'bru gsum gyis mchod gtor rnams byin gyis brlabs/ tsan+dan gyi maṇ+ḍal me tog sna tshogs bkram pa zhig mdun du bzhag rang gi snying ga nas kha 'od zer 'phro se/ri rab kyi byang phyogs nas gnod sbyin mo 'phrog ma bu lnga brgya dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza zhes spyan drangs te maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bzhugs par gyur pa ni sku mdog dmar ser g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i ne'u 'dzin pa/ mdzes shing sgeg pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ bu lnga brgyas bskor ba/ thams cad kyang ser skya be con dang chang bus gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas khro bo gshin rje gshed be con dang zhags pa thogs pa spros/ 'phrog ma'i spyi bor bzhugs/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āthugs kar spru/ ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ sngags kyi mthar kha kha hū zhes btags pa lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ skye( ha ri ce mahā yak+ṣiṇiye ha ra ha ra sarba yak+ṣi ṇi pra be sha ni swāhā/ zhe༅ci nus bzlas/ mthar mchod pung byas la/badz+ra mu gshogs su gsol/ bsnyen pa'i grangs ni 'bru 'bum mo/ /nor sgrub kyi tshe/ gnod sbyin mo brgyad pho dgu dang bcas te sgrub pa byed pa yin/ 'di'i lung sbyin pa ni/ gong bzhin gyi mchod bstod bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du song nas/ 'di'i sgrub thabs slob ma la bshad/ sngags la rjes zlos lan gsum byed pa nyid yin no/ /'di bstan pa srung ba'i chos skyong ma chen mo yin gsung ngo / /kun lasa'aphags pa'i mthu stobs can/ /dga' byed ma zhes rab grags pa'i/ /sgrub thabs snying po tsam 'di chi— 180—

ni/ /rgya gar mkhas pa'i zhal lung yin/ /paṇ+ḍita ga rnga badz+ra gsung las byung ba/ gnod spyin mo 'phrog ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /tseXkha swā sti/ dpal ldan bde chen mgon po la/ /ba spyod nas tshogs kyi bdag po ni/ /gser gyi mdog can sgrub pa'i thabs/ /shin tu rnyed dka' cung zad bshad/ /yi dam khro bo'i bdag bskyed zhig sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun du tshogs bdag gi bris sku la dmigs te bsangs sbyangs/ rke(nga pa'i ngang las pad+ma zla ba byi ba rnams kyi gdan la yi ge gaXn las tshogs kyi bdag po glang po'i gdong can sder po g.yas gnyis na tri shu la dang dgra sta/g.yon gnyis na nor bus gang ba'i snod dang la phug 'dzin pa/ lto ba 'phyang zhing rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing / mdun du la du la sogs pa kha zas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod la gzigs pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ tshogs kyi bdag po spyan drangs par bsams la/oṃ gaXn pa ti badz+ra sa mā dzaX a mṛ tas bgegs bskrad/ dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par bstim/ yi dam kyi sngags kyi mthar/ gaXn pa ti sa ma ya stuX/ zhes spyi bor rdo rje bzhag cing dbang bskur/ mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs te 'bul/ bzlas pa'i dmigasapa gsal btab la/ tso te traX ṭha ṭha ṭha huX dza swāhā/ /zhes ci nus su bzla/ me tog gi phreng ba dag 'dul phug sha chang rnams dang bcas pa'i gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ a kā ro bdun gyis phul/ 'dod don gsol ba bto/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis mthar/ badz+ra muXzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs pa'am/ bris sku yod na yig brgya'i mthar brtan bzhugs bya/ dus bzang po rnams su gtor chog gi gzhug la snod gtsang ma chus bkang ba 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ la du'i ril bu 'bru gsum brjod cing chu nang du dor bas ci nus 'bul/ 'di la'ang slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa —181 —

ni/ slob dpon gyis mchod bstod bzlas pa/ gsol btab sngon du 'gro bas/ sgrub thabs bshad nasabaka' gnang sbyin pa tsam nyid do/ /sngon chad bod kyi yul kun na/ tshogs bdag ser po'i sgrub thabasamed/ /de phyir dga' bas 'di zhus nas/ /snying sto tsam re bsgrub par bya/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag tshogs bdag ser po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ /sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ shākya rak+ṣi ta las brgyud pa'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bcu drug pa'o// //༄༅’/ /rgyal kun sras kyi thu bo ni/ /kun gyi mchog gyur 'jam dpal la/ /gus pas btud nas sgrub pa'i thabs/ /ngo mtshar chen po 'bri bar bya/ 'grub na maṇ+ḍal mchod pa sngon du btang / gang ltar yang smon pa byang sems dang stong pa nyid bsgom/ hūṃ n+ya twa'i sngags brjod/ rang gi snying gar pad zla la dhīXyig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog can/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad cing / phyag g.yon po tis mtshan pa'i ut+pa la'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing / mi bskyod pas dbu la spras pa/ zur phud lnga pa'am ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dar dang rin po tshes brgyan pa/ zhabs kyi drung du khro bo gshin rje gshed po mthing nag thod pa'i 'phrong ba can/ g.yas 'jam dpal gyi zhabs la brten pa'am phyag 'tshal ba/ g.yon tho ba rwa nyi shu pa 'dzin zhing khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /ye shes spyan 'dren gnas gsum byin rlabs bya/ na maXs man+ta bsnyi nāX/ oṃ ra ra sma ra a pra ti ha ta shā sa naX/ ku mā ra rū pa dha ri huX phaṭa swāhā/—182—

thun mtshams su 'jam dpal gnas pa zhes bya ba'i mdo klog pa dang / 'jam dpal gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'don pa sogs chos spyod ci nus su bya'o/ /blo ldan kun nas dga' ba yi/ /sgrub thabasasnying po 'di tsam yin/ /mi sgom na ni rgyas pas ci/ /sgom na bsdus kyang don mchog 'grub/ /nye ba'i srasabargyad las 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs so// //༄༅༅/ /dmigs med thugs rje mkha' ltar khyab/ /rgyal sras kun gyi thu bo ni/ /spyan rasagazigs dbang la btud de/ /sgrub dza thabs mdo tsam 'bri bar bya/ /thugs rje chen po'i dbang phyug mtshan thos pa dang bzung ba tsam gyis mi ldog pa'i sa thob par 'gyur ba'i 'phags mchog de la ba sbu ldang zhing mchi ma 'khrug pa'i mos gus kyi sgo nas/ phyag dang mchod pa dang bstod pa dang bskor ba byas la/ byang chub kyi sos sgoms/ shā n+ya tswa) sngags don ba yi/ rang gi snying gar hiXyig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ 'jig rten mgon po ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba'i sku lus ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi ngos la bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya'am/ g.yas mchog spyin dang g.yon gdan la brten pas pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pa phrag pa g.yon pa la gnas pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ g.yas brkyang ba'i rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i drung du khro rgyal rta mgrin dmar po bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ dbu'i steng na rta mgo ljang khu rta skad 'tsher ba/ phyag g.yas phyag 'tshal ba dang g.yon pas be con dkar po 'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes pa spyan drangs/ mchod pas mchod/ rang la gzhugatso da āXhuX gis gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ na mo ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa tā ya/ mahā sa tā ya/ mahā —183

kā ru ni kwa ya/ kwa ru ṇi kwa ru ne/ mahā kā ru ṇa/ pra ti ste ti kā ru ṇa ya swāhā/ zhesaci nus su bzlas/ lha sku 'od gsal tu bsdus te dgob bsngo/ lhun mtshams su spyan ras gzigs kyisazhus pa zhes bya ba'i mdo dang / za ma tog bkod pa dang / 'phags mchog 'di nyid kyis mtshan brgya sogasa'adon no/ /kun las dga' ba'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /snying nas nyams len byas gyur na/ /'jig rten dbang po nyid mtshungs pa'i/ /go 'phang thob 'gyur a la la/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabasaso// //༄༅rti/ /na mo gu dra/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum la/ /rang byan chud pa mthu stobasadabang / /rdo rje 'chang ba la 'dud do/ /bdag kyang khyed dang mtshungs par shog/sngags dang rgyud la mngon par dga' ba rnams 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje la blo brtad 'cha' dgos te/ sngags rgyud thams cad kyi bdag po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /skyabs sems tshad med stong nyid sgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā wasasngags brjod/ hūX las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su nyi ma la hūX/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus pa las 'phags mchog phyag na rdo rje zhi ba ljang khu/rin po che'i dprog zhu can/ mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas thugs kar 'bar ba'i rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul dang /g.yon gdan la brten pa/ na bza' mchob dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/rab tu bzhad cing rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can no/ /yang na sku mdog sngon por byas kyang wo / de'i drung du bdud rtsi'akhyil ba khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs shing / ljang khu'am sngo sangs dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/de nas ye shes dgug gzhug dang / sgo gsum byin rlabs bya/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ mahwa badz+ra/ pra—184—

tiṣ+ṭha tā ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta sha rī rwan+ta rga tā ya/ badz+ra shā rī raX/ me ku ru badz+ra a dhiṣ+ṭha na swāhā/ snying po'o/ /de bzhin dzin gas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdo dang / gsang bdag nyid kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa klog mchod pa dang gtor ma la yang brtson par bya'o/ /bde skad gsakun gyi 'phrin las ni/ /rab dgas sgrub mdzad sems dpa' che/ /de yi mngon rtogs snyib swo tsam/ /u dum ba ra'i me tog 'dra/ /nye ba'i sras brgyad las phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs so/ /zhus dag/ma ṅga laX// //༄༅/ /sgrol ma nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs dang rjes su 'brel ba 'dus gsal go bde ba bzhugs/༈ na mo gu ru ār+ya tā rā yi/ mtha' dag rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum/ /lha mo de la gusabatud nas/ /sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa rnams/ /ma 'dres mchog tu gsal bar bshad/ /'dir phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgrub thabs nyams su len pa la/ thog mar spyi sgrub nyams su blang dgos pas/de'i tshul ni/ spro na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du bto / rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnasapa'i tāX yig las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma rigs kyi bdag po'i rnam pa can gyis dbu brgyan pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tsho gis kyis bskor ba/ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaX o ༅ r+sā tā ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaX pra titsā nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchoge gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ badz+ra muX gshegs su gsol/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun la/ skye( tshwa/ n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ tāX yig ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma sku —185—

mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon mtheb srin gyis ut+pa la'i sdong bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i rol pas bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can/ mig gnyis la oṃ tā re swāhā/ rna ba gnyis la oṃ tu stu re swāhā/ mgrin pa oṃ tu swāhā/ snying gar oṃ re swāhā/spyi bor oṃ tā re ṇi swāhā/ dpral bar oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rnam par spyan drangs/ oX badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX dbang gi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar lkoX badz+ra sa mā dzaX pur+sha sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegasapa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du tāX gi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar bsam la/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /ga sto chog ni a mṛ tas ba4sa/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oX las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du huX zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha ho hiX rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaX pad+ma ka ma la ye stuX/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar a kā rob lnga snya pa lan bdun gyis 'bul/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ phyi mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod/lha dang lha min cod pan gyis sogs bstod/ mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la —186—

sogs 'dod don gsol ba bto/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor ra pa dang sogs bzod gsol dang / badz+ra mu gshegs su gsol/ tshul 'dis bsnyen pa legs par song nas/ las tshogs kyi lha nyi shu rtsa gcig po rnams 'og nas 'byung ba ltar/ so so'i sgrub thabs bsgom bzhin pas/ rab tu bzlas pa khri phrag bzhi bzhi'am/ 'bring du khri phrag re re/ tha ma yang stong phrag bzhi bzhi byas pas/ gzhung las ji skad bshad pa'i las tshogs mtha' dag sgrub pa la dbang ba yin zhing / sgrol ma bla med lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i rgyun thob na/ bsnyen pa 'di kho nas de'i dbang bskur du rung ste/ de'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga yang phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs 'di nyid kyi las tshogs su snang bas so/ khyad par spyi sgrub 'di dang las tshogs kyi lha nyi shu rtsa gtseg po rnams kyi rjes gnang gi bka' nges par bsgrub par bya ba yin la/ sgrol ma lus dkyil du grags pa yang 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs kho nar 'gyur zhing / sngon dus sgrol ma nyer gcig dkyil 'khor gcig tu bsdus pa'i dbang bka' zhig kyang byung bar mngon la/bar skabs su de la brten te gan bo go 'pho rang bzor sbyar nas dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa gcig gi dbang bskur byed pa byung snang ba ni/ grangs mang ba la dga' ba tsam ste/ tshegs chen la don med pa'o/ /nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs sgrol ma nyer gcig gi chos skor 'di rnams bla med du bkral ba shin tu zab cing byin rlabs che ba yin/ sngon dus bod du 'di dar rgyas che zhing / sa skya ba'i rjes btsun dkar po rnam gsum gyi ring la chos skor 'di'i phyag len shin tu dar/ las tshogs rnams man ngag khyad par can du thugs yid ches kyang / gzhung gi rtsom rgya gar ma yin min cung zad dpyad gzhi yod pa'i skabs/ rje btsun chen po'i chos grwar kha che'i dge tshul zhig byung ba'i lag nas 'di'i rgya dpe byung / phyis yul tha dad kyi rgya dpe gnyisagasum 'dzoms pas/ rgya gzhu rtsod med du gyur te/ skyes mchog dam pa rnams shin tu thugs yid ches par mdzad do/ /da ni so so'i sgrub thabs bsten par bya ste/ de yang 'di rnams la skyabs sems tshad med sngon du — 187—

'gro bas/ shu n+ya tus stong pa nyid du sbyong ba nas brtsams te/ bzlas pa'i bar du sgrub thabs spyi'i bya ba gong dang mtshungs pa las/ mig byin rlabs sogs mi dgos/ sa bon dang sku'i rnam pa dang rigs bdag rnams rim pas 'gyur ba'i khyad par tsam yin par shes par byas te/ lhag ma rnams mthun par nyams su blang ngo / /de la dang po rab tu dpa' ba'i sgrol ma ni/ chos 'byung gi dbus su pad+ma ser po dang zla ba'i gdan la oṃ las sgrol ma rab tu dpa' mo sku mdog dmar mo me dpung 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis spyi bor bsnol ba'i rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa gnyis mda' dang gzhu/ gsum pa gnyis 'khor lo dang dung / bzhi pa gnyis ral gri dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhi ba'i sku can rigs bdag rnam snang ngo / /gnyis pa dkar mo zla mdangs kyi sgrol ma ni/ pad zla la tā yig las sgrol ma dkaramo dkar sngo ser ba'i zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis kyi dang po gnyis mnyam bzhag g.yas lhag mas kha ṭāX ga 'khor lo nor bu rdo rje me tog gi 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon rnams kyis spyi blugs ut+pal dril bu/ bum pa po ti 'dzin pa/rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med do/ /gsum pa gser mdog can gyi sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma nyi gdan la re yig la sgrol ma seramo zhal gcig phyag bcu ma g.yas rnams kyis 'phreng ba/ ral gri/ mda'/ rdo rje/ dbyug gu/ g.yon rnams kyis dar dpyangs/ zhags pa/ pad+ma/ dril bu/gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni rin 'byung ngo / /bzhi pa gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma ser po dang zla ba la tu ta yigalas sgrol ma ser mo gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang 'phreng ba/—188—

g.yon spyi blugs dang dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung can no/ /rigs bdag ni don grub bo/ /lnga pa hūṃ sgra sgrog pa'i sgrol ma ni/ zla ba la tā yig las sgrol ma ser mo zhal gag phyag gnyis/ g.yas skyabs spyin/ g.yon pad+ma ser po bsnams pa/ rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med do/ /drug pa 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dmar po dang nyi ma'i gdan la re yig las sgrol ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas dang po rdo rje/ gnyis pas ral gri/ g.yon dang po sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas zhags pa bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med do/ /bdun pa rgol ba 'joms pa'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma ser po dang nyi ma la tu yig las sgrol ma sku mdog nag mo na bza' ser po bsnams pa/ drag mod bu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas kyi thog ma 'khor lo phyi ma ral gri/g.yon gyi thog ma pad+ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje phyi ma'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs can no/ /rigs bdag ni rin 'byung ngo / /brgyad pa dbang mchog ster ba'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba dang chu srin rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ de las sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/phyag dang po gnyis mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga dang pad+ma/ 'og ma gnyis phyed pa ༵ je ༵ rdo~X ༵ bye ༵ bzhugs ༵/ bu/ji gsab dhi pa / ne do /na dhi ljon /la/ krung —189—

dgu pa ni/ bstod pa rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu las/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma mdzad de/ de yi ltar na gong gi sgrol ma spyi sgrub ltar las/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin mdzad pa tsam yin la/ seng ldeng nagasakyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs logs su yod pa ltar na/ gtso mo de nyid dang 'dra ba las/ g.yas su maX las 'od zer can ma ser mo rdo rje dang mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ zhi ba'i cha lugs can/ g.yon du huX las ral gcig ma nag mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum stag lpags dang / glang lpags kyi na bza' can/ drag mo'i cha lugs rdzogs pa gnyis ka'ang rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugasapa'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi rgyun ni logs su yod pa ltar 'phros don du bkod pa yin gyi/ tsha/sa ni sgrol ma nyer snyag gi sgrub thabs ltar yin pas/ mchod stsol ba'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba la snya yig las sgrol ma dmar mo phyag bzhi dang po gnyis/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas dga' ba'i phyag rgya spyi bor 'ching ba/ g.yas pa gar gyi tshul gyis se gol gtogs pa dang / g.yon gnyis pas a shwa ka'i yal ga 'dzin pas 'gro ba rnams la rin po che'i char 'bebs pa'o/ /dbu rgyan ni don grub bo/ /bcu pa mya ngan sel ba'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba la sa yig las sgro le/ma dmar mo/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang mya ngan med pa'i yal ga tshe tog dmar po can 'dzin pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni don grub bo/ /bcu gcig pa 'gro ba 'gugs pa'am/ 'phongs pa sel ba'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hā yig las sgrol ma nag mo drag mo'i sku can/ g.yas gza' brgyad 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu dang / g.yon 'phongs pa sel ba'i lcags kyu zhags pa —190—

dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni rin ཿnga ngo / /ya gnyis pa bkra shis snang ba'i sgrol ma ni/ sna tsho gis pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du a yig las sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams rtse gsum/lcags kyu rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon rnams thugs kar gtod pa'i rin po che lcags kyu/ dbyug gu bum pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni rnam snang ngo / /stso gsum pa yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dmar po dang nyi ma la rgyuX yig las sgrol ma dmar mo drag mo'i sku can/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos ral gau/gnyis pas mda'/ g.yon gyi dang pos 'khor lo/ gnyis pas gzhu 'dzin pa/g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med do/ / — bi bzhi pa khro gnyer g.yo ba'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dmar ser nyi ma la mi ro'i bdan gyi steng du/ a ta yig las sgrol ma mthing ga nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum khro gnyer bsdus shing / mi'i rgyu ma zhal du gsol ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnamasakyis ral gri/ lcags kyu/ dbyug pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa zhags pa tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ stag lpags dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du rin po che'i shing gi myu gu skyes pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni don grub bo/ /bco lnga pa zhib za mo'am dge legs ster ba'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dkar po la ṇi yig las/ sgrol ma dkar mo phyag g.yas gsum na/ 'phreng ba mchog spyin nga/byug pa/—191—

g.yon gsum na pad+ma ril pa po ti 'dzin pa'o/ /bstod pa las ni us la gan4'ishoti yin par shad do/ /rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med do/ /bcu drug pa chags pa 'joms pa'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dmar ser dang nyi ma la e las sgrol ma dmar mo/ phyag g.yas thugs kar rtse gsum dang / g.yon sdigs mdzub 'phyar bas snying po dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i shing 'dzin pa/ semasadapa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /'dil rig pa huX las sgrol ma nyid ma zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ hūṃ las bskyed na legs par mngon no/ /bcu bdun pa bde ba sgrub pa'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma la sha yig las/sgrol ma dmar ser phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni don yod grub pa'o/ /'di yang hūṃ las bskyed na legs pa 'dra'o/ /bco brgyad pa rab tu rgyas pa'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dkar po zla ba dang ngang pa'i gdan la ki yig las sgrol ma dkar mo phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis spyi bor bsnol bas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lhag ma gnyis mchoge spyin dang glegs bam gyis mtshan pa'i ut+pal bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ rigs bdag ni snang ba mtha' yas so/ /bcu dgu pa sdug bsngal sreg pa'i sgrol ma ni/ pad dkar dang nyi ma la dza yig las sgrol ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar me thab bsnams pa/ cung zad g.yas brkyang ba'i sems dpa'i skyil krung can no/ /rigs bdag ni rnam snang ngo / /—192—

nyi shu pa dngos grub 'byung ba'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba la tse yig lasasgrol ma dmar ser phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni don yod grub pa'o /nyer gcig pa yongs rdzogs byed pa'i sgrol ma ni/ ha yig las byung ba'i khyu mchog glangadakar po'i steng na pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du phe yig las sgrol ma dkar mo cung zad khro zhing spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas mdung rtse gsum dang / g.yon mu tig gi 'che/nga ba 'dzin pa/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs shing stag lpagang / kyi sham thabs can rmu /rigs bdag ni rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /de dag rnams kyi sa bon ni thams cad tī yig 'ba' zhig gis rung la/ zhabs stabs mi gsa'/ ba rnams rdo rje'i skyil krung ngo / /de ltar na nyi shu rtsa gcig po rnams kyi yang bsnyen pa'i dus dang rjes gnang ngam/ bzlas lung gi gnas skabs su yi ge bcu pa nyid bzla zhing sgyin par bya ba yin la/ so rbo'i lasatshogs sgrub pa'i sngags ni rgya gzhung na gsal lo/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed thabs ni/ dang por spyi sgrub kyi rjes su gnang ba sbyin dgos pas mdun du tshom bu/ mchod gtor dang bcas par spyi dang mthun par bsham/ rdor dril nang mchod/ 'thor nas sogasayo byad rnams 'joms par byas la/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nagadabu brgyan zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las/ rang gi zer ba sogs dor/ de nas mchod bstod byas la snying po ci rigs par bzlas/ gong bzhin gtor ma phul/ chos skyong so sodang / mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs kyang spro na bya/ de nas bum pa zhig bcas la/ bum pa bskyed chog spyi dang mthun/ bum pa'i nang du mdun bskyed ltar sgrol ma bskyed la bzlas pa cung zad bya'o/ /mchod — 193—

bstod mchod yon phul bas lha bdud rtsir zhu/ slob ma'i bya ba ni/ rjes gnang spyi'i go ba chags pa zhig gis bya ste/ 'dir go rim ni phyag 'tshal sems bskyed gsal btab chos bshad maṇ+ḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba ltar gyi rgyun spun gas rnams bya ste sngon 'gro'o/ /bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i 'od kyisaslob ma sbyangs la/ shā n+ya tu'i sngags nas dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed kyi dmigasapa ltar slob ma la 'bogs ba ni sku'i rjes gnang yin la/ ye shes pa bstim pa'i skabs dril sil dang /dbang bskur ba'i skabs bum chu sbyin/ gsung gi rjes gnang la/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung dang / dam bca' ba'i lung dang / byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung rnams spyi dang mthun/ thugs kyi rjes gnang phyag mtshan ut+na la bstim pa yin/ slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba/ khas blang maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba bran du bzung ba dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa kha gsos nas mdun bskyed la mchod bstod dngos grub blang / yig brgya bzla bzod gsol gshegs gsol smon lam bkra shis sogs spyi dang mthun no/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig po so so'i rjes gnang la/ bum pa bca' ba mi dges shing sku'i rjes gnang ṣ+kaskabs rnam snang gi dbu brgyan can zhes sogs dbu brgyan rang chas su bskyed pa tsam las dbangabaskur ba mi mdzad do/ /gal te thun re la rjes gnang mang du byed pa dang myur bar 'dod na/ nyi ma gcig la ji tsam byed pa'i tshom bu rnams phyogs gcig tu bshams te/ gtor ma'ang de nyid kyi grangs bshams/dang por bdag bskyed rnams kyang sbrel te bsgom/ mdun bskyed dngos gzhi yang go rim bzhin tu sprel/mchod bstod gtor ma byin rlabs rnams phyogs gcig tu byas te/ so sol dmigs nas gtor ma go rim bzhin du 'bul/ yang mchod bstod sogs chabs gcig tu bya/ rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro rnams gcig gis chog pa bya zhing / rjes kyi bya ba'ang gcig gis rung ngo / /'di ni lag len cung zad bsdus pa yin la/cung zad rgyas par spro na rjes gnang dang po de nyid legs par bsgrubs nas/ slob ma la'ang rjes gnang — 194—

dang po'i thugs kyi rjes gnang yan chad dngos gzhi rnams grub pa na/ de'i mchod pa kha gso༅rjes chog byas la/ slar yang tshom bu gsar pa bkod/ ma/chod pa dang gtor ma gsar du bsham thub na legs shing /de bzhin min na kha gsos la/ rjes gnang gnyis pa bsgrubs/ de dag gi bar du slob ma rnams phyag 'tshal nyer gcig dang yan lag bdun pa sogs 'don/ sgrub thabs zin mtshams su rjes gnang gnyisapa de nyid kyi dngos gzhi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang rnams bya/ yang sngar bzhin sgrub pa sogs nyi ma de nyid la ci 'grub byed pa yin zhing / ci tsam byed pa rnams rdzogs pa na/ rjes gnang rjes ma de'i thugs kyi rjes gnang song mtshams su gtso bos ji ltar sogs slo ba mas rjes kyi bya ba rnams byas te/ de'i rjesasu mdun bskyed de'i rjes chog bya'o/ /spyir lag len rgyas bsdus kyi rim pa 'di dag gsung rgyun dang mthong ba brgyud pa las rtogs pa gal che'o/ /lam 'di nyid las mchog brnyes pa/ /grub chen nyi ma sbas pa'i bzhed/ /sgrol ma nyer gcig sgrubs pa'i thabs/ /slob ma rjes 'dzin dang bcas pa/ /lag len rgyun ni ma chad kyang / /nyer mkho go bde'i yi ge ni/ /sngon chad gsal po ma mthong zhing / /blo ldan gzhan gyi'ang bskul ba'i phyir/ /tā ra nā thas sbyar ba yin/ /ces pa sgrol ma nyer gcig nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrub pa'i thabs mdo tsam shin tu gsal ba 'di ni/ rigs dang tshul khrims dang thos pa la sogs pa lugasaganyis kyi yon to du mas mngon par mtho ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos kyi rje mi pham rdo rje bdud 'joms zhes bya ba'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ tshul 'di dag gi chos skor la yang cung zad sbyangs pa/rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha zhes bya bas/ rang lo sum cu rtsa gcig pa la sbyar ba'o/ /kun nas dga' bar grags pa'i chos/ /gzhung dang yig sna la sogs pa/ /rgya bod gsung rab mtha' yas las/ /yang snyid 'dril bhor byas 'di mtshar/ /sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ /nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bcu bdun pa'o// //zhus dag /ma ṅga la/ /— 195 —

༄༅// /tsho'e swā sti/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /bka' yi srung ma chos skyong che/ /zin chen mang la rab bsgyud de/ /rgyal chen ser po'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /bris sku rten rdzas mchod gtor sogs 'dzom par byas la/ bgegs gtor btang / mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ gsang bdag gos sngon can gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ slar yang oṃ a rlu ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūX phaṭa/ ces pa dang / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa dz+wa la raX dz+wa la raX phaṭa raX phaṭa raX/ zhes phyogs kun tub4sag sto bya/ rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ byang phyogs nas rgyalapo chen po rnam thos sras gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaXpad+ma ka ma la ye sto/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gso/la/ /tseX( be+e shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra titsā skye( āXhūX/ de bzhin du zhabasabasil nas rol mo'i bar smi byaX nas shabha'i bar du spel/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras nor mang ldan/ /gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid chags shing / /sprin bral nyi 'od stong gi gzi ldan pa/ /'dod dgu'i char 'bebs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod cing / mkha' khyab yid 'ong lha rdzas dngos kun dang / /zhesasogs spro na yan lag bdun pa bya/ bsdu na/ dkon mchos/ gsum la bdag skyabs mchigos kyis chog/bdag nyid phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i gnas gsum nas 'od zeradakar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i gnas gsum du thim pas 'od du zhu nas stong pa nyid du gyur/ oṃ su bhā wa shudha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las huX e yaX raX baX laX suX rnams las srung 'khor 'byung bzhi brtsegs pa gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du/ bhuX las rin po —196—

che sna rdzas las grub pa'i pho brang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/kha nang ltas khor yug tu bskor ba'i shar shel/ lho skra rje rla/ nub pad+ma rwag byang dzaX bu chu bo'i gser las grub pa/ phyogs re re nas ka ba nyis stong lnga brgya lnga brgyas btegs pa'i gdung ring dang / gdung thung gis mdzes par phub pa phyi rol du dpyangs pa'i dra ba dra phyed/ pha gu shar bu mda' yab sogs rgyan thams cad dang bcas pa/ dbus su rin po che'i khang bzang gsum brtsegs su yod pa/sa 'og tu gter gyi khang pa bco lnga dang bcas pa/ phyi rol du 'khor sa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ 'khor sa dang po la phyogs mtshams brgyad du khang bzang brgyad/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol yongs su bskor ba'o/ /dbus kyi pho brang gi nang du hiXlas sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i saX las seng ge dkar po/ de'i steng du be+e ser po la yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po tshes mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan be+e yig gis mtshan pa/de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul 'phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dpal dang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus te be+e yig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rgyal po chen po ngal gsos po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po tshes mtshan pa'i rgyal mawo 'dzin pa/ g.yon na gter gyi ne'u les yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i char 'bebs pa bsnams pa/ ne'u le la mig mngon du phyogs pa'i seng ge dkar po lus nyams rtsal dang ldan pa nyal stabs su gnas pa'i steng na rol pa'i stabs —197—

kyis bzhugs pa/ zhal nas 'dod dgu'i myong 'bebs pa/ nyi ma 'bum dus gcig tu shar ba lha bu'i gzi brjed can/ rin po che'i thor tshugs dang dbu rgyan la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing / dar sna tsho gos pa'i na bza' lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yas nas nyi ma dang g.yon pa nas zla ba 'a myong ba/ mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa'i sku can du gyur pa la/ lha klu gnod spyin mthu bo che du ma dang / gnod spyin bye bas bskor ba'o/ /phyogs mtshams kyi khang pa brtsegs pa brgyad la/ shar du dzaX las dzam+bha la ser po rin po che bsnams pa/ lhor paX las gang ba bzang po ser po rin po che'i bum pa gang ba 'dzin pa/ nub tu maX las nor bu bzang po dkar po nor bu 'dzin pa/ byang du ke las ku be ra nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor saX las yang dag shes ser po ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gaX las 'brog gnas nag po rin po che'i mdung dmar 'dzin pa/ nub byang du paX las lnga rtsen ser skya khang brtsegs 'dzin pa/byang shar du paX las dzaX po 'khyil pa dkar po g.yas gri dang g.yon phub 'dzin pa/thams cad kyang g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams shing / rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rta la chings pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/dpa' zhing brjid la mi sdug pa'i cha byad can rnams rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa/ 'khor sa bar pa na klu chen brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa dang / 'khor sa tha ma na lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi rgas rnams sku mdog ma nges pa/ mi sdug cing brjid la rngam pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa/ 'khor sa tha ma de nyid kyi nang rim na/ sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad po thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar —198—

nag ral gri dang phub 'dzin pa rnams dang / phyi rim la stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis po thams cad sku mdog ljang nag go cha dang bcas pa/ mdung dang ral gri 'dzin pa rnams rang rang gi 'khor tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa/thams cad kyang g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pas sgrub pa po la dngos grub kyi char 'bebs pa'o/ /spos sbyor bsreg cing / rang gi thugs ka'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ 'od zer gyi sne la khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa byung ste/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /thams cad nyon mongs 'dam bying pas/ /mtshams med lnga ni kun spyod cing / /gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas ngan yang / shwakya seng ge'i spyan sngar khyod/ /thugs dam gang bzhes de dgongs la/ /'dren pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /sems can kun la sman slad du/ /byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa rnams/ /sems can don phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ be+e shra ma ṇa sa pā ri wā ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX oṃ be+e swāhā/ oṃ be+e shra ma ṇa a kar+ṣa ya dzaX bai ring po brdzid dang ldan pa mig 'dzum sum cu soganyis kyi yun tshad du brjod/ a tshu ta'i sngags kyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bsgrad/ rgyal po'i thugs kar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi 'dab ma re re la be+ebazhi bzhi/ bdag mdun gyi thugs 'od zer gyi lcags kyus sbrel bar gyur/ oX rat+na mu ka ṭa a bhi 'khri ñtsa maX/ zhes cod pan gyis dbang bskur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ ar+ghaX nas/ shabha'i bar gyis gong bzhi phul/ rin chen gdugs dang gser nya dang / /gter chen bum pa pad+ma —199—

bzang / /dung dkar g.yas 'khyil dpal belā /mchog gi rgyal mtshan 'khor lo sogs/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba'i phyir/ /rgyal wo snyen ra dang bcas la 'bul/ /tse( be+e shra ma ṇa sa pā ri wā ra aṣ+ṭa ma rgo la pū dza tshe gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hū/ phun tshogs 'khor lo rin po che/ /dri med btsun mo khyim bdag dang / /cang shes rta dang glang po dang / /phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i/ /dmag dpon rin chen sna bdun rnams/ /bdag nibs ma pa yongs rdzogs phyir/ /rgyal chen sras dang btsun mor bcas/ /'khor dang bcas pas bzhes su gsol/ /sa bha rat+na/ yid 'ong nags tshal ral gri dang / khang bzang mal cha lha yi gos/ /sprul gyi pags pa lham la sogs/— /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /u pa sa sta rat+na/ me long gi ha ba zho dang / /dur ba bil ba li khri dang / /nyungs kar la sogs bkra shis rdzas/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /aṣ+ṭa ma ṅga la dra bya/ yid 'ong gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra/ /yid 'dzin dri dang ro brgya'i zas/ /'jam mnyen 'khril chags reg bya'i mchog/rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa/ bstod pa ni/ hū mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri steng na/ /be+e las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal gsos dge ba stobs po che/ /sa brgyad dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi dang / khyad par las sgrub gnod sbyin brgyad/ /nor mchog ster ba'i klu chen brgyad/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dgra bgegs ma lus gzhom pa dang / /'byor ba'i longs spyod phun tshogs shing / /'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /gzhan don lhun —200—

gyis grub par mdzode/ /de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal bto la/ ta bya thā/ hi li maṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oX e hre hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha sarba ar+sha me snya dha ni/ ta bya tha/ su dha ni/ su ra su/ su ma ti/ su pu ski hi li mi li swāhā/ gan 'khor thams cad kyis sngags so/ /lkoX be+e shra ma ṇa ya swāhā/ gtso bo'i snying po'o/ /oṃ be+e swāhā/ nye snying ngo / oṃ ra la ye swāhā/ oṃ purba bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ye swāhā/ oX ku be ra ye swāhā/ oṃ saX pra dza na ye swāhā/oX gu phya tha na ye swāhā/ oṃ pa shi ni ka ye swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa la ye swāhā/ 'khor gnod sbyin brgyad po rnams kyi sngags so/ /de ltar ci nus par bzlas nas/ thun gyi mthar gtor ma 'bul ba ni/oX badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dhas bgegs bskrad/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oX las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod kyi nang du khaX zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ de nyid kyi mtha' skor du kaX las bum pa/baX las khrus kyi rdzing bu/ khaX las dpag bsam gyi shing dang / 'dod 'jo'i ba mo la sogs pas bskor ba dang / gtor ma'i steng du/ oX āXhuX/ zhu ba las kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āXhuX lan gsum/ a kā ro sogs dang / ru ru sogs dang / nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya rnams lan gsum mam bdun bdun gyis rgya cher spel/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūX phaṭa/ oṃbe+e shra ma ṇa i daX bā li gros skye sa ma ya rak+ta skye ma ma sarba sirnyi sme pra rte ma ma sarba karma spyo dha a mo gha ya swāhā/ zhes lan bdun la sogs pas mi mi bo dang / oṃ nga 'a(ye i —201—

da sogs rang rang so so'i ming sngags sprel bas/ rta bdag brgyad dang / oṃ a:da nā ga sha ta sa ha sra ko ṭi yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa i da sogs kyis 'khor spyi la 'bul/ bsdu na/ a kā ro'am/ glu cheṅgashra ma ṇa ye sa pa ri wā ra sogs kyis phul kyang chog de nas bstod pa ni/ bsdus pa gos can namāshin tu bsdus par na/ gnod spyin rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ /nor la dbang bsgyur 'dod yon char du 'bebs/ /dbul ba'i gdung sel mgon po thugs rje can/ /rgyal po 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa tsam gyis kyang chog la/cung zad rgyas par spro na/ rin chen pho brang dam pa na/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri stengan/ /be+e las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal gsos dge ba stobs po che/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dag gis bzhugs/ /g.yas na rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams/ /sku ni gser gyi 'od pas mdzes/ /zhal nas rin chen char pa 'bebs/ /thugs rjes phongs pa las sgrol mdzad/ /zin chen rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan/ /byang phyogs rgyal por sku yang sprul/ /rnam thos sras su mtshan yang grags/ /gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu la rin chen cod pan gsol/ /yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /sde po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan gyi dpung rnams 'joms par byed/ /stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bum pa bzang pos rnam par brgyan/ /dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing / /rdzing bu bzang po'adod 'jo'i ba/ /gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nga la ni gser gyi mdog/rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon pa ne'u le g.yas pa na/ /zin chen bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang ba bzang po sku mdog ser/ /rdzu 'phrul —202—

rta yi steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon pa ne' bum pa bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu bzang po sku mdog dkar/ /rdzu 'phrul rta: g.yon pa: nor bu bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ku be ra ni sku mdog nag/rdzu 'phrul rta: g.yon pa: ral gri bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag shes ni sku mdog ser/ /rdzu 'phrul rta g.yon pa gser gri bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'brog gnas sku mdog nag po la/ /rdzu 'phrul: g.yon pa: mdung dmar bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lnga rtsen sku mdog ser skya la/ /rdzu 'phrul: g.yon pa khang brtsegs bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ni dkar/ /rdzu 'phrul: g.yon pa:gri phub 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu chen brgyad ni sku mdog ser/ /rin chen sprul gyi gdengs kas brjid/ /phyag gnyis 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa'i/ /nor bu 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ khar du ring po mig bzang dang / /gang po ser skya sa pa gnas/ /seng ge nye seng dung can dang / /dga' ba shin du sa pa lho/ /seng ge seng ge'i ral pa dang / /bla ma ser skya nag po nub/ /'dzin pa 'dzin dga' brtson skyong dang / khyab 'jug nye nag byang du'o/ /lnga spyod nyi ma byang shar na/ /me ru tshigs lnga ser po bzla/ /ri mnyam me ni lho nub tu'o/ /ser can rlung ni nub byang na/ /gnod spyin sde dpon nyi shu brgyad/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /smug nag rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /gri phub 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang po zla ba chu zla dang / /skye bdag gdos pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / /dbang ldan tsan dan 'dod pa'i gtso/ /mgrin ngan mgul nges pa ṭi dang / /nor bu nor spyod dgra rab dang / /nyer lnga dang ni ri mnyam —203—

dang / /gser can gang po seng ldeng dang / /g.yon phyogs lha dang ba glang skyong / /'brog gnas mi yi rgyal po dang / /rgyal ba khyu mchog tshig lnga ser/ /bzhin bzang dang ni ring po dang / /dri za sna tshogs 'bras bu gsum/ /mgul gsum lcags mdung ring po dang / /lha las byung ba'i ma ldan te/ /sa ga'i rigs las byung ba yi/ /stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis yin/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams bsrung zhing skyong / /ljang nag gri mdung 'dzin la bstod/ /lha rgyal dkar po rdo rje 'dzin/ /klu rgyal dkar po sbrul zhags bsnams/ /gnod sbyin ser po ne'u le bsnams/ /dri za dmar po rgyud mangs can/ /lha min sngon po go mtshon 'dzin/ /mkha' lding gser mdog gsho/ga pa rgyas/ /mi ci'i rgyal po rta mgo can/ /ltos 'phye sngon po sbrul mgo can/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor bcas rnams/ /kun kyang rang mdog rgyan gyis brgyan/ /phyag g.yas mtsho ni cha sna tshogs dang / /g.yon pa ne'u le 'dzin la bstod/ /de ltar bstod cing rab bsngags pas/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas bsrung ba dang / /'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub pa dang / /bgegs rnams ma lus med par mdzode/ /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang / /'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa dang / khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba dang / /bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ /spro na/byang phyogs skyong ba nas/ myur du 'grub par mdzod/ kyi bar kyang brjod/ yi ge brgya pasalhag chad kha bskang / be+e ring po brjod pas pad 'dab kyi be+e rnams gi shogs/ 'od kyi lcags kyu bkrol bar bsam/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can sogs dang / badz+ra muX ye shes pa byang phyogs su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par brjod do/ /—204—

'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud dang bcas pa bri/ de'i steng du rten gtor khang bzang gsum brtsegs 'khor sa rim pa gsum sogs sgom don dang mthun pa 'god pa rgyas pa'i lugs dang / zlum gtor gtso 'khor dgu pa 'god pa 'bring po'i lugs dang /maṇ+ḍal mi 'bri bar gtor ma kho na byed pa bsdus pa'i lugs gsum po gang gis kyang chog mod/ deng sang lag len rgyas pa la mdzad cing / de yang gtor ma byed pa rgya gar pa'i lugs dang / khang bzang byed pa rgya nag gi lugs yin gsung / de'i mdun nam g.yas phyogs su yi dam dang chos skyong gi 'bur gtor bsham/ mchod pa dang spyan gzigs gzhan rnams kyang ci bde bar bkod nas/ bgegs gtor btang /mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ gos sngon can gyi bdag bskyed dang / gtor 'bul sngon du 'gro bas/ gong du bstan pa ltar mdun bskyed chos skyong chen po rnam thos sras 'khor bcas bskyed cing mchod gtor 'bul ba dang / bzlas pa sogs rjes chog ma gtogs gong du bstan pa rnams tshang bar byas/ slob ma rnams khrusabyas/ gos gsang pa gyon/ phyag dang me tog bkye bsdu sngon du 'gro bas/ bgegs gtor btang la bgegs bskrad/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ chos bshad dang 'di'i lo rgyus ci rigs par bshad/maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bcug khro phu ba'i lag len ltar na/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyi gsol btab byed/stus kyi lag len ltar na/ gnod sbyin gter skyong rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /che mchog bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan rdzogs/ /sgrub mchoge bdag la mchopo dang thun mong gi /dngos grub ma lus dus 'dir stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis go lta ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum/ khro phu ba'i lag len la rgyun bshags mi mdzad do/ /dngos gzhi ni/ thog mar slob ma phyag rdor gyi mngon rtogs rigs bdag gi bar rdzogs par phogamadun gyi gtor ma la dmigs su bcug ste/ tso rdzo su bhā wa nas/ thugs kar hū gi bar go bcu sngo/ bsgom pa las/ spyan 'dren gyi tshe rol mo drag la yun ring bar byed/ ar+gha nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis—205—

mchod/ mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri steng nas/ phyag kyang 'tshal gyi bar gyis bstod/ sku'i rjesaganang ngo / /bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros mdun bskyed rgyal po'i thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas sngags 'phreng rin chen 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba lta bu gyur/de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi dbul 'phongs bsal/ 'jig rten khams kyi dngos grub thams cad bsdus te sngags 'phreng la thim/ de nyid slob ma'i kha sgo nas zhugs te snying ga'i hu la thim/ de nas sngags 'phreng 'khore lo ltar 'khordo ra ba la sems gtad du bcug ste/ gzungs tshar gsum/gtso bo'i snying po brgya rtsa brgyad/ rta bdag brgyad kyi snying po tshar bdun bdun rjes bzlos byed pa'am/bsdu na thams cad lan gsum res chog slob mas slob dpon la me tog 'thor zhing / bcom ldan bdag la stsal/ lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/slob dpon gyi bgrang 'phreng slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gong bzhin mdun bskyed la mchod bstod bya/ slob ma gsang bdag gi nga rgyal brtan po bskyed du bcug la/gtor ma lag tu gtad de/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan nas brjod cing / gtor ma'i bka' bsgo drag tu bya/de rjes kho phu ba'i phyag len ltar na bar chad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir drag po'i rjes gnang mdzad de/ 'di ltar na gong spyan 'dren gyi skabs phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad mi dgos/ 'on kyang slob ma yi dam gyi bsnyen song yin na ma gtogs/ drag po'i rjes gnang bka' gnyan pas ci thod thod du mi bya'o/ /thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo / /de nas slob ma 'di'i rjes bzlos byed du stsog ste/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/mi'i 'jig rten du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la chos dang / longs spyod dang /rin po che'i phung po la sogs pa shin tu rgyas par gyur cig/ces lan gsum dang /spo 206

na/ 'dod pa'i khams na longs spyod pa'i/ /dngos grub bdag gis kun thob nas/ /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog mchod/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi rdzogs par shog/rin chen sna bdun longs spyad nas/ /gter gyi dngos grub phyugs rnamasadang / /gzi brjid dang ldan chos skyong gis/ /rtag tu bdag la srung gyur cig/bar mdzod 'bru dang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /rgyal mtshan 'khor los bsgyur ba dang / /thogs med rdzu 'phrul grub nas ni/ /las mchog bde la gnas par shog/cesapa'am/ bsdu na tshigs bcad tha ma lan gsum brjod/ khro phu ba'i lugs la smon lam 'di mi mdzad/ rjesakhas blangs/ maṇ+ḍal/ yon 'bul ba rnams spyi dang 'dra zhing / mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog gong du bstan pa bzhin bya/ dga' ston yang rgya cher sprel lo/ /rnam sras sgrub thabs kun dga'i phul/ /spal ti'i bzhed pa gzhung bsrang nas/ /lugs gzhan khyad par gsal bkod pa/ /snying po'i yi ge ngo mtshar rmad/ /rgyal po chen po rnam sras ser chen gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅༅/ /glud swā sti/ dbang gi las la cher bsngags shing / /pha rol g.yul rnams 'jomasal dpa'/ /ngal gsos rgyal po'i sgrub thabs ni/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig bri bar bya/ /rgyal po mer chen gyi sgrub thabs shes nas 'di la 'jug par bya ste/ mchod gtor bshams/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ e ya ra ba la su las 'byu/nga bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor bhu las gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ rdo rje sa gzhi la gnas shing rdo rje rwa bas bskor ba/mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/nang gi lha snam phyogs kyi mdog can du gnas pa'i dbus su/ 'khor lo sngon po —207—

rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte ba la sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'i rta sngonag lus nyams rtsal dang ldan pa/ gser gyi sga dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i steng du be+e dmar po/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/sems can gyi don byas/ khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ slar thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gnyis dmar la zlum pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas mdung dmar dar chen bcas 'phyar zhing / g.yon gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pas sgrub pa po la dngos grub kyi char 'bebs pa/ dar sna tsho gos kyi na bza' lhab lhub dang / bse khrab gsol ba/gser gyi ske rags can/ dbu la rmog zhu dang / zhabs la bse'i lo khram gsol ba/ khams gsum ma lus dbang du bsdu ba'i 'od zer 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs bzhi la/ shar du sha yig las sras gza' mchog wo po rā hu la sku mdog dud kha sku stong srin po'i lus la sku smad sbrul 'jug tu 'khyil ba/ dbu dgu'i steng na bya rog gi mgo yod pa/ mgo lus thams cad mig gis gang ba/ phyag g.yas chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang / g.yon sbrul zhugs 'dzin pa'o/ /lho ru ra las gnod sbyin dha na/ nub tu ma las gnod spyin ka la/ byang du na las gnod spyin ku be ra/ de'i phyi rol lha snam gyi phyogs bzhin/ shar du sha las gnod sbyin bum sna/ lho ru sa las gnod spyin dung sna/nub tu ha las gnod sbyin sna gsum/ byang du a las gnod spyin sna bo che/ de lhar bdun ka'ang thung zhing gsus po che ba 'jigs pa'i gzugs can dar dang —208—

rin po tshes brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ khar sgor dzaXlas lcags kyu ma dkar mo/ lho sgor huX las zhags pa ma ser mo/ nub sgor baX las lcags sgrog ma dmar mo/ byang sgor hoXlas dril bu ma ljang khu/ thams cad 'dzum khro g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po tshes brgyan pa'o/ /rgyas pa la spro na/ bstod pa ltar bskyed chog kyang rgyas pa bzhi bya'o/ /de nas spyan 'dren nas dbu brgyan pa'i bar gser chen dang 'dra/ mchod pa'ang spro na gser chen ltar rgyas par phul ba'i rjes la/ 'di nyid kyi sa mong ma yin pa'i thugs dam bskang ba rnams bya/ bsdu na ar+ghaX la sogasapas mchod/ bstod pa ni/ be+e/ rin chen mgon po bcom ldan 'das/ /sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas/ /'gro ba'i bsam pa rdzogs mdzad pa/ /ngal gsos po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'og min gnas mchog bla med nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang / /'gro ba'i re 'dod skong mdzod pa/ /thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drang srong rnam mang thos pa dang / /btsun mod pa la tshul bzang mo yi/ /sras su smon lam rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog na/ /bzang po'i khri la bzhugs nas ni/ /gter chen bzhi la mnga' mdzad pa/ /ra la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha chen khyod ni khros pa'i tshe/ /spyan rtsa dmar po bzlog pa yis/ /dgra la mi nad phyugasand gtong/ /lus ngan po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshin rje ya mun+ta ka yis/ /gdong dmar 'dul bar dbang bskur ba/ /gshin rje dmar po srog gi bdag/ma ru rtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya gar rdo rje gdan drung du/ /rgyal ba shākya thub pa yis/ /chos 'khor bsrung mar dbang bskur ba/ /sgo ba che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /—209—

gru gu'i yul du gshegs pa'i tshe/ /gru gu rta dmag rgyal po yis/ /srung ma chen por dbang bskur ba/ /ku be ra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya nag yul du gshegs pa'i tshe/ /rgya rje dar btsan dmar po yis/ /te de'i srung mar mnga' gsol ba/ /mdung dmar can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bod yul dbus kyi bsam yas su/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /srung ma chen por dbang bskur ba/ /chos kyi rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos skyong rgyal po rdzu 'phrul can/ khyod kyi mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /da lta bdag gi mgon mdzod cig /sras mchog dam pa rā hu la/ /mgo dgu srin po'i cha lugs can/ / chu srin rgyal mtshan sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod/ / gnod spyin dha na sku mdog ser/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis pa/ /rtse gsum thod khrag 'bar ba 'dzin/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod/ /tshig rkang gnyis pa dang bzhi pa de kho na bzhi du sbyar ba/ gnod spyin ka la 'jigs gzugs smug/zhal gcig phyag gnyis: be con thod khrag 'bar ba 'dzin/ /gdug pa: ku be ra ni sku mu dog ljang / /zhal gcig: dbyug tho 'bar ba thod khrag 'dzin/ /gdug pa: dregs pa bum sna dmar ljang la/ /zhal gcigajorgyal mtshan dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gdug pa: dregs pa dung sna ser ljang la/ /zhal gcig: mdung dmar dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gdug pa dregs pa sna gsum ljang nag la/ /zhal gcig: mdung dmar rtse gsum ne'u le 'dzin/ /gdug pa dregs pa sna chen dkar ljang la/ /zhal gcig: dbyung tho 'bar ba ne'u le 'dzin/ /zhes 'don pa spo/shar phyogs sgo srung chen mo ni/ /dkar mo zhal—210—

gcig phyag gnyis ma/ khro bzhad brkyang bskum gar gyis rol/ /lcags kyu 'dzin la phyag 'tshal 'e1/ /de bzhin du tshigs rkang gsum la 'don pa spos la/ lho phyogasasgosrung ser mo zhal: khro bzhad thegs pa 'dzin la: nub phyogs dmar mo:khro bzhad lcags sgrog: byang phyogs: ljang nag khro bzhad: dril bu phyi rol khor yug la gnas pa'i/ /gnod spyin nor lha'i tshogs rnams kun/ /lcags kyu dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /las kun sgrub mdzad khyod la bstod/ /de nas bzlas dmigasagasal btab la/ oṃ mahā rā dza yak+ṣa sa ma ye be+e shra ma ṇa ye sarba tsit+ta rat+na hri hri dzadzaXzhes ci nus bzla/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlud raX las me/ a las mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum/ oṃ las thod pa'i nang du bhuX aX dzi khaX huX rnams las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad bkug ste bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi phung po chen po dang gtor ma gcig tu 'dres nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oX āXhuX sogs ser chen gyi skabs dang 'dra/ a mṛ ta'i mthar/ oX be+e shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wā ra i daX sogs kyisa'abul/ ar+ghaX nas shak+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ rin chen mdzes pa'i pho brang na/ khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i lha/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ /mdung dmar 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /be+e byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /sras dang blon po sgo ma dang / /gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas/ /'khor bcas ma lus thams cad kun/ /mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /bu sdug bzhin du bskyang ba dang / /tshe dang —211—

bsod nams rgyas par mdzod/ /gzhan yang bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /log par zhugs pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /de yi phru ma gzhom pa dang / /gtan nas brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /de ltar bcol ba'i las 'di dag /dam tshig ldan pa khyed rnams kyis/ /sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /ma g.yel da lta 'gru/ba par ma1rdzod/ ces 'phrin las gzhol/ bskang ba rgyas par byed na skabs 'dir bya/rjes chog ser chen gyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /de'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod na legs par 'grub na sgom don dang mas pa'i dkyil 'khor/rdul mtshon nam/ ras bris dgram/ bsdu na pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kyi steng du/ gtor ma gru gsum la mdung dmar sngags can btsugs/ bris sku dang mchod gtor bsham/ dung chos dri bzang gis gang ba dang /rdo dril rol mo sogs tshang bar byas la/ gsang bdag gi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas gong bzhin 'dod don gsol btab kyi bar du mdun bskyed kyi cho ga grub pa na rjes dzinang bya ste/ gsol gdab ni/thugs rje chen po'i gter mnga' ba/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /bdag sogs dbul phongs bskyab pa'i phyir/ /gter chen grub pa bdag la stsol/ /zhes so/ /de nas/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos pa ni/ khyod kyis brtson par ma sna de nus sam/ /'phrin las bcol dang dam tshig rnams/ /rjes su mthun par byed nus sam/ /zhes slob dpon gyis dris pa la/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs rjes bzlosakyi lan gdab/ rgyun bshags nas/ mchod bstod kyi bar ser chen nyid kyis rigs 'gre/ lcags kyi rdo rje slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag 'di ni ye shes rdo rje ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kun gyi bdag/dregs pa spyi'i gnyen po mchog khyod la bdag gis deng 'dir bskur/ /oṃ mahā a bhi ṣañtsa tu ma oṃ ā hu swāhā/ dregs pa spyi 'dul ba'i rjes gnang gtor ma chenapo—212—

snying gar gto la/ mdun bskyed las rgyal po mdung dmar can gnyis pa rbad nas/slob ma'i snying gar thim lus dang grib ma'i tshul du bzhugs par mos oṃ be+e rā dza sa mā ya sirnyi dza hu ba ho 'di ni rgyal po chen po ste/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i lha/ /dngos grub gnyen po chen po 'dis/ khyod la dbang bskur thob gyur cig /kā ya sirnyi skye(/ /lha ka sirnyi ā tsit+ta sirnyi hu/ zhes sku dngos kyis byin gyisabarlabs/ mdung dmar lag tu gto la/ 'di ni dbang gi mdung dmar te/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par byed/ /'gro ba thams cad dbang du sdud/ /dbang gi las kyis dbang bskur sbyin/ /o bai rā dza ma ma dung dung phaṭa/ dbang gi las kyi rjesaganang ngo / /dung phor nas dri bzang lce la bzhag gtor ma nas cung zad bcad de dngos grub tu spyin/bdud rtsi'i ro mchog dam pa yis/ /zas nor longs spyod char ltar 'bebs/ /'jig rten gsum gyi bcud thams cad/ /bdud rtsir bsgyur nas gtad cing bskur/ /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta sirnyi hu skyo/ dngos grub kyi rjes gnang ngo / /mthar gtor dbang bskur ba'i zugs kyang 'dug mod kyi/ 'di nyid kyi gtor dbang ni sku dngos kyi rjes gnang nyid yin pas/logs su mi dgos par mngon no/ /smon lam gdab pa man chad kyang ser chen gyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /rgyal chen sgrub thabs ngo mtshar rmad/ /gter ma ku5 gyi rtsa ba ste/ /rab dga'i snyib po mdor bsdus tsam/ /rjes gnang bcas pa gsal bar bris/ /mdung dmar can bya rgod ga sgo pas kyi gter mar grags pa phyi sgrub rta sngon can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ /༄༅༅/ /glu ste swā sti/ dpal ldan rgyal po ngal gsos po/ /de la btud de phyag 'tshal nas/ /nor sgrub shin tu rmad byung ba/ /gsang sgrub ljang khu'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /'di'i cho ga spyi rnams ser chen —213—

gzhir bzhag pa la mdun bskyed ba4sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ tri las rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ bai yig ljang khu las 'od 'phro / sa 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bus mtshan pa'i be con thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas dngos grub ster ba'i ne'u le brla g.yon pa la brten te bsnams pa/ zhi 'dzu ma sgeg la yan lag rags shing gsus khyim che ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing / zhal nas nor bu'i char 'bebs pa/ phrag gong g.yas g.yon nas nyi zla 'char ba/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis gter gyi bum pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du phu yig las yum pad+ma gtsug phud ma sku mdog dmar mo/ g.yas nor bu dang g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil zhing sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /nor bdag gter la mnga' brnyes pa/ /klu rgyal tso ges la dbang yang bsgyur/ /rgyal chen yab yum 'khordo ra bcas la/ /gus pas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes bstod/ yab kyi sngags ni ser chen dang 'dra/ oṃ nā ga ni ba su te ku ru ye swāhā/ yum gyi sngags so/ /gtor 'bur gyisasngags ser chen gyi gtor sngags bsdus pa des mdzad/ rjes gnang gi gsol btab dang / dri ba dri lan mdung dmar can gyi skabs bzhin byed/ rjes gnang gi ngo bo ser chen dang 'dra/ srog 'khor ga'u bla rdor bcas pa yod na/ sgrub pa'i skabs maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su de 'jog cing / slob ma'i snying gar gtugs nas/rgyal chen 'di la stsal nas ni/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du ga cho khri// /zhes pa thugasakyi rjes minang gomathar mdzad/ de ma 'byor na bgrang 'phreng snying gar gtugs nas/ rgyal chen sogs—214—

brjod/ rten gyi gtor ma nor bu'i gzugs can kho na mdzad pa rnams khyad par ro/ /zangs dkar tre man ngag ni/ /kun gyi mthar thug yin par bsngags/ /rgyas pa'i las sgrub ches dga' ba/ /sgrub thabs snyid sto'i yi ge'o/ /rgyal chen rnam thos sras ljang ser be con ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅’/ cha swā sti/ sangs rgyas rin chen mang po ni/ /res 'ga' byang chub sems dpa'i tshul//gzhan du gshod sbyin bdag war sprul/ /de la phyag 'tshal sgrub thabs bshad/ /'dir mdung dmar can gsang sgrub gar mkhan mchog gi sgrub thabs ni/ mdung dmar rta sngon can gyi skabs su bshad pa dang sgrub thabs rjes gnang ni spyi 'dra ba las/ rten gtor dmar po zlum po nor bu 'bar ba'i dbyibs can gyis rtse mo mtshan pa zhig bshom/ gtor ma byin rlabs ser chen dang 'dra/ bya ba thams cad dmar ser gnyis kyi rigs 'gre ba las/ mdun bskyed bas ris sbyangs/ rke(nga pa'i ngang la bhāX las gzha0/yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs lpi'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma drug pa'i lte bar g.yu 'brug sngon mo me'i ze ba can mgo g.yas su bstan pa/ de'i steng du be+e yig dmar smug las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras gar mkhan mchog sku mdog dmar smug zhal gsum sku lus dang mtshungs pa'i mdog can/ phyag bco brgyad kyi dang po gnyis nor bus gang ba'i gzhong pa 'dzin pa/ lhag ma bcu drug rim pa bzhin du/ rgyal mtshan dbyug to ral gri mda'/ /rtse gsum tho ba bi dza pur/ /mdung dmar rnams ni g.yas su'o/ /ne'u le pad+ma sgrags pa dang / /sbrul zhags 'khong ra lo rdo rje'i zhags/ /gzhu dang bum pa ri rab dang / /yongs 'du'i shing sdong g.yon na 'dzin/ /dar gyi na bza' dang / gser gyi go khrab mu tig gi rgyan can —215—

dang / sprul dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa khro 'dzum ral pa'i thor tshugs can no/ /mdun du yum pad+ma gtsug phud ma dmar mo bum pa dang rin po che bsnams pa/ 'dab ma drug la mdun nas brtsam te g.yas bskor gyis/sras nyi ma la dga' ba dkar po rin po che 'dzin pa lha'i cha lugs can/ nor bu bzang po dkar po lug gomago can rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ gang ba bzang po ser po rta'i mgo can bum pa 'dzin pa/ yang dag shes sngon po sha ba'i mgo can nor bu 'dzin pa/ sred spong dmar ser ra'i mgo can gre ba 'dzin pa/ blon po rgyal ba khyu mchog ljang khu glang po che'i mgo can gzhong pa 'dzin pa/ khyams su gnod sbyin dang klu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa'o/ /sngags ni/ na mo be+e shra ma ṇa ye/na da ku be ra mahā bha ga khyu krit+ta bhi na dh+ya ma na sirnyi swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /bstod pa'i skasasu/ dpal ldan rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /gar mkhan ma ceb gi gzugs 'dzin pa/ /btsun mo sras dang blon po dang / /rgyal phran 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /ces dang / gtor sngags kyi skabs/ oṃ be+e shra wa ṇa na da ku be ra sa pa ri wā ra zhes shod/rjes gnang mdung dmar can dang 'dra ba las/ mdung dmar lag tu gtor ba'i tshab tu/ zangs gzhong 'bru sna sman sna nor sna zas snas gang ba gto la/ 'di ni rgyas pa'i gtor gzhong ste/ khyad pararigs brgyud phun sum tshogs/ /'phel zhing rgyas par byed pa yi/ /rgyas pa'i dbang bskur spyin par bya/ /oṃ be+e rā dza spu sna ku ru a bhi ti ྅ hūX/ zhes brjod pa khyad par ro/ /kun nas gar mkhan mchog go zhes/ /dga' bar bsngags pa'i rnam thos bu/ /'khor bcasasgrub thabs rmad byung gi /yi ge snying po tsam zhig sprel/ /rnam sras gsang sgrub dmar po gar mkhan mchog gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /—216—

༄༅༅/ /glu ste swā sti/ shin tu zab pa'i man ngag ni/ /shog ril drug pa las byung ba'i/ /snyan grags rgya cher sgrub pa'i thabs/ /dmar po chos dung can de yin/ /sgrub thabs kyi yan lag ser chen ji lta ba bzhi las/ rten gtor zlum po dmar por byed/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ rin po che'i ri bo'i steng du rin po che'i khang bzang de'i nang du seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ be+e yig dmar po las dung dkar sbas mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'phro ba zhi zhing 'dzum la sgeg cing sha nyams rgyas pa/ phyag gnyis kyi dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba 'bud cing / sgrub pa po la snyan pa'i grags pas stong gsum khyab par mdzad pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'khor gnod sbyin brgyad dang / gnod sbyin mo brgyad po thams cad kyang khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i cha lugs can dung dkar 'bud pa'o/ /bstod pa ni/rdo rje 'jigs byed lus ngan po/ /dpal dang grags pa rab 'phel ba/ /gsung mchog rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /ces bstod/ sngags ni/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ma ma kirti dzu sna ku ru swāhā/ lhag mag kho chog dang / rjes gnang gi ngo bo thams cad ser chen nyid 'don pa spos pas chog/kun la ma grags chesadakon yang/ khungs ma'i man ngag rab dga' ba/ /yig rnying don gyi snying sto tsam/ /gsal bar bris pa e ma ho/ /rgyal chen rnam thos sras gsung mchog lus ngan po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyasa'aphel//

༄༅ma/ /o swā sti/ gsang bdag thugs las sprul pa ni/ /mngon spyod las kyi bdag por bsngags/ /rdo rje drag byed la btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /cho ga spyi phal cher ser chen dang 'dra ba las/ rten gtor nag po gru gsum snying gi gzugs lta bu zug ma/ 'bul gtor mdung dmar can bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rgyu las gzhal yas khangadrag po 'bar ba'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dbus su/ gnem lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i nye bar paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ be+e yig nag po las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar rab tu gnag la 'jigs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ka shi'i ras kyi ba dan dpyangs pa'i rdo rje'i dbyug tho nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon mchod rten nag po thugs kar 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro gnyer bsdus shing sma ra smin ma dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang dar gyi stod g.yogs can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/phrag gong g.yas g.yon nas nyi zla 'char ba/ sku stod nas bya gcan gdug pa'i tshogs dang / sku sked nas gnod sbyin srin po'i tshogs dang / sku smad nas seng ge sogs gcan zan gdug pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spro ba/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /'dam ma brgyad la —218—

phuXyig nag po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ klu chen brgyad po thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing nag khro zhing mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag thugs kar thal mo sbyar bas nor bu 'dzin pa/ sbrul ma sto gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan zhing / smad sbrul 'jug tu 'khyil ba/ gtsug gi nor bu las 'od 'phro zhing zhal nas phugs kyi sgra sgrog pa/ phyi rol du gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs dang / lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ ni laX ba ra dha ra badz+rapā ṇi mahā yak+ṣa rā dza ku be ra/ be+e ru dha ka sirnyi sme pra ya smo hūX huX phaṭa/ cesapa'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga mdung dmar can dang 'dra/ bstod pa ni/ stobs chen mi sdug 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /gtum po ma rung tshar gcod pa/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /mchode cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes brjod/ rjes gnang ni skabagardo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ sogs kyis gsol ba bto/ rjes gnang gi ngo bo ser chen nyid 'don pa spos pas chog pa la/ gzhug gi smon lam gdab mi dgos/ slob ma yi dam gyi bsnyen song yin na gnad la dbab pa'i drag po'i rjes gnang de yang nges par mdzad/ dregs byed 'di la seng ge'i gdan byed pa dang / shing rta la bzhugs pa dang / na bza' 'jol ber gsol ba dang / go khrab sogs gsol ba byed pa'i lugs kyang yod pa gang mos su bya'o/ /kun nas rab dga' rgyud gzhung dang / /'brel ba'i sgrub thabs yid ches can/ /yig sna shin tu mang po yi/ /nyer mkho snying po mdo tsam mo/ /rnam thos sras drag byed kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ /༄༅༅/ /tseXlte swā sti/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i srung ma mchog/rnam sras sgrub thabs 'brog gnasakyi/ /sngags rgyud las dang rjes mthun pa'i/ /drag po'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /'di'i sgrub thabs—219—
