dang / gtor ma'i bshom dang / byin rlabs sogs spyi rnams mdung dmar can dang mthun pa las/ rten gtor kha doganag po dang / dam rdzas rnams kyang mgon po nag po bzhin byed/ mdun bskyed bsangasasbyangs/ rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar gnam lcags 'bar ba'i tsha tsha 'khrug pa'i sa gzhi la rwa gur gyi dbus su/ sprin nag 'khrug pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la thod ril brtsigs pa'i gzhal yas khang zlum po sgo rnyag pa/ phyi rol du dur khrod kyis yongs su bskor ba/ de'i dbus su bhuX las 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bzhi pa lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa/ral gri'i phreng bas bskor ba'i dbus su/ chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag gi lte bar/ ru ṭa pho mo bsgral ba'i gdan/ phyogs kyi rtsibs bzhi la/ shar du zhe sdang 'o ma'i mtsho/ /lhor nga rgyal mar khu'i mtsho/ /nub tu 'dod chags khrag gi mtsho/ /byang du phrag tog gser gyi mtsho/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ hūX mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgregs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rgyal po chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gnyis dgra bgegs la sdang mig tu lta ba/ mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer bsdus pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri me 'bar ba 'phyar ba/ g.yon mda' dar leb rgan gyi mdog can khrag pa la bkal ba/ sku la dar nag go ber chen bse khrab smug po dang bcas pa gsol ba/ dbu la lcags kyi rmog zhu gser gyi thig le can bsnams pa/ sma ra smin ma me ltar 'bar ba/ zhabs la sag lham g.yu ris can gsol ba/ lbu zla rla'i mdog can gyi rta mchog lus nyams rtsal dang ldan pa/ gser gyi sga dang phra men —220—

gyi yob can cings pa/ shin tu 'jigs su rung ba srin po'i cha lugs can/ tsherlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i bai yig mthing nag phyogs kyi mtsho bzhi'i dbus su/ shar du drag las bdud mogashin rje mgo dgu ma nag mo phyag g.yas dung gi sbu gri dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rin po tshes brgyan pa/ ber dkar gsol zhing ba men ru yon la chibs pa/ lho ru raka las bdud mo gshin rje lag brgya ma ser mo g.yas lnga bcu ral gri dang / g.yon lnga bcu bdud zhags 'phyar ba/ sku stod la mi lpags dang / sku smad la stag lpags gsol ba/ ma he la chings pa/ nub tu sha las bdud mo phung khrol ma dmar nag g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon dgra snying 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can zhal nas khrag gi zor 'phen pa/ g.yag rgod nag po la rtsibs pa/ byang du spyo las bdud mogasod byed ma ljang nag g.yas lnga na khram shing / g.yon lnga na bdud zhags glo snying dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ sku stod la mi lpags dang sku smad la dred lpagasagasol ba/ rkyang bu kha dkar la chings pa/ thams cad kyang mi mgo'i do shal dang rin po tshes brgyan pa/ rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i bud med 'bum 'bum gyis bskor ba/ snye'i lo'i rtsibs wo bzhi la/ shar lhor lcu las yul 'go srung dkar po pi wang 'dzin pa glang po che la zhon pa/ lho nub tu be las 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa ma he la zhon pa/ nub byang du bi las mig mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags dang mchod rten 'dzin pa chu srin la zhon pa/ byang shar du be las ngal gsos po ljang nag dbyug tho dang ne'u le 'dzin pa seng ge la —221—

zhon pa/thams cad kyang go cha gsol zhing ches khros pa'o//sngags ni drag sngagasangadu yod kyang snying po/glu( be tra ka rak+ta sgro zhe༅pa yin la/bstod pa bsdus pa ni/lha tsho go/sa dbugs 'byin lha min 'joms la dpa'//mi bzad bdud kyi cha lugs bstan pa skyong //byang phyogs rgyal po bdud rgyal rnam thos sras//'khor bcas sprul pa yang sprul tshogs la bstod//gtor chog kyang snying pos mgo drangs nas 'bul ba'i khyad ma gtogs mdung dmar can gyi skabs dang 'dra'o//rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/pad+ma sngon po 'dab brgyad kyi khyad ma gtogs bsgom dang bdag mdun mdung dmar can dang 'dra/gsol btab nas dbu brgyan pa'i bar ser chen bzhin mdung dmar can bzhin dregs pa spyi'i dbang bskur/sku dngos kyi rjes minang yang mdung dmar can dang phal cher 'dra ba las/'di ni rgyal po chen po ste//sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang //dgra bgegs 'dul zhing brlag mdzad pa//las kun sgrub pa'i dbang bskur sbyin//kā ya sirnyi sogs 'don pa spo/tsa ka li'am gtor ma lag tu gtad la bka' bsgo drag tu bya ba/ral gri lag tu gto la/chos skyong rgyal po 'bor bcas rnams//gdul dka' sna tshogs 'dul mdzad pa//shin tu gtum pa'i khro tshul gyis//ma rungs dgra bgegs tshar gco / da cig/oṃ mahā a bhi khi ྅ hu/oṃ u hu swāhā/rdorje dang ral gri lhan cig 'phyar du bcug ste/yi dam spro ba lnga'am drug chos stong gi spro ba gsum gyis dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i mos pa byed du bcug bgrang 'phreng slob ma'i snying gar gtugs la bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/rjes smon lam gdab pa man chad ser chen gyi skabs dang 'dra'o//kun tu drag shul che ba 'di//snubs kyi man ngag yin par grags//sgrub skor rgyas shing rab dga' ba'i//snying po nyer mkho tsam zhig gris//rnam sras nag po rta sngon gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no////dge legs 'phel//22

༄༅’/ /ma ste swā sti/ bla ma dang ni gsang ba'i bdag/rgyal chen 'khor bcas la btud nas/ /dkar po tshe 'dzin sgrub pa'i thabs/ /mdo tsam bdag gis4gad par bya/ /rten gtor zlum gtor dkar po gtso 'khor dgu pa'am khang bzang ma gang rung bya/ choga'i spyi rnams ser chen gyi rigs 'gre ba las/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang la gaX las gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa steng thog rom pa gsum du phub pa/ 'khor sa rim pa gsum dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ paX las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma bgyod pa'i lte bar a las zla ba dang raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la saX las seng ge dkar po rin po ches brgyan pa/ de'i steng du be+e dkar po las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ khams gsum snod bcud kyi bcud dang bkrag mdangs thams cad 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas dngos grub dgug pa'i lcags kyu dang / g.yon 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i chu shel gyi bum pa gser gyi rdo rjes kha brgyan pa 'dzin pa/ zhi zhing sgeg la brjid pa'i nyams can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la k+ṣa yig dkar po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du dzaX bha la/ lho ru gang ba bzang po/ nub tu nor bu bzang po/ byang du ku be ra/ shar ltor yang dag shes/ lho nub tu 'brog gnas/ nub byang du lnga rtsen/ byang shar du pi tsi —223—

kuṇ+ḍa li rnams thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po g.yas na lcags kyu dang /g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ dar dkar po dang rin po tshes brgyan pa/ rta dkar po la chibs pa'o/ /'khor sa dang po la klu brgyad/ bar pa la gnod sbyin bye ba/ tha ma la sde dpon nyer brgyad dang / stobs chen so gnyis thams cad kyang dkar po tshe 'dzin gyi rnam pa can no/ /zhes dang / sngags ni/ oṃ bhuX ṇi ā yu ṣe huX dzaX bstodaspuni/ gdong lnga nyi zla'i gdan steng na/ /be+e las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /kai la sha ltar sku mdog dkar/ /g.yas pa tshe 'gugs lcags kyu 'dzin/ /g.yon pa tshe yi shel bum bsnams/ /sku la rin chen sna tshogs spras/ /lha yi nor ster khyod la 'dud/ /tshe dang nor gyi dngos grub stsol/ /zhes pa'o/ /ga sto chog kyang ser chen kho na dnga'adra ba las gtor sngags bsdus pas chog/rjes gnang gi cho ga ni/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad tshom bu dgu dang bcas pa la/ bum pa spyi dang mthun par bshams/ rten gtor 'cha' ba dang / mi 'cha' bo'i lugasaganyis yod pa las/ 'cha' ba'i tshe bum pa'i g.yas su bshams/ mdun bskyed sgrub tshul ser chen dang 'dra ba las/ thog mar bum pa sgrub pa dang ste/ bum pa'i nang du lha dgu bskyed/ /sgrub tshul spyi dang 'dra/ de nas rten gtor ram bris sku yod na de la dmigs/ med na mdun bskyed kyi nam mkhar bskyed pa yin/bum pa la dmigs nas/ oṃ pi shra ma ṇa ye/ ā yu ṣe ā yadzñā na sirnyi a pa ra mi ta tshergyuX/ zhes pa brgya rtsa sogs bzla/ rjes gnang la yang cho ga'i gzhi ser chen dang 'dra ba las/ gsol ba kha/ sgrub mchoge bdag la tshe dang ye shes kyi/ /zhes 'don pa spo/ sku'i rjes gnang la slob ma nyid lha chogs su bskyed cing / ye shes pa bstim pa'i skabs/ snying po'i mthar a be sha ya a btags pa mang du bzlas/ de rjes slob dpon gsang bdag dang / mdun bskyed rgyal chen 'khor bcas kyi dbang bskur bar mos su bcug la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /sogs kyi mthar/ bum —224—

bzlas kyi sngags brjod cing / bum pa spyi bor bzhug bum chu 'thung du bcug pas 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par bsam/ de rjes rin po che'i dbu rgyan bcing —ba sogs byed cing / rten gtor med na/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi skabs/ bris sku'am bum pa mgo thog tu bzhag nas bka' bsgo byed/ yod na rten gtor spyi bor bzhag la gtor dbang bka' bsgo byed pa yin te/ ser chen dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par de rnamasaso/ /'di la 'khor sa mi byed pa dang / 'khor sa gsum la/ nang rim gyi sde dpon nyer brgyad/ stobasachen soganyis/ gnod spyin bye ba rnams 'god pa'i lugs kyang yod pa gang bder bya'o/ /kun du zab cing dga' bar grags/ /yid la ngo mtshar cher bskyed pa'i/ /sgrub yig snga phyi mang po las/ /snyid sto bsdus pa de tsam lags/ /rnam sras dkar po tshe 'dzin gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ /༄༅༅/ glu ste swā sti/ nam mkha' mdzod la gus btud nas/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogasapa/ /nor gyi dbang phyug sgrub pa'i thabs/ /nor bu lta bu bshad par bya/ /dpal he ru ka'am gsang bdagagi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ gtor ma ri rab gling bzhi'i rnam pa can maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du nor sna sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod du bzhag/mchod gtor sna tshogs kyis kyang bskor la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ yaX raX baX laX suX las 'byu/nga bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor bhuX las gzhal yas khang / de'i dbus su seng ge la gnas pa'i zla ba'i steng du be+e yig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rgyal po rnam thos sras sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig spyan gsum pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas rin chen phreng bas mtshan pa'i dbyug tho dang / g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le dku la brten pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang gser gyi go cha gsol ba/rin po che'i rgyan kyis brgyan zhing / sems dpa'i phyed skyil gyis seng ge'i gdan —225—

la bzhugs pa/ gzi brjid nyi ma stong dang 'dra ba'o/ /gtso bo nyid grub pa na/lus dang grib ma'i tshul gyis nga la la sogs pa rta bdag chen po brgyad sku mdog phyag mtshan spyi dang mthun/ thams cad kyang rta sngon po la chibs pa gnod spyin bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /phyi rol du klu chen brgyad kar sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na rin po che bsnams pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXspyiXbaX hoXdapral bar oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ oṃ rat+na a bhi khiñtsa muX/ zhes dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ ma rdzo bstod gzhan dang mthun/bzlas pa'i dmigs pa rnams man ngag bzhin shes par byas la/ tseXrga be+e shra ma ṇa huX swāhā/ bsnyen pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ be+e shra ma ṇa rat+na gu hre sirnyi a be sha ya dzaX sgrub pa'i sngags sgo /oṃ be+e shra ma ṇa rat+na gu hre a bhi khiñtsa maX/ a pa ya/ rat+na sirnyi huX huX/ las sbyor gyi sngagasaso/ /oX be+e shra ma ṇa ye hūX/ srog sa mā ya lha hri dza dzaX spogs chog gi sngags so/ /gonga.oṃ.a mṛ tas ba4sa/ sā bhā was sbyangs/ zlaX las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod du oṃ lasabyung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya rmi tshor gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ snying po'i mthar a kā ro ba khas pas tshin bo la la tsho//'khor gyi gnod sbyin spyi la/ oṃ pū dza bā li gro hā kha kha ji hi ji hi/ zhes pa dang / 2ba lha/rdel kha 'bar ma'i sngags kyis spyin/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim pa rnams bya'o/ /'di nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum dang / gtor ma'i man ngag che chung / gcesapa'i ga dmasang ga bcu bzhi la sogs pa ni yig rnying du shes par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ maṇ+ḍal/ gsol btab/ rgyun bshags rnams spyi dang 'dra/ slob dpon yi —226—

dam du gsal ba gnas gyur te/ rgyal po rnam thos sras su gyur par mos la/ slob ma'ang mngon rtogasabazhin rnam thos sras su bskyed cing ye shes pa spyan drangs te bstim/ rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa'i bar bya/ rin po che'i go cha dang gzugs brnyan slob ma la gtad/ thang ka spyi bor bzhag la/ mdun bskyed las sku gnyis pa chad de thim par bsam/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo / /bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin pa las 'phreng ba lag tu gtad/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo / /snying gar sa bon sngags 'phreng 'od 'bar bar bsgom/ sems can thams cad dbul ba'i sdug bsngal las bsal bar bya'o snyam du bzhugs pa ni/thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo / /rin po che dang ne'u le gzugs bar+sā gto la/ las sbyor gyi sngags brjod/yon to gyi rjes gnang ngo / /gtor ma'i bka' bsgo byas la mtheb kyu nas cung zad cig spyin/ 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo / /rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /shin tu zab par rab grags pa/ /rtags las kun du yid ches shing / /bla ma las thob dga' ba skyes/ /snyed sto nyer mkho tsam zhig gris/ /rnam sras ljang gu seng zhog dzñā na lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /o swā sti/ nor sbyin dbang po la btud nas/ /gsang sgrub shin du rnyed dka' ba/ /yang gsang phyag mtshan bzhi pa yi/ khyad par cung zad bshad pa bya/ /gong du bshad pa ltar rgyal chen dmar po rta sngon can gyi sgrub thabs spyi dang mtshungs pa las/ gzhal yas khang ser chen bzhin bskyed/dbus su seng ge'i gdan bskyed pa'i sa bon tsa yig la byed pa dang / gtso bo'i sa bon bi'am tra gang rung dang / rgyal po chen po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas stag gi rgyal mtshan dang mdung dmar/ g.yon gyis ne'u le dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar la mche ba gtsigs pa/ dar dmar po'i cod pan can rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ cha lugs gzhan rnams rta sngon canadang—227—

'dra/ phyogs bzhir trag dmar po bzhi las/ shar du nor rgyun ma/ lho ru dbyangs can ma/ nub tu nor skyong ma/ byang du bha ra li rnams dmar mo zhi ma khro/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ g.yas lcags kyu dang / gawa ne rnga yab bsnams pa/phyi'i khang bzang brgyad du/ skad cig gis rta bdag brgyad ni/ ser chen bzhin las/ g.yas na rang rang gi phyag mtshan dang mdung dmar/ g.yon na lcags kyu dang ne'u le 'dzin pa'o /rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ rta sngon can dang 'dra ba las gsang rten gri snying yod na/ de nyid spyi bor bzhag ste/ 'phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo bzhin bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ de med na sngags kyi 'khor lo gtor ma'i nang du bcug pa zhig byas la bka' bsgo drag tu mdzad pa phyag len yin/ sngags kyi bzla tshul sogs sham bu mi 'dra ba mang du yod na'ang / rjes gnang tsam la mi dgos la/ phyi sgrub rta sngon can nyid kyi rjes gnang thob pas nang sgrub gsang sgrub yang gsang thams cad kyi nyams len byas pas chog par mngon yang / so so'i rjes gnang mdzad pa'i phyag len kyang 'dug cing / khyad par yang gsang 'di la gal po cher mdzad do/ /shin tu zab par kun nas grags/ /sna tshogs spyod rnams yid dga'i gnas/ /las tshogasasgrub skor ches mang yang / /rjes gnang snying sto tsam 'dis chog/yang gsang phyag mtshan bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅// /o swā sti/ rgyal ba thugs rje'i mnga' bdag ni/ /gter gyi bdag por sku sprul pa/ /de la bshud nas de'i sgrub thabs/ /cha tsam gsal bar dho pa ༵ /nga gā/rmyo/ ༵ga ma~Xbye ༵ ༵gh+ri rji/ ༵ rdo ༵/ rdo ༵ ༵sa/ pa ༵dī sbya~Xrdo/ —228—

dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang sems rdza yig ser po yongs su gyur pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ 'dod dgu'i char phab/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa nga la gser btso ma ltar 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog spyin gyi mthil na shing thog bi dza pu ra ka bsnams pa/ g.yon gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pas yid bzhin nor bu rin po che'i myong 'bebs pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa sha nyams rgyas pa' hur bag chags pa/ rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan gdangs shing dbu skra nag po'i thor cog can/ rin po tsho dbu rgyan dang bcas pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i rol pa'i stabs kyis dung gi mgo dang / pad+ma'i mgo zhes bya ba la sogs pa gter chen po rnams la zhabs brten pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi lhab lhub dang zin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ut+pal sngon po'i do shal can/ 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i sku can du gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' 'phags pa dza bha la 'khor ra bcas badz+ra sa mā dza dza tu rba ho dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs kar gu dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'bor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzakhyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang go lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi khri nyu hū/zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang drim dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ rma sku r+ya nga la sa pa ri wā ra ar+gha pra tisnro swāhā/ purdze nas/ sha lta bar gyis mchod/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' —229—

zhing / /gnod spyin nor 'aḥ mang po kun gyi rje/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon bo nga la/ /dngos grub mchog stsolas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ oṃng la dza len+d+ra ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ mthar lha sku mi dmigs par sbyangs te mnyam par bzhag slar yang lha skur langs te dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su ji skad bshad pa'i chu sbyin la sogs pa la nan tan du bya zhing / mchod gtor la yang nan tan du bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad tsho pa bu can nam/ ma 'grub na rjes gnang spyi dang mthun par bya/ dkar gtor mchod pa dze+e bgos zangs gzhong zangs bum chus gang ba sogs yo byad rnams tshang bar bya/ mchod pa byin brlabs spyi dang mthun/ gong bzhin bdag bskyed byas la/mdun bskyed kyang bdag bskyed 'don pa spos pas chog cing / bzlas pa'i mthar gtor ma la a mṛ tasab4sa/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang riX las byung pa'i rin po che'i snod du oṃ zhu ba las gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya ma sma chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhūX/ snying po mthar 6/ daX bā li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi btags pa lan gsum mam lngas phul/ a/r+ghaX nas/sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ gong bzhi bstod la/ ser sna'i las kyi me yis gdungs pa dag/skye ba skye bar khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /rin chen gter gyi bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyis/ /sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod/ /ces gsol btab/skabs 'dir yang chu spyin spro na bya/ rjes gnang go ngo bo sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang 'dra/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi mthar/ slob mas phul bar mos te/ chu spyin 'bul ba ni/ zangs gzhong gi dbus su/ rke(nga pa'i ngang las 'phags pa dzaX bha la gong bzhin bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ gnas gsum byin rlangasadang / dbang bskur byed mi dgos/ rang gi lag pa g.yas kyi mthil du zla ba la gnasapa'i oṃ hūṃ truX hi a/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi —230—

byin rlabs rnams bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug ste thim/ o ā hu/ zhes chu byin gyisabarlabs te/ snying po'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad kyis chu khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ bum pa'i chu rgyun mi 'chad par dbul bar bya'o/ /mthar j-i bgos chu nang du bcug la/ gong gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngags kyis phul/gong bzhin mchod bstod gsol btab lan gsum bya/ de nas 'phags pa nga la dgyes te/ slob ma la yid bzhi gyi nor bu dang / bdud rtsi'i dngos grub byin par mos la/ dzo sgogs nas cung zad bcad cing ster ba dang / chu ci dgar 'thung du gzhug go /rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /kun nas grags che chesazab pa/ /nor gyi sgrub thabs rab dga' ni/ /snga phyi'i yig tshogs dpag med las/ /snyib go tsam zhig nyer mkhor bkod/ /'phags pa ra la ser po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅༅/ /tso'e swā sti/ rgyud rgyal kun gyi rtser son pa/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus lasabyung / /ye shes zhabs kyi man ngag ste/ /gnod gnas sgrub thabs bsdus pa 'di'o/ /'di la rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa zhu ba glus bskul yan chad gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje lhan skyes gyi skabs bzhin nyams su blangasanas/ glus bskul ba/ dza las bi dza pu ra dza gyis mtshan/ pa dang / ba las snye ma ba gyis mtshan pa'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid rdzabha la ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'dra'i yum nor rgyun ma la 'byud pa/lhag ma g.yas gnyis bi dza pu ra dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis gter gyi ne'u le dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ cha lugs rnams dzam+bha la spyi dang mthun pa'o/ /skye mched byin rlabs/ gnasagasum byin rlabs/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams kyang 'jam rdor dang sdu gnyi/༵ ༵grwa/ byin pa sna snya kā/ dzhai sgyu rnams slo kyi/ sa ༵kā dī dzhai/bag/ bdag dī rdo dhi —231 —

mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba rnams byas te/ rang gi snying ga nas rja spros mdun du rang dnga'adra bar bskyed/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin rlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba mkha' nang du dzaX bha lar gyur/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros/mchodi pa phul te mdun bskyed la thim/ dbang bskur rgyas bto bya/ rang gi lag mthil du pad zla la huX las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de'i lhe bar mi bskyod pa lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par mos te/ lha rnams rjes chags kyi snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur pa/ mdun bskyed dzaX bha la'i ljags la dza yig gis mtshan pa'i steng du bab pas gso le/ bar bsams la/ chu spyin brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul/ gtor 'bul mchod bstod 'dod don gsol bto rnams spyi dang mthun par byas la/ rang gi snying gar bsdu/ bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal gyis/skye( āXdza huX/ zhes pa dang / yi ge bcu pa ci 'grub tu bzlas/ bang mdzod thams cad du yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i char 'bebs par bsam/ 'jug tu dge ba bsngo zhing / thun mtshams su lha'i nga rgyal la gnasapar bya/ 'dil yang sgom lung gis chog go /gnod gnas sgrub thabs rnam gsum las/ /'bring po'i lugs su kun nas grags/ /sngags shes dga' zhing yid ches gnas/ /rgyun bshad las byung snying por dril/ /gsang 'dus las byung ba chu sbyin dbang po 'bring po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyasa'aphel/ /༄༅rti/ /rma swā sti/ nor bu'i rigs kyi sngags gtso bo/ /chos ldan kun gyi nor sgrub pa/ /'phags pa j-i bha lar btud nas/ /dpa' bo grub pa'i man ngag bshad/ /'di nyid kyi rten nam 'khor lo —232—

mdun du bldan la/ mchod gtor bzang pos mtha' skor/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bsamachod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hu yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ pa las gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma bgyod pa/ de'i nye ba dang 'dab ma rnams la kyu dgu dang ba dgu yongs su gyur pa las/dbus su 'phags pa dza bha la nor rgyun mas yang dag par 'khyud pa/ shar du nor bu bzang po dang zla shel ma/ lho ru gang ba bzang po dang sbyin ma/ nub tu nor sbyin dang spyin bzang ma/ byang du rnam thos kyi bu dang 'phags ma/ shar lhor ki li mi li dang rab bzang ma/ lho nub tu 'jam po 'khyil pa dang rab sbas ma/nub byang du zhal gyi dbang po dang lha'i bud med/ byang shar du spyod pa'i dbang po dang dbyangs can ma/ thams cad kyang sku mdog gser btso ma ltar rab tu 'bar ba/ dar dang zin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ yab rnams rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na bi dza pu ra dang / g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ yum rnams g.yas mchog spyin dang g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa'o/ /gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes sbyan 'kho/dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams spyi dang mthun/ ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'gro la dmigs med thugs rje yi/ /thabs mkhas rang bzhin sku sprul pa/ /gnod sbyin pho mo'i tshogs rnams la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /spro na/ rja rto' mtshan brgya dang / bstod pa rgyas pa dang / nor rgyun ma'i bstod pa rnams kyis kyang bstod do/ /oṃ dza bha la dza la n+di ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas shing / oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya swāhā/ oṃ pu r+ṇa bha draya swāhā/ tsho( bhan da ya swāhā/ tsho( bai shra wa ṇa ya swāhā/ 8kho gī li mā li ni ye swāhā/—233—

oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍali ni swāhā/ oṃ mu khe sgru ya swāhā/ oṃ tsa ren+d+ra ya swāhā/ oṃ ba su dha ra ṇi swāhā/ skye( tsan+t+ra kañtsi swāhā/ skye rna dat+ta ye swāhā/ tso( su dat+ta ye swāhā/ tseX( ār+ya ye swāhā/skye( su bha dra ye swāhā/ skyed su gup+ta ye swāhā/ tso( di byi swāhā/ glu( swa ra spyo ste swāhā/ zhesapa rnams kyang ci rigs su bzlas la/ mthar chu spyin spyi dang mthun par phul/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel/ gtso 'khor so so'i sngags kyis mthar/ a kā ro / btags pas 'bul te/ gtso bo la lan bdun dang / gzhan rnams la gsum gsum mo/ /mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol btab sogs spyi dang 'dra bar bya/ 'di'i rjes gnang sbyin par 'dod na/ mdun bskyed kyi rten pho rkyang mo rkyang pho mo sbrags pa ste gsum mam/ 'khor lo gsum 'god/ma 'grub na/ maṇ+ḍal gsum la de'i rim pas tshom bu bkod/ mthar mchod gtor gyis bskor/ dbus su gong bzhin bskyed/ g.yas su gnod sbyin pho dgu'i dkyil 'khor bskyed/ g.yon du mo dgu'i bskyed/gnas gsum byin rlabs man chad chabs gcig tu bya/ slob ma rnams kyis gsol btab yan lag bdun pa sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra bar byas/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal 'dzin du bcu gam dun bskyed rnams blo yul du nges par bskyed nas/ chu sbyin gtor 'bul mchod bstod rnams bya/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung spyin te/de nyid kyis slob ma'i bya ba 'grub pa yin no/ ta khor lo kun la grags mod kyang / /rab dga'i bka' gto shin du dkon/ /snyid nas tshul 'dir 'jug 'os na/ /dang stor rig gto zhu ba gces/ /dze+e bha la lha mang gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅’/ /oṃ snyu sti/ mi bskyod rdo rjes byin rlabs pa/ khro bo 'chol ba'i cha lugasacan/ /smug 'dzin de la ba spyod byas nas/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas pa bshad/ /skyabs 'gro semasabaskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ bsrung 'khor gang 'os shig bsgoms nas/ rang gi snying gar a las zla —234—

ba'i steng du/ huX las rdo rje rwa dgu pa/ phyi ser la nang nag pa/ de'i lte ba la hūX gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ a zhes pa'i sgra dang bcas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'phags pa dzaX bha la nag po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ na ma u tsuṣ+ṭha ār+ya dzaX bha la sa pa ri wā ra khyoX zhe༅phyag bya/ ar+ghaX nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang sna/ zla ba rdo rje hūX dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu/rang nyid la thim/ mdun gyi 'phags pa nga la'i tshogs kyang oṃ a zhes pas spyan drangs nas hūX la thim/ rang lus kyang zla ba rdo rje dang bcas pa la thim de nyid kyang snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /zhes brjod la cung zad mnyam par bzhag zla ba rdorje hūXyig dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa dzaX bha la sku mdog bung ba ltar gnag pa/ gcer bu rigs ngan gyi cha lugs rna ba ma phug pa ri'i thung gi rnam pa can/ mtshan ma gyen du bsgreng ba/dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril la khro gnyer bsdus pa/ phyag g.yas pas ka pā la khrag gis/ gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas nor bu sna tshogs skyug pa'i ne'u le brla g.yon pa la brten pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa zhabs g.yas bskum/ g.yon brkyang bas pad+ma dang / zla ba'i gdan la nor bdag rnam thos bu'i gzugs can nor bu skyug pa mnan pa/ byis pa'i gzugs can skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan zhing / spyi bor rgyal ba mi bskyod pa bzhugs pa/ medapung —235—

'bar ba'i dbus na 'a kyang ba'i thugs kar zla ba la rdo rje rwa dgu pa hūX yig dang bcas pa/ phyogs kyi rwa rnams rab tu gdengs shing / dbus kyi rwa rnam par dkar ba nor bu'i tog gis brgyan pa/ de'i lte bar zla ba la skyoX/ dpral bar oṃ/lce la dzaX/ dpung pa g.yas la bha/ g.yon la la/ thugs kar dza/ lte bar len/ngar gdong g.yas la dra/ g.yon la ye/ bol gong g.yas la snya/ g.yon la hā rnams zla gdan la gnas pa/ yi ge thams cad kyang mdog nag po 'od zer ser po 'phro ba'o/ /de thams cad las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas dzaX bha lar gyur nas rang gi snying ga'i hūX la thim/ yang 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rin po che'i thams cad bsdus/ rlung nang du brngubs pa'i tshe/ klu chen brgyad dang nor bdag rnams kyi kha nang du song / rlung phyir rgyu ba'i tshe bskyugs pas rin po che'i phung por gyur/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du baX las byung ba'i bum pa bzang po/ lag pa'i 'khrig ma la lkoX/ bum nang du dzaX/mdzub mo la bha/ gung mo la la/ srin lag la dza/ mthe'u chung la len/ mthe bong la dra/ lag mthil gyi rtsa ba'i dbus su ye/ g.yon du snya/ g.yas su hā rnams zla ba la gnas par gyur/ dzaX yig las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas bum pa gang / mdun du zangs ga tshe de gi nang du sku gzugs sam ling ga bzhugs su gsol/ de nyid skad cig gis gong bzhi bskyed/ rang gi thugs ka nas dzaX bha la gcig spros nas de la bstim/ oṃ in+d+ra ya ṇi mu khaX bh+ra ma ri swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi khyor bas chu blug ste bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pa rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs/ dzaX gyi 'od kyis ser por gyur/ huX la sogs pa'i 'od —236—

zer gyis nus mthu chen por byas te/ thugs ka nas gyen zlu du log zhal nas thon/ lag mthil du byung ba phul bar mos pa'am/ rdo rje'i lam nas khyor bar phul bar bsam pa gang drang gi dmigs pa dang bcas/ o swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad kyis chu spyin lag len bzhin 'bul lo/ /de nas gtang sngags lan bdun gyis chu khyor ba bdun phul/ gtor ma pho bshos 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha drwa ya/ mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ ta du thā/ o dzam+bha la dza len+t+ra ye swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal gyi dbang phyug dpal chen bcu gnas rin chen rnam pa mang ldan pa/ /thabs mang stobs chen dri med thugs rje drang srong lha mo'i sras gyur de'i/ /sras cig mtshungs med ma lus srid dang zhi ba'i nor bdag gter chen ni/ /mi'u thung cha byad thod khrag ne'u le 'dzin mdzad khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mgon po nam mkha'i mdzod can nor gyi char 'bebs pa/ /ma skyes rang bzhin dag pas sku mdog sngon por bzhugs/ khyod ni rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du bdag mchod na/ /rtag tu yid la re ba'i 'bras bu mchis par mjodi/ ltes bstod cing gsol ba bto/ rten chu nang du sgoṇango / /rten med na rang gi snying gar bsdu ba'am/ gshegs pa gang rung bya/ gtor ma gtsang sar btang ngo //tse( dza bha la dza len+t+ra ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas par bya'o/ /mthar lha sku mi dmigs par sbyangs te dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su yang lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba byed/'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu mchod gtor rnams spyi dang mthun par bsham/bgegs gtor btang / mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par byed/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams bzlasapa'i bar gong bzhin byas la/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi la hu —237—

las nas/ bskyed cing yi ge 'god pa bzhin bya/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ gtor 'bul mchod bstod bzlas pa rnams bdag bskyed bzhin byas la/ slob ma'i bya ba ni sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang 'dra ba las/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags kyi dod/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yi sogs kyi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byed/ sku'i rjes gnang gi mthar yi ge rnams 'god/ snod bcud lhar bsgyur nas bstim/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi mthar lag pa byin rlabs nas mchod bstod kyi bar/ slob ma nyid chu spyin rgyas par 'bul du 'jug pa'am/ mi lcog na/ slob ma'i don du dmigs nas slob dpon gyisabya/ de'i mthar mdun bskyed kyi klu brgyad sogs kyis rin po che zos shing bskyugs pas slob ma la dngosagrub stsol ba'i dmigs pa gong bzhin phog la rja bshos dang chu nas cung zad sbyin/ rjes kyi bya ba thamasacad spyi dang 'dra/ 'di thun mong ma yin pa paṇa chen shākya shrī'i man ngag gi lugs yin/ thun mong tsam sgyin par 'dod na sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang / rgya mtsho'i nang nas 'byung ba kho nas chog go /kun nas ngo mtshar mchog gyur pa'i/ /man ngag bzhi zhes dga' bar bsngags/ /gzhung dang man ngag mtha' yas las/ /nyer mkho snyid sto tsam zhig bsdus/ /'phags pa rja bha la nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅// /oX snya sti/ 'ag rten mgon po la btud nas/ /de yi rnam 'phrul nor lha'i gtso/rde /gnod gnas lha lnga la btud nas/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas pa bshad/ /mdun du brisasku'am maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dang bcas pa'i rten bshams la/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ spyan rasagazigs kyi bdag bskyed gang yang rung ba sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed a rlu tas bsangs/ sā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i gzhal med khang pa'i dbus su/ dzaXyig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa lbo bha la sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/—238—

khro bo'i cha lugs can/ phyag g.yas pas mdung rtse gsum pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas nor bus mtshan pa'i be con bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yu 'khrug sngon mo la chings pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing sangs rgyas dpa' bo'i ngo bor gyur/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon rten 'brel gyi rdzas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo g.yas rin po che sbungs pa dang g.yon lcags kyu bsnams pa/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon nor bus mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu g.yas rdo rje rgya gram dang g.yon gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ po ṭa la nas dzaX bha la 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/oX badzi bha wa a bhi khiñtsa hūX zhes gsungs shing dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang bskur/ gtso bo la de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang / 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzaX bha la hri da ya huX phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzlagathun 'jog khar/ zangs gzhong gi snod du sdugs sku bzhag pa'am/ sku gzugs med kyang rung / rang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba'i lag mthil g.yas su gaX las byung ba'i bum pa bzang po'i nang du/ oX āXskyoX las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyo mtsho chen por gyur/ mdun gyi dzaX bha la 'khor bcas zangs gzhong gi nang du byon par bsams la/ snying po brgya rtsa brgyad kyis chu sbyin 'bul/ mthar thig pa gcig lce thog tu bzhag la/—239—

lhag ma phyogs bzhir gtor/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ tseX( āXhuX/lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzaX bha la hri da ya bā li ta kha khakhāhi khu hi/ lan lngas phul/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ spyan ras gzigs dbang sku las mngon sprul pa/ /rigs lngas byin rlabs bdud rtsa char ltar 'bebs/ /pad+ma khro bo ār+ya dzaX bha la/ /rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas la 'dud/ /celo'adod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol sogs byas la/ gong du bshad pa bzhin rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang / tshom bu la yang bsnyen pa ma thon gyi bar du brtan bzhugs byed/ rgyun gyi bzlas pa'i skabs lta bu rten dang tshom bu gnyis ka med na/ badz+ra muX gshags su gsol/ mkha' 'gro rigasabazhis sngags kyang sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi skabs ma gtogs mi dgos so/ /de ltar na sngags 'bru 'bum du bzlas pas bsnyen pa sgrub pa yin pas ga'u'i sgrub pa las spyor dang bcas pa sogs 'di nyid kyi lasatshogs rnams sgrub pas rtags 'phral du thon par 'gyur ba yin no/ /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dkar po zhig bri/ lte ba dang phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la 'bru'i tshom bu bkod/ bum pa bcud dang ldan pa kha rgyan canadabāgator ma dkar gtor gtso 'khor lnga pa zhig dang / gzhan yang 'bul gtor mchod pa tsā ru'i bza' ba rnams ci bder bshams/ rtse gsum be con rdo rje rdzas gzhong nor bu lcags kyu pad+ma rgyal mtshan/ sna tshogasardo rje ne'u le'i rkyal pa rnams dngos sam tsa ka li tshang bar bsham/ dbu rgyan dang rin po che'i 'phreng ba zhig kyang bzhag 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed 'dod don gsol btab yan chad gong dang 'dra ba las/ maṇ+ḍal gtor ma bum pa gsum gyi gnas su rin po che'i gzhal med khang pa zhes sogs brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /de gsum la so sor dmigs nas bzlas pa brgya phrag re re bya'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'dug pa la/ bgegs gtor spyi —240—

dang mthun par btang / yid ches pa'i lo rgyus bshad/ slar yang maṇ+ḍal phul/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ /sogs gsol ba btab/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdusanas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon/ /brjes ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi glo/ ltes nyan par gdams/ sangs rgyas chos dang ma lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs ma:blo sogs lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung / sku'i rjes gnang la spyi dang mthun par byas pa'i rjes su/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī ye hūX/ slob dpon 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba dang / mdun bskyed dzaX bha la rigs lngas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang / sdig pa dag par mo khro// dbu brgyan zhing / oX rat+na mu ka ṭa a bhi khiñtsa hūX/ rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsam/ si po che'i 'phreng ba mgo la bskon/ oX rat+na mā la a bhi khiñtsa traX traX traX traX traX/ gsung gi rjes gnang dngathugs phyag mtshan bstim pa spyi dang 'dra/ mdun bskyed kyi gnas gsum nas/ dzaX bha la dkar dmar mthing gsum spros nas/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du bstim pa yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo / /gtso bo'i phyag mtshan lag tu gtad/ rje btsun 'phags pa dzaX bha la'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams/ /bu yis myur du thob par shog /lkoX pad+ma kro dha gos/ bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi sogs gong ltar brjod bzhi du/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag mtshan gto la/ oX badz+ra ḍā ki ni pi shi ni steng lha'i snang srid thams cad slob ma'adis dbang du gyur cig 'og klu'i snang srid thams cad: bar mi'i snang srid thams cad: swāhā/ de bzhin du/ rin chen mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag mtshan gtad la/ bcom ldan —241 —

rin chen mkha' 'gro ma'i sogs dang / oṃ rat+na ḍā ki ni pi shi ni/ 'jig rten khams kyi nor rdzas bang mdzod thams cad slob ma 'dis dbang du bsdus shig swāhā/pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag mtshan gton la/ bcom ldan pad+ma sogs dang / tsho( pad+ma ḍā ki ni pi shi ni/ rgyal po dang blon po dang yul mi dbang wo po dang nor bu'i bdag po klu chen po rnams slob ma 'dis dbang du bsdus shig swāhā/ las kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i phyagamatshan gto la/ bcom ldan las kyi sogs dang / oṃ karma ḍā ki nī pi shi ni/ yul miphyug po dang / rkang 'gros dang / zas nor sna tshogs pa slob ma 'dis dbang du bsdus shig swāhā/ zhes pa ni 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo / /de nas gtor ma'i bka' bsgo spyi dang rimathun par byas la/ ga|nga ma'i lha lnga slob ma la bstim/ su pra la/brtan bzhugs bya/ gtor ma nasabag tsam dngos grub kyi don du slob ma la sbyin/ rjes rnams spyi dang 'dra zhing / tsā ru'i bza' ba longs spyad par bya'o/ /'di'i sgrub thabs bdag bskyed du byed pa'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ gong du bshad pa nyid legs so/ /nor sgrub kun las khyad 'phags pa/ /zin chen phung por spungs pa dang / /mtshungs shing dga' bar rjes bsngags pa'i/ /snyid swo mdo tsam bkod pa yin/ /j-i bha la dkar po jo ma lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /skye( snya sti/ dpal ldan sdom pa he ru ka'i/ /rnam 'phrul las byung lbo bha la/ /dmar po srog sgrub ces bya ba'i/ /sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri bar bya/ /'di'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bya ba yig rnying las shes par bya'o/ /'dir mdo tsam smos na/ bde mchog lhan skyes sam/ bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs kyang rung ste/ gang ltar yang bde mchog gi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas bris sku'i mdun du mchod gtor bzang du zug mas/ nang mchod dang phyi mchod bdag bskyed ltar byin —242—

gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad dang / a las zla ba'i steng du bhuX las gter gyi bum pa gnyis zhabs sprad cing kha g.yas g.yon du bstan pa las rin po che'i char 'bebs pa/ de'i steng du raX las nyi ma'i dkyil ge bor/ de'i steng du dzaX dang baX las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ 'phags pa dzaX bha la sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum nor bu 'bar ba'i thor tshugs can/ phyag g.yas rin po che dbang gi rgyal po thugs ka'i thad tsam du 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa gter gyi ne'u le rin po che skyug bzhin pa yum gyi sta zur g.yon gyi thad tsam du 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs can dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ brjid bag chags la bde ba rgyas pa'i nyams can yid tsam khro ba'i ngang tshul can no/ /yum bde ba rgyas byed ma yab dang rnam pa mtshungs pa las/phyag g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ skra grol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang bas yab la 'phyud pa/ lha mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /yab yum gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar khyuX rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoXganyis su med par thim/ ye shes sems dpa' dang lhan cig byon pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi khiñtsa hūX zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchode par gyur/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar dang / bzlas sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ rjes chags dpa' bo mchog tu bde ba'i rang bzhin can/ /zag pa —243—

dang bral mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug dpa' bo che/ /gnyis med rnam rol dgos 'dod kun 'byung mchog gi lha/ /mgon po khyod la mngon par 'dud do mngon phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs kar yi dam gyi sngags 'phreng gi dbus su/ dzam+bha la yab yum/ de'i thugs kar de nyid kyi sngags 'phreng dang sa bon bsgom/ de'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed bskul ba sogs dmigs pa gsal btab la/ rmadza bha la dza la n+di ye dha na me dhi sdi ḍā ki nī dza la sam+bha ra swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /mthar gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ yi dam gyi mngon rtogs ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis 'bul/ gong bzhin mar bstod dang / mchod sbyin gtor ma nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis 'dod don gsowab btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol brtan bzhugs rnams spyi dang mthun zhing/ rten med na gshegs gsol bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod na/ skar ma rgyal gyi nyin mo/ stegs bu gru bzhi pa btsag gisabyugs pa zhig la bcad dmar skyas pad+ma 'dab brgyad 'bri/ dbus su tshom bu dmar po bkod/ der mañdzi bkod pa'i steng du nang mchod dang / de'i steng du maṇ+ḍal la rdo ras byugs/ de la chos 'byung gi dbung su dzo dang ba/ mtha' ma sngags kyis bskor ba bri/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang mchod pa byin rlabs rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ 'dod don gsol btab yan chad bdag mdun gong bzhin byas nas/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can sogs lan gsum gyisagasol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ sku'i rjes gnang spyi dang mthun par byas pa'i rjes su/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ maṇ+ḍal gyi si rgyu ra mtheb srin gyisablangs la/ slob ma'i dpral bar lan gsum du byug snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa lan gsum —244—

brjod/ de nas rjes su bzlas pa'i lung / dam bca' ba'i lung / byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin pa las/ slob ma'i snying gar j-i dang paṃ gnyis kar bkod cing / mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas yi dam gyi sngags kyis 'go drangs nas/ sngags 'phreng spro ba ni/ khyad par ro/ /mthar nang mchod 'bru gsum gyis sbyin/ lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang / bde bas pas khyab par mos su gzhug rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra zhing tsā ru'i ston mo rgya cher bya'o/ /'di slob dpon birlu pas man ngag tu 'dod pa dang / khyad par 'brog mi nas brgyud par 'dod pa ni brgyud yig shin tu 'khrul ba yin pa sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi chings sogs la brtags pas kyang shes par yod cing / yi ge 'ga' zhig las 'byung ba ltar/ bla ma sa skya pa che pos ba ri lo tsā ba la gsan par byas pa nyid 'thad pas/ brgyud pa'ang de yan chad bde mchog lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ /gnod gnas dmar po'i sgrub thabs ni/ /kun lasakhyad par 'phags pa yi/ /dga' chen he ru ka mtshungs pa/ /sgrub thabs snyib bho mdo tsam gris/ /pho bha la dmar po sa lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅༅/ /skye( rdza sti/ pad+ma gar dbang rnam 'phrul las/ /nor lha'i rgyal por sku sprul pa/ /de la btud nas de'i sgrub thabs/ /mdo tsam bdag gis brjod par bya/ /dzo bha la dmar po grwa ba mngon shesalugs kyi sgrub thabs dang / rjes gnang gi rim pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal la ba byung dang dri bzang gis byugs pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po bris pa'i lte bar bdud rtsi ril bu dang ldan pa'i myos byed bzang po ka pā la gang ba bu ram sbyar ba dang / de'i mdun du gtor ma rin po che 'bar ba'i dbyibs can 'bri mog pas dmar por bsgyur ba la bu ram dang sha la sogs pas brgyan pa dang / 'bul gtor gcig gam/'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gcig ste gnyis kyang bsham/ g.yas su bum pa dmar po mtshan nyid dang ldan pa kha rgyan dang / mgul chings kyis mdzes pa'i nang du chu gtsang ma dang / lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas tshang bar blug pa —245—

bkod/ g.yon du mchod sbyin gyi snod zangs gzhong du sku bzhugs su gsol/ mtha' mchod pas bskor te/yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dmigs rten rnams a mṛ tasab4sa/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du paX las pad+ma/ ma las nyi ma/a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ dzaX yig dmar po las 'od zer 'phros/sems can dbul 'phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las ur+ya rja bha la dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs ba pa/ sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i phung po ltar dmar zhing 'od 'bar ba/ chags pa dang sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing cung zad khro la 'dzum pa/ rtsa zhal dmar la ba 'ad pa/ g.yas dkar g.yon sngo ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rin po che dang / bar pa na lcags kyu/ g.yon gyi dang po na thod pa rin po tshes gang ba/ bar pa na zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams nas btsir bas nor bu rin po che sna tshogs skyug pa/ zhabs g.yas pa gnyis cung zad bskum zhing g.yon pa gnyis cung zad brkyang ba'i 'dor stabs kyis gnod spyin nor bu skyug pa gnyis mnan pa/ klu chen po brgyad dang rin po che sna tsho gis pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing / me tog phreng ba dang dar gyi cod pan gyis mdzes pa/ de'i thugs kar khyoXyig dmar po las gsang ba'i lha mo ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis kyis ut+pa la'i mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs shing / 'og ma gnyis kyis ut+pa las mtshan pa'i lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum pa'i brang ba g.yon pa'i brla la bstad pa'i skyil krung phyed pas bzhengs pa/ mi rus kyi 'phreng ba'i phyag rgya lnga dang / zin po che'i rgyan dpag tu med pas —246—

brgyan pa/ khro zhing 'dzum la sgeg pa'i nyams ldan gsal bar bsgoms te/ yab yum gnyis ka'i gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/thugs ka'i dbus su rang gi sa bon bkod pa las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya lbo bha la shrī ku ru kul+le sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dza mahā ar+gha pra snye swāhā/ pad+ma ka ma la ye stu/dza / ba ho gnyis su med par bsam/ yang 'od 'phros dbang lha spyan drangs ma snang de/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a ni khiñtsa tu/ ma/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+re bha wa a bhi rdzi rtse hu/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas rin po che 'dzin pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ rdza bha la dza len+d+ra ye dha na mi dhi hi swāhā/ zhesapa'i sngags ci nus su bgrangs bas mnyes nas nor gyi dngos grub spyin par bsam mo/ /gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ snying po'i mthar i da bā ling ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ ba khasapadang / gtor ma phyi ma a kā ros 'bul/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ sgo so'i phyag rgya dang cas pas/na ma sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya dzo bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+gha pra titsā pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa / ma ya ā hū ཾ dang / de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ ngu khrig/ pukhre/ dhu pe/ ā/lo ke ga rnye/ nai we kyi/ shasta zhes sogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas mchod/ bde gshe/gas kun gyi gsung las legs sprul zhing / /thugs rjes chags pa'i sku mdog dmar por bzhugs/ /dbang gi 'phrin las rdzogs mdzad dza bha la/ /ma lus 'gro sna ༵rdo~X dī tshi sbya~X /stong pa/ tsho/ sdo las zla ba'i sna dan ༵ shā ༵ sa rin po~X/ —247—

bum pa/ dmar po mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang phyogs bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ zle aX dzi khaX hūX las byung ba'i rigs lnga thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po/ zha logacig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che dang /g.yon gter gyi bum pa 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan dpag tu med pas brgyan pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs te/ thugs ka nas spros pa'i 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dgug gzhug bcings mnyes byas/ dbang lha spyan drangs pa la mchod de dbang bskur bas/ rang rang go rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa la mchod cing bstod de/rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril ba rigs lngasathugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ sku'i cha thams cad nas babs pa'i bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar bsams nas/ oṃ hūX traX khyiX.a/ zhes pa ci nus su bzlasate/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / rigs lnga 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dzaX bha la dmar po sngar bzhin yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed de/ mchod bstod dang bzlas pa sogs sngar bzhin byas/ lhag chad kha bskang / 'dod don gsol ba bto/ lha zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i rnanagyur par bsam/ thun mtshams su chu sbyin dang gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas zangs gzhong du sngar ltar bskyed nas/ ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ de'i thugs kar raX dmar po me'i rang bzhin can gcig bsams nas/ raX zhes brjod pas rjes su chags pa'i me 'bar te/zhal nas me lce cung zad byung bas shin tu skom pa'i gdung ba la mchod pa 'bul bar bsam/ rang gi lag mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ zlaX aX dzi khaX hūX las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gang ba sor rmi'i rtse —248—

las 'dzags/ sngags kyis phul bas skom pa'i gdung ba zhi ste mnyes nas zhal dang ne'u le dang nor bdag rnams kyi kha nas rin po che sna tshogs byung bas rang gi dgos 'dod thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bsams la/ chu sbyin zhing sngags nyer gcig las mi nyung bar bzlas/ gtor ma tso( āXhūX gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas/sngags kyi mthar/ i daX bā li ti kha kha ji hi ji hi btanas pa gsum mam lnga la sogs pas phul bas ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bas/ mnyes nas 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsol bar ba45/ ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ rgyal ba rin chen mang gi thugs rje las/ /mngon par sprul pa nor bdag kun gyi rje/ /gsung gi dbang phyug ār+ya rja bha la/ /'dod dgu'i char 'bebs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ 'dod pa'i tho lagasol ba btab/ dze+e bha la'i zhal dang/ nor skyug pa dang / ne'u le la reg par bsams nas/ chu sbyin phul pa'i chu las thigs pa gcig mtheb srin gyis blangs te/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun lce la bzhag par bsam/ skye( āXhuX zhes brjod cing dngos grub blangs/ gtor chu dang bcas pa rang gi longs spyod pa'am/chu bo chen por gnas pa rnams la sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams rjes su bzung bar bya ste/ de la spyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/slob ma rnams khrus phyag maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas gral du 'khod pa la gsol ba btab pa'i rjes zlos gyisazhes brda sbyar nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can nas/ blo mchog bdag la gnangabar ma ljadi// /kyi bar lan gsum brjod du gzhug gur nas 'byung pa'i rgyun bshags sam gang yang rung ba'i sgo nas/ sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa phog ste/ mdun bskyed kyi dmigs pa sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar phog bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos 'dun byed du bcug la/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/—249—

mdun bskyed kyi sku las 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma la phog slob ma'i nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ lus 'od dmar po'i gong bur gyur par bsam du gzhug go /gnyis pa ni/ slob ma ba4sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun bskyed kyi skabasasubarjod pa de nyid 'don pa spos te/ slob ma rja dmar du bsgoms pa'i gnas gsumabyin gyis brlabs/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon kyi 'od kyisaphyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha gter bdag dang bcas pa thams cad rdzabha la dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma la thim pas dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par bsam du gzhug sngags kyi gzham la a be sha ya a zhes btags pa brjod cing/ gu gul gyis bdug rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas ye shes pa dbab bo/ /rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan par bya'o/ /slar yang slob dpon gyi 'thugs ka' hu las 'od 'phros pas dbang lha spyan drangs pa la/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba 'debs su bcug slob dpon gyis 'di la zhes 'don pa spos la brjod/ lhas rang rang gis dbang bskur ba'i bya ba rnams mdzad par bsam du stsog nas/sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis zhes sogs dang / ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hu/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis smin mtshams yan chad gang / lus kyi sgrib pa dag bum dbang thob/ mgripa yan ngag gi: gsang dbang : snying ga yan: yid kyi shes rab ye shesakyi: lus thams cad: sgo gsum sa rgya dbang bzhi pa thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med mnyam bzhag gi phyag na rin po che bsnams pas dbu —250—

brgyan par bsam du bcug slar yang slob mas bla ma la me tog gi 'phreng ba re phulabar bsams te/ bsnyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhesalan gsum brjod du bcug slob dpon gyis 'di gsan pas khyab rjes zlos bya mi 'tshal zhes brda' sbyar/bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gso le/ /zhesalan gsum dang/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ /rdza la dmar po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bde chen gnas su rung du gsol/ /zhes brjod cing / spyi bor me tog bzhag par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar dbang bskur ba de dag brtan par bya ba'i phyir rjes su gnang ba sbyin par bya ste/ thod chang lag tu bzhug la/ khams gsum snying khrag bsdus pa'i bcud/ /byang chub sems ni dmar la dwangs/ /srid gsum dbang du byed pa'i rdzas/ /bu yis blangs pas dngos grub thob/ /ces brjod/ bdud rtsi lce la bzhagacing / sngags kyi mthar a bhi khiñtsa a zhes brjod/ gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba lag par bzhag la/ yid bzhin rin chen 'bar ba yis/ khams gsum kun gyi nor bsdus pas/ /'dod dgu char 'bebs dbang gi rgyal/ /bu la sbyin pas de pos grub thob/ /ces dang / gtor zan byin zhing sngags sngar bzhin brjod/ de nas chu sbyin pa'i rjes su gnang pa yang bya ste/ chu sbyin gyi dmigs pa sngags gtor bsngo/ bstod pa 'dod don gsol ba'i bar lag len ltar byed cing / slob ma yang byed du bcug /de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas/ dzo bha la dmar po'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa yin pas/ cu bha la dmar po nor lhar bsten mchod gtor dang bsnyen sgrub ci nus su bya snyam pa'i rjes—251 —

zlos kyis bya/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum brjod/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bcuganag deng nas brtsams te sogs gsum brjod/ bsngo ba smon lam rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa byasanas/ rjes kyi cho ga rnams kyang cha tshang la ma nor bar bya'o/ /kun la zab par grags pa yi/ /sgrub thabasayi ge ches dga' ba/ /rgyas bsdus gnyis ka'i skyon spangs nas/ /snying po tsam zhig bsdus pa yin/ /rja bha la dmar po gter ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ /༄༅// /tshe swā sti/ chu dbang snying rje chen po la/ /btud nas po mtshar sgrub thabs ni/ /nor sgrub bcud len bsrung sogs la/ /lhag par bsngags pa 'dir brjod bya/ /rgyud 'grel las ji skad bshad pa'i rten tshang spun ma/ rin na'ang shing las byas pa'am/ mi mor bris pas kyang rung ste/ chu sbyin gyi chas dang / mchod gtor mdun du bshams/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa dusa'akhor gyi lugs bzhin nam/ spyi dang ma lhun par byin gyis rlabs kyang rung / gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ badz+ra bhā tī shwa ri ga ga na swa bhā wa sarba da ra bya bi shwa dha ni/ sarba dra bya ṇi/ bi shwa dha ya huX phe phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed ba4sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma'i sdong po'i rtse mor pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ 'dab ma rnams phyogs kyi mdog can/ lte bar haX las 'phags pa dzo bha la ljang khu'am ljang ser phyag mtshan sogs dzaX bha la ser po spyi dang mthun par bskyed/ de'i brla g.yon pa'i steng du tshiXlas lha mo nor rgyun ma sngon mo phyag g.yas mchos/ spyin gyi phyag rgya dang lhan cig yab la 'khru da pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du ho las zla shel ma/ mer twoXlas rab bzang ma gnyis nag mo/ lho ru hro las sbyin ma/ bden bral du lhaXlas rab sbas ma gnyis dmar mo/ byang du huX —252—

las 'phags me/ byang shar du rmuXlas dbyangs can ma gnyis dkar mo/ nub tu slo las spyin bzang ma/ nub byang du kluXlas lha mo dpal gnyis ser mo/ de ltar gnod spyin mo dgu char yang g.yas mchog sgyin gyi mthil nas 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs shing / g.yon pas rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs pa rnams su gyur/ ye shes pa spyan drangs te/dzaXhūX baX ho ༷ ༷hiXzhes bsre/ dpral bar oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar guX lte bar hoX gtsug gtor du haX/ gsang bar k+ṣaXrnams kyis rgyas btab/ lha dbang bskur ba ni mi mdzad/ gal te byed par spro na chu dbang bskur te/ rigs drug gis so sor rgyas btab/lag mthil du a i ṛ u lo'i 'od kyis 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi bdud rtsithams cad bsdus/ zhal du phul bar bsams la/ chu sbyin spyi dang mthun par phul/gtor ma yang gsol bar mos la/ oṃ āXhuX hoX.ār+ya dzaX bha la sa pa ri wā re khyoX i daX bā li gan+taX pu yoX sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje dbyings dbang phyug /sgrol ma reg bya rdo rje ma/ /gos dkar ro ma mā ma gī /gzugs ma spyan ma dri rdo rje/ /gnod spyin mo dgu'i tshul bstan pas/ /rab bskor 'phags pa rmug 'dzin ni/ /dpal ldan mi bskyod rdo rje ste/ /thabs mkhas tshul gyis longs spyod ster/ /de dag rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /ces sogs dang phyogs mas gyis bstod pa ci shes kyis bstod/ mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis gsol bto/ yi ge ༅ pa'i bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ ga rgod sbyin mo dgu'i mtshan sngags kyang ci rigs par bzlas la/ de nas o āXhuX hoXhaX k+ṣaX.ār+ya dzaX bha la sirnyi me pra ya:skyo/ ma ma dha naX/ da da tu/ badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya te swāhā/ zhes las sgrub pa'i sngags kyang cung zad bzla'o/ /mthar dngos grub blang ba —253—

dang / yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ rten la brtan bzhugs sogs byas la/ thun mtshams la 'ju ga go /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ rten dngos sam tshom bu la brten kyang rung ste/ bzlas pa yan chad gong bzhin song ba na/ rdo rje shugs kyi skabs bzhin gsol btab yan lag bdun pa/ rigs drug go sdom bzung rnams bya/ mdun bskyed gsal 'debs su bcug/slob ma rja bha lar bsgom pa la ye shes pa bstim/sngags kyi bzlas lung bya/ slob ma chu sbyin 'bul du gzhug de tsam gyis chog go /kun tu khungs che rab zab kyang / /rgyud 'dir yid dga' can kun gyis/ /ma thos dbul zhing 'phongs ba la/ /brtse bas nyid sto tsam zhig bris/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las byung ba ra la ljang khu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅gi/ /glu | swā sti/ dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag po la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal ci nusamachod/ /gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po yi/ /sgrub thabs bzlas lung mdo tsam bri/ /mdun du rin po che'i snod du gtor ma zhig bsham/ de la nor bu bzang po'i tsa ka li 'dzugs/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ phyag na rdo rje'i bdag bskyed dang / rang gi mdun du rnam thos sras skad cig gis bskyed/ tsa ka li bsangasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po sku mdog ser po rta sngon la chibs shing rgyug pa/ phyag g.yas nor bu 'bar ba dang g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po tshes brgyan pa/ snying gar zla ba la ma/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gnod sbyin 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dza dza : ba ho oṃ badzi a bhi khiñtsa hu zhes rdo rje'i phyag rgya bstan pas dam la bzhagacingadabang bskur/ ha sa ma sarba sa/ zhes pa ni brda'i dbang ste/ mi bskyod pa dang / 'jam pa'i rdo rje/rdo rje lcags kyu'i sa bon no/ /gtor ma rnam sras ljang khu seng zhon ltar byin gyis brlabs/ snying po la a 254—

kā ro bsas te 'bul/ ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ nor bu'i rigs kyi gsang sngags ni/kun gyi bdag por dbang bskur ba/ /lha rnams kun gyi'ang nor gyi bdag/nor bu bzang po khyod la bstod / 'tho don gsol bto spyi dang mas/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/rdorje 'dzin pa zhes sogs gsol btab dang / gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma nyid rnam thos sras su skad cig gis bskyed/ slob dpon phyag rdor du gsal bas/ gtor ma slob ma'i lag tu sprad la bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ mtha' bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin te rjes kyi bya ba thams cad spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bram ze mig ser las brgyud cing / /bha ro tsa ku ni zhes dang / /dzā ma pā las kun grub pa/ /rab dga'i rigs gto snyib sto tsam/ /'di'i bsnyen grub ni yig rnying las shes par bya'o/ /nor spyin nor bu bzang po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /tseXlte swā sti/ rab zab sgrub thabs rnyed dka' ba/ /gang gi rtog pa las bsdusanas/ /bla ma'i zhal gyi man ngag bzhin/ /rjes gnang bcas pa cung zad brjod/ /mchod gtor gtsang sbra can bshams la/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi bdag bskyed dang / rnam thos sras ser chen lta bu rnam thos sras gang rigs kyi mdun bskyed sngon du song nas/ de'i mdun du bka' nyan gyi tshul du bskyed par bya ba yin te/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma'i gdan la k+ṣa yig gudagum gzhon nu'i mdog can las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ sras gar mkhan mchog sku mdog dmar ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum khro zhing bzhad la skra gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag bcu drug gog yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma ral gri zhags pa mda' bo che dgra sta rnams dang / g.yon pa brgyad kyis dril bu rtse gsum ne'u le me tog gi phur ma ba dan thod pa gzhu rnga —255—

yab rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing / stag lpagasadang / dar gyi na bza' dang / sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrug pa/ de'i g.yas su tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug ga sku ni du dbang phyug dang lusang na/ phyogs bzhir gnod sbyin gter bdag pho bzhi/mtshams bzhir mo bzhi dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ tshe shesaspyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las/ spyan 'dren gyi tshe/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya bca' ste/ gung mo zlum por bkug pa la mdzub mo dkris/ sor mo lhag ma rnams so sor gshibs te rtse sbyar ba las mthe bong dang mthe'u chung steng 'og tu bskyod pa'o/ /de nyid g.yab cing / oṃ ṭak+ki ku pa raswāhā/ zhes spyan drangs/ sor mo gzhan rnams bsnol/ gung mo bsgreng ba spyi bor bzhug ste/ oṃ tsi ti tsiti bi tsi ti ther+sha ra huX huX zhes dam la bzhag ste las la bskul/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni rnam sras gar mkhan mchog dang 'dra ba zhig lag len la mdzad na/ de yang bya mod kyi/na mo rat+na dra yā ya/ na mo be+e shra ma ṇa ya/ na ṭa ku pa ra phye/ gu hra kā/ na rta pa ti/ma bha ra ta yi rtsiX/ a nu dū pa su hwa pa na ṭa ku pa ra/ tsan+d+ra khaX/ na tsa kaX/ he mahā skaX/ na ḍa ku pa ra/ he ma kaX ku ha kaX tsa la tsa la/ pa tsa pa tsa/ phu lu phu lu ku pa ra/ zhes rgyud las 'byung ba'ang bzla'o/ /gtor chog kyang rnam sras dang 'dra ba las/ na mo na ḍa ku pa ra/ bi dza ya/ pra bhā ra/ ku pa ra ya/ i daX bā li ta sogs sbyar bas phul/ gshogasagasol gyi sngags ni/ na mo be+e shra wa ṇa su ta ya/ na ḍa ku pa ra ya/ oṃ pa ra pa ra/na spyo na sna/ gasnro swa bhā wan/ ya thā su/ a twaX ya skye n+t+ra swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang 'dra'o/ /ngal gsos po yi sras kun gyi/ /mchog gyur yin zhes dga' bar bsngags/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs ches dkon pa'i/ /yi ge'i snying po spel 'di —256—

mtshar/ /sras gar mkhan mchog gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ /༄༅༅/ /glu ste swā sti/ dpal ldan rgyal po rnam thos bu/ /de sras bcas la btud byasanas/ /gzungs las 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs zhig/shin tu rnyed par dka' phyir bshad/ /rgyal po ser chen gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs sam/ gan rkyang gi sgrub thabs bzhin nyams su blangs nas/ gtso bo / re mdun du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la k+ṣa yig ser po las gnod spyin rgyal ba khyu mchog sku mdog gser btso ma lhar rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis nor bus gang ba'i sgrom bu 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bus mtshan pa'i be con dang ne'u le bsnams pa/ gzhon nu'i lus can dar dang rin po tshes brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba khyu mchog gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa ā kar+ṣa ya dzan mo be+e shra ba ṇa ya/ mahā dha na dā ya/ tsaṇ+ḍa shwa rā ya/ ā kar+ṣa ya/ a pa ra bi ta tsaṇ+ḍa shwa ra/ pa ra ma kā ru ṇi kā sarba satwa/ hi ta tsin+ta/ ma ma dha na wa ra do pa rkye shaswa ya ma ā kar+ṣa ya swāhā/ zhes spyan drangs/ bgegs bskrad/ dbang bskur dbu brgyan/ mchogasarnams rnam sras dang 'dra/ rgyal po'i sras ni 'phrul che ba/ /nor gyi bdag po mthu boche/ /rgyal ba khyu mchog 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes bstod/ na mo be+e shra wa ṇa ya/ ta bya thā/ si mi si mi/ su mu su mu/ tsaṇ+ḍatsaṇ+ḍa/ tsa ra tsa ra/ sa ra sar/ ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ki li ki li/ ku ru ku sma ༵ wa / ḍi ༵ swahā /ru sedha rdo sna~Xswahā// smri gh+ri hūm̐ kau ri/ rdzu sngu hā rte snya/ shā/saba~X/—257—

gtor ma ni rnam thos sras la phul ba'i rjes su/ oṃ dzin rga bha sa pa ri lda ra idaX sogs kyisa'abul/ bsnyen pa song nas sbyin bsreg la 'bad na dngos grub stsol bar bshad/ 'di la rjes gnang med bzlas lung tsam mdzad do/ /rgya nag lugs kyi rnam sras sa /grags pa'ang 'di dang rjes sumathun/ /kun tu btsal yang rnyed dka' ste/ /dga' bas snying sto tsam zhig bsdus/ /gser 'od las byung ba rgyal ba khyu mchog go sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge legs 'phel/ /༄༅// /tshe swā sti/ rgyal ba ston pa la btud nas/ /rnam thos sras kyi btsun mor grags/ /lha mo dpal gyi sgrub thabs ni/ /shin tu rnyed par dka' phyir bshad/ /gtsang sbra can gyi mchod gtor rgya cher zug ma/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gter gyi bum pa dgu'i stengadu pad zla la seng ge'i gdan/ de'i steng tu shri yig yongs su gyur pa las/ lha mo dpal chen mo ljang khu/ sgeg cing bzhad la spyan gdangs pa/ dar dang rin po tshes brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas nor bus mtshan pa'i pad+ma dang / g.yon skyi skyabs na mdzad pa/ 'khor gnod sbyin ma mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /gnasagasum byin brlabs/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams spyi dang mthun pa las/ rigasabadag ni skyon rje skyod do/ /ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa mo/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting 'dzin las/ /sgrub la dngos grub stsol ba'i tshul/ /dpal gyi lha mo de la bstod/ /tshe ka ma la wa si ni/ ka ma le/ mahā la k+ṣi ma ra dzu me/ de hi de hi ba ra de swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzlas/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyisabarlabs nas/ oṃ shrī de swe sa pa ri wā ra khyoX la a kā ro btags pas 'bul/ mchod bstod/ 'don don gsol bto/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshogs gsol rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ /—258—

'di la bsgom lung 'bogs pa las gzhan pa'i rjes gnang mi dgos/ dpa 'bo chig sgrub kyi rgyud la brten par mngon zhing / jo bo'i man ngag bka' gdams pa rnams las brgyud pa'i gdams pa ngo mtshar can yin no/ /kun la ma grags rnyed dka' ba/ /thos pa nyung ba'i skyon yin te/ /sngags rgyud shes rnams yid dga'i gnas/ /snying nas yid ches gsal por bkod/ /lha mo dpal chen mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ /༄༅// /o swā sti/ dpal mo dbyig go char 'bebs ma/ /nor sgrub kun gyi rig sngags rgyal/ /de la bsnyad de phyag 'tshal nas/ /sgrub thabs gsal bar brjod par bya/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gter chen po'i sagazhi la rin po che sna tsho gis las grub pa'i khang bzang gi dbus su/ gser gyi bum pa nor bus gang ba'i khri la paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i steng du/ baX las rang nyid lha mo nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyisagayas mchog sbyin gyi mthil nas nor bu'i char 'bebs pa/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma rab tu rgyas pa dang rin po che'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing / sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa/ dar dang rin po tshes brgyan pa'o/ /mtha' skor du nor dpal mo la sogs pa gter gyi bdag mo'i tshogs thams cad dang / steng gi cha la sangs rgyas dang / byang chub semasadapa' tham bros cad bzhugs par gyur/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ gang/bskur rgyas btab rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las rigs bdag ni rin chen 'gyung ldan no/ /ar+ghaX nas/sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ gang sngon spyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas/ /tshe dang nor—259—

dang mthu'i dpal brnyes shing / /sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa'i/ /dpal mo nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal go /ces bstod/ oṃ bā su dha ri ni swāhā/ zhelosnying po ci nus dang / ji ltar rigs par nor rgyun ma'i gzungs 'don pa'am/ klog par bya'o/ mdun bskyed ni/ ba'i lci ba'i maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa byas la/ der me tog gi tsho pa bu bkod/ mchod gtor gtsang ma spyi dang ma lhun pa dang / khyad par me tog sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod bzhag mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed la/ mchod bstod bzlas pa rnams tshar ba'i rjes la/ snying po'i mthar/pu rje/ tisnro na ma btags pas lan brgya rtsa brgyad me tog phul la/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyisabarlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab/ yig brgya/bzod gsol/ gshogs gsol/ smon lam/ bkra shis rnams bya/ rjes gnang gi bya ba ni sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ gsung gi rjes gnang song ba'i skabs ga nor rgyun ma'i mdo bklags te/gzungs dngos gzhi la rjes zlos lan gnig byar gzhug go /sangs rgyas pa yi sngags rgyud la/ /nor sgrub kun gyi rtsa bar grags/ /zur bka'i sgrub thabs rab dga' ba/ /snyed rje'i sems kyis gsal stor bris/ /lha mo nor rgyun ma'i rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ /༄༅༅/ /tsho( snya sti/ gang la longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /dka' ba med par thob 'gyur pa/ /gnod sbyin mo'i rigs sngags mchog/shin du zab gyur mdo tsam bri/ /maṇ+ḍal khru gang ba la tsan+dan gyi chus phyir gru bzhir byugs/ dbus su zlum skor la thug par byugs/ tshe tog gi tshom bu bzhi bkod/ me tog dkar po'i phung po dang / shing pi tsu ra'i 'bras bu dgos par bshad kyang / ma rnyed na bil ba'i dod byas bdag bskyed khro bo gang rung zhig sngon du 'gro bas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su nor rgyun ma gser btso ma lta bu/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing / lang tsho phun —260—

sum tshogs pa/ phyag g.yas pi tsu ra'i 'bras bu sngo dmar bsnams pa/ g.yon 'bras kyi snyem 'dzin pa/ zin po che'i bum pa zhabs sprad cing / kha gnyis nas rin po che'i rgyun 'bab bzhin pa'i steng na mnyam par bzhengs pa/ sngags re re brjod cing / me tog re 'bul ba lan nyi shu rtsa gcig byas pas/ gdugs dkar po re re dbu thog tu byung bar bsam/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes lan bdun gsol ba bto/ sngags ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ gha ta dzhai bha sa rak+ṣa ṇi/ pha la ho rto bā su bha ri te/ shi wa ka ri sharnyi ku sa dza sna ku sa bha ya nā sa ni/ sarba duglubhasma bhasma rdzu bha rdza bha/ sta bha sta bha/ a mṛ te/ gi khyu/ we/ ku ru ku dra/ ma ma ka bye swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /gshegs gsol mi dgos/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di rgyun gyi nyams len yin la/bsnyen pa'i tshe/ sngags dang bcas te me tog ci nus su 'bul ba yin la/ 'bum phrag bzhi rim/ zla ba gsum gyi bsnyen pa rdzogs par bzhed do/ /'di'i rig gto ni/ rgyun gyi nyams len de nyid slob dpon gyis tshang bar byas pa'i rjes la/ slob mas yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ me tog dkar po bzhi bcu zhe gnyis las mi nyung ba slob dpon gyi phyag tu gto/ slob dpon gyi me tog de/ mdun bskyed la phul/ me tog re slob ma'i spyi bor sbungs/ slob ma 'di la dngos grub stsa'1 du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de ltar lan nyer gcig byas la/ sgrub thabasabashad pa nyid kyis don 'grub pa yin no/ /mdun bskyed mi dmigs par bzhag pa nyid kyis chog/rjesachog mi dgos so/ /nor rgyun sgrub thabs ches zab pa/ /kun la ma grags rab dga'i tog/'dzim lo'i man ngag snyid bho 'di/ /gsal bar bkod pa'ang rmad du byung / /dza ma ri'i lugs nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /—261—

༄༅shā/ glu ste swā sti/ gnod sbyin bdag po ngal gsos po'i/ /slas kyi gan mor rab gragasapa'i/ /gnyis las ba lang rdzi yi ni/ /sgrub thabs snying po bri bar bya/ /rang yi dam du gsal ba'i smin mtshams nas 'od 'phros/ lcang lo can nas nor rgyun ma badz+ra sa mā dzamadun du 'khod pa ni/ sku mdog ser mo sgeg cing mdzes pa/ phyag g.yas pa pi tsu ra'i 'bras bu dang / g.yon pas rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa/ gter gyi bum pa zhabs sprad pa/ zin po che'i myong 'bebs pa'i steng na mnyam par bzhengs pa/byang chub kyi shing la rgyab bsten pa/ 'dod 'jo'i ba mo'i khyus bskor ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams nor rgyun ma rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs bzhin byas/ oṃ dzo dhi ka tha ma no ha ra sa rnga bha na panarasnre/ hū dzu hu hū swāhā/ zhes bzla/ mthar gshegs su gsol/ 'di la maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu bshams nagaslob dpon nyid kyis gong bzhin nyams su blangs nas/ slob ma la bsgom lung 'bogs pa ni/ slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi bya ba'o/ /glo bur dgos pa'i las kun la/ /rab tu dga' bar bsngags pa yi/ /nor rgyun bran mo'i sgrub thabs kyi/ /snying po 'di yang ngo mtshar che/ /ba lang rdzi'i nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅’/ /o swā sti/ dbang byed pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma/ /pho nya'i las byed gnod sbyin mo/ /de la brten nas de'i sgrub thabs/ /cung zad tsam zhig bri bar bya/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rke(nga pa'i ngang las rang nyid nor rgyun ma dmar mo dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'od dang bkrag mdangs 'bar ba/ lcags kyu dang ne'u le bsnams pa/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ oṃ ma no ha ra ha ra/ oṃ a du —262—

sha a du sha hri hri hri/ hu hū hū phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas/ mdun bskyed dang / mchodabastod byed tshul dang / slob ma la lung 'bogs tshul rnams ba lang rdzi'i nor rgyun ma'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /'di yang kun du zab po zhes/ /bsngags shing rab dga' las tshogs can/ /snying nas sgrub par 'dod na ni/ /yig rnying rnams la te por gzigs/ /yid 'phrog nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ /༄༅’/ /o swā sti/ thugs kyi rdo rje gsang ba'i bdag/phyag na rdo rje la btud nas/ /gnod spyin chen po zhang 'on gyi/ /phyi nang gsang gsum sgrub thabs4gad/ /bris sku'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams la/ phyag na rdorje'i khang bu brtsegs pa'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed bsangasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bsrung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i nang du/'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa de'i lte bar pad+ma nyi ma srin po pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la/ hu mthing nag las gnod spyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul phyag g.yas nor bu rin po che dang / g.yon gser gyi bum pa rin po tshes gang ba 'dzin pa/ sku mdog nag po khro zhing brjed pa/ spyan gsum/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'gril ba/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber gsol zhing / sag ti'i lham gyon pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang / gser gyi ske rags bcings pa/ mi mgo'i do shal dang bcas shing / rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan zhing / me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yon du smyo las yum rdo rje kun 'grub ma sku mdog sngon mo phyag g.yas pas zhal zas gtso la stobs cing / g.yon pas nad rkyal 'dzin pa/ dar dkar —263—

gyi na bza' dang / mgo bo'i do shal can/ skra dmar ser thur du 'gring ba'o/ /rtsibs bzhi la shar du nor lha dkar po dar dkar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan can/ g.yas nor bu dang / g.yon rin po che'i sgrom bu 'dzin pa/brkyang bskum gyi stabs kyis dri za pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ zhi ba'i nyams can no/ /lho ru mgon po nag po shin tu khros shing dar nag mtha' ljang can gsol ba/ sprul dang mi mgos brgyan pa/ g.yas tsan+dan gyi bing chen dang / g.yon lcags par 'dzin par brkyang bskum gyi stabs kyis gshin rje pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ nub tu 'brog gnas dmar po zhal lnga ste/dbus seng ge g.yas rta dang lug g.yon ra dang sprelā phyag drug dang po gnyis kyis rin po che'i sgrom bu 'dzin pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis gser gyi 'khor lo dang shing 'bras 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis 'bras dang sman sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/ dar dang zin po tshes brgyan pa/ brkyang bskum stabs kyis klu pho mo bsnol pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ byang du rnam sras ljang khu sku sbom zhing brdzid pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan dang bse'i khrab dang rmog zhu gsol ba/gser gyi rta lcags dang / sman sna nor bus gang ba'i gzhong ba bsnams pa/ rta ngang ser la chibs shing / gnod sbyin pho mo brdzis pa'o/ /gal te de dag sa bon snyobaskyed na/ dzaXhūX k+ṣaX bo zhes pa rnams las bskyed do/ /gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dbang bskur rgyas bto/ gtso bo la phyag na rdo rje dang / 'khor rnams la rdo rje rtse lnga pa res dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i spri gyis mchod/ dpal chen rdo rje bdud 'dul ni/ /gdug pa 'dul zhing bar chad sel/ khyod kyis 'phrin las kun —264—

sgrub pa/ /gnod sbyin 'khong dang bcas la bstod/ /de nas bzlas pa ni/ yi dam gyi sngags kyis cung zad thogs drangs nas/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na tsit+ta ra ga ra ge huX phaṭa/ gtso bo'i sngagasaso/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na tsit+ta ban+ta bdud ma ting skyol ting ting dza dzaX yum gyi'o/ /oṃ badz+rakro dha ur+ya dzaX bha la hri da ya swāhā/ oṃ mahā kā la ha na ha na badzin swāhā/ oṃ mahā yak+ṣa pañtsa de ba rā dza ya swāhā/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye swāhā/ zhes bzlas zhing / gtor cho go2spyidang sna par byin gyis brlabs la/ snying po'i mthar i daX bā ling ta kha kha ji hi khyahi/ mahāpañtsa a rlu ta ji hi/ mahā rak+ta ji hi/ sa ma ya swāhā/ zhe༅btags shing / 'khor rnamasala.i daX bā ling ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ gcig pu btags pas 'bul/ mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyi 'dod don zhu/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ 'di dkyus kyi nyams len ltar yin/ phyi sgrub kho na ltar na/ yum mi bskyed par gan 'khor lngas chog go /gan bo'i phyag g.yas kyi phyag mtshan nor bus mtshan pa'i be con byed pa'ang yod do/ /nang sgrub ni gzhan 'dra ba las/ 'khore bzhi mi bskyed par rdo rje bdud 'dul sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kha ṭāX rtse gsum dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gang bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas srin po pho mo mnan pa/ cha lugs gong dang 'dra/ yum yang snga ma bzhin bskyed de lcam dral gnyis su sgrub pa yin no/ /gsang sgrub ltar na/ sku mdog mthing nag/nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum mche ba gtsigasashing dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag drug g.yas gsum na rtse gsum/ dbyug pa ral gri/ g.yon gsum na thod pa zhags pa lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis dgra bgegs thams cad mnan pa/ rgyan cha lugs gong dang 'dra/phyogs bzhir/ k+ṣa las gnod sbyin bzhi ste/ g.yas su rnon po nag po dgra sta —265—

ral gri nad rkyal zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon du kun gyis 'jigs byed dmar ser dar nag ral gri nad rkyal zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu nyi ma mig dmar nag gri gug zhags pa nad rkyal thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mdun du yum rdo rje kun 'grub ma/ gong bzhi/ de rnams me lha/ srin po/ rlud lha/ dbang ldan rnamasabaskyel ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ gnod sbyin pho gsum myong yang phyag bzhi pa/thams cad kyang zhi ma khro sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /gnod spyin de gsum gyi rigs sngags ni rim pas/ oṃ badz+ra mahā yak+ṣa ya a ka tri skyol dza dzaX oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣatsakra dun dun dza dzaX oṃ mahā dzñā na nā ga rā dza ha ha rbad rbad sam ya dza dzaX zhesaso /rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ yi ge rnying ma rnams na/ rnying ma'i lugs kyi byin rlabs dbang gi tshul can 'dra min sna tshogs zhig 'dug na'ang / deng sang lag len gyi rgyun med la/ da ltar gsar ma dang ma lhun pa'i rjes gnang la phyag len mdzad de/ sgom don dang mas pa'i dkyil 'khor ram/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad tsam/ bsdu na tshom bus kyang rung ste/ steng du gtor ma rdo rje phyed pa'i rnam pa can bkod/ mtha' mchod gtod gyis bskor/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gtor chog yan song mtshams/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /dpal chen rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang dang / /byin gyis brlab pa stsal du gsol/ /zhesalan gsum gsol ba btab/ slob dpon phyag rdor dang / mdun bskyed gsad sbyin 'khor bcas gsal btab nas rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma gnod sbyin 'khor bcas su bskyed la/ gnas gsum byin gyisabarlabs/ lcang lo can nas 'khor bcas spyan drangs la bstim/ rol mo bya/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo / /bzlasalung byin rlabs kyi lung dang bcas pa spyi dang ma lhun par sgyin/ gsung gi rjes gnang ste/ de gnyis la phyi'i —266—
