rjes gnang zhes bya/ phyag mtshan bstim pa thugs kyi rjes gnang zhes bya/ gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag la/btso bsgo drag tu bya/ mthar/ hu mgon po rdo rje bdud 'dul ni/ /thugs rje'i stobasakyis gdug pa 'dul/ /gzhon nu dpa' bo khros pa'i sku/ khro bo'i rgyal pos dbang bskur ro/ /lha thams cad kyi gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phro las/ slob ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru/ gsum la thim/ lus thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyis gang bas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ gsang ba'i rjes gnang ngo / /snying ga'i 'od zer gyisasnod bcud bsdu ba'i da rigs pa phog ste/ de kho na nyid kyi rjes gnang ngo / /rjes kyi bya goghodang 'dra/ phyi sgrub nang sgrub gsang sgrub gsum so sor don du gnyer ba la de dang de :na zhing thams cad don du gnyer na/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs phyi nang gsang gsum gyi gtso bo rnams gsum sgrigs su bskyed/phyi sgrub kyi 'khor bzhi dkyus ltar dang / gsang sgrub kyi 'khor bzhi de'i phyi rim la 'god/ lhun mong du mchod gtor sogs phul nas/ slob ma'i bya ba'i skabs/ slob ma yang mdun bskyed bzhin du bskyed/bzlas lung gi skabs phyi sgrub lha lnga'i sngags song ba'i rjes la/ gsang sgrub kyi 'khor bzhi'i sngags sbrel nas bzlas lung byed/ maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu so sor 'god/ gtor ma gcig gis chog pas gtor dbang yang gcig gis chog go /gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi/ /sgrub thabs kun du dga' ba 'di/ /sgyid sto len pa la mos shing / /tshig tshogs gtsor mi byed la 'os/ /gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi sgrub thabasakyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /glu ste swā sti/ gnod sbyin nor gyi dbang phyug gi /thugs kyi rnam 'phrul las mkhan mchog/gzhan gyis mi thub sgrub thabs ni/ /rjes gnang dang 'brel mdo tsam bri/ /mdun du maṇ+ḍal dkar —267—

po pad+ma 'dab brgyad la tshom bu gcig bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gtsang mas bskor/ phyag na rdo rje'i bdag bskyed bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhaX las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang sgo gcig pa/ de'i dbus su paX las pad+ma a las zla ba la lhaXyig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ gnod spyin chen po gangs ri'i mdog can/ gzhon nu'i lus la sdang mig dmar ba/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu dang / g.yon gter gyi bum pa 'dzin pa/ dar dkar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i phyag rgya bcas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ ri rab kyi byang shar nas/ gnod sbyin gzhan gyi mi thub pa 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaX dbang bskur spyi dang mas pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ zwa/ dza a pa ra dzi ta dza dzaXzhes ci nus bzlas/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun pa las/ 'bru gsum mang du brjod/ gtor ma byin rlabs rnam sras ljang khu seng zhon gyi skabs bzhin bya/ snying po la bā li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi swāhā/ zhes btanas pa lan bdun gyis 'bul/ ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ dpal ldan rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /de'i bang mdzod lde mig 'dzin/ /nor bdag chen po rin chen sbyin/ /'byor pa spel byed khyod la bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs spyi dang 'dra/ /slob ma khrus byas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang / bla ma rje btsun bdag la dgongs su gsol bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ gnod spyin gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i dngos grub kyi rjes su gnang ba mdzad du gsol/zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma la dar dkar gyis gos bskon/ stong par sbyangs pa nasarigs bdag gi bar sgrub pa'i thabs ltar dmigs pa phog slob ma'i lag tu rin po che'i 'phreng ba gtad de/bzlas lung spyi dang ma lhun par sbyin/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag ste/ bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ slob ma de 'di'i —268—

bsnyen sgrub byed nges yin na/ dam tshig bsre zhing bro dgag pa'i phyag len kyang yod/ rjes kyi bya ba rnamasaspyi dang 'dra ba la/ slob mas dar dkar po'am ser po'i yon dbul bar bya'o/ /'di'i sgrub tshul ni/ rgyud dang man ngag rgyas pa rnams su shes par bya'o/ /rab zab stag lung thang pa yi/ /thugs dam lha drug nang na'ang bzhugs/ /kun du rgyas pa'i yig cha las/ /rab dgu'i snyid po mdo tsam bsdus/ /gnod sbyin a pa ra dzi ta'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅// /o swā sti/ 'jig rten mgon dang he ru ka /ra hu la dang mar me mdzad/ /bla ma yi dam la btud nas/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /tshogs bdag chags pa rdo rje sgrub par 'dod pas/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal dkar po zlum po/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyis mtshan pa/ stegs bu gru bzhi la tsan+dan dkar po dang / go nya bsres pas byugs/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bum pa dkar po nang rdzas can bsham/ mthar mchod gtor gyis bskor/ tsa ka li dang la du la phug sogs kyang bsham/ bdag bskyed spyan ras gzigs sam/ dgyis rdor gang rung bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang lasarang gi mdun du gaX dkar po las tshogs kyi bdag po rtsa zhal glang po che'i gdong pa can/ g.yas byi la'i gdong / g.yon spre'u'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas gsum la phug nor bu ral gri/ g.yon la du chang snod dgra sta 'dzin pa/ zhabs mdun ma gnyis bsnol zhing / rgyab ma gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs can/ gcer bu rin po che'i rgyan dang / pad+ma'i tshangs skud can/ 'og tu yum dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gcer bu rin po tshes brgyan pa/ smre tshun gdong can ut+pal sngon po'i tshangs skud can/ phyag gnyis kyis gtso bo'i zhabs gnyis brten zhing / zhal gyis gsang ba'i rdo rje 'jib pa/ zhabs gnyis bgrad —269—

pa/ pho nya dang phyag brnyen mo spre sgyu lus can gyis brten pa/ sku'i 'og dang g.yas g.yon du gter gyi bum pa can/ mtha' bskor du bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / rdzas brgyad dang / rgyal srid rin po che'i sna bdun gyis bskor ba/ thugs kar sngags 'phreng sa bon dang bcas pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX ltebar huX/ thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng sa bon las yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyun babs/ gsang ba nas brgyud/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud gsang ba nas babs/ bum pa gang / de las lud de gnas khang gang bar gyur/mchod pa rnams spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs te spyi dang mthun par 'bul/ shel gyi ri bo lta bu'i sku/ /'phongs sel 'byor ba kun gyi bdag /tshogs rje tshogs bdag bgegs kyi gtso/ 'thor bcas rnams la bstod pa 'bul/ /oX ga ga na pa ti ma ma rat+na sirnyi ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga/ga na pa ti swāhā/ zhes bzla/ gtor ma a mṛ tas ba4sa/ spyo bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhāX las gtor snod du gtor mabadud rtsir bskyed/ oṃ āXspruX gis byin gyis brla bos/ oṃ ga na pa ti bā li ta kha kha ji hi sku hi/ lan bdun gyis phul/ gong bawo mchod bstod dang / mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/slob ma'i bya ba ni/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa rnams byas la/ slob ma tshogs bdag tu bskyed/ sngags kyi bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ la phug lag pa g.yas pa dang / la du lag pa g.yon du gtad/ maṇ+ḍal spyi bor bzhag la bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /rgyun gtor tsam dang nyer 'brel ba'i/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas 'di/ /kun nas mkho ba'i yid dga'i gnas/ /yi ge byas pa'i snying sto yin/ /'jur 'thegs sel ba'i tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs kyi —270—

le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /eXsta sti/ 'jig rten dbang la gus btud nas/ /tshogs bdag dkar po sgrub pa'i thabs/ /jo po rje yi man ngag bzhin/ /mdo tsam bdag gis bri bar bya/ /bag phye la mar dang sposadang sbrang rtsi btab pa la/ la du'i tshul gyi ril bu mang du bsham/ snod gtsang ma gzhan zhig chu gtsang gi gsum gnyis tsam bkang / me tog la sogs pa mchod pa spyi mthun du bsham zhing / rten yod na bgram/yi dam kyi mngon rtogs sngon du song bas/ rang gi mdun du pad zla'i gdan la tshogasabadag dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas gnyis na la phug dang 'phreng ba can/ g.yon gnyis na ne'u le dang dgra sta 'dzin pa/ gsus pa 'phyang ba rin po che'i rgyan dang / stag lpags kyi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs gsol ba/ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ sna shal dmar ba g.yas brkyang gi rol pas bzhugs pa/ byi ba la gnas pa'am/ rgyab brten pa'o/ /ril bu rnams 'bru gsum gyisabyin gyis brlabs/ tseX( āXhūX/ zhes mtheb srin g.yas pas ril bu rnams rim pas chu nang du bskyur bas rna shal gyis blangs shing gsol bar bsams la/ nyer gcig sogs gang nus su phul/ de nasabazlas pa ni/ glu( ༷ ga ṇa pa ti swāhā/ zhes dang / skye( bha ra ka ta ye swāhā/ zhes pa dab tseXrtsowa ka te daXniX na da hūX phaṭa/ zhes pa rnams gang rung ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ bhuX gaṇa pa ti rat+na sirnyi swāhā/ zhes pa'ang cung zad bzla'o/ /mthar ar+ghaX nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/lha yi rgyal po lha min 'joms/ /mtha' dag bgegs la dbang bsgyur ba/ / gangs ri'i mdog ltar rab tu dkar/ /tshogs rje gzi brjid 'bar la bstod/ / bdag gi mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i yon bdag mdzod cig/ces drag tu go.a—271 —

ba btab/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang / med na mi dmigs par sbyangs/ lung 'bogs tshul ni/ rjesaganang spyi dang 'dra bar byed pa'ang yod la/ yang slob ma'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnams bshams/ gsol btab yan chad tshar ba'i rjes la/ slob ma la bsgom lung phog nas/ sngags la rjes zlos byed pa nyid yin no/ khyung po rnal 'byor gyi zhal nas/ mi yi yon bdag ngo bsrung dka'/ /lha yi yon bdag bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhe༅dge bshes dkon mchog mkhar la gnang / de nas phag gru las brgyud pa'i gsung bsgrosalas 'byung ngo / /dka' tshegs chung zhing kun nas zab/ /gong ma'i phyag lan brgyud bcas 'di/ /dga' bar mthong nas 'bad de zhus/ /snying po tsam zhig yi ge byas/ /tshogs bdag jo bo lugs bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //༄༅༅/ /skye( snya sti/ gsang bdag la sogs ye shes kyi/ khro bo kun la btud byasanas/ /tshogs kyi bdag po sgrub thabs ni/ /mdo tsam rab tu bshad par bya/ /bde mchog gam phyag na rdo rje'i bdag bskyed sngon du song nas/ bris sku'i mdun du dam rdzas rnams tshogs par bya/ mdun bskyed ba4sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhuX las gzhal med khang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i gdan dang bcas pa/ lte bar gaX las tshogs bdag dmar po/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas la phug dang dgra sta/ g.yon la du dang 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ byi ba sngon po la chibs shing / gter gyi bum pa la zhabs brten pa/ thugs kar gaX /rtsibs brgyad la rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa re re/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ri rab kyi rtse mo nas tsho gis bdag badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXskyoX baX hoX oṃ ga na pa ti sam ya stuX/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag a mṛ tas phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ rat+na rat+na ra sno ra sno/ ga ṇa pa ti/ ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga/ga na pa ti/ tsu ru tsu sa ma nu pa —272—

tra/ ru ru ru sa ga ga ta ya/ ga ṇa pa ti ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas/ gtor ma cwamachod pa spyi dang ma lhun par byin gyis brlabs/ snying po'i mthar a kā ro btags pas gtor ma phul/mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab sogs tshogs bdag gzhan dang mthun no/ /'di ni dpal chen rga lo nas brgyud pa ste/ sku mdog dkar po byas kyang rung / gtso bor dbang golas kyi kha dog tu bya'o/ /'di bsgom lung kho nas 'grub bo/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i rgyud chung las/ /kun du gsal bar bstan pa yi/ /rab dga' sgrub thabs snyid po 'di/ /phag gru'i gsung dang ma lhun par 'dod/ /tshogs bdag dmar po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅/ /sog ma med kyi sgrub thabs go /༄༅// /oṃ snyu sti/ 'jig rten mgon po sangs rgyas dang / /phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs pad la/ /btud nas sog ma med ces pa/ /sngags bdag sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /phyag na rdo rje'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ dkar gtor dang mchod pa spun ma/ rang gi mdun du pad zla la phu yig las/ klu rgyal sog ma med gser mdog sprul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing lte ba man chad sbrul 'ju ga tu 'khyi/la ba/ bu dang chung ma la sogs pa'i gnyen 'dun dang 'khor g.yog drug khri dang bcas pa bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ byang phyogs nas sdo ho dzī rno // sna~X ༵ ༵ kau/dī ༵ shā tsho rje bzha / rngo ༵ ḍi/ rdo / dro ts+tsha byeda~Xr+sha—273—

rgya bstan la/ tseX( hi li / hi li mahā hi li phruX phu swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ tso( phuX':'aX : ta phuta mahā kro dha hūṃ sirnyi sirnyi h+pho ṭa ya huX phaṭa swāhā zhes ci nus su bzlas/ mthar klu dbang rgyawapo'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas sngags kyi mthar/ i daX bā li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ zhes gtso bo dang / tsho( bhak+ṣa ya/ bhak+ṣa ya/ sa mā ya nga / dzuX phruX phu spyiXswāhā/ zhes pas 'khor la 'bul/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ klu yi rgyal po sog ma med/ /sangs rgyas stong gi 'phrin las pa/ /gzhon nu gtum po sprul mgo can/ /sngags bdag sku la phyag 'tshal/ bstod/ /'dod don gsol ba btab la/ oṃ muXzhes spyan drangs pa rang gnas su gshegs/ bskyed gzhi mi dmigs par sbyangs/ bris sku yod na rab gnas bya'o/ /'dil rig gtad byed pa'i lag len yod par gda' na'ang / sgom lung thob pa tsam gyisachog go /kun la sog ma med ces grags/ /'ga' zhig tu ni sngags bdag ces/ /rab tu dga' bsamatshan gsol ba'i/ /sgrub thabs snyib bho tsam 'di yin/ /jo po rje las brgyud pa/ bka' gdams pa'i man ngag klu rgyal sog ma med kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅1/ /dbyug gu ma sbun gsum gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ /༄༅’/ /oṃ snya sti/ 'jig rten mgon la rab btud nas/ kha na ma thodang bral ba'i/ /longs spyod phun tshogs sgrub pa'i thabs/ /cung zad tsam zhig bri bar bya/ /snod gtsang mar dkar gtor gsum dang / chang bu gsum spun ma/ rang sems skad cig gis mdun du gnod sbyin mo kun+da li sku mdog mthing kha/ spyan rtsa dmar ba/ phyag gnyis kyi bar na rin po che bsnams pa'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod du oṃ —274—

āXhūṃ zhu ba las gtor mar gyur/ oṃ āXhuX/ lan gsum/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar me tog mañdzu sha ka kha bye ba'i ster du/ dbus su nor ster ma sngon mo/g.yas su gos ster ma dkar mo/ g.yon du zas steng ma dmar mo/ gsum ka'ang phyag g.yas nor bu dang / g.yon pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa dar dkar gyi stod g.yogs dang / sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' can/rin po che'i brgyan pa/ rol pas bzhugs shing 'a 6 5 pas bdag la gzigs pa/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ de las 'od 'phros/ dbyug gu ma sbun gsum badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ bzlas sku mi/oṃ a na le kuṇ+ḍa le mahā pi sha tsi ni ye swāhā/ oṃ gros mahā bhaṇ+ḍa pi sha tsi ni ye swāhā/oṃ shu dra mu khe mahā pi sha tsi ni ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas la/ dkar gtor gas lorabagi snying po lan gsum gyis phul/ skyoX mkha' 'gro chen mo khyed gsum la/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di phul bas/ /bdag la nor gos zas gsum gyis/ /mi 'phongs 'byor ba de nyid kyang / /chos kyi grogs su 'gro bar mdzod/ /bdag la skal pa med mod kyang / /log 'tsho med pa'i 'tsho ba stsol/ /zhes brjod la stong 4 dor/oṃbu thog mtha' gnyis la rang sngags dang / bar pa la/ glu( mi li gi pi li gi swāhā/ zhes pa lan bdun bdun gyis sngags grub pa'i tshe 'bul lo/ /zhes brda' gtor du bya/ de ltar rab zhag gsum 'bring brgyad/ tha ma nyer gcig gis 'grub bo/ /denas yig rnying las bshad pa ltar gyi/ byib kha sprad kyi rten bcas/ gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra ba la/ ta du thā/ skye( tsa tshe u tshe ni du kha / na swāhā/ zhesabazhi brgya tsam du bzla bar bshad do/ /dam tshig tshul khrims dang / gtsang sbra la dzinas shing / byi ba la mi sdang bar bya'o/ /'di lung tsam gyis 'grub cing / 'di'i brgyud yig 'ga' zhig na/ rdo rje gdan pa brgyud —275—

par byas pa'ang 'dug mod kyi/jo bo rje nas/bka' gdams pa las brgyud pa kho na yin par shes par bya'o//deng sang kun la ma grags pa'i//sgrub thabs rab tu dga' ba 'di//tshul ldan rnams kyi snying nor yin//rgyun gyi lag len gsal por bkod//dbyug yim skrun gsum gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no////dar rgyas 'phel//༄༅/khol po kun li sgrub thabs so//༄༅༅//glu( swasti/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang la//dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal nas//tsho gos kyi bdag po'i khol po ni//kun+ta li yi sgrub thabs bshad//ras la glang po che dkar po rin po che'i rgyan dang /sna thag can rin po che'i snod bkal ba zhig bris la mdun du dgram/'bras dang dkar gsum sogs bza' ba gtsang ma'i sbungs gtor bsham/bdag bskyed khro bo gang rigs dang /mdun du tshogs bdag dkar po skad cig gis bskyed nas/de'i mdun du thad ka skad cig gis gnod spyin kun+ta li dkar po g.yas lcags kyu dang /g.yon glang po che'i sna nas 'khrid pa/thun mtshams re la stong gsum bskor bar nus pa mdun du bzhugs par gyur/tso( pi sha tsi ku khyu/ li i da bā ling ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/zhesalan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod cing /gtor ma nas phud gtor bya/spos dkar dang tsas la sogs pa'i bdug pas bdug bdag dang tshogs bdag la nor bu dang 'bru'i mchod pa 'bul zhing /stong gsum bskor bar bsnyo/oṃ pi sha tsi kun+ta li mahā bzhi shwa ra/dhi ri dhi ri/phob phob/sirnyi skyo swāhā/zhes nyer gcig las mi nyung bar bzla'o//lha yon bdag tu sgrub pa zhes bya ste/'tsho ba tshegasamed par 'grub bo//'di la lung ma gtogs rjes gnang mi dgos/'di las gzhan pa'i man ngag kung 276

med do/ /'di yang jo bo rje nas brgyud pa bka' gdams pa'i gdams pa'o/ /kun la grags pa mi che yang / /tshul khrims ldan pa rab tu dga'/ /mi rnams snyid ni mgu dka' bas/ /lha sgrub pa la brtson stor bya/ khol ngo kun+ta li'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ sgrub thabs zin chen 'byung gnasalas/ nor lha'i sgrub thabs zugad pa'i skabs te/ bco brgyad pa'o// //zhu dag/'dir 'bad rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba yis/ /bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dbyer ma mchis/ /rtag tu zhal mthong gsung gi bdud rtsi la/ /brten nas mchog gi go 'phang myur thob shog/shu ste/ ma ṅga la// //
